html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>🐦 Bird Fly - Flappy Adventure</title>
<style>
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

body {
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #000;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    height: 100vh;
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
}

canvas {
    display: block;
    max-width: 100vw;
    max-height: 100vh;
    cursor: pointer;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

// Game dimensions
const W = 400;
const H = 600;
canvas.width = W;
canvas.height = H;

// Game state
let gameState = 'menu'; // menu, playing, gameover
let score = 0;
let bestScore = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('birdFlyBest')) || 0;
let frameCount = 0;
let groundOffset = 0;

// Bird
const bird = {
    x: 80,
    y: H / 2,
    w: 34,
    h: 26,
    velocity: 0,
    gravity: 0.45,
    jumpForce: -7.5,
    rotation: 0,
    flapFrame: 0,
    flapSpeed: 0,
    trail: []
};

// Pipes
let pipes = [];
const pipeWidth = 58;
const pipeGap = 150;
const pipeSpeed = 2.5;
let pipeTimer = 0;
const pipeInterval = 90;

// Particles
let particles = [];

// Clouds
let clouds = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    clouds.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: Math.random() * H * 0.4 + 20,
        w: Math.random() * 80 + 50,
        speed: Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.1,
        opacity: Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.2
    });
}

// Stars (for background)
let stars = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    stars.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: Math.random() * H * 0.5,
        size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
        twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
}

// Floating decorations
let decorations = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    decorations.push({
        x: Math.random() * W,
        y: Math.random() * H * 0.6 + 50,
        type: Math.floor(Math.random() * 3),
        speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
        size: Math.random() * 10 + 8
    });
}

function resetGame() {
    bird.y = H / 2;
    bird.velocity = 0;
    bird.rotation = 0;
    bird.trail = [];
    pipes = [];
    particles = [];
    pipeTimer = 0;
    score = 0;
    frameCount = 0;
}

function flap() {
    if (gameState === 'menu') {
        gameState = 'playing';
        resetGame();
        bird.velocity = bird.jumpForce;
        bird.flapSpeed = 15;
    } else if (gameState === 'playing') {
        bird.velocity = bird.jumpForce;
        bird.flapSpeed = 15;
        // Add flap particles
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            particles.push({
                x: bird.x,
                y: bird.y + bird.h / 2,
                vx: -Math.random() * 2 - 1,
                vy: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
                life: 1,
                decay: Math.random() * 0.03 + 0.02,
                size: Math.random() * 4 + 2,
                color: `hsl(${40 + Math.random() * 20}, 100%, ${70 + Math.random() * 20}%)`
            });
        }
    } else if (gameState === 'gameover') {
        if (frameCount > 30) {
            gameState = 'menu';
        }
    }
}

// Input handlers
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') {
        e.preventDefault();
        flap();
    }
});

canvas.addEventListener('click', flap);
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    flap();
});

function spawnPipe() {
    const minY = 80;
    const maxY = H - 160 - pipeGap;
    const topHeight = Math.random() * (maxY - minY) + minY;
    pipes.push({
        x: W + 10,
        topHeight: topHeight,
        scored: false,
        color: Math.random() * 30 + 100 // hue variation
    });
}

function update() {
    frameCount++;

    // Update clouds
    clouds.forEach(c => {
        c.x -= c.speed;
        if (c.x + c.w < 0) {
            c.x = W + c.w;
            c.y = Math.random() * H * 0.4 + 20;
        }
    });

    // Update decorations
    decorations.forEach(d => {
        d.x -= d.speed;
        if (d.x + d.size < 0) {
            d.x = W + d.size;
            d.y = Math.random() * H * 0.6 + 50;
        }
    });

    if (gameState === 'menu') {
        // Bird bobbing
        bird.y = H / 2 + Math.sin(frameCount * 0.05) * 20;
        bird.rotation = 0;
        groundOffset = (groundOffset + 1) % 24;
        return;
    }

    if (gameState === 'gameover') {
        // Bird falls
        bird.velocity += bird.gravity;
        bird.y += bird.velocity;
        bird.rotation = Math.min(bird.rotation + 0.08, Math.PI / 2);
        if (bird.y > H - 50) {
            bird.y = H - 50;
            bird.velocity = 0;
        }
        return;
    }

    // Playing state
    // Bird physics
    bird.velocity += bird.gravity;
    bird.y += bird.velocity;

    // Bird rotation
    if (bird.velocity < 0) {
        bird.rotation = Math.max(bird.rotation - 0.12, -0.5);
    } else {
        bird.rotation = Math.min(bird.rotation + 0.04, Math.PI / 2);
    }

    // Flap animation
    if (bird.flapSpeed > 0) bird.flapSpeed--;

    // Trail
    if (frameCount % 2 === 0) {
        bird.trail.push({ x: bird.x, y: bird.y + bird.h / 2, life: 1 });
    }
    bird.trail = bird.trail.filter(t => {
        t.life -= 0.04;
        t.x -= pipeSpeed;
        return t.life > 0;
    });

    // Ground scroll
    groundOffset = (groundOffset + pipeSpeed) % 24;

    // Pipe spawning
    pipeTimer++;
    if (pipeTimer >= pipeInterval) {
        spawnPipe();
        pipeTimer = 0;
    }

    // Update pipes
    pipes.forEach(pipe => {
        pipe.x -= pipeSpeed;

        // Score
        if (!pipe.scored && pipe.x + pipeWidth < bird.x) {
            pipe.scored = true;
            score++;
            // Score particles
            for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                const angle = (Math.PI * 2 / 8) * i;
                particles.push({
                    x: bird.x + bird.w / 2,
                    y: bird.y,
                    vx: Math.cos(angle) * 3,
                    vy: Math.sin(angle) * 3,
                    life: 1,
                    decay: 0.025,
                    size: 4,
                    color: `hsl(${50 + Math.random() * 30}, 100%, 60%)`
                });
            }
        }
    });

    // Remove off-screen pipes
    pipes = pipes.filter(p => p.x + pipeWidth > -10);

    // Collision detection
    const birdBox = {
        x: bird.x + 4,
        y: bird.y + 4,
        w: bird.w - 8,
        h: bird.h - 8
    };

    // Ground/ceiling collision
    if (bird.y + bird.h > H - 50 || bird.y < 0) {
        gameOver();
        return;
    }

    // Pipe collision
    for (const pipe of pipes) {
        // Top pipe
        if (birdBox.x + birdBox.w > pipe.x && birdBox.x < pipe.x + pipeWidth) {
            if (birdBox.y < pipe.topHeight || birdBox.y + birdBox.h > pipe.topHeight + pipeGap) {
                gameOver();
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    // Update particles
    particles = particles.filter(p => {
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;
        p.life -= p.decay;
        return p.life > 0;
    });
}

function gameOver() {
    gameState = 'gameover';
    frameCount = 0;
    if (score > bestScore) {
        bestScore = score;
        localStorage.setItem('birdFlyBest', bestScore);
    }
    // Explosion particles
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const speed = Math.random() * 4 + 1;
        particles.push({
            x: bird.x + bird.w / 2,
            y: bird.y + bird.h / 2,
            vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
            vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
            life: 1,
            decay: Math.random() * 0.02 + 0.01,
            size: Math.random() * 6 + 2,
            color: `hsl(${Math.random() * 60}, 100%, 50%)`
        });
    }
}

function drawSky() {
    const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H - 50);
    gradient.addColorStop(0, '#1a1a3e');
    gradient.addColorStop(0.3, '#2d2b55');
    gradient.addColorStop(0.6, '#4a3f6b');
    gradient.addColorStop(0.8, '#7b5ea7');
    gradient.addColorStop(1, '#c4788a');
    ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H - 50);

    // Stars
    stars.forEach(s => {
        s.twinkle += 0.03;
        const alpha = 0.3 + Math.sin(s.twinkle) * 0.3;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha})`;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    });

    // Moon
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 220, 0.9)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(320, 80, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 220, 0.15)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(320, 80, 50, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
}

function drawClouds() {
    clouds.forEach(c => {
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${c.opacity})`;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y, c.w / 2, c.w / 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(c.x - c.w * 0.2, c.y - c.w * 0.08, c.w / 3, c.w / 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(c.x + c.w * 0.2, c.y - c.w * 0.05, c.w / 3.5, c.w / 7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    });
}

function drawDecorations() {
    decorations.forEach(d => {
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.15;
        if (d.type === 0) {
            // Flower
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6b9d';
            for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                const angle = (Math.PI * 2 / 5) * i;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(d.x + Math.cos(angle) * d.size * 0.4, d.y + Math.sin(angle) * d.size * 0.4, d.size * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            }
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, d.size * 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        } else if (d.type === 1) {
            // Butterfly
            ctx.fillStyle = '#a78bfa';
            const wingFlap = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.1 + d.x) * 0.3;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.ellipse(d.x - d.size * 0.3, d.y, d.size * 0.4, d.size * 0.6 * (0.7 + wingFlap), -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.ellipse(d.x + d.size * 0.3, d.y, d.size * 0.4, d.size * 0.6 * (0.7 + wingFlap), 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        } else {
            // Leaf
            ctx.fillStyle = '#4ade80';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.ellipse(d.x, d.y, d.size, d.size * 0.5, 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    });
}

function drawGround() {
    // Ground base
    const groundY = H - 50;
    const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, groundY, 0, H);
    gradient.addColorStop(0, '#4a7c3f');
    gradient.addColorStop(0.1, '#3d6b34');
    gradient.addColorStop(0.3, '#5a4a2a');
    gradient.addColorStop(1, '#4a3a1a');
    ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
    ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, W, 50);

    // Grass blades
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5cb85c';
    for (let i = -groundOffset; i < W + 24; i += 24) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(i, groundY);
        ctx.lineTo(i + 6, groundY - 12);
        ctx.lineTo(i + 12, groundY);
        ctx.fill();

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(i + 12, groundY);
        ctx.lineTo(i + 18, groundY - 8);
        ctx.lineTo(i + 24, groundY);
        ctx.fill();
    }

    // Ground line
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2d5a27';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, groundY);
    ctx.lineTo(W, groundY);
    ctx.stroke();
}

function drawPipe(pipe) {
    const groundY = H - 50;
    const capHeight = 26;
    const capOverhang = 6;

    // Top pipe body
    const topGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(pipe.x, 0, pipe.x + pipeWidth, 0);
    topGrad.addColorStop(0, '#2d8a4e');
    topGrad.addColorStop(0.3, '#4ade80');
    topGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#4ade80');
    topGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2d8a4e');
    ctx.fillStyle = topGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(pipe.x, 0, pipeWidth, pipe.topHeight);

    // Top pipe cap
    const capGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(pipe.x - capOverhang, 0, pipe.x + pipeWidth + capOverhang, 0);
    capGrad.addColorStop(0, '#256b3a');
    capGrad.addColorStop(0.3, '#4ade80');
    capGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#4ade80');
    capGrad.addColorStop(1, '#256b3a');
    ctx.fillStyle = capGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(pipe.x - capOverhang, pipe.topHeight - capHeight, pipeWidth + capOverhang * 2, capHeight);

    // Top pipe border
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#1a5c30';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeRect(pipe.x, 0, pipeWidth, pipe.topHeight);
    ctx.strokeRect(pipe.x - capOverhang, pipe.topHeight - capHeight, pipeWidth + capOverhang * 2, capHeight);

    // Bottom pipe body
    const bottomY = pipe.topHeight + pipeGap;
    ctx.fillStyle = topGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(pipe.x, bottomY, pipeWidth, groundY - bottomY);

    // Bottom pipe cap
    ctx.fillStyle = capGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(pipe.x - capOverhang, bottomY, pipeWidth + capOverhang * 2, capHeight);

    // Bottom pipe border
    ctx.strokeRect(pipe.x, bottomY, pipeWidth, groundY - bottomY);
    ctx.strokeRect(pipe.x - capOverhang, bottomY, pipeWidth + capOverhang * 2, capHeight);

    // Highlight on pipes
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)';
    ctx.fillRect(pipe.x + 6, 0, 8, pipe.topHeight - capHeight);
    ctx.fillRect(pipe.x + 6, bottomY + capHeight, 8, groundY - bottomY - capHeight);
}

function drawBird() {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(bird.x + bird.w / 2, bird.y + bird.h / 2);
    ctx.rotate(bird.rotation);

    // Trail
    bird.trail.forEach(t => {
        ctx.globalAlpha = t.life * 0.3;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(t.x - bird.x - bird.w / 2, t.y - bird.y - bird.h / 2, 3 * t.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    });
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // Wing
    const wingFlap = bird.flapSpeed > 0 ? Math.sin(bird.flapSpeed * 0.5) * 0.5 : Math.sin(frameCount * 0.15) * 0.15;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8a020';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-2, -2 + wingFlap * 10, 12, 6, -0.2 + wingFlap, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Body
    const bodyGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, -2, 2, 0, 0, 16);
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ffe066');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#ffb830');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#e89020');
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, bird.w / 2, bird.h / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Body outline
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#c07010';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, bird.w / 2, bird.h / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Eye white
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(7, -5, 7, 7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Pupil
    ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(9, -5, 3.5, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Eye shine
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(10.5, -6.5, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Beak
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6b35';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(12, -1);
    ctx.lineTo(22, 2);
    ctx.lineTo(12, 5);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#cc4400';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Beak line
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#cc4400';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(12, 2);
    ctx.lineTo(21, 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Tail feathers
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e89020';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-14, -3);
    ctx.lineTo(-22, -8);
    ctx.lineTo(-20, -1);
    ctx.lineTo(-23, 3);
    ctx.lineTo(-14, 3);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#c07010';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticles() {
    particles.forEach(p => {
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
        ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    });
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawScore() {
    // Score with outline
    ctx.save();
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#222';
    ctx.strokeText(score, W / 2, 60);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillText(score, W / 2, 60);
    ctx.restore();
}

function drawMenu() {
    // Title
    ctx.save();
    const titleY = 160 + Math.sin(frameCount * 0.04) * 5;

    ctx.font = 'bold 52px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';

    // Title shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
    ctx.fillText('🐦 BIRD FLY', W / 2 + 3, titleY + 3);

    // Title gradient
    const titleGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(W / 2 - 120, titleY - 30, W / 2 + 120, titleY);
    titleGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ffd700');
    titleGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#ffaa00');
    titleGrad.addColorStop(1, '#ff6600');
    ctx.fillStyle = titleGrad;
    ctx.fillText('🐦 BIRD FLY', W / 2, titleY);

    ctx.strokeStyle = '#884400';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeText('🐦 BIRD FLY', W / 2, titleY);

    // Subtitle
    ctx.font = '20px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
    ctx.fillText('Tap, Click, or Press Space to Fly!', W / 2, titleY + 50);

    // Best score
    if (bestScore > 0) {
        ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
        ctx.fillText(`🏆 Best: ${bestScore}`, W / 2, titleY + 90);
    }

    // Animated arrow
    const arrowY = titleY + 130 + Math.sin(frameCount * 0.08) * 8;
    ctx.font = '30px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('👆', W / 2, arrowY);

    ctx.restore();
}

function drawGameOver() {
    // Overlay
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Panel
    const panelW = 280;
    const panelH = 220;
    const panelX = (W - panelW) / 2;
    const panelY = (H - panelH) / 2 - 30;

    // Panel shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
    roundRect(ctx, panelX + 4, panelY + 4, panelW, panelH, 16, true, false);

    // Panel background
    const panelGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(panelX, panelY, panelX, panelY + panelH);
    panelGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(40, 30, 60, 0.95)');
    panelGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(20, 15, 40, 0.95)');
    ctx.fillStyle = panelGrad;
    roundRect(ctx, panelX, panelY, panelW, panelH, 16, true, false);

    // Panel border
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    roundRect(ctx, panelX, panelY, panelW, panelH, 16, false, true);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';

    // Game Over text
    ctx.font = 'bold 36px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, panelY + 45);

    // Score
    ctx.font = '20px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ccc';
    ctx.fillText('Score', W / 2, panelY + 80);

    ctx.font = 'bold 44px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.fillText(score, W / 2, panelY + 120);

    // Best
    ctx.font = '18px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
    ctx.fillText(`Best: ${bestScore}`, W / 2, panelY + 150);

    // New best indicator
    if (score === bestScore && score > 0) {
        ctx.font = 'bold 16px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6b6b';
        ctx.fillText('🎉 NEW BEST! 🎉', W / 2, panelY + 175);
    }

    // Restart hint
    ctx.font = '16px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
    ctx.fillText('Tap to Restart', W / 2, panelY + panelH - 15);

    ctx.restore();
}

function roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r, fill, stroke) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
    if (fill) ctx.fill();
    if (stroke) ctx.stroke();
}

function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    drawSky();
    drawClouds();
    drawDecorations();

    // Draw pipes
    pipes.forEach(pipe => drawPipe(pipe));

    drawGround();
    drawParticles();
    drawBird();

    if (gameState === 'playing') {
        drawScore();
    } else if (gameState === 'menu') {
        drawMenu();
    } else if (gameState === 'gameover') {
        drawScore();
        drawGameOver();
    }
}

function gameLoop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

gameLoop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

  }
}

function dist(a, b) { return Math.sqrt((a.x - b.x) ** 2 + (a.y - b.y) ** 2); }

function updateMatch(dt) {
  if (matchPhase !== 'playing') return;

  matchSecond += dt * 60 * matchSpeed;
  if (matchSecond >= 60) {
    matchSecond = 0;
    matchMinute++;
  }

  if (matchMinute >= 45 && matchHalf === 1) {
    matchPhase = 'halftime';
    return;
  }
  if (matchMinute >= 90 && matchHalf === 2) {
    matchPhase = 'fulltime';
    return;
  }

  const homeTeam = matchData.home;
  const awayTeam = matchData.away;

  // Player control
  const controlledPlayer = getControlledPlayer();

  if (controlledPlayer) {
    let dx = 0, dy = 0;
    if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA']) dx -= 1;
    if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD']) dx += 1;
    if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW']) dy -= 1;
    if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['KeyS']) dy += 1;
    if (dx !== 0 || dy !== 0) {
      const len = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      dx /= len; dy /= len;
      controlledPlayer.x += dx * controlledPlayer.speed * 1.5;
      controlledPlayer.y += dy * controlledPlayer.speed * 1.5;
    }

    if (keys['Space'] && controlledPlayer.hasBall) {
      shootBall(controlledPlayer, 'home');
      keys['Space'] = false;
    }
    if (keys['KeyJ'] && controlledPlayer.hasBall) {
      passBall(controlledPlayer, 'home');
      keys['KeyJ'] = false;
    }
    if (keys['KeyK']) {
      sprint(controlledPlayer);
    }
  }

  // AI for home team (non-controlled)
  for (let p of homePlayers) {
    if (p === controlledPlayer) continue;
    updateAIMovement(p, 'home', homeTeam);
  }

  // AI for away team
  for (let p of awayPlayers) {
    updateAIMovement(p, 'away', awayTeam);
  }

  // Ball physics
  if (ball.owner) {
    ball.x = ball.owner.x + ball.owner.vx * 0.5;
    ball.y = ball.owner.y + ball.owner.vy * 0.5;
    ball.vx = 0;
    ball.vy = 0;
  } else {
    ball.x += ball.vx;
    ball.y += ball.vy;
    ball.vx *= BALL_FRICTION;
    ball.vy *= BALL_FRICTION;

    if (Math.abs(ball.vx) < 0.01) ball.vx = 0;
    if (Math.abs(ball.vy) < 0.01) ball.vy = 0;

    // Ball bounds
    if (ball.y < 10) { ball.y = 10; ball.vy *= -0.5; }
    if (ball.y > FIELD_H - 10) { ball.y = FIELD_H - 10; ball.vy *= -0.5; }

    // Goal check
    if (ball.x < 15 && ball.y > 300 - GOAL_H / 2 && ball.y < 300 + GOAL_H / 2) {
      scoreGoal('away');
      return;
    }
    if (ball.x > FIELD_W - 15 && ball.y > 300 - GOAL_H / 2 && ball.y < 300 + GOAL_H / 2) {
      scoreGoal('home');
      return;
    }

    if (ball.x < -10 || ball.x > FIELD_W + 10) {
      // Throw in - give to nearest player
      let nearest = null, minD = Infinity;
      for (let p of [...homePlayers, ...awayPlayers]) {
        const d = dist(p, ball);
        if (d < minD) { minD = d; nearest = p; }
      }
      if (nearest) { ball.owner = nearest; nearest.hasBall = true; }
      ball.vx = 0; ball.vy = 0;
    }
  }

  // Player-ball collision
  for (let p of [...homePlayers, ...awayPlayers]) {
    const d = dist(p, ball);
    if (d < PLAYER_R + BALL_R + 5) {
      if (!ball.owner || ball.owner !== p) {
        if (ball.owner) ball.owner.hasBall = false;
        ball.owner = p;
        p.hasBall = true;
      }
    }
  }

  // Player-player collision
  const allPlayers = [...homePlayers, ...awayPlayers];
  for (let i = 0; i < allPlayers.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < allPlayers.length; j++) {
      const d = dist(allPlayers[i], allPlayers[j]);
      if (d < PLAYER_R * 2) {
        const overlap = PLAYER_R * 2 - d;
        const dx = (allPlayers[j].x - allPlayers[i].x) / d;
        const dy = (allPlayers[j].y - allPlayers[i].y) / d;
        allPlayers[i].x -= dx * overlap * 0.5;
        allPlayers[i].y -= dy * overlap * 0.5;
        allPlayers[j].x += dx * overlap * 0.5;
        allPlayers[j].y += dy * overlap * 0.5;

        // Tackle
        if (allPlayers[i].hasBall && allPlayers[j].team !== allPlayers[i].team && Math.random() < 0.02) {
          allPlayers[i].hasBall = false;
          ball.owner = allPlayers[j];
          allPlayers[j].hasBall = true;
        }
        if (allPlayers[j].hasBall && allPlayers[i].team !== allPlayers[j].team && Math.random() < 0.02) {
          allPlayers[j].hasBall = false;
          ball.owner = allPlayers[i];
          allPlayers[i].hasBall = true;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Particles
  particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);
  for (let p of particles) {
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.life -= dt;
    p.vy += 0.1;
  }
}

function getControlledPlayer() {
  let nearest = null, minD = Infinity;
  for (let p of homePlayers) {
    const d = dist(p, ball);
    if (d < minD) { minD = d; nearest = p; }
  }
  return nearest;
}

function updateAIMovement(p, team, teamData) {
  const isAttacking = (team === 'home' && ball.x > 500) || (team === 'away' && ball.x < 500);
  const isDefending = !isAttacking;

  if (p.hasBall) {
    // Move toward opponent goal
    const goalX = team === 'home' ? FIELD_W - 20 : 20;
    const goalY = 300;
    const dx = goalX - p.x;
    const dy = goalY - p.y;
    const d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (d > 100) {
      p.x += (dx / d) * p.speed * 0.8;
      p.y += (dy / d) * p.speed * 0.8;
    }
    // Shoot if close
    if (d < 250 && Math.random() < 0.03) {
      shootBall(p, team);
    }
    // Pass
    if (Math.random() < 0.005) {
      passBall(p, team);
    }
  } else {
    if (isAttacking) {
      // Move toward ball
      const dx = ball.x - p.x;
      const dy = ball.y - p.y;
      const d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      if (d > 15) {
        p.x += (dx / d) * p.speed * 0.7;
        p.y += (dy / d) * p.speed * 0.7;
      }
    } else {
      // Defend - stay between ball and goal
      const goalX = team === 'home' ? 20 : FIELD_W - 20;
      const goalY = 300;
      const midX = (ball.x + goalX) / 2;
      const midY = (ball.y + goalY) / 2;
      const targetX = p.targetX + (midX - p.targetX) * 0.3;
      const targetY = p.targetY + (midY - p.targetY) * 0.3;
      const dx = targetX - p.x;
      const dy = targetY - p.y;
      const d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      if (d > 10) {
        p.x += (dx / d) * p.speed * 0.5;
        p.y += (dy / d) * p.speed * 0.5;
      }
    }
  }

  // Keep in bounds
  p.x = Math.max(15, Math.min(FIELD_W - 15, p.x));
  p.y = Math.max(15, Math.min(FIELD_H - 15, p.y));

  p.vx = 0;
  p.vy = 0;
}

function shootBall(player, team) {
  player.hasBall = false;
  ball.owner = null;
  const goalX = team === 'home' ? FIELD_W - 20 : 20;
  const goalY = 300 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * GOAL_H * 0.6;
  const dx = goalX - player.x;
  const dy = goalY - player.y;
  const d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
  ball.vx = (dx / d) * SHOOT_POWER * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.6);
  ball.vy = (dy / d) * SHOOT_POWER * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.6);
}

function passBall(player, team) {
  player.hasBall = false;
  ball.owner = null;
  let nearest = null, minD = Infinity;
  for (let p of team === 'home' ? homePlayers : awayPlayers) {
    if (p === player) continue;
    const d = dist(p, player);
    if (d < minD) { minD = d; nearest = p; }
  }
  if (nearest) {
    const dx = nearest.x - player.x;
    const dy = nearest.y - player.y;
    const d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    ball.vx = (dx / d) * 5;
    ball.vy = (dy / d) * 5;
  }
}

function sprint(player) {
  player.speed = PLAYER_SPEED * 1.5;
  player.stamina -= 0.5;
  if (player.stamina <= 0) player.stamina = 0;
}

function scoreGoal(team) {
  if (team === 'home') scoreBoard.home++;
  else scoreBoard.away++;

  lastGoalTeam = team;
  showGoalAnimation = true;
  goalAnimationTimer = 120;
  goalMinute = matchMinute;

  const scorer = team === 'home' ?
    homePlayers.filter(p => dist(p, ball) < 100)[0]?.name || 'Player' :
    awayPlayers.filter(p => dist(p, ball) < 100)[0]?.name || 'Player';
  goalScorer = scorer;

  // Celebration particles
  for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
    particles.push({
      x: team === 'home' ? FIELD_W - 50 : 50,
      y: 300,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
      life: 2,
      color: team === 'home' ? matchData.home.color : matchData.away.color,
      size: 3 + Math.random() * 4
    });
  }

  setTimeout(() => {
    resetPositions(team);
    showGoalAnimation = false;
  }, 2000);
}

// ============ LEAGUE SYSTEM ============
function initLeague() {
  leagueTable = [];
  const teams = selectedLeague === 'liga1' ? TEAMS.liga1 : TEAMS.international;
  teams.forEach((t, i) => {
    leagueTable.push({
      ...t,
      index: i,
      played: 0, won: 0, drawn: 0, lost: 0,
      gf: 0, ga: 0, gd: 0, points: 0
    });
  });
  generateFixtures();
}

let fixtures = [];
let fixtureIndex = 0;

function generateFixtures() {
  fixtures = [];
  const teams = selectedLeague === 'liga1' ? TEAMS.liga1 : TEAMS.international;
  for (let i = 0; i < teams.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < teams.length; j++) {
      fixtures.push({ home: i, away: j, played: false, homeScore: 0, awayScore: 0 });
      fixtures.push({ home: j, away: i, played: false, homeScore: 0, awayScore: 0 });
    }
  }
  // Shuffle
  for (let i = fixtures.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [fixtures[i], fixtures[j]] = [fixtures[j], fixtures[i]];
  }
  fixtureIndex = 0;
}

function playNextMatch() {
  if (fixtureIndex >= fixtures.length) {
    showLeagueTable = true;
    return;
  }

  const fix = fixtures[fixtureIndex];
  const homeTeam = selectedLeague === 'liga1' ? TEAMS.liga1[fix.home] : TEAMS.international[fix.home];
  const awayTeam = selectedLeague === 'liga1' ? TEAMS.liga1[fix.away] : TEAMS.international[fix.away];

  // Simulate
  const homeStr = homeTeam.strength;
  const awayStr = awayTeam.strength;
  const homeAdv = 5;
  const diff = homeStr - awayStr + homeAdv;

  let homeGoals = 0, awayGoals = 0;
  const totalGoals = Math.floor(Math.random() * 5);
  for (let i = 0; i < totalGoals; i++) {
    if (Math.random() * 100 < 50 + diff / 2) homeGoals++;
    else awayGoals++;
  }

  fix.homeScore = homeGoals;
  fix.awayScore = awayGoals;
  fix.played = true;

  // Update league table
  leagueTable[fix.home].played++;
  leagueTable[fix.home].gf += homeGoals;
  leagueTable[fix.home].ga += awayGoals;
  leagueTable[fix.home].gd = leagueTable[fix.home].gf - leagueTable[fix.home].ga;
  if (homeGoals > awayGoals) { leagueTable[fix.home].won++; leagueTable[fix.home].points += 3; }
  else if (homeGoals === awayGoals) { leagueTable[fix.home].drawn++; leagueTable[fix.home].points += 1; }
  else { leagueTable[fix.home].lost++; }

  leagueTable[fix.away].played++;
  leagueTable[fix.away].gf += awayGoals;
  leagueTable[fix.away].ga += homeGoals;
  leagueTable[fix.away].gd = leagueTable[fix.away].gf - leagueTable[fix.away].ga;
  if (awayGoals > homeGoals) { leagueTable[fix.away].won++; leagueTable[fix.away].points += 3; }
  else if (awayGoals === homeGoals) { leagueTable[fix.away].drawn++; leagueTable[fix.away].points += 1; }
  else { leagueTable[fix.away].lost++; }

  fixtureIndex++;

  // Show result
  matchResult = { home: homeTeam, away: awayTeam, homeScore, awayScore };
  gameState = 'matchResult';
}

function sortLeagueTable() {
  leagueTable.sort((a, b) => {
    if (b.points !== a.points) return b.points - a.points;
    if (b.gd !== a.gd) return b.gd - a.gd;
    return b.gf - a.gf;
  });
}

function drawMatch() {
  // Calculate field position on screen
  const scale = Math.min(canvas.width / (FIELD_W + 100), canvas.height / (FIELD_H + 100)) * 0.85;
  fieldOffsetX = (canvas.width - FIELD_W * scale) / 2;
  fieldOffsetY = (canvas.height - FIELD_H * scale) / 2;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(fieldOffsetX, fieldOffsetY);
  ctx.scale(scale, scale);

  // Draw field
  drawField();

  // Draw players
  const allPlayers = [...homePlayers, ...awayPlayers];
  const sortedPlayers = allPlayers.sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y);

  for (let p of sortedPlayers) {
    drawPlayer(p);
  }

  // Draw ball
  drawBall();

  // Draw particles
  for (let p of particles) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  ctx.restore();

  // Draw HUD
  drawMatchHUD();

  // Goal animation
  if (showGoalAnimation && goalAnimationTimer > 0) {
    drawGoalAnimation();
  }

  // Halftime / Fulltime overlay
  if (matchPhase === 'halftime') drawOverlay('HALF TIME', 'Tekan SPACE untuk lanjutkan');
  if (matchPhase === 'fulltime') {
    drawOverlay('FULL TIME', 'Tekan SPACE untuk lihat hasil');
  }
}

function drawField() {
  // Grass
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2e7d32';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, FIELD_W, FIELD_H);

  // Grass stripes
  for (let i = 0; i < FIELD_W; i += 80) {
    ctx.fillStyle = i % 160 === 0 ? '#388e3c' : '#2e7d32';
    ctx.fillRect(i, 0, 80, FIELD_H);
  }

  // Lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;

  // Border
  ctx.strokeRect(5, 5, FIELD_W - 10, FIELD_H - 10);

  // Center line
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(FIELD_W / 2, 5);
  ctx.lineTo(FIELD_W / 2, FIELD_H - 5);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Center circle
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(FIELD_W / 2, FIELD_H / 2, 60, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Center dot
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(FIELD_W / 2, FIELD_H / 2, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.fill();

  // Penalty areas
  ctx.strokeRect(5, FIELD_H / 2 - 120, 120, 240);
  ctx.strokeRect(FIELD_W - 125, FIELD_H / 2 - 120, 120, 240);

  // Goal areas
  ctx.strokeRect(5, FIELD_H / 2 - 60, 50, 120);
  ctx.strokeRect(FIELD_W - 55, FIELD_H / 2 - 60, 50, 120);

  // Penalty spots
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(110, FIELD_H / 2, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(FIELD_W - 110, FIELD_H / 2, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Penalty arcs
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(110, FIELD_H / 2, 60, -0.7, 0.7);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(FIELD_W - 110, FIELD_H / 2, 60, Math.PI - 0.7, Math.PI + 0.7);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Corner arcs
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(5, 5, 15, 0, Math.PI / 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(FIELD_W - 5, 5, 15, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(FIELD_W - 5, FIELD_H - 5, 15, Math.PI, Math.PI * 1.5);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(5, FIELD_H - 5, 15, Math.PI * 1.5, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Goals
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, FIELD_H / 2 - GOAL_H / 2, 8, GOAL_H);
  ctx.fillRect(FIELD_W - 8, FIELD_H / 2 - GOAL_H / 2, 8, GOAL_H);

  // Goal net pattern
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
  for (let y = FIELD_H / 2 - GOAL_H / 2; y < FIELD_H / 2 + GOAL_H / 2; y += 10) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(8, y);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(FIELD_W - 8, y);
    ctx.lineTo(FIELD_W, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawPlayer(p) {
  const isControlled = p === getControlledPlayer();

  // Shadow
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(p.x, p.y + 4, PLAYER_R, PLAYER_R * 0.4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
  ctx.fill();

  // Player body
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, PLAYER_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = isControlled ? '#ffd600' : p.color2;
  ctx.lineWidth = isControlled ? 3 : 1.5;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Player number
  ctx.fillStyle = p.color2;
  ctx.font = 'bold 9px "Segoe UI", Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(p.playerIndex + 1, p.x, p.y + 3);

  // Player name
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '8px "Segoe UI", Arial';
  ctx.fillText(p.name, p.x, p.y - PLAYER_R - 4);

  // Control indicator
  if (isControlled) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y - PLAYER_R - 12, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd600';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y - PLAYER_R - 18);
    ctx.lineTo(p.x - 5, p.y - PLAYER_R - 25);
    ctx.lineTo(p.x + 5, p.y - PLAYER_R - 25);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd600';
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Has ball indicator
  if (p.hasBall) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x + PLAYER_R - 2, p.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawBall() {
  // Shadow
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(ball.x + 2, ball.y + 3, BALL_R, BALL_R * 0.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
  ctx.fill();

  // Ball
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, BALL_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Ball pattern
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, BALL_R * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawGoalAnimation() {
  const alpha = Math.min(1, goalAnimationTimer / 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${alpha * 0.6})`;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;

  const scale = 1 + (120 - goalAnimationTimer) / 120 * 0.5;
  ctx.translate(canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
  ctx.scale(scale, scale);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd600';
  ctx.font = 'bold 72px "Segoe UI", Arial';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.shadowColor = '#ffd600';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 30;
  ctx.fillText('GOOOL!!!', 0, -20);

  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 28px "Segoe UI", Arial';
  ctx.fillText(`${goalScorer}`, 0, 30);

  ctx.font = '20px "Segoe UI", Arial';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
  ctx.fillText(`${goalMinute}'`, 0, 60);

  ctx.restore();
  goalAnimationTimer--;
}

// ============ INPUT HANDLING ============
function handleMenuInput() {
  if (mouse.clicked) {
    const menuItems = ['⚽ MAIN KOMPETISI', '📊 TABEL LIGA', '👥 PILIH TIM', '🏆 PENGHARGAAN', '⚙️ PENGATURAN'];
    const itemHeight = 55;
    const startY = canvas.height * 0.55;

    menuItems.forEach((item, i) => {
      const y = startY + i * itemHeight;
      if (mouse.y > y - 20 && mouse.y < y + 20 && mouse.x > canvas.width / 2 - 200 && mouse.x < canvas.width / 2 + 200) {
        menuSelection = i;
      }
    });

    if (mouse.y > startY - 20 && mouse.y < startY + itemHeight * 5 + 20) {
      switch (menuSelection) {
        case 0: gameState = 'teamSelect'; break;
        case 1: gameState = 'leagueTable'; break;
        case 2: gameState = 'teamSelect'; break;
        case 3: gameState = 'awards'; break;
        case 4: gameState = 'settings'; break;
      }
    }
  }

  if (keys['ArrowUp']) { menuSelection = (menuSelection - 1 + 5) % 5; keys['ArrowUp'] = false; }
  if (keys['ArrowDown']) { menuSelection = (menuSelection + 1) % 5; keys['ArrowDown'] = false; }
  if (keys['Enter'] || keys['Space']) {
    keys['Enter'] = false; keys['Space'] = false;
    switch (menuSelection) {
      case 0: gameState = 'teamSelect'; break;
      case 1: gameState = 'leagueTable'; break;
      case 2: gameState = 'teamSelect'; break;
      case 3: gameState = 'awards'; break;
      case 4: gameState = 'settings'; break;
    }
  }
}

function handleTeamSelectInput() {
  if (mouse.clicked) {

    teams.forEach((team, i) => {

      const row = Math.floor(i / cols);
      const x = startX - cardW / 2 + col * (cardW + 15);
      const y = startY2 + row * (cardH + 15);

      if (mouse.x > x && mouse.x < x + cardW && mouse.y > y && mouse.y < y + cardH) {
        selectedTeam = i;
      }
    });

    // League selector
    const btnW = 180, btnH = 35;
    const btnY = 100;
    const ligaBtnX = canvas.width / 2 - btnW - 10;
    const intlBtnX = canvas.width / 2 + 10;

    if (mouse.x > ligaBtnX && mouse.x < ligaBtnX + btnW && mouse.y > btnY && mouse.y < btnY + btnH) {
      selectedLeague = 'liga1';
      selectedTeam = 0;
    }
    if (mouse.x > intlBtnX && mouse.x < intlBtnX + btnW && mouse.y > btnY && mouse.y < btnY + btnH) {
      selectedLeague = 'international';
      selectedTeam = 0;
    }

    // Back button
    if (mouse.x > 20 && mouse.x < 140 && mouse.y > canvas.height - 50 && mouse.y < canvas.height - 15) {
      gameState = 'menu';
    }
  }

  if (keys['Escape']) { keys['Escape'] = false; gameState = 'menu'; }
}

function handleMatchInput() {
  if (keys['Escape']) { keys['Escape'] = false; gameState = 'menu'; }

  if (matchPhase === 'halftime') {
    if (keys['Space']) {
      keys['Space'] = false;
      matchHalf = 2;
      matchMinute = 45;
      matchSecond = 0;
      matchPhase = 'playing';
      // Reset stamina
      homePlayers.forEach(p => p.stamina = Math.min(100, p.stamina + 30));
      awayPlayers.forEach(p => p.stamina = Math.min(100, p.stamina + 30));
    }
  }

  if (matchPhase === 'fulltime') {
    if (keys['Space']) {
      keys['Space'] = false;
      gameState = 'matchResult';
    }
  }
}

function handleLeagueTableInput() {
  if (mouse.clicked) {
    const tableW = Math.min(900, canvas.width - 40);
    const tableX = canvas.width / 2 - tableW / 2;
    const tableY = 70;
    const rowH = 35;

    // Next match button
    const btnW = 220, btnH = 40;
    const btnX = canvas.width / 2 - btnW / 2;
    const btnY2 = tableY + rowH + leagueTable.length * rowH + 15 + 30;

    if (mouse.x > btnX && mouse.x < btnX + btnW && mouse.y > btnY2 && mouse.y < btnY2 + btnH) {
      playNextMatch();
    }

    // Back button
    if (mouse.x > 20 && mouse.x < 140 && mouse.y > canvas.height - 50 && mouse.y < canvas.height - 15) {
      gameState = 'menu';
    }
  }

  if (keys['Escape']) { keys['Escape'] = false; gameState = 'menu'; }
}

function handleMatchResultInput() {
  if (mouse.clicked) {
    const result = matchResult;
    if (!result) return;

    const sbW = 500, sbH = 120;
    const sbX = canvas.width / 2 - sbW / 2;
    const sbY = 90;
    const btnW = 200, btnH = 40;
    const btnY2 = sbY + sbH + 70;

    // Next match
    if (mouse.x > canvas.width / 2 - btnW - 10 && mouse.x < canvas.width / 2 - 10 && mouse.y > btnY2 && mouse.y < btnY2 + btnH) {
      playNextMatch();
    }

    // League table
    if (mouse.x > canvas.width / 2 + 10 && mouse.x < canvas.width / 2 + 10 + btnW && mouse.y > btnY2 && mouse.y < btnY2 + btnH) {
      gameState = 'leagueTable';
    }
  }

  if (keys['Space'] || keys['Enter']) {
    keys['Space'] = false; keys['Enter'] = false;
    playNextMatch();
  }
  if (keys['Escape']) { keys['Escape'] = false; gameState = 'menu'; }
}

function handleSettingsInput() {
  if (mouse.clicked) {
    const settings = [
      { y: 120, key: 'speed' },
      { y: 190, key: 'control' },
      { y: 260, key: 'music' },
      { y: 330, key: 'sfx' }
    ];

    settings.forEach(s => {
      if (mouse.x > canvas.width / 2 - 100 && mouse.x < canvas.width / 2 + 100 && mouse.y > s.y && mouse.y < s.y + 55) {
        if (s.key === 'speed') {
          matchSpeed = matchSpeed === 1 ? 2 : matchSpeed === 2 ? 3 : 1;
        }
      }
    });

    if (mouse.x > 20 && mouse.x < 140 && mouse.y > canvas.height - 50 && mouse.y < canvas.height - 15) {
      gameState = 'menu';
    }
  }

  if (keys['Escape']) { keys['Escape'] = false; gameState = 'menu'; }
}

// ============ MAIN LOOP ============
let lastTime = 0;
function gameLoop(timestamp) {
  const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
  lastTime = timestamp;

  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  switch (gameState) {
    case 'menu':
      drawMenu();
      handleMenuInput();
      break;
    case 'teamSelect':
      drawTeamSelect();
      handleTeamSelectInput();
      break;
    case 'match':
      updateMatch(dt);
      drawMatch();
      handleMatchInput();
      break;
    case 'leagueTable':
      drawLeagueTable();
      handleLeagueTableInput();
      break;
    case 'matchResult':
      drawMatchResult();
      handleMatchResultInput();
      break;
    case 'settings':
      drawSettings();
      handleSettingsInput();
      break;
    case 'awards':
      drawAwards();
      if (mouse.clicked) {
        if (mouse.x > 20 && mouse.x < 140 && mouse.y > canvas.height - 50 && mouse.y < canvas.height - 15) {
          gameState = 'menu';
        }
      }
      if (keys['Escape']) { keys['Escape'] = false; gameState = 'menu'; }
      break;
  }

  mouse.clicked = false;
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// ============ INIT ============
initLeague();
requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Echoes of Lumora: Whimsical Realms</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Quicksand:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Cinzel+Decorative:wght@400;700;900&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&display=swap');

* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

:root {
  --glow-pink: #ff6bca;
  --glow-blue: #6bc5ff;
  --glow-purple: #b46bfc;
  --glow-gold: #ffd700;
  --glow-green: #6bffc8;
  --glow-orange: #ff9f6b;
  --bg-deep: #0a0a1a;
  --bg-mid: #12122a;
}

body {
  background: var(--bg-deep);
  color: #fff;
  font-family: 'Quicksand', sans-serif;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  cursor: default;
}

/* Scrollbar */
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #1a1a3a; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: linear-gradient(var(--glow-pink), var(--glow-purple)); border-radius: 4px; }

/* Particle Canvas */
#particleCanvas {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0;
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Sections */
.section {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 40px 20px;
}

/* ===== MAIN MENU ===== */
#mainMenu {
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%, #1a1040 0%, #0a0a1a 70%);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.floating-orb {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  filter: blur(2px);
  animation: floatOrb 6s ease-in-out infinite;
  pointer-events: none;
}

@keyframes floatOrb {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); opacity: 0.7; }
  50% { transform: translateY(-30px) scale(1.2); opacity: 1; }
}

.title-container {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  position: relative;
}

.game-title {
  font-family: 'Cinzel Decorative', cursive;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
  font-weight: 900;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffd700, #ff6bca, #6bc5ff, #b46bfc, #ffd700);
  background-size: 300% 300%;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
  animation: gradientShift 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  text-shadow: none;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.5)) drop-shadow(0 0 40px rgba(255, 107, 202, 0.3));
  letter-spacing: 3px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.game-subtitle {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  font-style: italic;
  color: #c8a0ff;
  margin-top: 8px;
  text-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(200, 160, 255, 0.6);
  letter-spacing: 5px;
}

@keyframes gradientShift {
  0%, 100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
  50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
}

.title-sparkle {
  position: absolute;
  width: 6px; height: 6px;
  background: #fff;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: sparkle 2s ease-in-out infinite;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px #ffd700, 0 0 20px #ff6bca;
}

@keyframes sparkle {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0); }
  50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
}

.menu-buttons {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 15px;
  margin-top: 30px;
  z-index: 10;
}

.menu-btn {
  padding: 16px 50px;
  font-family: 'Quicksand', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.4);
  border-radius: 50px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(180, 107, 252, 0.2), rgba(107, 197, 255, 0.2));
  color: #fff;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.4s ease;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  min-width: 300px;
  text-align: center;
}

.menu-btn::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -50%; left: -50%;
  width: 200%; height: 200%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.15) 0%, transparent 60%);
  animation: btnGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes btnGlow {
  0%, 100% { transform: translate(-10%, -10%); }
  50% { transform: translate(10%, 10%); }
}

.menu-btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.05);
  border-color: var(--glow-gold);

<script>
// ===== LOADING SCREEN =====
window.addEventListener('load', () => {

// ===== PARTICLE SYSTEM =====
const particleCanvas = document.getElementById('particleCanvas');
const pCtx = particleCanvas.getContext('2d');
let particles = [];

function resizeParticleCanvas() {
  particleCanvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  particleCanvas.height = window.innerHeight;
}
resizeParticleCanvas();
window.addEventListener('resize', resizeParticleCanvas);

class Particle {
  constructor() {
    this.reset();
  }
  reset() {
    this.x = Math.random() * particleCanvas.width;
    this.y = Math.random() * particleCanvas.height;
    this.size = Math.random() * 3 + 1;
    this.speedX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
    this.speedY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5 - 0.2;
    this.opacity = Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.1;
    this.hue = Math.random() * 60 + 260; // purple-blue range
    this.life = Math.random() * 200 + 100;
    this.maxLife = this.life;
  }
  update() {
    this.x += this.speedX;
    this.y += this.speedY;
    this.life--;
    this.opacity = (this.life / this.maxLife) * 0.5;
    if (this.life <= 0 || this.x < 0 || this.x > particleCanvas.width || this.y < 0 || this.y > particleCanvas.height) {
      this.reset();
    }
  }
  draw() {
    pCtx.beginPath();
    pCtx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    pCtx.fillStyle = `hsla(${this.hue}, 80%, 70%, ${this.opacity})`;
    pCtx.fill();
    pCtx.beginPath();
    pCtx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.size * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    pCtx.fillStyle = `hsla(${this.hue}, 80%, 70%, ${this.opacity * 0.3})`;
    pCtx.fill();
  }
}

for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
  particles.push(new Particle());
}

function animateParticles() {
  pCtx.clearRect(0, 0, particleCanvas.width, particleCanvas.height);
  particles.forEach(p => { p.update(); p.draw(); });
  requestAnimationFrame(animateParticles);
}
animateParticles();

// ===== FLOATING ORBS ON MAIN MENU =====

// ===== QR CODE GENERATOR =====
function generateQR() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('qrCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const size = 180;
  canvas.width = size;
  canvas.height = size;

  // UPI QR code pattern (simplified visual representation)
  const moduleSize = 6;
  const modules = Math.floor(size / moduleSize);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);

  // Generate a deterministic pattern based on UPI string
  const upiData = "upi://pay?pa=8840756392@fam&pn=Echoes%20of%20Lumora&cu=INR";
  let seed = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < upiData.length; i++) {
    seed = ((seed << 5) - seed) + upiData.charCodeAt(i);
    seed |= 0;
  }

  function pseudoRandom() {
    seed = (seed * 16807 + 0) % 2147483647;
    return (seed & 1);
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a0a30';

  // Position patterns (top-left, top-right, bottom-left)
  function drawFinderPattern(x, y) {
    // Outer
    ctx.fillRect(x, y, 7 * moduleSize, 7 * moduleSize);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(x + moduleSize, y + moduleSize, 5 * moduleSize, 5 * moduleSize);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a0a30';
    ctx.fillRect(x + 2 * moduleSize, y + 2 * moduleSize, 3 * moduleSize, 3 * moduleSize);
  }

  drawFinderPattern(0, 0);
  drawFinderPattern((modules - 7) * moduleSize, 0);
  drawFinderPattern(0, (modules - 7) * moduleSize);

  // Data modules
  for (let row = 0; row < modules; row++) {
    for (let col = 0; col < modules; col++) {
      // Skip finder pattern areas
      if ((row < 8 && col < 8) || (row < 8 && col >= modules - 8) || (row >= modules - 8 && col < 8)) continue;

      if (pseudoRandom()) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1a0a30';
        ctx.fillRect(col * moduleSize, row * moduleSize, moduleSize, moduleSize);
      }
    }
  }

  // Center logo area
  const centerX = (size - 30) / 2;
  const centerY = (size - 30) / 2;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillRect(centerX - 2, centerY - 2, 34, 34);
  ctx.font = '24px serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
  ctx.fillText('✦', size / 2, size / 2);
}
generateQR();

// ===== GAME ENGINE =====
const gameCanvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const gCtx = gameCanvas.getContext('2d');
let gameStarted = false;
let gameOrbs = 0;
let gameLives = 3;
let currentIsland = 1;
let currentEmotion = 'joy';
let gameTime = 0;

let player = {
  x: 100, y: 300, width: 30, height: 40,
  vx: 0, vy: 0, onGround: false,
  facing: 1, frame: 0, frameTimer: 0
};

let platforms = [];
let collectibles = [];
let enemies = [];
let particles = [];
let bgElements = [];
let rainDrops = [];
let fireParticles = [];
let portalEffects = [];

const emotions = {
  joy: { color: '#ffd700', bgColor: '#1a1a3a', particleColor: '#ffd700', secondaryColor: '#ff9f6b' },
  sadness: { color: '#6bc5ff', bgColor: '#0a1525', particleColor: '#6bc5ff', secondaryColor: '#4a8fd4' },
  anger: { color: '#ff6b6b', bgColor: '#2a0a0a', particleColor: '#ff6b6b', secondaryColor: '#ff9f6b' },
  curiosity: { color: '#b46bfc', bgColor: '#150a2a', particleColor: '#b46bfc', secondaryColor: '#6bc5ff' }
};

function resizeGameCanvas() {
  const container = gameCanvas.parentElement;
  gameCanvas.width = container.clientWidth;
  gameCanvas.height = 500;
}

function startGame() {
  if (gameStarted) return;
  gameStarted = true;
  resizeGameCanvas();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resizeGameCanvas);
  generateLevel();
  gameLoop();
}

function generateLevel() {
  platforms = [];
  collectibles = [];
  enemies = [];
  bgElements = [];
  rainDrops = [];
  fireParticles = [];
  portalEffects = [];

  const w = gameCanvas.width;
  const h = gameCanvas.height;

  // Ground platforms
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    platforms.push({
      x: i * (w / 6) + Math.random() * 50 - 25,
      y: h - 40 - Math.random() * 30,
      width: 100 + Math.random() * 80,
      height: 20,
      type: 'ground'
    });
  }

  // Floating platforms
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    platforms.push({
      x: Math.random() * w,
      y: 100 + Math.random() * (h - 200),
      width: 60 + Math.random() * 80,
      height: 15,
      type: 'floating'
    });
  }

  // Collectibles (Lumora Orbs)
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    collectibles.push({
      x: 50 + Math.random() * (w - 100),
      y: 50 + Math.random() * (h - 150),
      size: 12,
      collected: false,
      bobOffset: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
  }

  // Enemies
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    enemies.push({
      x: 200 + Math.random() * (w - 300),
      y: 100 + Math.random() * (h - 250),
      width: 25,
      height: 25,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2,
      vy: 0,
      type: Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'bat' : 'slime',
      frame: 0
    });
  }

  // Background elements (floating islands, crystals)
  for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
    bgElements.push({
      x: Math.random() * w,
      y: Math.random() * h,
      size: 5 + Math.random() * 20,
      type: Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'crystal' : 'island',
      speed: 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.3,
      opacity: 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.3
    });
  }
}

// Input handling
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  keys[e.code] = true;
  if (e.code === 'Space') e.preventDefault();
  if (e.key === '1') setEmotion('joy');
  if (e.key === '2') setEmotion('sadness');
  if (e.key === '3') setEmotion('anger');
  if (e.key === '4') setEmotion('curiosity');
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => { keys[e.code] = false; });

// Touch controls
let touchX = null;
let touchJump = false;
gameCanvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const touch = e.touches[0];
  const rect = gameCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  touchX = touch.clientX - rect.left;
  if (touch.clientY - rect.top < rect.height / 2) {
    touchJump = true;
  }
});
gameCanvas.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const touch = e.touches[0];
  const rect = gameCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  touchX = touch.clientX - rect.left;
});
gameCanvas.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  touchX = null;
  touchJump = false;
});

function setEmotion(emotion) {
  currentEmotion = emotion;
  document.querySelectorAll('.emotion-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelector(`.emotion-btn.${emotion}`).classList.add('active');

  // Spawn emotion particles
  const e = emotions[emotion];
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    particles.push({
      x: player.x + player.width / 2,
      y: player.y + player.height / 2,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4 - 2,
      size: Math.random() * 5 + 2,
      life: 60,
      maxLife: 60,
      color: e.particleColor
    });
  }

  // Special effects per emotion
  if (emotion === 'sadness') {
    for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
      rainDrops.push({
        x: Math.random() * gameCanvas.width,
        y: -10,
        speed: 3 + Math.random() * 3,
        length: 10 + Math.random() * 15,
        opacity: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4
      });
    }
  }
  if (emotion === 'anger') {
    for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
      fireParticles.push({
        x: player.x + player.width / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40,
        y: player.y + player.height,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2,
        vy: -1 - Math.random() * 3,
        size: 3 + Math.random() * 5,
        life: 30 + Math.random() * 20,
        maxLife: 50,
        hue: 0 + Math.random() * 40
      });
    }
  }
  if (emotion === 'curiosity') {
    portalEffects.push({
      x: player.x + player.width / 2,
      y: player.y + player.height / 2,
      radius: 0,
      maxRadius: 80,
      life: 60
    });
  }
}

function updateGame() {
  gameTime++;
  const w = gameCanvas.width;
  const h = gameCanvas.height;
  const e = emotions[currentEmotion];

  // Player movement
  const speed = 4;
  const gravity = 0.5;
  const jumpForce = -10;

  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA']) {
    player.vx = -speed;
    player.facing = -1;
  } else if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD']) {
    player.vx = speed;
    player.facing = 1;
  } else {
    player.vx *= 0.8;
  }

  // Touch controls
  if (touchX !== null) {
    if (touchX < player.x - 10) { player.vx = -speed; player.facing = -1; }
    else if (touchX > player.x + player.width + 10) { player.vx = speed; player.facing = 1; }
    else { player.vx *= 0.8; }
  }

  if ((keys['Space'] || keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW'] || touchJump) && player.onGround) {
    player.vy = jumpForce;
    player.onGround = false;
    touchJump = false;
  }

  // Apply gravity
  player.vy += gravity;
  player.x += player.vx;
  player.y += player.vy;

  // Platform collision
  player.onGround = false;
  platforms.forEach(p => {
    if (player.x + player.width > p.x && player.x < p.x + p.width &&
        player.y + player.height > p.y && player.y + player.height < p.y + p.height + 15 &&
        player.vy >= 0) {
      player.y = p.y - player.height;
      player.vy = 0;
      player.onGround = true;
    }
  });

  // Screen boundaries
  if (player.x < 0) player.x = 0;
  if (player.x + player.width > w) player.x = w - player.width;
  if (player.y > h + 50) {
    gameLives--;
    document.getElementById('gameLives').textContent = gameLives;
    if (gameLives <= 0) {
      gameLives = 3;
      document.getElementById('gameLives').textContent = gameLives;
      player.x = 100;
      player.y = 300;
      showToast('💔 Lost a life! Try again!');
    } else {
      player.x = 100;
      player.y = 300;
      player.vy = 0;
    }
  }

  // Collectibles
  collectibles.forEach(c => {
    if (!c.collected) {
      const dx = (player.x + player.width / 2) - c.x;
      const dy = (player.y + player.height / 2) - c.y;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      if (dist < c.size + 20) {
        c.collected = true;
        gameOrbs += 10;
        document.getElementById('gameOrbs').textContent = gameOrbs;
        for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
          particles.push({
            x: c.x, y: c.y,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3,
            vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3,
            size: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
            life: 40,
            maxLife: 40,
            color: '#ffd700'
          });
        }
      }
    }
  });

  // Respawn collectibles
  if (collectibles.filter(c => c.collected).length >= 15) {
    collectibles.forEach(c => c.collected = false);
    currentIsland++;
    document.getElementById('gameIsland').textContent = currentIsland;
    showToast(`🌍 Welcome to Island ${currentIsland}!`);
    generateLevel();
  }

  // Enemies
  enemies.forEach(en => {
    en.x += en.vx;
    en.frame += 0.05;
    if (en.x < 0 || en.x + en.width > w) en.vx *= -1;

    // Collision with player
    if (player.x + player.width > en.x && player.x < en.x + en.width &&
        player.y + player.height > en.y && player.y < en.y + en.height) {
      // Check if player is above enemy (stomp)
      if (player.vy > 0 && player.y + player.height < en.y + en.height / 2 + 10) {
        en.x = Math.random() * w;
        en.y = 100 + Math.random() * (h - 250);
        player.vy = -8;
        gameOrbs += 25;
        document.getElementById('gameOrbs').textContent = gameOrbs;
      } else {
        gameLives--;
        document.getElementById('gameLives').textContent = gameLives;
        player.x = 100;
        player.y = 300;
        player.vy = 0;
        if (gameLives <= 0) {
          gameLives = 3;
          document.getElementById('gameLives').textContent = gameLives;
          showToast('💔 Game Over! Restarting...');
        } else {
          showToast('💔 Hit! Be careful!');
        }
      }
    }
  });

  // Update particles
  particles = particles.filter(p => {
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.life--;
    p.vy += 0.05;
    return p.life > 0;
  });

  // Rain drops
  rainDrops = rainDrops.filter(r => {
    r.y += r.speed;
    r.x -= 0.5;
    return r.y < h;
  });

  // Fire particles
  fireParticles = fireParticles.filter(f => {
    f.x += f.vx;
    f.y += f.vy;
    f.life--;
    f.size *= 0.97;
    return f.life > 0;
  });

  // Portal effects
  portalEffects = portalEffects.filter(p => {
    p.radius += 2;
    p.life--;
    return p.life > 0;
  });

  // Background elements parallax
  bgElements.forEach(bg => {
    bg.x -= bg.speed;
    if (bg.x < -50) bg.x = w + 50;
  });

  // Joy: spawn flower particles
  if (currentEmotion === 'joy' && gameTime % 10 === 0) {
    particles.push({
      x: player.x + Math.random() * 60 - 30,
      y: player.y + Math.random() * 20,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1,
      vy: -1 - Math.random(),
      size: 3 + Math.random() * 4,
      life: 50,
      maxLife: 50,
      color: Math.random() > 0.5 ? '#ffd700' : '#ff6bca'
    });
  }

  // Player animation
  player.frameTimer++;
  if (player.frameTimer > 8) {
    player.frame = (player.frame + 1) % 4;
    player.frameTimer = 0;
  }
}

function drawGame() {
  const w = gameCanvas.width;
  const h = gameCanvas.height;
  const e = emotions[currentEmotion];

  // Background
  const bgGrad = gCtx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0, e.bgColor);
  bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0a0a1a');
  gCtx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
  gCtx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

  // Parallax stars
  gCtx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
    const sx = (i * 137.5 + gameTime * 0.05) % w;
    const sy = (i * 97.3) % h;
    const ss = 1 + Math.sin(gameTime * 0.02 + i) * 0.5;
    gCtx.beginPath();
    gCtx.arc(sx, sy, ss, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    gCtx.fill();
  }

  // Background elements (crystals, floating islands)
  bgElements.forEach(bg => {
    gCtx.globalAlpha = bg.opacity;
    if (bg.type === 'crystal') {
      gCtx.fillStyle = e.particleColor;
      gCtx.beginPath();
      gCtx.moveTo(bg.x, bg.y - bg.size);
      gCtx.lineTo(bg.x + bg.size * 0.5, bg.y);
      gCtx.lineTo(bg.x, bg.y + bg.size);
      gCtx.lineTo(bg.x - bg.size * 0.5, bg.y);
      gCtx.closePath();
      gCtx.fill();
    } else {
      gCtx.fillStyle = e.secondaryColor;
      gCtx.beginPath();
      gCtx.ellipse(bg.x, bg.y, bg.size * 2, bg.size * 0.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      gCtx.fill();
    }
    gCtx.globalAlpha = 1;
  });

  // Rain drops (sadness)
  if (currentEmotion === 'sadness') {
    rainDrops.forEach(r => {
      gCtx.strokeStyle = `rgba(107, 197, 255, ${r.opacity})`;
      gCtx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      gCtx.beginPath();
      gCtx.moveTo(r.x, r.y);
      gCtx.lineTo(r.x - 1, r.y + r.length);
      gCtx.stroke();
    });
  }

  // Platforms
  platforms.forEach(p => {
    const pGrad = gCtx.createLinearGradient(p.x, p.y, p.x, p.y + p.height);
    pGrad.addColorStop(0, e.particleColor + '40');
    pGrad.addColorStop(1, e.particleColor + '10');
    gCtx.fillStyle = pGrad;
    gCtx.beginPath();
    gCtx.roundRect(p.x, p.y, p.width, p.height, 8);
    gCtx.fill();

    // Platform glow
    gCtx.strokeStyle = e.particleColor + '60';
    gCtx.lineWidth = 1;
    gCtx.beginPath();
    gCtx.roundRect(p.x, p.y, p.width, p.height, 8);
    gCtx.stroke();

    // Platform top grass/detail
    gCtx.fillStyle = e.particleColor + '30';
    gCtx.beginPath();
    gCtx.roundRect(p.x, p.y, p.width, 4, [4, 4, 0, 0]);
    gCtx.fill();
  });

  // Portal effects (curiosity)
  portalEffects.forEach(p => {
    const alpha = p.life / 60;
    gCtx.strokeStyle = `rgba(180, 107, 252, ${alpha * 0.5})`;
    gCtx.lineWidth = 2;
    gCtx.beginPath();
    gCtx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    gCtx.stroke();
    gCtx.beginPath();
    gCtx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    gCtx.strokeStyle = `rgba(107, 197, 255, ${alpha * 0.3})`;
    gCtx.stroke();
  });

  // Fire particles (anger)
  fireParticles.forEach(f => {
    const alpha = f.life / f.maxLife;
    gCtx.fillStyle = `hsla(${f.hue}, 100%, 60%, ${alpha})`;
    gCtx.beginPath();
    gCtx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    gCtx.fill();
  });

  // Collectibles
  collectibles.forEach(c => {
    if (!c.collected) {
      const bob = Math.sin(gameTime * 0.05 + c.bobOffset) * 5;
      const cy = c.y + bob;

      // Glow
      const glowGrad = gCtx.createRadialGradient(c.x, cy, 0, c.x, cy, c.size * 3);
      glowGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3)');
      glowGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 215, 0, 0)');
      gCtx.fillStyle = glowGrad;
      gCtx.beginPath();
      gCtx.arc(c.x, cy, c.size * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      gCtx.fill();

      // Orb
      gCtx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
      gCtx.beginPath();
      gCtx.arc(c.x, cy, c.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      gCtx.fill();

      // Inner highlight
      gCtx.fillStyle = '#fff8dc';
      gCtx.beginPath();
      gCtx.arc(c.x - 2, cy - 2, c.size * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      gCtx.fill();
    }
  });

  // Enemies
  enemies.forEach(en => {
    const bounce = Math.sin(en.frame * 3) * 3;
    if (en.type === 'bat') {
      // Bat
      gCtx.fillStyle = '#8b4585';
      gCtx.beginPath();
      gCtx.ellipse(en.x + en.width / 2, en.y + en.height / 2 + bounce, en.width / 2, en.height / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      gCtx.fill();
      // Wings
      const wingAngle = Math.sin(en.frame * 8) * 0.5;
      gCtx.fillStyle = '#6b2565';
      gCtx.save();
      gCtx.translate(en.x + en.width / 2, en.y + en.height / 2 + bounce);
      gCtx.rotate(wingAngle);
      gCtx.beginPath();
      gCtx.ellipse(-en.width / 2, 0, en.width / 2, en.height / 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      gCtx.fill();
      gCtx.restore();
      gCtx.save();
      gCtx.translate(en.x + en.width / 2, en.y + en.height / 2 + bounce);
      gCtx.rotate(-wingAngle);
      gCtx.beginPath();
      gCtx.ellipse(en.width / 2, 0, en.width / 2, en.height / 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      gCtx.fill();
      gCtx.restore();
      // Eyes
      gCtx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
      gCtx.beginPath();
      gCtx.arc(en.x + en.width / 2 - 4, en.y + en.height / 2 - 3 + bounce, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      gCtx.arc(en.x + en.width / 2 + 4, en.y + en.height / 2 - 3 + bounce, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      gCtx.fill();
    } else {
      // Slime
      gCtx.fillStyle = '#44aa44';
      gCtx.beginPath();
      gCtx.ellipse(en.x + en.width / 2, en.y + en.height + bounce, en.width / 2, en.height / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      gCtx.fill();
      // Eyes
      gCtx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      gCtx.beginPath();
      gCtx.arc(en.x + en.width / 2 - 4, en.y + en.height / 2 + bounce, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      gCtx.arc(en.x + en.width / 2 + 4, en.y + en.height / 2 + bounce, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      gCtx.fill();
      gCtx.fillStyle = '#222';
      gCtx.beginPath();
      gCtx.arc(en.x + en.width / 2 - 3, en.y + en.height / 2 + bounce, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      gCtx.arc(en.x + en.width / 2 + 5, en.y + en.height / 2 + bounce, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      gCtx.fill();
    }
  });

  // Player
  const px = player.x;
  const py = player.y;
  const pf = player.facing;

  // Player glow
  const playerGlow = gCtx.createRadialGradient(px + player.width / 2, py + player.height / 2, 0, px + player.width / 2, py + player.height / 2, 40);
  playerGlow.addColorStop(0, e.particleColor + '40');
  playerGlow.addColorStop(1, e.particleColor + '00');
  gCtx.fillStyle = playerGlow;
  gCtx.beginPath();
  gCtx.arc(px + player.width / 2, py + player.height / 2, 40, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  gCtx.fill();

  // Player body (cute character)
  gCtx.fillStyle = e.particleColor;
  // Body
  gCtx.beginPath();
  gCtx.ellipse(px + player.width / 2, py + player.height - 5, player.width / 2, player.height / 2 - 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  gCtx.fill();

  // Head
  gCtx.fillStyle = e.secondaryColor;
  gCtx.beginPath();
  gCtx.arc(px + player.width / 2, py + 10, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  gCtx.fill();

  // Eyes (big and expressive)
  gCtx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  gCtx.beginPath();
  gCtx.ellipse(px + player.width / 2 - 4 + pf * 2, py + 8, 4, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  gCtx.ellipse(px + player.width / 2 + 4 + pf * 2, py + 8, 4, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  gCtx.fill();

  gCtx.fillStyle = '#1a0a30';
  gCtx.beginPath();
  gCtx.arc(px + player.width / 2 - 4 + pf * 3, py + 9, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  gCtx.arc(px + player.width / 2 + 4 + pf * 3, py + 9, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  gCtx.fill();

  // Eye shine
  gCtx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  gCtx.beginPath();
  gCtx.arc(px + player.width / 2 - 3 + pf * 3, py + 7, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  gCtx.arc(px + player.width / 2 + 5 + pf * 3, py + 7, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  gCtx.fill();

  // Mouth
  gCtx.strokeStyle = '#1a0a30';
  gCtx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  gCtx.beginPath();
  gCtx.arc(px + player.width / 2 + pf * 1, py + 15, 3, 0.1, Math.PI - 0.1);
  gCtx.stroke();

  // Legs (animation)
  const legOffset = player.onGround ? Math.sin(player.frame * Math.PI / 2) * 3 : 2;
  gCtx.fillStyle = e.particleColor;
  gCtx.fillRect(px + 5, py + player.height - 8, 6, 8 + legOffset);
  gCtx.fillRect(px + player.width - 11, py + player.height - 8, 6, 8 - legOffset);

  // Particles
  particles.forEach(p => {
    const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
    gCtx.fillStyle = p.color + Math.floor(alpha * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
    gCtx.beginPath();
    gCtx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    gCtx.fill();
  });

  // Emotion indicator
  const emotionIcons = { joy: '😊', sadness: '😢', anger: '😤', curiosity: '🤔' };
  gCtx.font = '24px serif';
  gCtx.textAlign = 'center';
  gCtx.fillText(emotionIcons[currentEmotion], player.x + player.width / 2, player.y - 15);

  // Emotion label
  gCtx.font = '10px Quicksand, sans-serif';
  gCtx.fillStyle = e.particleColor;
  gCtx.fillText(currentEmotion.toUpperCase(), player.x + player.width / 2, player.y - 25);
}

function gameLoop() {
  if (!gameStarted) return;
  updateGame();
  drawGame();
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// ===== SMOOTH SCROLL FOR NAV =====
document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
  anchor.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
    if (target) target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  });
});

// ===== INITIALIZE =====
showSection('mainMenu');
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<title>Shadow Fight 2</title>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

background: #000;
display: flex;
justify-content: center;
align-items: center;

display: block;

top: 0; left: 0;
width: 100%; height: 100%;
pointer-events: none;
