</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

canvas.width = 1200;
canvas.height = 700;

// Audio context for sound effects
const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
const audioCtx = new AudioCtx();

function playSound(freq, duration, type = 'square', volume = 0.15) {
    const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
    const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
    osc.type = type;
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * 0.5, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume, audioCtx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    osc.start();
    osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
}

function playHitSound() {
    playSound(150, 0.15, 'sawtooth', 0.2);
    playSound(80, 0.2, 'square', 0.15);
}

function playBlockSound() {
    playSound(400, 0.1, 'triangle', 0.1);
}

function playSpecialSound() {
    playSound(200, 0.4, 'sawtooth', 0.2);
    playSound(300, 0.3, 'square', 0.15);
}

function playKOSound() {
    playSound(100, 0.8, 'sawtooth', 0.3);
    setTimeout(() => playSound(80, 0.5, 'square', 0.2), 200);
}

// Game state
const GAME_STATE = {
    MENU: 0,
    FIGHT: 1,
    ROUND_END: 2,
    GAME_OVER: 3,
    COUNTDOWN: 4
};

let gameState = GAME_STATE.MENU;
let roundTimer = 99;
let timerCounter = 0;
let round = 1;
let maxRounds = 3;
let countdownTimer = 0;
let countdownText = '';
let screenShake = 0;
let particles = [];
let hitSparks = [];
let bgStars = [];
let bgBuildings = [];
let roundWins = [0, 0];
let comboCount = [0, 0];
let comboTimer = [0, 0];
let lastHitTime = [0, 0];
let slowMotion = 0;
let slowMotionFactor = 1;

// Initialize background elements
for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
    bgStars.push({
        x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
        y: Math.random() * canvas.height * 0.6,
        size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
        twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        speed: Math.random() * 0.02 + 0.01
    });
}

for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
    bgBuildings.push({
        x: i * 90 - 100,
        width: Math.random() * 60 + 40,
        height: Math.random() * 150 + 80,
        shade: Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.1
    });
}

// Fighter class
class Fighter {
    constructor(x, facing, name, color) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = canvas.height - 150;
        this.vx = 0;
        this.vy = 0;
        this.facing = facing;
        this.name = name;
        this.color = color;
        this.width = 50;
        this.height = 120;
        this.health = 100;
        this.maxHealth = 100;
        this.energy = 0;
        this.maxEnergy = 100;
        this.state = 'idle';
        this.stateTimer = 0;
        this.animFrame = 0;
        this.animTimer = 0;
        this.isGrounded = true;
        this.isBlocking = false;
        this.isCrouching = false;
        this.hitStun = 0;
        this.blockStun = 0;
        this.attackHit = false;
        this.wins = 0;
        this.limbAngles = {
            head: 0,
            torso: 0,
            leftArm: 0,
            rightArm: 0,
            leftLeg: 0,
            rightLeg: 0
        };
        this.targetLimbAngles = { ...this.limbAngles };
        this.attackType = null;
        this.attackPhase = 0;
        this.combo = 0;
        this.lastAttackTime = 0;
        this.invincible = 0;
        this.knockdownTimer = 0;
        this.crouching = false;
    }

    reset(x) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = canvas.height - 150;
        this.vx = 0;
        this.vy = 0;
        this.health = 100;
        this.energy = 0;
        this.state = 'idle';
        this.stateTimer = 0;
        this.hitStun = 0;
        this.blockStun = 0;
        this.isBlocking = false;
        this.isCrouching = false;
        this.attackHit = false;
        this.invincible = 0;
        this.knockdownTimer = 0;
        this.combo = 0;
        this.limbAngles = {
            head: 0, torso: 0, leftArm: 0, rightArm: 0,
            leftLeg: 0, rightLeg: 0
        };
        this.targetLimbAngles = { ...this.limbAngles };
        this.attackType = null;
        this.attackPhase = 0;
    }

    getHitbox() {
        let h = this.isCrouching ? this.height * 0.6 : this.height;
        let yOff = this.isCrouching ? this.height * 0.4 : 0;
        return {
            x: this.x - this.width / 2,
            y: this.y - h + yOff,
            w: this.width,
            h: h
        };
    }

    getAttackBox() {
        if (!this.attackType || this.attackPhase !== 1) return null;
        let range = 60;
        let yOff = 0;
        if (this.attackType === 'kick') { range = 75; yOff = 20; }
        if (this.attackType === 'uppercut') { range = 55; yOff = -30; }
        if (this.attackType === 'special') { range = 80; yOff = 10; }
        if (this.attackType === 'sweep') { range = 70; yOff = 40; }
        return {
            x: this.facing === 1 ? this.x + 10 : this.x - 10 - range,
            y: this.y - 60 + yOff,
            w: range,
            h: 30
        };
    }

    attack(type) {
        if (this.state !== 'idle' && this.state !== 'walking' && this.state !== 'crouching') return;
        if (this.hitStun > 0 || this.blockStun > 0) return;
        if (type === 'special' && this.energy < 50) return;

        this.attackType = type;
        this.attackPhase = 0;
        this.stateTimer = 0;
        this.attackHit = false;
        this.state = 'attacking';

        if (type === 'special') {
            this.energy -= 50;
            playSpecialSound();
        }
    }

    takeDamage(amount, attackerX, attackType) {
        if (this.invincible > 0) return;

        if (this.isBlocking) {
            this.blockStun = 15;
            this.energy = Math.min(this.maxEnergy, this.energy + 5);
            playBlockSound();
            spawnBlockSparks(this.x + (this.facing === 1 ? -20 : 20), this.y - 60);
            return;
        }

        this.health -= amount;
        if (this.health < 0) this.health = 0;

        this.energy = Math.min(this.maxEnergy, this.energy + amount * 0.5);
        attacker.energy = Math.min(attacker.maxEnergy, attacker.energy + amount * 0.3);

        let knockback = attackType === 'special' ? 12 : attackType === 'kick' ? 8 : 5;
        this.vx = (this.x > attackerX ? 1 : -1) * knockback;
        this.hitStun = attackType === 'special' ? 30 : 20;
        this.state = 'hitstun';

        if (attackType === 'special' || amount > 15) {
            this.knockdownTimer = 45;
            this.vy = -8;
            this.isGrounded = false;
        }

        screenShake = attackType === 'special' ? 15 : 8;
        slowMotion = attackType === 'special' ? 10 : 3;
        slowMotionFactor = 0.3;

        playHitSound();
        spawnHitParticles(this.x, this.y - 60, attackType);
    }

    update(opponent) {
        this.animTimer++;
        if (this.animTimer >= 6) {
            this.animTimer = 0;
            this.animFrame++;
        }

        if (this.invincible > 0) this.invincible--;
        if (this.hitStun > 0) this.hitStun--;
        if (this.blockStun > 0) this.blockStun--;
        if (this.knockdownTimer > 0) {
            this.knockdownTimer--;
            if (this.knockdownTimer <= 0 && this.isGrounded) {
                this.state = 'idle';
                this.invincible = 30;
            }
        }

        // Combo timer
        if (this.combo > 0) {
            comboTimer[this === player1 ? 0 : 1]--;
            if (comboTimer[this === player1 ? 0 : 1] <= 0) {
                this.combo = 0;
            }
        }

        // Attack animation
        if (this.state === 'attacking') {
            this.stateTimer++;
            let totalFrames = this.attackType === 'special' ? 40 :
                              this.attackType === 'uppercut' ? 25 :
                              this.attackType === 'sweep' ? 30 : 20;
            let activeStart = this.attackType === 'special' ? 10 :
                              this.attackType === 'uppercut' ? 6 :
                              this.attackType === 'sweep' ? 8 : 5;
            let activeEnd = activeStart + (this.attackType === 'special' ? 15 : 10);

            if (this.stateTimer < activeStart) {
                this.attackPhase = 0; // windup
            } else if (this.stateTimer >= activeStart && this.stateTimer <= activeEnd) {
                this.attackPhase = 1; // active
            } else {
                this.attackPhase = 2; // recovery
            }

            if (this.stateTimer >= totalFrames) {
                this.state = 'idle';
                this.attackType = null;
                this.attackPhase = 0;
            }
        }

        // Physics
        if (!this.isGrounded) {
            this.vy += 0.6;
        }
        this.x += this.vx;
        this.y += this.vy;

        // Ground collision
        let groundY = canvas.height - 150;
        if (this.y >= groundY) {
            this.y = groundY;
            this.vy = 0;
            this.isGrounded = true;
        }

        // Friction
        if (this.isGrounded) {
            this.vx *= 0.85;
        } else {
            this.vx *= 0.98;
        }

        // Boundaries
        if (this.x < 40) this.x = 40;
        if (this.x > canvas.width - 40) this.x = canvas.width - 40;

        // Update limb angles
        this.updateLimbAngles(opponent);
    }

    updateLimbAngles(opponent) {
        let t = this.animTimer / 6 + this.animFrame * 0.1;
        let base = Math.sin(t) * 0.1;

        if (this.state === 'hitstun' || this.knockdownTimer > 0) {
            this.targetLimbAngles = {
                head: -0.3 * this.facing,
                torso: -0.5 * this.facing,
                leftArm: 0.5,
                rightArm: -0.5,
                leftLeg: 0.3,
                rightLeg: -0.3
            };
        } else if (this.state === 'attacking') {
            let progress = this.stateTimer / 40;
            if (this.attackType === 'punch') {
                this.targetLimbAngles = {
                    head: 0,
                    torso: this.facing * 0.15,
                    leftArm: -0.3,
                    rightArm: this.attackPhase === 1 ? -1.5 : -0.3 + Math.sin(progress * Math.PI) * 0.5,
                    leftLeg: 0.2,
                    rightLeg: -0.1
                };
            } else if (this.attackType === 'kick') {
                this.targetLimbAngles = {
                    head: -this.facing * 0.1,
                    torso: -this.facing * 0.2,
                    leftArm: 0.3,
                    rightArm: 0.3,
                    leftLeg: -0.1,
                    rightLeg: this.attackPhase === 1 ? -1.2 : -0.1 + Math.sin(progress * Math.PI) * 0.5
                };
            } else if (this.attackType === 'uppercut') {
                this.targetLimbAngles = {
                    head: 0.2,
                    torso: -0.15,
                    leftArm: this.attackPhase === 1 ? -1.8 : -0.5,
                    rightArm: -0.3,
                    leftLeg: 0.3,
                    rightLeg: -0.1
                };
            } else if (this.attackType === 'special') {
                this.targetLimbAngles = {
                    head: this.facing * 0.2,
                    torso: this.facing * 0.25,
                    leftArm: -1.2 + Math.sin(progress * Math.PI * 2) * 0.3,
                    rightArm: -1.2 + Math.sin(progress * Math.PI * 2) * 0.3,
                    leftLeg: 0.4,
                    rightLeg: -0.3
                };
            } else if (this.attackType === 'sweep') {
                this.targetLimbAngles = {
                    head: -this.facing * 0.2,
                    torso: -this.facing * 0.3,
                    leftArm: 0.3,
                    rightArm: 0.3,
                    leftLeg: this.attackPhase === 1 ? 0.8 : 0.2,
                    rightLeg: -0.2
                };
            }
        } else if (this.state === 'crouching') {
            this.targetLimbAngles = {
                head: 0.3,
                torso: 0.4,
                leftArm: 0.5,
                rightArm: 0.5,
                leftLeg: 1.0,
                rightLeg: 0.8
            };
        } else if (this.state === 'hitstun') {
            // handled above
        } else {
            // Idle / walking
            let walkCycle = Math.sin(t * 2) * (Math.abs(this.vx) > 0.5 ? 0.4 : 0.05);
            this.targetLimbAngles = {
                head: Math.sin(t * 0.5) * 0.05,
                torso: base * 0.3,
                leftArm: -0.3 + walkCycle,
                rightArm: -0.3 - walkCycle,
                leftLeg: walkCycle * 0.5,
                rightLeg: -walkCycle * 0.5
            };
        }

        if (this.isBlocking) {
            this.targetLimbAngles.leftArm = -1.0;
            this.targetLimbAngles.rightArm = -1.2;
        }

        // Smooth interpolation
        let lerpSpeed = 0.2;
        for (let key in this.limbAngles) {
            this.limbAngles[key] += (this.targetLimbAngles[key] - this.limbAngles[key]) * lerpSpeed;
        }
    }

    draw() {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);

        let scaleX = this.facing;
        ctx.scale(scaleX, 1);

        // Shadow on ground
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 5, 30, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Invincibility flash
        if (this.invincible > 0 && Math.floor(this.invincible / 3) % 2 === 0) {
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;
        }

        let la = this.limbAngles;
        let bodyColor = this.color;
        let glowColor = this.attackType === 'special' ? '#ff4400' :
                        this.attackPhase === 1 ? '#ffaa00' : bodyColor;

        // Glow effect during attacks
        if (this.attackPhase === 1 || this.attackType === 'special') {
            ctx.shadowColor = glowColor;
            ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
        }

        // Draw shadow figure
        ctx.fillStyle = bodyColor;
        ctx.strokeStyle = bodyColor;
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

        let bodyY = -60;
        let headY = -95;
        let bodyH = 35;

        // Torso
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(0, bodyY);
        ctx.rotate(la.torso);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(0, -bodyH);
        ctx.lineWidth = 8;
        ctx.stroke();

        // Head
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, headY - bodyY, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Eyes (glowing)
        ctx.fillStyle = this.attackPhase === 1 ? '#ffaa00' : '#ffffff';
        ctx.shadowColor = this.attackPhase === 1 ? '#ffaa00' : '#ffffff';
        ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(4, headY - bodyY - 2, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(10, headY - bodyY - 2, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

        // Left arm
        ctx.strokeStyle = bodyColor;
        ctx.shadowColor = glowColor;
        ctx.shadowBlur = this.attackPhase === 1 ? 15 : 0;
        ctx.lineWidth = 5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, -bodyH + 5);
        let lArmEndX = Math.sin(la.leftArm) * 25;
        let lArmEndY = -bodyH + 5 + Math.cos(la.leftArm) * 25;
        ctx.lineTo(lArmEndX, lArmEndY);
        ctx.stroke();

        // Fist
        ctx.fillStyle = bodyColor;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(lArmEndX, lArmEndY, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Right arm
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, -bodyH + 5);
        let rArmEndX = Math.sin(la.rightArm) * 25;
        let rArmEndY = -bodyH + 5 + Math.cos(la.rightArm) * 25;
        ctx.lineTo(rArmEndX, rArmEndY);
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(rArmEndX, rArmEndY, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

        // Left leg
        ctx.strokeStyle = bodyColor;
        ctx.lineWidth = 6;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
        let lLegEndX = Math.sin(la.leftLeg) * 30;
        let lLegEndY = Math.cos(la.leftLeg) * 30;
        ctx.lineTo(lLegEndX, lLegEndY);
        ctx.stroke();

        // Right leg
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
        let rLegEndX = Math.sin(la.rightLeg) * 30;
        let rLegEndY = Math.cos(la.rightLeg) * 30;
        ctx.lineTo(rLegEndX, rLegEndY);
        ctx.stroke();

        // Kick/fist effect
        if (this.attackPhase === 1) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = glowColor;
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
            if (this.attackType === 'punch' || this.attackType === 'uppercut') {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(rArmEndX, rArmEndY, 15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.stroke();
            }
            if (this.attackType === 'kick') {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(rLegEndX, rLegEndY, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.stroke();
            }
            if (this.attackType === 'special') {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(rArmEndX, rArmEndY, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(lArmEndX, lArmEndY, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.stroke();
            }
            ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        }

        ctx.restore();
        ctx.restore();
    }
}

// Particles
function spawnHitParticles(x, y, type) {
    let count = type === 'special' ? 20 : type === 'kick' ? 12 : 8;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        particles.push({
            x: x,
            y: y,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * (type === 'special' ? 12 : 6),
            vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * (type === 'special' ? 12 : 6) - 2,
            life: 30 + Math.random() * 20,
            maxLife: 50,
            size: Math.random() * 4 + 2,
            color: type === 'special' ? `hsl(${Math.random() * 40 + 10}, 100%, 60%)` :
                   type === 'kick' ? '#ff6644' : '#ffaa44'
        });
    }
}

function spawnBlockSparks(x, y) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        particles.push({
            x: x,
            y: y,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
            vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
            life: 15 + Math.random() * 10,
            maxLife: 25,
            size: Math.random() * 3 + 1,
            color: '#88ccff'
        });
    }
}

// Create fighters
let player1 = new Fighter(300, 1, 'Player', '#1a1a2e');
let player2 = new Fighter(900, -1, 'AI', '#2e1a1a');

// Input handling
const keys = {};
const keysPressed = {};

document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (!keys[e.code]) keysPressed[e.code] = true;
    keys[e.code] = true;
    e.preventDefault();
});

document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    keys[e.code] = false;
    e.preventDefault();
});

// Touch controls
let touchControls = { left: false, right: false, up: false, down: false, punch: false, kick: false, block: false, special: false };

canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', handleTouch, { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouch, { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    touchControls = { left: false, right: false, up: false, down: false, punch: false, kick: false, block: false, special: false };
});

function handleTouch(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    touchControls = { left: false, right: false, up: false, down: false, punch: false, kick: false, block: false, special: false };
    for (let touch of e.touches) {
        let tx = touch.clientX / window.innerWidth;
        let ty = touch.clientY / window.innerHeight;
        if (tx < 0.15 && ty > 0.5) touchControls.left = true;
        if (tx > 0.85 && ty > 0.5) touchControls.right = true;
        if (ty < 0.3) touchControls.up = true;
        if (ty > 0.85 && ty < 0.95) touchControls.down = true;
        if (tx > 0.15 && tx < 0.35 && ty > 0.3 && ty < 0.85) touchControls.punch = true;
        if (tx > 0.35 && tx < 0.55 && ty > 0.3 && ty < 0.85) touchControls.kick = true;
        if (tx > 0.55 && tx < 0.75 && ty > 0.3 && ty < 0.85) touchControls.block = true;
        if (tx > 0.75 && tx < 0.85 && ty > 0.3 && ty < 0.85) touchControls.special = true;
    }
}

// AI Logic
function updateAI() {
    let dist = Math.abs(player2.x - player1.x);
    let facingPlayer = (player1.x < player2.x && player2.facing === -1) ||
                       (player1.x > player2.x && player2.facing === 1);

    // Face player
    if (!facingPlayer) player2.facing = player1.x < player2.x ? -1 : 1;

    if (player2.state === 'hitstun' || player2.blockStun > 0 || player2.knockdownTimer > 0) return;

    // Decision making
    let rand = Math.random();

    if (dist > 200) {
        // Approach
        player2.vx += player2.facing * 0.8;
        player2.state = 'walking';
        player2.isBlocking = false;
    } else if (dist > 80) {
        // Mid range
        if (rand < 0.03 && player2.energy >= 50) {
            player2.attack('special');
        } else if (rand < 0.08) {
            player2.attack('kick');
        } else if (rand < 0.15) {
            player2.attack('punch');
        } else if (rand < 0.2 && player1.state === 'attacking') {
            player2.isBlocking = true;
        } else {
            player2.vx += player2.facing * 0.5;
            player2.state = 'walking';
            player2.isBlocking = false;
        }
    } else {
        // Close range
        if (rand < 0.04 && player2.energy >= 50) {
            player2.attack('special');
        } else if (rand < 0.12) {
            player2.attack('uppercut');
        } else if (rand < 0.2) {
            player2.attack('kick');
        } else if (rand < 0.28) {
            player2.attack('punch');
        } else if (rand < 0.35) {
            player2.isBlocking = true;
        } else if (rand < 0.42) {
            player2.attack('sweep');
        } else {
            player2.isBlocking = false;
            if (rand < 0.5) {
                player2.vx -= player2.facing * 0.5;
            }
        }
    }

    // Jump occasionally
    if (rand < 0.02 && player2.isGrounded && dist < 150) {
        player2.vy = -12;
        player2.isGrounded = false;
    }
}

// Collision detection
function boxOverlap(a, b) {
    if (!a || !b) return false;
    return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
}

function checkAttacks(attacker, defender) {
    let atkBox = attacker.getAttackBox();
    let defBox = defender.getHitbox();

    if (atkBox && !attacker.attackHit && boxOverlap(atkBox, defBox)) {
        attacker.attackHit = true;

        let damage = attacker.attackType === 'punch' ? 8 :
                     attacker.attackType === 'kick' ? 12 :
                     attacker.attackType === 'uppercut' ? 15 :
                     attacker.attackType === 'sweep' ? 10 : 25;

        let idx = attacker === player1 ? 0 : 1;
        let now = Date.now();
        if (now - lastHitTime[idx] < 1500) {
            attacker.combo++;
            damage += attacker.combo * 2;
        } else {
            attacker.combo = 1;
        }
        lastHitTime[idx] = now;
        comboTimer[idx] = 90;

        defender.takeDamage(damage, attacker.x, attacker.attackType);
    }
}

// Drawing functions
function drawBackground() {
    // Sky gradient
    let grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0a1a');
    grad.addColorStop(0.4, '#1a1a3a');
    grad.addColorStop(0.7, '#2a1a2a');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#1a0a1a');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    // Stars
    for (let star of bgStars) {
        star.twinkle += star.speed;
        let alpha = 0.3 + Math.sin(star.twinkle) * 0.3;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha})`;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    }

    // Moon
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ddd';
    ctx.shadowColor = '#aaaaff';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 40;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(1000, 80, 40, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    // Buildings
    for (let b of bgBuildings) {
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(10, 10, 20, ${0.5 + b.shade})`;
        ctx.fillRect(b.x, canvas.height - 150 - b.height, b.width, b.height);

        // Windows
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 200, 100, ${0.1 + Math.random() * 0.05})`;
        for (let wy = canvas.height - 150 - b.height + 10; wy < canvas.height - 160; wy += 20) {
            for (let wx = b.x + 5; wx < b.x + b.width - 5; wx += 15) {
                if (Math.random() > 0.3) {
                    ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, 6, 8);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Ground
    let groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, canvas.height - 150, 0, canvas.height);
    groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a1a2e');
    groundGrad.addColorStop(0.3, '#151525');
    groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0a0a15');
    ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, canvas.height - 150, canvas.width, 150);

    // Ground line
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333355';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, canvas.height - 150);
    ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, canvas.height - 150);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Ground details
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(50, 50, 80, 0.3)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < canvas.width; i += 30) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(i, canvas.height - 150);
        ctx.lineTo(i + 15, canvas.height - 140);
        ctx.stroke();
    }
}

function drawHUD() {
    let barWidth = 400;
    let barHeight = 25;
    let barY = 30;
    let energyHeight = 8;

    // Player 1 health bar (left side)
    let p1x = 50;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
    ctx.fillRect(p1x, barY, barWidth, barHeight);
    let p1HealthW = (player1.health / player1.maxHealth) * barWidth;
    let p1HealthGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(p1x, 0, p1x + barWidth, 0);
    p1HealthGrad.addColorStop(0, '#44ff44');
    p1HealthGrad.addColorStop(1, '#22aa22');
    ctx.fillStyle = p1HealthGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(p1x, barY, p1HealthW, barHeight);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#666';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeRect(p1x, barY, barWidth, barHeight);

    // Player 1 energy bar
    ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
    ctx.fillRect(p1x, barY + barHeight + 5, barWidth, energyHeight);
    let p1EnergyW = (player1.energy / player1.maxEnergy) * barWidth;
    ctx.fillStyle = player1.energy >= 50 ? '#ffaa00' : '#ff6600';
    ctx.fillRect(p1x, barY + barHeight + 5, p1EnergyW, energyHeight);

    // Player 2 health bar (right side)
    let p2x = canvas.width - 50 - barWidth;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
    ctx.fillRect(p2x, barY, barWidth, barHeight);
    let p2HealthW = (player2.health / player2.maxHealth) * barWidth;
    let p2HealthGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(p2x, 0, p2x + barWidth, 0);
    p2HealthGrad.addColorStop(0, '#aa2222');
    p2HealthGrad.addColorStop(1, '#ff4444');
    ctx.fillStyle = p2HealthGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(p2x + barWidth - p2HealthW, barY, p2HealthW, barHeight);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#666';
    ctx.strokeRect(p2x, barY, barWidth, barHeight);

    // Player 2 energy bar
    ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
    ctx.fillRect(p2x, barY + barHeight + 5, barWidth, energyHeight);
    let p2EnergyW = (player2.energy / player2.maxEnergy) * barWidth;
    ctx.fillStyle = player2.energy >= 50 ? '#ffaa00' : '#ff6600';
    ctx.fillRect(p2x + barWidth - p2EnergyW, barY + barHeight + 5, p2EnergyW, energyHeight);

    // Names
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(player1.name, p1x, barY - 5);
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText(player2.name, p2x + barWidth, barY - 5);

    // Timer
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.font = 'bold 32px Arial';
    ctx.fillStyle = roundTimer <= 10 ? '#ff4444' : '#fff';
    ctx.fillText(Math.ceil(roundTimer).toString(), canvas.width / 2, barY + 22);

    // Round indicators
    ctx.font = '14px Arial';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
    ctx.fillText(`Round ${round}`, canvas.width / 2, barY + 40);

    // Win indicators
    for (let i = 0; i < maxRounds; i++) {
        // P1 wins
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p1x + barWidth + 15 + i * 20, barY + 12, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = i < roundWins[0] ? '#ffcc00' : '#444';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#666';
        ctx.stroke();

        // P2 wins
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p2x - 15 - i * 20, barY + 12, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = i < roundWins[1] ? '#ffcc00' : '#444';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#666';
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Combo display
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        if (comboCount[i] > 1 && comboTimer[i] > 0) {
            let cx = i === 0 ? 80 : canvas.width - 80;
            ctx.textAlign = i === 0 ? 'left' : 'right';
            ctx.font = 'bold 28px Arial';
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc00';
            ctx.shadowColor = '#ffcc00';
            ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
            ctx.fillText(`${comboCount[i]} HIT COMBO!`, cx, 120);
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        }
    }

    // Controls hint
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.font = '11px Arial';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
    ctx.fillText('A/D: Move | W: Jump | S: Crouch | J: Punch | K: Kick | L: Block | U: Special', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height - 15);
}

function drawMenu() {
    drawBackground();

    // Title
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.font = 'bold 72px Arial';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.shadowColor = '#ff6600';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 30;
    ctx.fillText('SHADOW FIGHT', canvas.width / 2, 200);
    ctx.font = 'bold 80px Arial';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6600';
    ctx.fillText('II', canvas.width / 2 + 200, 200);
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    // Subtitle
    ctx.font = '20px Arial';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
    ctx.fillText('A Shadow Style Fighting Game', canvas.width / 2, 240);

    // Animated fighters
    let t = Date.now() / 1000;
    let fighterY = canvas.height - 150;

    // Left fighter shadow
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(350, fighterY);
    ctx.scale(2, 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -95, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#1a1a2e';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -60);
    ctx.lineTo(0, -95);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -60);
    ctx.lineTo(Math.sin(t * 2) * 15, -40);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -60);
    ctx.lineTo(Math.sin(t * 2 + Math.PI) * 15, -40);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    // Right fighter shadow
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(850, fighterY);
    ctx.scale(2, 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2e1a1a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -95, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2e1a1a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -60);
    ctx.lineTo(0, -95);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -60);
    ctx.lineTo(Math.sin(t * 2 + Math.PI) * 15, -40);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -60);
    ctx.lineTo(Math.sin(t * 2) * 15, -40);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    // VS
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Arial';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4400';
    ctx.shadowColor = '#ff4400';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
    ctx.fillText('VS', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height - 200);
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    // Start prompt
    let pulse = Math.sin(t * 3) * 0.3 + 0.7;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.font = 'bold 28px Arial';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to Start', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height - 100);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // Controls
    ctx.font = '14px Arial';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
    ctx.fillText('A/D: Move | W: Jump | S: Crouch | J: Punch | K: Kick | L: Block | U: Special (50+ Energy)', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height - 50);
}

function drawCountdown() {
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.font = 'bold 80px Arial';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.shadowColor = '#ff6600';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 20;

    if (countdownTimer > 60) {
        ctx.fillText('3', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
    } else if (countdownTimer > 30) {
        ctx.fillText('2', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
    } else if (countdownTimer > 0) {
        ctx.fillText('1', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
    } else {
        ctx.fillText('FIGHT!', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
    }
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
}

function drawRoundEnd() {
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';

    let winner = roundWins[0] >= 2 ? player1.name : roundWins[1] >= 2 ? player2.name : null;

    if (winner) {
        ctx.font = 'bold 60px Arial';
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc00';
        ctx.shadowColor = '#ffcc00';
        ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
        ctx.fillText(`${winner} WINS!`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 30);
        ctx.font = '24px Arial';
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        ctx.fillText('Press ENTER for Rematch', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
    } else {
        ctx.font = 'bold 48px Arial';
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.shadowColor = '#ff6600';
        ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
        ctx.fillText('ROUND COMPLETE', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
        ctx.font = '24px Arial';
        ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        ctx.fillText('Press ENTER for Next Round', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
    }
}

// Main game loop
function update() {
    if (gameState === GAME_STATE.MENU) {
        if (keysPressed['Enter'] || keysPressed['Space']) {
            gameState = GAME_STATE.COUNTDOWN;
            countdownTimer = 90;
            player1.reset(300);
            player2.reset(900);
            roundWins = [0, 0];
            round = 1;
            roundTimer = 99;
            keysPressed['Enter'] = false;
            keysPressed['Space'] = false;
        }
        return;
    }

    if (gameState === GAME_STATE.COUNTDOWN) {
        countdownTimer--;
        if (countdownTimer <= 0) {
            gameState = GAME_STATE.FIGHT;
        }
        return;
    }

    if (gameState === GAME_STATE.ROUND_END) {
        let winner = roundWins[0] >= 2 ? player1.name : roundWins[1] >= 2 ? player2.name : null;
        if (keysPressed['Enter'] || keysPressed['Space']) {
            if (winner) {
                // Rematch
                gameState = GAME_STATE.COUNTDOWN;
                countdownTimer = 90;
                roundWins = [0, 0];
                round = 1;
                roundTimer = 99;
                player1.reset(300);
                player2.reset(900);
            } else {
                // Next round
                round++;
                roundTimer = 99;
                gameState = GAME_STATE.COUNTDOWN;
                countdownTimer = 90;
                player1.reset(300);
                player2.reset(900);
            }
            keysPressed['Enter'] = false;
            keysPressed['Space'] = false;
        }
        return;
    }

    // Slow motion
    if (slowMotion > 0) {
        slowMotion--;
        slowMotionFactor = 0.3;
    } else {
        slowMotionFactor = 1;
    }

    // Timer
    timerCounter++;
    if (timerCounter >= 60) {
        timerCounter = 0;
        roundTimer--;
        if (roundTimer <= 0) {
            roundTimer = 0;
            // Time's up - whoever has more health wins
            if (player1.health > player2.health) {
                roundWins[0]++;
            } else if (player2.health > player1.health) {
                roundWins[1]++;
            } else {
                // Draw - both get a point
                roundWins[0]++;
                roundWins[1]++;
            }
            playKOSound();
            gameState = GAME_STATE.ROUND_END;
            return;
        }
    }

    // Player 1 input
    if (player1.hitStun <= 0 && player1.blockStun <= 0 && player1.knockdownTimer <= 0 && player1.state !== 'attacking') {
        let moveSpeed = 0.7;

        if (keys['KeyA'] || touchControls.left) {
            player1.vx -= moveSpeed;
            player1.state = 'walking';
        } else if (keys['KeyD'] || touchControls.right) {
            player1.vx += moveSpeed;
            player1.state = 'walking';
        } else {
            player1.state = 'idle';
        }

        player1.isCrouching = (keys['KeyS'] || touchControls.down) && player1.isGrounded;
        if (player1.isCrouching) {
            player1.state = 'crouching';
            player1.vx *= 0.5;
        }

        if ((keys['KeyW'] || touchControls.up) && player1.isGrounded) {
            player1.vy = -13;
            player1.isGrounded = false;
        }

        player1.isBlocking = keys['KeyL'] || touchControls.block;

        if (keysPressed['KeyJ'] || touchControls.punch) {
            player1.attack('punch');
            keysPressed['KeyJ'] = false;
            touchControls.punch = false;
        }
        if (keysPressed['KeyK'] || touchControls.kick) {
            player1.attack('kick');
            keysPressed['KeyK'] = false;
            touchControls.kick = false;
        }
        if (keysPressed['KeyU'] || touchControls.special) {
            player1.attack('special');
            keysPressed['KeyU'] = false;
            touchControls.special = false;
        }
    }

    // Update fighters
    player1.update(player2);
    player2.update(player1);
    updateAI();

    // Face each other
    if (player1.state !== 'hitstun' && player1.state !== 'attacking') {
        player1.facing = player2.x > player1.x ? 1 : -1;
    }
    if (player2.state !== 'hitstun' && player2.state !== 'attacking') {
        player2.facing = player1.x > player2.x ? 1 : -1;
    }

    // Check attacks
    checkAttacks(player1, player2);
    checkAttacks(player2, player1);

    // Update combo counts
    comboCount[0] = player1.combo;
    comboCount[1] = player2.combo;

    // Check KO
    if (player1.health <= 0 || player2.health <= 0) {
        if (player1.health <= 0) roundWins[1]++;
        if (player2.health <= 0) roundWins[0]++;
        playKOSound();
        screenShake = 20;
        gameState = GAME_STATE.ROUND_END;
    }

    // Update particles
    particles = particles.filter(p => {
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;
        p.vy += 0.15;
        p.life--;
        p.vx *= 0.98;
        return p.life > 0;
    });

    // Screen shake decay
    if (screenShake > 0) screenShake *= 0.9;
    if (screenShake < 0.5) screenShake = 0;

    // Clear pressed keys
    for (let key in keysPressed) {
        keysPressed[key] = false;
    }
}

function draw() {
    ctx.save();

    // Screen shake
    if (screenShake > 0) {
        ctx.translate(
            (Math.random() - 0.5) * screenShake * 2,
            (Math.random() - 0.5) * screenShake * 2
        );
    }

    if (gameState === GAME_STATE.MENU) {
        drawMenu();
        ctx.restore();
        return;
    }

    drawBackground();

    // Draw particles
    for (let p of particles) {
        let alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
        ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
        ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
        ctx.shadowColor = p.color;
        ctx.shadowBlur = 5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    // Draw fighters
    player1.draw();
    player2.draw();

    // Draw HUD
    drawHUD();

    // Draw countdown
    if (gameState === GAME_STATE.COUNTDOWN) {
        drawCountdown();
    }

    // Draw round end
    if (gameState === GAME_STATE.ROUND_END) {
        drawRoundEnd();
    }

    ctx.restore();
}

function gameLoop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

gameLoop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Escape the Murderers!</title>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
body {
background: #0a0a1a;
display: flex;
justify-content: center;
align-items: center;
height: 100vh;
overflow: hidden;
font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
}
canvas {
border: 3px solid #333;
border-radius: 8px;
box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.3);
cursor: none;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

canvas.width = 900;
canvas.height = 600;

// Game state
let gameState = 'menu'; // menu, playing, gameover
let score = 0;
let highScore = 0;
let gameTime = 0;
let difficulty = 1;
let screenShake = 0;
let particles = [];
let bloodParticles = [];
let stars = [];
let obstacles = [];
let powerUps = [];
let comboCount = 0;
let lastDodgeTime = 0;
let flashEffect = 0;
let warningTimer = 0;

// Generate stars
for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
    stars.push({
        x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
        y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
        size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
        twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
}

// Generate obstacles
function generateObstacles() {
    obstacles = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        obstacles.push({
            x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - 100) + 50,
            y: Math.random() * (canvas.height - 100) + 50,
            w: Math.random() * 40 + 30,
            h: Math.random() * 40 + 30,
            type: Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'rock' : 'barrel'
        });
    }
}

// Player
const player = {
    x: canvas.width / 2,
    y: canvas.height / 2,
    w: 30,
    h: 35,
    speed: 3.5,
    vx: 0,
    vy: 0,
    facing: 1,
    frame: 0,
    frameTimer: 0,
    stamina: 100,
    isSprinting: false,
    invincible: 0,
    trail: [],
    alive: true,
    dodgeCooldown: 0
};

// Enemies
let enemies = [];
let enemySpawnTimer = 0;
let maxEnemies = 3;

class Enemy {
    constructor(type) {
        this.type = type || 'normal';
        this.w = 28;
        this.h = 38;
        this.frame = 0;
        this.frameTimer = 0;
        this.speed = 1.2 + Math.random() * 0.5 + difficulty * 0.15;
        this.alive = true;
        this.attackCooldown = 0;
        this.angle = 0;
        this.swordAngle = 0;

        // Spawn from edges
        const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
        switch(side) {
            case 0: this.x = -30; this.y = Math.random() * canvas.height; break;
            case 1: this.x = canvas.width + 30; this.y = Math.random() * canvas.height; break;
            case 2: this.x = Math.random() * canvas.width; this.y = -30; break;
            case 3: this.x = Math.random() * canvas.width; this.y = canvas.height + 30; break;
        }

        if (this.type === 'fast') {
            this.speed *= 1.5;
            this.w = 24;
            this.h = 32;
        } else if (this.type === 'big') {
            this.speed *= 0.7;
            this.w = 36;
            this.h = 44;
        }
    }

    update() {
        if (!this.alive) return;

        let dx = player.x - this.x;
        let dy = player.y - this.y;
        let dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

        if (dist > 0) {
            this.x += (dx / dist) * this.speed;
            this.y += (dy / dist) * this.speed;
        }

        this.facing = dx > 0 ? 1 : -1;
        this.angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);

        // Attack animation
        if (dist < 50) {
            this.attackCooldown++;
            this.swordAngle = Math.sin(this.attackCooldown * 0.1) * 0.8;
        } else {
            this.swordAngle = 0;
        }

        // Collision with player
        if (dist < 30 && player.invincible <= 0) {
            playerHit();
        }

        // Collision with obstacles
        for (let obs of obstacles) {
            if (this.x > obs.x - obs.w/2 - this.w/2 &&
                this.x < obs.x + obs.w/2 + this.w/2 &&
                this.y > obs.y - obs.h/2 - this.h/2 &&
                this.y < obs.y + obs.h/2 + this.h/2) {
                // Bounce off obstacles
                let ox = this.x - obs.x;
                let oy = this.y - obs.y;
                if (Math.abs(ox / obs.w) > Math.abs(oy / obs.h)) {
                    this.x += Math.sign(ox) * 2;
                } else {
                    this.y += Math.sign(oy) * 2;
                }
            }
        }

        this.frameTimer++;
        if (this.frameTimer > 8) {
            this.frame = (this.frame + 1) % 4;
            this.frameTimer = 0;
        }
    }

    draw() {
        if (!this.alive) return;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);

        const bobY = Math.sin(this.frame * Math.PI / 2) * 3;

        // Shadow
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, this.h/2 + 5, 15, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Body
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
        ctx.fillRect(-this.w/2, -this.h/2 + bobY, this.w, this.h);

        // Dark cloak
        ctx.fillStyle = '#0d0d1a';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-this.w/2 - 5, this.h/2 + bobY);
        ctx.lineTo(-this.w/2 + 3, -this.h/2 + bobY);
        ctx.lineTo(this.w/2 - 3, -this.h/2 + bobY);
        ctx.lineTo(this.w/2 + 5, this.h/2 + bobY);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();

        // Head
        ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2a3e';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -this.h/2 + 5 + bobY, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Glowing red eyes
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0000';
        ctx.shadowColor = '#ff0000';
        ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(-4, -this.h/2 + 3 + bobY, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.arc(4, -this.h/2 + 3 + bobY, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

        // Sword arm
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(this.facing * 12, -this.h/2 + 15 + bobY);
        ctx.rotate(this.swordAngle);
        // Arm
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
        ctx.fillRect(0, -3, 15 * this.facing, 6);
        // Sword
        ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
        ctx.fillRect(10 * this.facing, -2, 20 * this.facing, 4);
        // Sword tip
        ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(30 * this.facing, -2);
        ctx.lineTo(35 * this.facing, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(30 * this.facing, 2);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        // Blood on sword
        ctx.fillStyle = '#8b0000';
        ctx.fillRect(15 * this.facing, -1, 8 * this.facing, 2);
        ctx.restore();

        // Legs animation
        const legOffset = Math.sin(this.frame * Math.PI / 2) * 5;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
        ctx.fillRect(-8, this.h/2 - 5 + bobY, 6, 8 + legOffset);
        ctx.fillRect(2, this.h/2 - 5 + bobY, 6, 8 - legOffset);

        ctx.restore();
    }
}

// Power-up class
class PowerUp {
    constructor() {
        this.x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - 60) + 30;
        this.y = Math.random() * (canvas.height - 60) + 30;
        this.type = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'shield' : 'speed';
        this.life = 600;
        this.pulse = 0;
    }

    update() {
        this.life--;
        this.pulse += 0.05;
    }

    draw() {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);

        const glow = Math.sin(this.pulse) * 0.3 + 0.7;
        ctx.globalAlpha = glow;

        if (this.type === 'shield') {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#4488ff';
            ctx.shadowColor = '#4488ff';
            ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(0, 0, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = '14px Arial';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('🛡', 0, 5);
        } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#44ff44';
            ctx.shadowColor = '#44ff44';
            ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(0, 0, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = '14px Arial';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('⚡', 0, 5);
        }

        ctx.restore();
    }
}

// Particle system
function createParticles(x, y, color, count, speed) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        particles.push({
            x: x,
            y: y,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed,
            vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed,
            life: 30 + Math.random() * 20,
            maxLife: 50,
            color: color,
            size: Math.random() * 4 + 1
        });
    }
}

function createBloodParticles(x, y) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
        bloodParticles.push({
            x: x,
            y: y,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
            vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
            life: 40 + Math.random() * 30,
            maxLife: 70,
            size: Math.random() * 5 + 2,
            gravity: 0.15
        });
    }
}

function playerHit() {
    if (player.invincible > 0) return;

    player.invincible = 60;
    screenShake = 15;
    flashEffect = 10;
    createBloodParticles(player.x, player.y);
    createParticles(player.x, player.y, '#ff4444', 10, 5);

    // Push player away
    let dx = player.x - enemies[0].x;
    let dy = player.y - enemies[0].y;
    let dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
    if (dist > 0) {
        player.x += (dx/dist) * 30;
        player.y += (dy/dist) * 30;
    }

    // Keep player in bounds
    player.x = Math.max(20, Math.min(canvas.width - 20, player.x));
    player.y = Math.max(20, Math.min(canvas.height - 20, player.y));
}

// Input handling
const keys = {};
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
    if (e.key === ' ' && gameState === 'playing') {
        tryDodge();
    }
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        if (gameState === 'menu') startGame();
        else if (gameState === 'gameover') { gameState = 'menu'; }
    }
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
});

function tryDodge() {
    if (player.dodgeCooldown > 0 || player.stamina < 20) return;
    player.dodgeCooldown = 30;
    player.stamina -= 20;
    player.invincible = 15;

    let dx = 0, dy = 0;
    if (keys['w'] || keys['arrowup']) dy = -1;
    if (keys['s'] || keys['arrowdown']) dy = 1;
    if (keys['a'] || keys['arrowleft']) dx = -1;
    if (keys['d'] || keys['arrowright']) dx = 1;

    if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) dx = player.facing;

    let dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
    if (dist > 0) {
        player.x += (dx/dist) * 60;
        player.y += (dy/dist) * 60;
    }

    createParticles(player.x, player.y, '#aaddff', 8, 4);
    screenShake = 5;
}

function startGame() {
    gameState = 'playing';
    score = 0;
    gameTime = 0;
    difficulty = 1;
    player.x = canvas.width / 2;
    player.y = canvas.height / 2;
    player.alive = true;
    player.invincible = 60;
    player.stamina = 100;
    player.dodgeCooldown = 0;
    player.trail = [];
    enemies = [];
    particles = [];
    bloodParticles = [];
    powerUps = [];
    enemySpawnTimer = 0;
    maxEnemies = 3;
    generateObstacles();
}

function spawnEnemy() {
    const types = ['normal', 'normal', 'normal', 'fast', 'big'];
    if (difficulty > 3) types.push('fast', 'big');
    if (difficulty > 5) types.push('big', 'big');

    const type = types[Math.floor(Math.random() * types.length)];
    enemies.push(new Enemy(type));
}

function update() {
    if (gameState !== 'playing') return;

    gameTime++;
    score = Math.floor(gameTime / 6);
    difficulty = 1 + Math.floor(gameTime / 600);

    // Increase max enemies over time
    maxEnemies = Math.min(3 + Math.floor(gameTime / 300), 15);

    // Spawn enemies
    enemySpawnTimer++;
    let spawnRate = Math.max(60, 180 - difficulty * 15);
    if (enemySpawnTimer >= spawnRate && enemies.length < maxEnemies) {
        spawnEnemy();
        enemySpawnTimer = 0;
    }

    // Spawn power-ups
    if (Math.random() < 0.001 && powerUps.length < 2) {
        powerUps.push(new PowerUp());
    }

    // Player movement
    let moveX = 0, moveY = 0;
    if (keys['w'] || keys['arrowup']) moveY = -1;
    if (keys['s'] || keys['arrowdown']) moveY = 1;
    if (keys['a'] || keys['arrowleft']) moveX = -1;
    if (keys['d'] || keys['arrowright']) moveX = 1;

    player.isSprinting = keys['shift'] && player.stamina > 0;
    let currentSpeed = player.isSprinting ? player.speed * 1.6 : player.speed;

    if (player.isSprinting) {
        player.stamina = Math.max(0, player.stamina - 0.3);
    } else {
        player.stamina = Math.min(100, player.stamina + 0.15);
    }

    if (moveX !== 0 || moveY !== 0) {
        let len = Math.sqrt(moveX * moveX + moveY * moveY);
        player.vx = (moveX / len) * currentSpeed;
        player.vy = (moveY / len) * currentSpeed;

        if (moveX !== 0) player.facing = moveX > 0 ? 1 : -1;

        // Animation
        player.frameTimer++;
        if (player.frameTimer > 6) {
            player.frame = (player.frame + 1) % 4;
            player.frameTimer = 0;
        }
    } else {
        player.vx *= 0.8;
        player.vy *= 0.8;
    }

    // Apply movement
    let newX = player.x + player.vx;
    let newY = player.y + player.vy;

    // Obstacle collision for player
    let canMoveX = true, canMoveY = true;
    for (let obs of obstacles) {
        if (newX > obs.x - obs.w/2 - 15 && newX < obs.x + obs.w/2 + 15 &&
            player.y > obs.y - obs.h/2 - 15 && player.y < obs.y + obs.h/2 + 15) {
            canMoveX = false;
        }
        if (player.x > obs.x - obs.w/2 - 15 && player.x < obs.x + obs.w/2 + 15 &&
            newY > obs.y - obs.h/2 - 15 && newY < obs.y + obs.h/2 + 15) {
            canMoveY = false;
        }
    }

    if (canMoveX) player.x = Math.max(15, Math.min(canvas.width - 15, newX));
    if (canMoveY) player.y = Math.max(15, Math.min(canvas.height - 15, newY));

    // Trail
    player.trail.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y, life: 15 });
    if (player.trail.length > 15) player.trail.shift();

    // Invincibility
    if (player.invincible > 0) player.invincible--;
    if (player.dodgeCooldown > 0) player.dodgeCooldown--;

    // Update enemies
    for (let enemy of enemies) {
        enemy.update();
    }

    // Remove dead enemies
    enemies = enemies.filter(e => e.alive);

    // Update particles
    particles = particles.filter(p => {
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;
        p.life--;
        p.vx *= 0.95;
        p.vy *= 0.95;
        return p.life > 0;
    });

    bloodParticles = bloodParticles.filter(p => {
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;
        p.vy += p.gravity;
        p.life--;
        p.vx *= 0.98;
        p.vy *= 0.98;
        return p.life > 0;
    });

    // Update power-ups
    powerUps = powerUps.filter(p => {
        p.update();
        let dx = player.x - p.x;
        let dy = player.y - p.y;
        let dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
        if (dist < 25) {
            if (p.type === 'shield') {
                player.invincible = 180;
                createParticles(player.x, player.y, '#4488ff', 20, 6);
            } else {
                player.speed += 0.5;
                setTimeout(() => { player.speed = 3.5; }, 5000);
                createParticles(player.x, player.y, '#44ff44', 20, 6);
            }
            return false;
        }
        return p.life > 0;
    });

    // Screen shake decay
    if (screenShake > 0) screenShake *= 0.85;
    if (flashEffect > 0) flashEffect--;

    // Update stars
    for (let star of stars) {
        star.twinkle += 0.02;
    }
}

function drawPlayer() {
    if (!player.alive) return;

    ctx.save();

    // Trail effect
    for (let i = 0; i < player.trail.length; i++) {
        let t = player.trail[i];
        let alpha = (i / player.trail.length) * 0.3;
        ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffaa44';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    ctx.translate(player.x, player.y);

    const bobY = Math.sin(player.frame * Math.PI / 2) * 2;
    const blink = player.invincible > 0 && Math.floor(player.invincible / 4) % 2;

    if (blink) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;
    }

    // Shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 20, 14, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Legs
    const legAnim = Math.sin(player.frame * Math.PI / 2) * 4;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3366cc';
    ctx.fillRect(-7, 8 + bobY, 6, 12 + legAnim);
    ctx.fillRect(1, 8 + bobY, 6, 12 - legAnim);

    // Shoes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#553322';
    ctx.fillRect(-8, 18 + bobY + legAnim, 8, 4);
    ctx.fillRect(0, 18 + bobY - legAnim, 8, 4);

    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6633';
    ctx.fillRect(-10, -8 + bobY, 20, 18);

    // Shirt detail
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8844';
    ctx.fillRect(-8, -5 + bobY, 16, 4);

    // Backpack (puppy-like)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cc5522';
    ctx.fillRect(-12, -5 + bobY, 5, 12);
    // Backpack ear
    ctx.fillStyle = '#dd6633';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-10, -8 + bobY, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Arms
    const armAnim = Math.sin(player.frame * Math.PI / 2) * 6;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc88';
    ctx.fillRect(-14, -4 + bobY + armAnim, 5, 10);
    ctx.fillRect(9, -4 + bobY - armAnim, 5, 10);

    // Head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc88';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -14 + bobY, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Hair
    ctx.fillStyle = '#553311';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -18 + bobY, 10, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Hair tuft
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-3, -26 + bobY);
    ctx.lineTo(0, -30 + bobY);
    ctx.lineTo(3, -26 + bobY);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();

    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-4, -15 + bobY, 3.5, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.ellipse(4, -15 + bobY, 3.5, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Pupils
    ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-3.5 + player.facing, -14.5 + bobY, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(4.5 + player.facing, -14.5 + bobY, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Eye shine
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-2.5 + player.facing, -15.5 + bobY, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(5.5 + player.facing, -15.5 + bobY, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Mouth (scared expression)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cc4444';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -9 + bobY, 3, 0, Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();

    // Cheeks (blush)
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,100,100,0.4)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-8, -11 + bobY, 3, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.ellipse(8, -11 + bobY, 3, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Puppy ears on head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#553311';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-9, -20 + bobY, 4, 6, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(9, -20 + bobY, 4, 6, 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Inner ears
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffaa88';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-9, -20 + bobY, 2, 4, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(9, -20 + bobY, 2, 4, 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
}

function draw() {
    ctx.save();

    // Screen shake
    if (screenShake > 0.5) {
        ctx.translate(
            (Math.random() - 0.5) * screenShake,
            (Math.random() - 0.5) * screenShake
        );
    }

    // Background
    const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
    gradient.addColorStop(0, '#0a0a1a');
    gradient.addColorStop(0.5, '#1a1a2e');
    gradient.addColorStop(1, '#16213e');
    ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
    ctx.fillRect(-10, -10, canvas.width + 20, canvas.height + 20);

    // Stars
    for (let star of stars) {
        let alpha = 0.3 + Math.sin(star.twinkle) * 0.3;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha})`;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    }

    // Ground pattern
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let x = 0; x < canvas.width; x += 40) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(x, canvas.height);
        ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (let y = 0; y < canvas.height; y += 40) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, y);
        ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, y);
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Obstacles
    for (let obs of obstacles) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(obs.x, obs.y);

        if (obs.type === 'rock') {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#444455';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(-obs.w/2, obs.h/2);
            ctx.lineTo(-obs.w/2 + 5, -obs.h/2);
            ctx.lineTo(obs.w/2 - 5, -obs.h/2 + 3);
            ctx.lineTo(obs.w/2, obs.h/2);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#555566';
            ctx.fillRect(-obs.w/2 + 3, -obs.h/2 + 2, obs.w - 6, 3);
        } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#664422';
            ctx.fillRect(-obs.w/2, -obs.h/2, obs.w, obs.h);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#775533';
            ctx.fillRect(-obs.w/2 + 2, -obs.h/2 + 2, obs.w - 4, obs.h - 4);
            // Barrel bands
            ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
            ctx.fillRect(-obs.w/2, -obs.h/4, obs.w, 3);
            ctx.fillRect(-obs.w/2, obs.h/4, obs.w, 3);
        }
        ctx.restore();
    }

    // Power-ups
    for (let p of powerUps) {
        p.draw();
    }

    // Blood particles
    for (let p of bloodParticles) {
        let alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(139, 0, 0, ${alpha})`;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    }

    // Particles
    for (let p of particles) {
        let alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
        ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
        ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // Enemies
    for (let enemy of enemies) {
        enemy.draw();
    }

    // Player
    drawPlayer();

    // Flash effect
    if (flashEffect > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 0, 0, ${flashEffect * 0.05})`;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    }

    // HUD
    if (gameState === 'playing') {
        // Score
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        ctx.fillText(`⏱ ${Math.floor(gameTime / 60)}s`, 15, 30);
        ctx.fillText(`⭐ ${score}`, 15, 55);

        // Stamina bar
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
        ctx.fillRect(15, 65, 120, 12);
        const staminaColor = player.stamina > 30 ? '#44ff44' : '#ff4444';
        ctx.fillStyle = staminaColor;
        ctx.fillRect(15, 65, player.stamina, 12);
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.strokeRect(15, 65, 120, 12);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.font = '10px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('STAMINA', 45, 75);

        // Dodge cooldown indicator
        if (player.dodgeCooldown > 0) {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
            ctx.font = '12px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
            ctx.fillText('DODGE: COOLDOWN', 15, 95);
        } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,200,255,0.7)';
            ctx.font = '12px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
            ctx.fillText('DODGE: SPACE', 15, 95);
        }

        // Enemy count
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6666';
        ctx.font = '14px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'right';
        ctx.fillText(`☠ Enemies: ${enemies.length}`, canvas.width - 15, 30);

        // Difficulty warning
        if (difficulty > 1) {
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, ${Math.random() > 0.5 ? 100 : 200}, 0, ${0.5 + Math.sin(gameTime * 0.1) * 0.3})`;
            ctx.font = 'bold 16px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(`⚠ WARNING: Difficulty Level ${difficulty} ⚠`, canvas.width / 2, 30);
        }

        // Minimap-style enemy indicators
        for (let enemy of enemies) {
            let dx = enemy.x - player.x;
            let dy = enemy.y - player.y;
            let dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
            if (dist < 200) {
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 0, 0, ${1 - dist/200})`;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(enemy.x, enemy.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            }
        }
    }

    // Menu screen
    if (gameState === 'menu') {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        // Title
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
        ctx.font = 'bold 48px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.shadowColor = '#ff0000';
        ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
        ctx.fillText('🐶 ESCAPE! 🐶', canvas.width / 2, 180);
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffaa44';
        ctx.font = '22px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('A puppy boy is being chased by murderers!', canvas.width / 2, 230);

        // Instructions
        ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
        ctx.font = '16px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('🎮 WASD / Arrow Keys to move', canvas.width / 2, 300);
        ctx.fillText('🏃 SHIFT to sprint', canvas.width / 2, 325);
        ctx.fillText('💨 SPACE to dodge roll', canvas.width / 2, 350);

        // Start prompt
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 100, ${0.5 + Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.005) * 0.5})`;
        ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('Press ENTER or SPACE to Start', canvas.width / 2, 430);

        if (highScore > 0) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
            ctx.font = '18px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
            ctx.fillText(`High Score: ${highScore}`, canvas.width / 2, 470);
        }

        // Animated puppy
        const puppyBob = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.005) * 5;
        ctx.font = '60px Arial';
        ctx.fillText('🐶', canvas.width / 2, 130 + puppyBob);
    }

    // Game Over screen
    if (gameState === 'gameover') {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75)';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0000';
        ctx.font = 'bold 52px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.shadowColor = '#ff0000';
        ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
        ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', canvas.width / 2, 200);
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc44';
        ctx.font = '28px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText(`You survived ${Math.floor(gameTime / 60)} seconds!`, canvas.width / 2, 260);

        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.font = '24px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, canvas.width / 2, 300);

        if (score >= highScore) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#44ff44';
            ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
            ctx.fillText('🏆 NEW HIGH SCORE! 🏆', canvas.width / 2, 340);
        }

        ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
        ctx.font = '18px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText(`High Score: ${highScore}`, canvas.width / 2, 375);

        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 100, ${0.5 + Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.005) * 0.5})`;
        ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('Press ENTER to Continue', canvas.width / 2, 440);

        // Sad puppy
        ctx.font = '50px Arial';
        const sadBob = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.003) * 3;
        ctx.fillText('😢', canvas.width / 2, 400 + sadBob);
    }

    ctx.restore();
}

function gameOver() {
    gameState = 'gameover';
    if (score > highScore) highScore = score;
    createBloodParticles(player.x, player.y);
    createParticles(player.x, player.y, '#ff0000', 30, 8);
    screenShake = 20;
    flashEffect = 20;
}

// Override playerHit to include game over check
const originalPlayerHit = playerHit;
playerHit = function() {
    if (player.invincible > 0) return;

    player.invincible = 90;
    screenShake = 20;
    flashEffect = 15;
    createBloodParticles(player.x, player.y);
    createParticles(player.x, player.y, '#ff4444', 15, 6);

    let dx = player.x - enemies[0].x;
    let dy = player.y - enemies[0].y;
    let dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
    if (dist > 0) {
        player.x += (dx/dist) * 40;
        player.y += (dy/dist) * 40;
    }

    player.x = Math.max(20, Math.min(canvas.width - 20, player.x));
    player.y = Math.max(20, Math.min(canvas.height - 20, player.y));

    // Game over on hit
    gameOver();
};

// Game loop
function gameLoop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

gameLoop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
