<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="it">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>El Héros de Tunis - Platform Avventura</title>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
body { background: #1a0a2e; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; min-height: 100vh; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }
canvas { display: block; image-rendering: auto; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(255,170,0,0.3); }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = 960, H = 540;
canvas.width = W; canvas.height = H;

// Audio Context
let audioCtx;
function initAudio() {
    if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
}

function playTone(freq, dur, type='square', vol=0.1) {
    if (!audioCtx) return;
    const o = audioCtx.createOscillator();
    const g = audioCtx.createGain();
    o.type = type;
    o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, audioCtx.currentTime);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
    o.connect(g); g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    o.start(); o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
}

function playJump() { playTone(400, 0.15, 'square', 0.08); setTimeout(()=>playTone(600, 0.1, 'square', 0.06), 50); }
function playCoin() { playTone(880, 0.1, 'square', 0.07); setTimeout(()=>playTone(1100, 0.15, 'square', 0.06), 80); }
function playHit() { playTone(150, 0.3, 'sawtooth', 0.1); }
function playDash() { playTone(200, 0.2, 'sawtooth', 0.06); setTimeout(()=>playTone(300, 0.1, 'sawtooth', 0.04), 50); }
function playAttack() { playTone(300, 0.1, 'square', 0.08); setTimeout(()=>playTone(500, 0.15, 'square', 0.06), 40); }
function playPowerUp() { [0,80,160,240].forEach((d,i)=>setTimeout(()=>playTone(500+i*100, 0.15, 'square', 0.06), d)); }
function playCheckpoint() { [0,100,200].forEach((d,i)=>setTimeout(()=>playTone(440+i*110, 0.2, 'triangle', 0.08), d)); }
function playBossHit() { playTone(100, 0.4, 'sawtooth', 0.12); }
function playDeath() { [0,150,300].forEach((d,i)=>setTimeout(()=>playTone(300-i*80, 0.3, 'sawtooth', 0.1), d)); }
function playWin() { [0,100,200,300,400,500].forEach((d,i)=>setTimeout(()=>playTone(440+i*80, 0.25, 'triangle', 0.08), d)); }

// Music
let musicInterval;
const scales = [293.66, 329.63, 369.99, 415.30, 466.16, 523.25, 587.33, 659.25];
const arabicScale = [293.66, 311.13, 349.23, 369.99, 415.30, 440.00, 466.16, 523.25];
function startMusic() {
    if (musicInterval) clearInterval(musicInterval);
    let note = 0;
    musicInterval = setInterval(() => {
        if (gameState !== 'PLAYING') return;
        const freq = arabicScale[note % arabicScale.length];
        playTone(freq, 0.3, 'triangle', 0.03);
        if (note % 4 === 0) playTone(freq * 0.5, 0.4, 'sine', 0.02);
        note++;
    }, 350);
}
function stopMusic() { if (musicInterval) { clearInterval(musicInterval); musicInterval = null; } }

// Game State
let gameState = 'MENU';
let currentLevel = 0;
let lives = 3;
let coins = 0;
let score = 0;
let checkpoint = null;
let screenShake = 0;
let sandstormTimer = 0;
let sandstormActive = false;
let levelTransition = 0;
let levelTransitionText = '';
let particles = [];
let frameCount = 0;

// Input
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.code] = true; e.preventDefault(); });
window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; e.preventDefault(); });

// Player
const player = {
    x: 50, y: 300, w: 32, h: 48, vx: 0, vy: 0,
    onGround: false, facing: 1,
    jumpHeld: false, canJump: true,
    dashTimer: 0, dashCooldown: 0, dashDir: 1,
    attackTimer: 0, attackCooldown: 0,
    invincible: 0, shieldTimer: 0,
    baboucheBoost: 0, doubleJump: false,
    animFrame: 0, animTimer: 0,
    dead: false, respawnTimer: 0
};

// Camera
const camera = { x: 0, y: 0 };

// Level definitions
const LEVELS = [
    { // Level 1: Medina
        name: "La Medina",
        bgColor1: '#FFD4A0', bgColor2: '#FF8C42',
        groundColor: '#C4956A', platformColor: '#A07850',
        archColor: '#8B6914', skyColor: '#FF9944',
        length: 4000,
        sandstorm: false,
        generate() {
            const platforms = [];
            const enemies = [];
            const collectibles = [];
            const obstacles = [];
            const powerups = [];
            const decorations = [];

            // Ground
            for (let x = 0; x < 4000; x += 200) {
                if (Math.random() < 0.15 && x > 400 && x < 3600) {
                    // Gap
                    platforms.push({ x: x, y: 480, w: 140, h: 60, type: 'ground' });
                    platforms.push({ x: x + 160, y: 480, w: 140, h: 60, type: 'ground' });
                } else {
                    platforms.push({ x: x, y: 480, w: 200, h: 60, type: 'ground' });
                }
            }

            // Platforms
            for (let i = 0; i < 35; i++) {
                const px = 300 + Math.random() * 3500;
                const py = 250 + Math.random() * 180;
                const pw = 80 + Math.random() * 120;
                platforms.push({ x: px, y: py, w: pw, h: 20, type: 'platform' });
            }

            // Moving platforms
            for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                const px = 500 + Math.random() * 3000;
                const py = 200 + Math.random() * 200;
                platforms.push({
                    x: px, y: py, w: 100, h: 20, type: 'moving',
                    startX: px, startY: py,
                    moveX: Math.random() < 0.5 ? 100 + Math.random() * 80 : 0,
                    moveY: Math.random() < 0.5 ? 50 + Math.random() * 60 : 0,
                    speed: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1,
                    phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
                });
            }

            // Sliding carpets
            for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                const px = 600 + i * 700;
                platforms.push({
                    x: px, y: 350, w: 120, h: 15, type: 'carpet',
                    speed: 2 + Math.random(), dir: 1
                });
            }

            // Arch decorations
            for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
                decorations.push({
                    x: 200 + i * 320, y: 320, type: 'arch'
                });
            }

            // Crates
            for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
                obstacles.push({
                    x: 400 + Math.random() * 3400, y: 440, w: 40, h: 40,
                    type: 'crate', vx: 0
                });
            }

            // Enemies
            for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
                const ex = 400 + Math.random() * 3500;
                const etype = Math.random();
                if (etype < 0.4) {
                    enemies.push({ x: ex, y: 440, w: 30, h: 25, type: 'scarab', vx: 1, hp: 1, alive: true, animTimer: 0 });
                } else if (etype < 0.7) {
                    enemies.push({ x: ex, y: 200 + Math.random() * 150, w: 35, h: 25, type: 'pigeon', vx: 0.8, vy: 0, hp: 1, alive: true, animTimer: 0, flyPhase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 });
                } else {
                    enemies.push({ x: ex, y: 440, w: 35, h: 50, type: 'bandit', vx: 0.6, hp: 2, alive: true, animTimer: 0, patrolStart: ex - 100, patrolEnd: ex + 100 });
                }
            }

            // Coins
            for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
                collectibles.push({
                    x: 200 + Math.random() * 3600, y: 200 + Math.random() * 250,
                    type: 'coin', collected: false, bobPhase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
                });
            }

            // Checkpoints
            collectibles.push({ x: 1000, y: 400, type: 'checkpoint', collected: false, active: true });
            collectibles.push({ x: 2500, y: 400, type: 'checkpoint', collected: false, active: true });

            // Power-ups
            powerups.push({ x: 800, y: 300, type: 'babouche', collected: false, bobPhase: 0 });
            powerups.push({ x: 2000, y: 250, type: 'tajine', collected: false, bobPhase: 0 });
            powerups.push({ x: 3200, y: 300, type: 'babouche', collected: false, bobPhase: 0 });

            return { platforms, enemies, collectibles, obstacles, powerups, decorations, length: 4000 };
        }
    },
    { // Level 2: Desert
        name: "Il Deserto",
        bgColor1: '#FFB347', bgColor2: '#FF6B35',
        groundColor: '#D4A574', platformColor: '#B8860B',
        archColor: '#8B6914', skyColor: '#FF7733',
        length: 4500,
        sandstorm: true,
        generate() {
            const platforms = [];
            const enemies = [];
            const collectibles = [];
            const obstacles = [];
            const powerups = [];
            const decorations = [];

            for (let x = 0; x < 4500; x += 200) {
                if (Math.random() < 0.2 && x > 400 && x < 4000) {
                    platforms.push({ x: x, y: 480, w: 120, h: 60, type: 'ground' });
                    platforms.push({ x: x + 140, y: 480, w: 120, h: 60, type: 'ground' });
                } else {
                    platforms.push({ x: x, y: 480, w: 200, h: 60, type: 'ground' });
                }
            }

            // Dune platforms
            for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
                const px = 300 + Math.random() * 3800;
                const py = 280 + Math.random() * 150;
                platforms.push({ x: px, y: py, w: 100 + Math.random() * 80, h: 20, type: 'platform' });
            }

            // Moving platforms over dunes
            for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                const px = 400 + Math.random() * 3500;
                const py = 180 + Math.random() * 200;
                platforms.push({
                    x: px, y: py, w: 90, h: 20, type: 'moving',
                    startX: px, startY: py,
                    moveX: 80 + Math.random() * 100, moveY: 40 + Math.random() * 50,
                    speed: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.8, phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
                });
            }

            // Ruins
            for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                decorations.push({ x: 300 + i * 500, y: 350, type: 'ruin', pillar: Math.random() < 0.5 });
            }

            // Oasis
            decorations.push({ x: 1500, y: 460, type: 'oasis' });
            decorations.push({ x: 3000, y: 460, type: 'oasis' });

            // Crates
            for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
                obstacles.push({ x: 500 + Math.random() * 3800, y: 440, w: 40, h: 40, type: 'crate', vx: 0 });
            }

            // Enemies
            for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
                const ex = 400 + Math.random() * 3800;

let levelData = null;

function loadLevel(idx) {
    currentLevel = idx;
    const lvl = LEVELS[idx];
    levelData = lvl.generate();
    player.x = 50; player.y = 300; player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
    player.dead = false; player.respawnTimer = 0;
    player.invincible = 0; player.shieldTimer = 0;
    player.baboucheBoost = 0; player.doubleJump = false;
    player.dashTimer = 0; player.dashCooldown = 0;
    player.attackTimer = 0; player.attackCooldown = 0;
    checkpoint = null;
    sandstormTimer = 0; sandstormActive = false;
    particles = [];
    camera.x = 0; camera.y = 0;
    gameState = 'PLAYING';
    startMusic();
}

function resetPlayer() {
    player.x = 50; player.y = 300; player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
    player.dead = false; player.respawnTimer = 0;
    player.invincible = 120; player.shieldTimer = 0;
    player.baboucheBoost = 0; player.doubleJump = false;
    player.dashTimer = 0; player.dashCooldown = 0;
    player.attackTimer = 0; player.attackCooldown = 0;
    camera.x = 0; camera.y = 0;
}

function respawnAtCheckpoint() {
    if (checkpoint) {
        player.x = checkpoint.x;
        player.y = checkpoint.y - 60;
    } else {
        resetPlayer();
    }
    player.dead = false;
    player.invincible = 90;
    player.vx = 0; player.vy = 0;
}

function addParticle(x, y, color, count=5, speed=3) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        particles.push({
            x, y, vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed * 2,
            vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed * 2 - 1,
            life: 30 + Math.random() * 20,
            maxLife: 50, color, size: 2 + Math.random() * 4
        });
    }
}

function addCoinParticle(x, y) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        const angle = (Math.PI * 2 / 8) * i;
        particles.push({
            x, y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * 3, vy: Math.sin(angle) * 3,
            life: 25, maxLife: 25, color: '#FFD700', size: 3
        });
    }
}

// Collision
function rectCollide(a, b) {
    return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
}

function update() {
    frameCount++;

    if (gameState === 'MENU') {
        if (keys['Space'] || keys['Enter']) {
            initAudio();
            lives = 3; coins = 0; score = 0;
            loadLevel(0);
        }
        return;
    }

    if (gameState === 'LEVEL_END' || gameState === 'GAME_OVER' || gameState === 'WIN') {
        if (keys['Space'] || keys['Enter']) {
            if (gameState === 'GAME_OVER') {
                gameState = 'MENU';
                stopMusic();
            } else if (gameState === 'WIN') {
                gameState = 'MENU';
                stopMusic();
            } else {
                if (currentLevel < 3) {
                    loadLevel(currentLevel + 1);
                } else {
                    gameState = 'WIN';
                    stopMusic();
                    playWin();
                }
            }
        }
        return;
    }

    if (gameState !== 'PLAYING') return;

    const lvl = LEVELS[currentLevel];
    const p = player;
    const grav = 0.55;
    const moveSpeed = 4.5;
    const jumpForce = p.baboucheBoost > 0 ? -13 : -11;
    const maxFall = 12;

    // Sandstorm
    if (lvl.sandstorm) {
        sandstormTimer++;
        if (sandstormTimer > 600 && sandstormTimer < 1200) sandstormActive = true;
        if (sandstormTimer > 1200 && sandstormTimer < 1800) sandstormActive = false;
        if (sandstormTimer > 1800) sandstormTimer = 0;
        if (sandstormActive && p.invincible <= 0) {
            p.invincible = 30;
            if (p.shieldTimer <= 0) {
                lives--;
                playDeath();
                screenShake = 15;
                if (lives <= 0) {
                    p.dead = true;
                    gameState = 'GAME_OVER';
                    stopMusic();
                    return;
                }
                respawnAtCheckpoint();
            }
        }
    }

    // Movement
    let moveX = 0;
    if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA']) { moveX = -1; p.facing = -1; }
    if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD']) { moveX = 1; p.facing = 1; }

    if (p.dashTimer > 0) {
        p.vx = p.dashDir * 12;
        p.dashTimer--;
        if (frameCount % 3 === 0) addParticle(p.x + p.w/2, p.y + p.h/2, '#00BFFF', 2, 2);
    } else {
        p.vx = moveX * moveSpeed;
    }

    // Dash
    if ((keys['ShiftLeft'] || keys['ShiftRight'] || keys['KeyX']) && p.dashCooldown <= 0 && p.dashTimer <= 0) {
        p.dashTimer = 10;
        p.dashCooldown = 40;
        p.dashDir = p.facing;
        playDash();
        addParticle(p.x + p.w/2, p.y + p.h/2, '#00BFFF', 8, 4);
    }
    if (p.dashCooldown > 0) p.dashCooldown--;

    // Attack
    if ((keys['KeyZ'] || keys['ControlLeft']) && p.attackCooldown <= 0 && p.dashTimer <= 0) {
        p.attackTimer = 12;
        p.attackCooldown = 20;
        playAttack();
        // Check enemy hits
        const attackBox = {
            x: p.facing === 1 ? p.x + p.w : p.x - 30,
            y: p.y + 5, w: 30, h: p.h - 10
        };
        levelData.enemies.forEach(e => {
            if (e.alive && rectCollide(attackBox, e)) {
                e.hp--;
                if (e.hp <= 0) {
                    e.alive = false;
                    score += e.type === 'boss' ? 5000 : (e.type === 'sandbandit' ? 200 : 100);
                    addParticle(e.x + e.w/2, e.y + e.h/2, '#FF6B35', 12, 5);
                    if (e.type === 'boss') {
                        screenShake = 30;
                        playWin();
                        gameState = 'LEVEL_END';
                        levelTransitionText = 'VITTORIA! Il Souk è salvo!';
                        score += 10000;
                    }
                } else {
                    addParticle(e.x + e.w/2, e.y + e.h/2, '#FF0000', 5, 3);
                    playHit();
                    screenShake = 5;
                }
            }
        });
    }
    if (p.attackTimer > 0) p.attackTimer--;
    if (p.attackCooldown > 0) p.attackCooldown--;

    // Jump
    if ((keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW'] || keys['Space']) && p.canJump) {
        if (p.onGround) {
            p.vy = jumpForce;
            p.onGround = false;
            p.canJump = false;
            playJump();
            addParticle(p.x + p.w/2, p.y + p.h, '#FFFFFF', 4, 2);
        } else if (p.doubleJump) {
            p.vy = jumpForce * 0.85;
            p.doubleJump = false;
            playJump();
            addParticle(p.x + p.w/2, p.y + p.h, '#FFD700', 6, 3);
        }
    }
    if (!(keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW'] || keys['Space'])) {
        p.canJump = true;
    }

    // Gravity
    if (p.dashTimer <= 0) {
        p.vy += grav;
        if (p.vy > maxFall) p.vy = maxFall;
    }

    // Move X
    p.x += p.vx;
    // Collision X
    levelData.platforms.forEach(pl => {
        if (rectCollide(p, pl)) {
            if (p.vx > 0) p.x = pl.x - p.w;
            else if (p.vx < 0) p.x = pl.x + pl.w;
            p.vx = 0;
        }
    });

    // Move Y
    p.y += p.vy;
    p.onGround = false;
    // Collision Y
    levelData.platforms.forEach(pl => {
        if (rectCollide(p, pl)) {
            if (p.vy > 0) {
                p.y = pl.y - p.h;
                p.vy = 0;
                p.onGround = true;
                p.doubleJump = false;
                // Carpet movement
                if (pl.type === 'carpet') {
                    p.x += pl.speed * pl.dir;
                }
                // Moving platform
                if (pl.type === 'moving') {
                    p.x += Math.cos(pl.phase) * pl.moveX * 0.01 * pl.speed;
                }
            } else if (p.vy < 0) {
                p.y = pl.y + pl.h;
                p.vy = 0;
            }
        }
    });

    // Update moving platforms
    levelData.platforms.forEach(pl => {
        if (pl.type === 'moving') {
            pl.phase += 0.02 * pl.speed;
            pl.x = pl.startX + Math.sin(pl.phase) * pl.moveX;
            pl.y = pl.startY + Math.sin(pl.phase) * pl.moveY;
        }
        if (pl.type === 'carpet') {
            pl.x += pl.speed * pl.dir;
            if (pl.x > pl.startX + 200 || pl.x < pl.startX - 200) pl.dir *= -1;
        }
    });

    // Update obstacles
    levelData.obstacles.forEach(ob => {
        if (ob.type === 'crate') {
            ob.x += ob.vx;
            ob.vx *= 0.98;
            // Check player attack
            if (p.attackTimer > 0 && rectCollide(
                { x: p.facing === 1 ? p.x + p.w : p.x - 30, y: p.y + 5, w: 30, h: p.h - 10 },
                ob
            )) {
                ob.vx = p.facing * 5;
                score += 50;
                addParticle(ob.x + ob.w/2, ob.y + ob.h/2, '#8B4513', 6, 3);
                playHit();
            }
        }
    });

    // Update enemies
    levelData.enemies.forEach(e => {
        if (!e.alive) return;
        e.animTimer += 0.1;

        if (e.type === 'scarab') {
            e.x += e.vx;
            // Turn at edges
            let onPlatform = false;
            levelData.platforms.forEach(pl => {
                if (e.x + e.w > pl.x && e.x < pl.x + pl.w && Math.abs(e.y + e.h - pl.y) < 5) onPlatform = true;
            });
            if (!onPlatform || e.x < 0 || e.x > levelData.length) e.vx *= -1;
        } else if (e.type === 'pigeon') {
            e.flyPhase += 0.05;
            e.x += e.vx * Math.cos(e.flyPhase);
            e.y += Math.sin(e.flyPhase * 2) * 1.5;
            if (e.x < 0 || e.x > levelData.length) e.vx *= -1;
        } else if (e.type === 'bandit' || e.type === 'sandbandit') {
            e.x += e.vx;
            if (e.x <= e.patrolStart || e.x >= e.patrolEnd) e.vx *= -1;
        } else if (e.type === 'boss') {
            const boss = e;
            boss.attackTimer++;
            boss.animTimer += 0.05;

            // Boss AI patterns
            if (boss.attackTimer % 120 === 0) {
                // Charge attack
                boss.chargeDir = player.x > boss.x ? 1 : -1;
                boss.vx = boss.chargeDir * 6;
                boss.chargeTimer = 60;
            }
            if (boss.chargeTimer > 0) {
                boss.chargeTimer--;
                if (boss.chargeTimer <= 0) boss.vx = 0;
            } else {
                // Patrol
                if (boss.attackTimer % 90 === 0) {
                    boss.vx = (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * 2;
                }
            }
            boss.x += boss.vx;
            boss.x = Math.max(50, Math.min(levelData.length - 50, boss.x));

            // Jump attack
            if (boss.attackTimer % 180 === 0 && boss.y >= 380) {
                boss.vy = -14;
            }
            // Projectile (sand blast)
            if (boss.attackTimer % 100 === 0) {
                // Create projectile enemy
                levelData.enemies.push({
                    x: boss.x + (player.x > boss.x ? 40 : -40), y: boss.y + 30,
                    w: 20, h: 20, type: 'bossproj', vx: (player.x > boss.x ? 1 : -1) * 4,
                    vy: 0, hp: 1, alive: true, animTimer: 0, life: 120
                });
            }
            // Gravity for boss
            boss.vy = (boss.vy || 0) + 0.5;
            boss.y += boss.vy;
            levelData.platforms.forEach(pl => {
                if (rectCollide(boss, pl) && boss.vy > 0) {
                    boss.y = pl.y - boss.h;
                    boss.vy = 0;
                }
            });
        }

        // Boss projectile update
        if (e.type === 'bossproj') {
            e.x += e.vx;
            e.y += e.vy;
            e.life--;
            if (e.life <= 0) e.alive = false;
            if (rectCollide(p, e) && p.invincible <= 0) {
                damagePlayer();
            }
        }

        // Player collision with enemy
        if (e.type !== 'bossproj' && rectCollide(p, e) && p.invincible <= 0) {
            // Stomp from above
            if (p.vy > 0 && p.y + p.h - 10 < e.y + e.h / 2) {
                if (e.type === 'boss') {
                    // Can't stomp boss
                } else {
                    e.hp--;
                    if (e.hp <= 0) {
                        e.alive = false;
                        score += 100;
                        addParticle(e.x + e.w/2, e.y + e.h/2, '#FF6B35', 10, 4);
                    }
                    p.vy = -8;
                    playHit();
                    addParticle(p.x + p.w/2, p.y + p.h, '#FFFFFF', 4, 2);
                }
            } else {
                damagePlayer();
            }
        }
    });

    // Collectibles
    levelData.collectibles.forEach(c => {
        if (c.collected) return;
        c.bobPhase += 0.05;
        const cy = c.type === 'coin' ? c.y + Math.sin(c.bobPhase) * 5 : c.y;

        if (rectCollide(p, { x: c.x - 10, y: cy - 10, w: 20, h: 20 })) {
            if (c.type === 'coin') {
                c.collected = true;
                coins++;
                score += 10;
                playCoin();
                addCoinParticle(c.x, cy);
            } else if (c.type === 'checkpoint' && c.active) {
                c.collected = true;
                c.active = false;
                checkpoint = { x: c.x, y: c.y };
                playCheckpoint();
                addParticle(c.x, c.y, '#00FF00', 10, 4);
            }
        }
    });

    // Power-ups
    levelData.powerups.forEach(pu => {
        if (pu.collected) return;
        pu.bobPhase += 0.04;
        const py = pu.y + Math.sin(pu.bobPhase) * 5;
        if (rectCollide(p, { x: pu.x - 15, y: py - 15, w: 30, h: 30 })) {
            pu.collected = true;
            playPowerUp();
            addParticle(pu.x, py, '#FFD700', 12, 5);
            if (pu.type === 'babouche') {
                p.baboucheBoost = 600;
                p.doubleJump = true;
            } else if (pu.type === 'tajine') {
                p.shieldTimer = 600;
            }
        }
    });

    // Timers
    if (p.invincible > 0) p.invincible--;
    if (p.shieldTimer > 0) p.shieldTimer--;
    if (p.baboucheBoost > 0) p.baboucheBoost--;

    // Fall death
    if (p.y > 550) {
        lives--;
        playDeath();
        screenShake = 15;
        if (lives <= 0) {
            p.dead = true;
            gameState = 'GAME_OVER';
            stopMusic();
            return;
        }
        respawnAtCheckpoint();
    }

    // Level end
    if (p.x > levelData.length - 50 && !lvl.isBoss) {
        gameState = 'LEVEL_END';
        levelTransitionText = `Livello completato! ${lvl.name}`;
        score += 500;
        stopMusic();
        playWin();
    }

    // Animation
    p.animTimer += 0.15;
    if (Math.abs(p.vx) > 0.5) p.animFrame = Math.floor(p.animTimer) % 4;
    else p.animFrame = 0;

    // Camera
    const targetCX = p.x - W / 3;
    const targetCY = p.y - H / 2;
    camera.x += (targetCX - camera.x) * 0.1;
    camera.y += (targetCY - camera.y) * 0.08;
    camera.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(levelData.length - W, camera.x));
    camera.y = Math.max(-100, Math.min(100, camera.y));

    // Particles
    particles.forEach(pt => {
        pt.x += pt.vx;
        pt.y += pt.vy;
        pt.vy += 0.1;
        pt.life--;
    });
    particles = particles.filter(pt => pt.life > 0);

    // Screen shake
    if (screenShake > 0) screenShake--;
}

function damagePlayer() {
    const p = player;
    if (p.invincible > 0) return;
    if (p.shieldTimer > 0) {
        p.shieldTimer = 0;
        p.invincible = 60;
        addParticle(p.x + p.w/2, p.y + p.h/2, '#FFD700', 10, 4);
        playHit();
        return;
    }
    lives--;
    p.invincible = 90;
    playDeath();
    screenShake = 15;
    addParticle(p.x + p.w/2, p.y + p.h/2, '#FF0000', 10, 4);
    if (lives <= 0) {
        p.dead = true;
        gameState = 'GAME_OVER';
        stopMusic();
    } else {
        respawnAtCheckpoint();
    }
}

// Drawing functions
function drawVectorHero(x, y, facing, frame, attacking, invincible, shieldActive, babouche) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x + 16, y + 24);
    ctx.scale(facing, 1);

    if (invincible > 0 && Math.floor(invincible / 4) % 2 === 0) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;
    }

    // Shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 24, 14, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Legs
    const legAnim = Math.sin(frame * 1.5) * 6;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2C3E50';
    ctx.fillRect(-8, 8, 7, 16 + (legAnim > 0 ? legAnim : 0));
    ctx.fillRect(1, 8, 7, 16 + (legAnim < 0 ? -legAnim : 0));

    // Shoes (babouche)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#E74C3C';
    ctx.fillRect(-9, 22 + (legAnim > 0 ? legAnim : 0), 9, 5);
    ctx.fillRect(0, 22 + (legAnim < 0 ? -legAnim : 0), 9, 5);

    // Body (modernized galabeya)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ECF0F1';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(-12, -12, 24, 22, 4);
    ctx.fill();

    // Belt
    ctx.fillStyle = '#F39C12';
    ctx.fillRect(-12, 2, 24, 4);

    // Decorative pattern on body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#E74C3C';
    ctx.fillRect(-8, -8, 16, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(-6, -4, 12, 2);

    // Arms
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ECF0F1';
    const armAnim = attacking ? -20 : Math.sin(frame * 1.5) * 8;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(-12, -6);
    ctx.rotate((armAnim) * Math.PI / 180);
    ctx.fillRect(-3, 0, 6, 16);
    // Hand
    ctx.fillStyle = '#D4A574';
    ctx.fillRect(-2, 14, 4, 4);
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(12, -6);
    ctx.rotate((-armAnim) * Math.PI / 180);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ECF0F1';
    ctx.fillRect(-3, 0, 6, 16);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#D4A574';
    ctx.fillRect(-2, 14, 4, 4);
    ctx.restore();

    // Head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#D4A574';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -18, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2C3E50';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(4, -20, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Eye shine
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(5, -21, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Smile
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2C3E50';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(3, -16, 4, 0.1, Math.PI - 0.1);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Chechia (traditional hat)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#E74C3C';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-10, -26);
    ctx.lineTo(-8, -34);
    ctx.lineTo(8, -34);
    ctx.lineTo(10, -26);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    // Tassel
    ctx.fillStyle = '#F39C12';
    ctx.fillRect(6, -34, 2, 6);

    // Shield effect
    if (shieldActive) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 215, 0, ${0.5 + Math.sin(frameCount * 0.1) * 0.3})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 0, 28, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 215, 0, ${0.2 + Math.sin(frameCount * 0.15) * 0.15})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 6;
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Babouche boost glow
    if (babouche) {
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0, 255, 255, ${0.3 + Math.sin(frameCount * 0.1) * 0.2})`;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 24, 10 + Math.sin(frameCount * 0.15) * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.restore();
}

function drawEnemy(e) {
    const sx = e.x - camera.x;
    const sy = e.y - camera.y;
    if (sx < -50 || sx > W + 50 || sy < -50 || sy > H + 50) return;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(sx + e.w/2, sy + e.h/2);

    if (e.type === 'scarab') {
        // Scarab beetle
        const wobble = Math.sin(e.animTimer * 3) * 3;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#2ECC71';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, wobble, e.w/2, e.h/2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        // Shell pattern
        ctx.fillStyle = '#27AE60';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, wobble, e.w/3, e.h/3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        // Legs
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#1A5E35';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i += 2) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(i * 12, wobble);
            ctx.lineTo(i * 18, wobble + 8);
            ctx.stroke();
        }
        // Eyes
        ctx.fillStyle = '#E74C3C';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(6, wobble - 5, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.arc(-6, wobble - 5, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    } else if (e.type === 'pigeon') {
        // Pigeon
        const wing = Math.sin(e.animTimer * 5) * 15;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#7F8C8D';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, e.w/2, e.h/3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        // Wings
        ctx.fillStyle = '#95A5A6';
        ctx.save();
        ctx.rotate(wing * Math.PI / 180);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(-5, -5, 15, 6, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
        // Head
        ctx.fillStyle = '#BDC3C7';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(e.w/3, -5, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        // Eye
        ctx.fillStyle = '#E74C3C';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(e.w/3 + 3, -6, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        // Beak
        ctx.fillStyle = '#F39C12';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(e.w/3 + 7, -5);
        ctx.lineTo(e.w/3 + 12, -3);
        ctx.lineTo(e.w/3 + 7, -1);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
    } else if (e.type === 'bandit' || e.type === 'sandbandit') {
        // Bandit
        const dir = e.vx > 0 ? 1 : -1;
        ctx.scale(dir, 1);
        // Body
        ctx.fillStyle = e.type === 'sandbandit' ? '#8B4513' : '#34495E';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(-15, -20, 30, 40, 5);
        ctx.fill();
        // Head
        ctx.fillStyle = '#D4A574';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -25, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        // Bandana
        ctx.fillStyle = '#C0392B';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -28, 10, Math.PI, 0);
        ctx.fill();
        // Bandana tail
        ctx.fillRect(8, -30, 10, 3);
        // Eyes (evil)
        ctx.fillStyle = '#E74C3C';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(3, -26, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        // Scarf
        ctx.fillStyle = '#F39C12';
        ctx.fillRect(-12, -12, 24, 5);
        // Legs
        ctx.fillStyle = '#2C3E50';
        ctx.fillRect(-10, 18, 8, 12);
        ctx.fillRect(2, 18, 8, 12);
        // Sandbandit special
        if (e.type === 'sandbandit') {
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(210, 180, 140, ${0.3 + Math.sin(frameCount * 0.1) * 0.2})`;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(0, 0, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }
    } else if (e.type === 'boss') {
        // Boss: Guardiano del Souk
        const breathe = Math.sin(e.animTimer * 2) * 2;
        // Body (large, imposing)
        ctx.fillStyle = '#8B0000';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(-35, -40 + breathe, 70, 80, 8);
        ctx.fill();
        // Armor plates
        ctx.fillStyle = '#B8860B';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(-30, -30 + breathe, 60, 20, 4);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(-25, -5 + breathe, 50, 15, 4);
        ctx.fill();
        // Head
        ctx.fillStyle = '#D4A574';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -48 + breathe, 16, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        // Crown
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-14, -62 + breathe);
        ctx.lineTo(-10, -72 + breathe);
        ctx.lineTo(-5, -65 + breathe);
        ctx.lineTo(0, -75 + breathe);
        ctx.lineTo(5, -65 + breathe);
        ctx.lineTo(10, -72 + breathe);
        ctx.lineTo(14, -62 + breathe);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        // Eyes (menacing)
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FF0000';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(-6, -50 + breathe, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.arc(6, -50 + breathe, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(-6, -50 + breathe, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.arc(6, -50 + breathe, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        // Mouth
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#2C3E50';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -42 + breathe, 6, 0.2, Math.PI - 0.2);
        ctx.stroke();
        // Arms
        ctx.fillStyle = '#8B0000';
        ctx.fillRect(-45, -25 + breathe, 15, 35);
        ctx.fillRect(30, -25 + breathe, 15, 35);
        // Weapons (swords)
        ctx.fillStyle = '#C0C0C0';
        ctx.fillRect(-48, -30 + breathe, 4, 40);
        ctx.fillRect(44, -30 + breathe, 4, 40);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
        ctx.fillRect(-50, -32 + breathe, 8, 4);
        ctx.fillRect(42, -32 + breathe, 8, 4);
        // Legs
        ctx.fillStyle = '#6B3A2A';
        ctx.fillRect(-20, 38 + breathe, 14, 15);
        ctx.fillRect(6, 38 + breathe, 14, 15);
        // HP bar
        ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
        ctx.fillRect(-35, -85, 70, 8);
        ctx.fillStyle = e.hp > e.maxHp * 0.3 ? '#E74C3C' : '#FF0000';
        ctx.fillRect(-35, -85, 70 * (e.hp / e.maxHp), 8);
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#FFD700';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.strokeRect(-35, -85, 70, 8);
    } else if (e.type === 'bossproj') {
        // Sand projectile
        ctx.fillStyle = '#D4A574';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 0, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#E8C170';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 0, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        // Trail
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(210, 180, 140, 0.5)`;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(-e.vx * 3, 0, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.restore();
}

function drawCollectible(c) {
    if (c.collected) return;
    const sx = c.x - camera.x;
    const sy = c.type === 'coin' ? c.y + Math.sin(c.bobPhase) * 5 - camera.y : c.y - camera.y;
    if (sx < -20 || sx > W + 20 || sy < -20 || sy > H + 20) return;

    if (c.type === 'coin') {
        // Dinar coin
        const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(c.bobPhase * 2) * 0.1;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(sx, sy);
        ctx.scale(pulse, pulse);
        // Outer
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 0, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        // Inner
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFA500';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 0, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        // Star
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
        ctx.font = 'bold 10px sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.fillText('★', 0, 0);
        ctx.restore();
    } else if (c.type === 'checkpoint') {
        // Flag
        ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513';
        ctx.fillRect(sx - 2, sy - 40, 4, 40);
        ctx.fillStyle = c.active ? '#00FF00' : '#666';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(sx + 2, sy - 40);
        ctx.lineTo(sx + 22, sy - 30);
        ctx.lineTo(sx + 2, sy - 20);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        // Glow
        if (c.active) {
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0, 255, 0, ${0.2 + Math.sin(frameCount * 0.08) * 0.15})`;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(sx, sy - 20, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }
    }
}

function drawPowerup(pu) {
    if (pu.collected) return;
    const sx = pu.x - camera.x;
    const sy = pu.y + Math.sin(pu.bobPhase) * 5 - camera.y;
    if (sx < -30 || sx > W + 30 || sy < -30 || sy > H + 30) return;

    // Glow
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 215, 0, ${0.2 + Math.sin(frameCount * 0.06) * 0.15})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    if (pu.type === 'babouche') {
        // Babouche shoe
        ctx.fillStyle = '#E74C3C';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(sx - 12, sy + 5);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx - 15, sy - 5, sx - 5, sy - 10);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx + 5, sy - 12, sx + 10, sy - 5);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx + 15, sy + 2, sx + 12, sy + 8);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx + 5, sy + 10, sx - 5, sy + 8);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#F39C12';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(sx - 5, sy - 5, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        // Label
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
        ctx.font = 'bold 8px sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText('⬆', sx, sy + 18);
    } else if (pu.type === 'tajine') {
        // Tajine pot
        ctx.fillStyle = '#D4A574';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(sx - 10, sy + 5);
        ctx.lineTo(sx - 12, sy - 2);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx, sy - 18, sx + 12, sy - 2);
        ctx.lineTo(sx + 10, sy + 5);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#E8C170';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(sx, sy - 10, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        // Shield icon
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
        ctx.font = 'bold 8px sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText('🛡', sx, sy + 18);
    }
}

function drawPlatform(pl) {
    const sx = pl.x - camera.x;
    const sy = pl.y - camera.y;
    if (sx + pl.w < -10 || sx > W + 10) return;

    if (pl.type === 'ground') {
        // Ground with pattern
        const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(sx, sy, sx, sy + pl.h);
        grad.addColorStop(0, '#C4956A');
        grad.addColorStop(1, '#8B6914');
        ctx.fillStyle = grad;
        ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, pl.w, pl.h);
        // Top line
        ctx.fillStyle = '#D4A574';
        ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, pl.w, 4);
        // Pattern
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(139, 105, 20, 0.3)';
        for (let i = 0; i < pl.w; i += 30) {
            ctx.fillRect(sx + i, sy + 10, 20, 2);
            ctx.fillRect(sx + i + 10, sy + 20, 20, 2);
        }
    } else if (pl.type === 'platform') {
        // Wooden platform
        const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(sx, sy, sx, sy + pl.h);
        grad.addColorStop(0, '#A07850');
        grad.addColorStop(1, '#8B6914');
        ctx.fillStyle = grad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(sx, sy, pl.w, pl.h, 4);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#B8860B';
        ctx.fillRect(sx + 2, sy + 2, pl.w - 4, 3);
    } else if (pl.type === 'moving') {
        // Moving platform with glow
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(100, 200, 255, ${0.3 + Math.sin(frameCount * 0.05) * 0.15})`;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(sx - 3, sy - 3, pl.w + 6, pl.h + 6, 6);
        ctx.fill();
        const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(sx, sy, sx, sy + pl.h);
        grad.addColorStop(0, '#5DADE2');
        grad.addColorStop(1, '#2E86C1');
        ctx.fillStyle = grad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(sx, sy, pl.w, pl.h, 4);
        ctx.fill();
    } else if (pl.type === 'carpet') {
        // Sliding carpet
        ctx.fillStyle = '#C0392B';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(sx, sy, pl.w, pl.h, 7);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#E74C3C';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(sx + 5, sy + 2, pl.w - 10, pl.h - 4, 4);
        ctx.fill();
        // Pattern
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
        for (let i = 10; i < pl.w - 10; i += 15) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(sx + i, sy + pl.h/2, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }
        // Fringe
        ctx.fillStyle = '#F39C12';
        for (let i = 0; i < pl.w; i += 8) {
            ctx.fillRect(sx + i, sy + pl.h, 3, 5);
        }
    }
}

function drawObstacle(ob) {
    const sx = ob.x - camera.x;
    const sy = ob.y - camera.y;
    if (sx + ob.w < -10 || sx > W + 10) return;

    if (ob.type === 'crate') {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(sx, sy, ob.w, ob.h, 3);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#A0522D';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(sx + 3, sy + 3, ob.w - 6, ob.h - 6, 2);
        ctx.fill();
        // Cross pattern
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#654321';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(sx + 5, sy + 5);
        ctx.lineTo(sx + ob.w - 5, sy + ob.h - 5);
        ctx.moveTo(sx + ob.w - 5, sy + 5);
        ctx.lineTo(sx + 5, sy + ob.h - 5);
        ctx.stroke();
    }
}

function drawDecoration(d) {
    const sx = d.x - camera.x;
    const sy = d.y - camera.y;
    if (sx < -100 || sx > W + 100) return;

    if (d.type === 'arch') {
        // Tunisian arch
        ctx.fillStyle = '#8B6914';
        ctx.fillRect(sx - 8, sy, 16, 180);
        ctx.fillRect(sx + 32, sy, 16, 180);
        // Arch top
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(sx + 24, sy, 40, Math.PI, 0);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#A07850';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#8B6914';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(sx + 24, sy, 32, Math.PI, 0);
        ctx.fill();
        // Decorative pattern
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(sx + 12 + i * 24, sy + 15, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }
    } else if (d.type === 'ruin') {
        // Ruin pillar
        ctx.fillStyle = '#6B5B3A';
        ctx.fillRect(sx - 12, sy - 60, 24, 120);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#8B7B5A';
        ctx.fillRect(sx - 15, sy - 65, 30, 10);
        ctx.fillRect(sx - 15, sy + 55, 30, 10);
        // Cracks
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#4A3F2F';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(sx - 5, sy - 40);
        ctx.lineTo(sx + 3, sy - 20);
        ctx.lineTo(sx - 2, sy);
        ctx.stroke();
    } else if (d.type === 'oasis') {
        // Oasis
        ctx.fillStyle = '#2ECC71';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(sx, sy + 10, 60, 20, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#3498DB';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(sx, sy + 12, 50, 15, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        // Palm trees
        for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i += 2) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513';
            ctx.fillRect(sx + i * 40, sy - 50, 6, 60);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#27AE60';
            for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
                const angle = (j / 5) * Math.PI - Math.PI / 2;
                ctx.save();
                ctx.translate(sx + i * 40 + 3, sy - 50);
                ctx.rotate(angle);
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.ellipse(15, 0, 18, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.restore();
            }
        }
    }
}

function drawBackground() {
    const lvl = LEVELS[currentLevel];

    // Sky gradient
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    grad.addColorStop(0, lvl.bgColor1);
    grad.addColorStop(1, lvl.bgColor2);
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Stars (for night levels)
    if (currentLevel === 2) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
        for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
            const sx = (i * 137 + frameCount * 0.02) % W;
            const sy = (i * 97) % (H * 0.6);
            const twinkle = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.05 + i) * 0.5 + 0.5;
            ctx.globalAlpha = twinkle;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(sx, sy, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    // Background mountains/buildings (parallax)
    ctx.fillStyle = currentLevel === 2 ? '#1A1A2E' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)';
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        const bx = i * 120 - (camera.x * 0.2) % 120;
        const bh = 80 + Math.sin(i * 2.5) * 40;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(bx, H);
        ctx.lineTo(bx + 30, H - bh);
        ctx.lineTo(bx + 60, H - bh + 20);
        ctx.lineTo(bx + 90, H - bh - 10);
        ctx.lineTo(bx + 120, H);
        ctx.fill();
    }

    // Mid-ground (parallax)
    ctx.fillStyle = currentLevel === 2 ? '#2E4057' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.08)';
    for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
        const bx = i * 80 - (camera.x * 0.4) % 80;
        const bh = 40 + Math.sin(i * 1.7) * 25;
        ctx.fillRect(bx, H - bh, 60, bh);
        // Dome tops
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(bx + 30, H - bh, 30, Math.PI, 0);
        ctx.fill();
    }

    // Sandstorm effect
    if (sandstormActive) {
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(210, 180, 140, ${0.15 + Math.sin(frameCount * 0.1) * 0.1})`;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
        // Sand particles
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(210, 180, 140, 0.4)';
        for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
            const sx = (i * 73 + frameCount * 5) % (W + 100) - 50;
            const sy = (i * 47 + Math.sin(frameCount * 0.03 + i) * 50) % H;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(sx, sy, 2 + Math.random() * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }
    }
}

function drawUI() {
    // Lives
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(10, 10, 150, 35, 8);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#E74C3C';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('❤️', 20, 33);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
    ctx.fillText(`x ${lives}`, 45, 33);

    // Coins
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(170, 10, 120, 35, 8);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(`💰 ${coins}`, 185, 33);

    // Score
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(W - 180, 10, 170, 35, 8);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
    ctx.font = 'bold 14px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText(`Punteggio: ${score}`, W - 20, 33);

    // Power-up bars
    if (player.baboucheBoost > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(10, 50, 100, 16, 4);
        ctx.fill();
        const bw = 96 * (player.baboucheBoost / 600);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#00BFFF';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(12, 52, bw, 12, 3);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
        ctx.font = 'bold 9px sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        ctx.fillText('BABOUCHE', 16, 62);
    }

    if (player.shieldTimer > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(10, 70, 100, 16, 4);
        ctx.fill();
        const bw = 96 * (player.shieldTimer / 600);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(12, 72, bw, 12, 3);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
        ctx.font = 'bold 9px sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        ctx.fillText('TAJINE SHIELD', 16, 82);
    }

    // Dash cooldown
    if (player.dashCooldown > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(W - 120, 50, 110, 16, 4);
        ctx.fill();
        const bw = 106 * (1 - player.dashCooldown / 40);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#5DADE2';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(W - 118, 52, bw, 12, 3);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
        ctx.font = 'bold 9px sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'right';
        ctx.fillText('DASH', W - 22, 62);
    } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(W - 120, 50, 110, 16, 4);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#00FF00';
        ctx.font = 'bold 9px sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'right';
        ctx.fillText('DASH ✓', W - 22, 62);
    }

    // Level name
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(W/2 - 80, 10, 160, 30, 8);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
    ctx.font = 'bold 13px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(LEVELS[currentLevel].name, W/2, 30);

    // Controls hint
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
    ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('← → Muovi | ↑ Salta | X Dash | Z Attacco', W/2, H - 10);
}

function drawParticles() {
    particles.forEach(pt => {
        const alpha = pt.life / pt.maxLife;
        ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
        ctx.fillStyle = pt.color;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(pt.x - camera.x, pt.y - camera.y, pt.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    });
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function draw() {
    ctx.save();

    // Screen shake
    if (screenShake > 0) {
        ctx.translate(
            (Math.random() - 0.5) * screenShake,
            (Math.random() - 0.5) * screenShake
        );
    }

    if (gameState === 'MENU') {
        drawMenu();
        ctx.restore();
        return;
    }

    if (gameState === 'GAME_OVER') {
        drawGameOver();
        ctx.restore();
        return;
    }

    if (gameState === 'WIN') {
        drawWin();
        ctx.restore();
        return;
    }

    // Game world
    drawBackground();

    if (levelData) {
        // Draw decorations
        levelData.decorations.forEach(d => drawDecoration(d));

        // Draw platforms
        levelData.platforms.forEach(pl => drawPlatform(pl));

        // Draw obstacles
        levelData.obstacles.forEach(ob => drawObstacle(ob));

        // Draw collectibles
        levelData.collectibles.forEach(c => drawCollectible(c));

        // Draw power-ups
        levelData.powerups.forEach(pu => drawPowerup(pu));

        // Draw enemies
        levelData.enemies.forEach(e => {
            if (e.alive) drawEnemy(e);
        });

        // Draw player
        if (!player.dead) {
            drawVectorHero(
                player.x - camera.x, player.y - camera.y,
                player.facing, player.animFrame,
                player.attackTimer > 0, player.invincible,
                player.shieldTimer > 0, player.baboucheBoost > 0
            );
        }

        // Draw particles
        drawParticles();

        // UI
        drawUI();
    }

    ctx.restore();
}

function drawMenu() {
    // Background
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#1A0A2E');
    grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#2D1B69');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#FF8C42');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Decorative pattern
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.15)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
        const angle = (i / 15) * Math.PI * 2 + frameCount * 0.005;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(W/2, H/2 - 30, 150 + i * 15, angle, angle + 0.3);
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Title
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('🏜️ EL HÉROS DE TUNIS 🏜️', W/2, 120);

    // Subtitle
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFA500';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Un\'Avventura nella Medina', W/2, 160);

    // Hero preview
    drawVectorHero(W/2 - 16, 200, 1, frameCount * 0.05, false, 0, false, false);

    // Level info
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ECF0F1';
    ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('4 Livelli • Boss Finale • Collezionabili', W/2, 310);

    // Controls
    ctx.fillStyle = '#BDC3C7';
    ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('← → Muovi  |  ↑ Salta  |  X Dash  |  Z Attacco', W/2, 350);

    // Start prompt
    const pulse = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.08) * 0.3 + 0.7;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 215, 0, ${pulse})`;
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Premi SPAZIO o INVIO per iniziare', W/2, 420);

    // Credits
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7F8C8D';
    ctx.font = '12px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Ispirato ai classici platform anni \'90', W/2, 480);
}

function drawGameOver() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#E74C3C';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W/2, H/2 - 60);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ECF0F1';
    ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(`Punteggio finale: ${score}`, W/2, H/2);
    ctx.fillText(`Monete: ${coins}`, W/2, H/2 + 30);

    const pulse = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.08) * 0.3 + 0.7;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${pulse})`;
    ctx.font = '18px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Premi SPAZIO per tornare al menu', W/2, H/2 + 90);
}

function drawWin() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
    ctx.font = 'bold 42px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('🎉 VITTORIA! 🎉', W/2, H/2 - 80);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFA500';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Il Guardiano del Souk è stato sconfitto!', W/2, H/2 - 35);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ECF0F1';
    ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(`Punteggio finale: ${score}`, W/2, H/2 + 10);
    ctx.fillText(`Monete raccolte: ${coins}`, W/2, H/2 + 40);
    ctx.fillText(`Vite rimanenti: ${lives}`, W/2, H/2 + 70);

    const pulse = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.08) * 0.3 + 0.7;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 215, 0, ${pulse})`;
    ctx.font = '18px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Premi SPAZIO per tornare al menu', W/2, H/2 + 120);
}

function drawLevelEnd() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
    ctx.font = 'bold 36px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(levelTransitionText, W/2, H/2 - 60);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ECF0F1';
    ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(`Punteggio: ${score}`, W/2, H/2);
    ctx.fillText(`Monete: ${coins}`, W/2, H/2 + 30);
    ctx.fillText(`Vite: ${lives}`, W/2, H/2 + 60);

    if (currentLevel < 3) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#2ECC71';
        ctx.font = 'bold 18px sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText(`Prossimo: ${LEVELS[currentLevel + 1].name}`, W/2, H/2 + 110);
    }

    const pulse = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.08) * 0.3 + 0.7;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${pulse})`;
    ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Premi SPAZIO per continuare', W/2, H/2 + 160);
}

// Override the draw to include level end screen
const originalDraw = draw;
draw = function() {
    ctx.save();
    if (screenShake > 0) {
        ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * screenShake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * screenShake);
    }

    if (gameState === 'MENU') {
        drawMenu();
        ctx.restore();
        return;
    }

    if (gameState === 'GAME_OVER') {
        drawGameOver();
        ctx.restore();
        return;
    }

    if (gameState === 'WIN') {
        drawWin();
        ctx.restore();
        return;
    }

    if (gameState === 'LEVEL_END') {
        drawBackground();
        if (levelData) {
            levelData.decorations.forEach(d => drawDecoration(d));
            levelData.platforms.forEach(pl => drawPlatform(pl));
            levelData.obstacles.forEach(ob => drawObstacle(ob));
            levelData.collectibles.forEach(c => drawCollectible(c));
            levelData.powerups.forEach(pu => drawPowerup(pu));
            levelData.enemies.forEach(e => { if (e.alive) drawEnemy(e); });
            if (!player.dead) {
                drawVectorHero(player.x - camera.x, player.y - camera.y, player.facing, player.animFrame, false, 0, false, false);
            }
            drawParticles();
        }
        drawLevelEnd();
        ctx.restore();
        return;
    }

    drawBackground();

    if (levelData) {
        levelData.decorations.forEach(d => drawDecoration(d));
        levelData.platforms.forEach(pl => drawPlatform(pl));
        levelData.obstacles.forEach(ob => drawObstacle(ob));
        levelData.collectibles.forEach(c => drawCollectible(c));
        levelData.powerups.forEach(pu => drawPowerup(pu));
        levelData.enemies.forEach(e => { if (e.alive) drawEnemy(e); });
        if (!player.dead) {
            drawVectorHero(player.x - camera.x, player.y - camera.y, player.facing, player.animFrame, player.attackTimer > 0, player.invincible, player.shieldTimer > 0, player.baboucheBoost > 0);
        }
        drawParticles();
        drawUI();
    }

    ctx.restore();
};

// Game loop
function gameLoop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// Polyfill roundRect
if (!CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect) {
    CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect = function(x, y, w, h, r) {
        if (typeof r === 'number') r = [r, r, r, r];
        const [tl, tr, br, bl] = r;
        this.moveTo(x + tl, y);
        this.lineTo(x + w - tr, y);
        this.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + tr);
        this.lineTo(x + w, y + h - br);
        this.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - br, y + h);
        this.lineTo(x + bl, y + h);
        this.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - bl);
        this.lineTo(x, y + tl);
        this.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + tl, y);
        this.closePath();
        return this;
    };
}

gameLoop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
