<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="description" content="PlayHive Universe - Free online learning games for kids, teens, and families. Play Wordle, Sudoku, Tic-Tac-Toe, Math games, Coloring, Drawing, and more!">
<meta name="keywords" content="kids games, learning games, free online games, wordle, sudoku, tic tac toe, math games, coloring games, drawing games, family games">
<meta name="author" content="PlayHive Universe">
<meta name="robots" content="index, follow">
<meta property="og:title" content="PlayHive Universe – Multi-Game Learning Arcade">
<meta property="og:description" content="Fun + Learning! Play free educational games for all ages.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://playhiveuniverse.com">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<title>PlayHive Universe – Multi-Game Learning Arcade | Free Educational Games for Kids & Families</title>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://playhiveuniverse.com">
<style>
:root{--primary:#6C63FF;--secondary:#FF6584;--accent:#43E97B;--dark:#1a1a2e;--darker:#16213e;--card:#0f3460;--text:#e0e0e0;--white:#fff;--gold:#FFD700;--orange:#FF8C00;--cyan:#00CED1;--pink:#FF69B4;--bg:#0a0a1a;--gradient1:linear-gradient(135deg,#6C63FF,#FF6584);--gradient2:linear-gradient(135deg,#43E97B,#38F9D7);--gradient3:linear-gradient(135deg,#FF6584,#FFD700);--radius:16px;--shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
body{font-family:'Segoe UI',Tahoma,Geneva,Verdana,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);line-height:1.6;overflow-x:hidden}
a{color:var(--primary);text-decoration:none;transition:.3s}
a:hover{color:var(--secondary)}
img{max-width:100%;height:auto}
.container{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}

/* HEADER */
header{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(15,15,40,.98),rgba(10,10,26,.95));backdrop-filter:blur(10px);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1000;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.2)}
.header-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 20px;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:800}
.logo-icon{width:42px;height:42px;background:var(--gradient1);border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.4rem}
.logo span{background:var(--gradient1);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
nav{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
nav a{color:var(--text);padding:8px 16px;border-radius:8px;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:500;transition:.3s}
nav a:hover,nav a.active{background:rgba(108,99,255,.2);color:var(--white)}
.hamburger{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;cursor:pointer;padding:8px}
.hamburger span{width:25px;height:3px;background:var(--text);border-radius:2px;transition:.3s}

/* HERO */
.hero{padding:80px 20px;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-50%;left:-50%;width:200%;height:200%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 50%,rgba(108,99,255,.15),transparent 50%),radial-gradient(circle at 70% 50%,rgba(255,101,132,.1),transparent 50%);animation:heroFloat 20s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes heroFloat{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}50%{transform:translate(-2%,2%)}}
.hero h1{font-size:3.2rem;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:16px;position:relative}
.hero h1 .highlight{background:var(--gradient1);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.hero p{font-size:1.2rem;color:#aaa;max-width:600px;margin:0 auto 32px;position:relative}
.hero-stats{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:40px;margin-top:40px;position:relative}
.hero-stat{text-align:center}
.hero-stat .num{font-size:2rem;font-weight:800;background:var(--gradient1);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.hero-stat .label{font-size:.85rem;color:#888}
.cta-btn{display:inline-block;padding:14px 36px;background:var(--gradient1);color:var(--white);border-radius:50px;font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem;transition:.3s;position:relative;border:none;cursor:pointer}
.cta-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(108,99,255,.4)}

/* AD SLOTS */
.ad-slot{background:rgba(108,99,255,.05);border:1px dashed rgba(108,99,255,.2);border-radius:12px;padding:20px;text-align:center;margin:20px auto;max-width:728px;color:#555;font-size:.85rem}

/* SECTIONS */
.section{padding:60px 20px}
.section-title{text-align:center;margin-bottom:48px}
.section-title h2{font-size:2.2rem;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:8px}
.section-title h2 .highlight{background:var(--gradient1);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.section-title p{color:#888;font-size:1rem}

/* GAME GRID */
.game-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:24px}
.game-card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(15,52,96,.6),rgba(22,33,62,.8));border:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.15);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;transition:.4s;cursor:pointer;position:relative}
.game-card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-color:rgba(108,99,255,.4)}
.game-thumb{height:180px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:4rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.game-thumb::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:60px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(15,52,96,.6))}
.game-card:nth-child(1) .game-thumb{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6C63FF33,#6C63FF11)}
.game-card:nth-child(2) .game-thumb{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FF658433,#FF658411)}
.game-card:nth-child(3) .game-thumb{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#43E97B33,#43E97B11)}
.game-card:nth-child(4) .game-thumb{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FFD70033,#FFD70011)}
.game-card:nth-child(5) .game-thumb{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00CED133,#00CED111)}
.game-card:nth-child(6) .game-thumb{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FF69B433,#FF69B411)}
.game-card:nth-child(7) .game-thumb{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FF8C0033,#FF8C0011)}
.game-card:nth-child(8) .game-thumb{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#9B59B633,#9B59B611)}
.game-card:nth-child(9) .game-thumb{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E74C3C33,#E74C3C11)}
.game-card:nth-child(10) .game-thumb{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1ABC9C33,#1ABC9C11)}
.game-card:nth-child(11) .game-thumb{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3498DB33,#3498DB11)}
.game-card:nth-child(12) .game-thumb{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E67E2233,#E67E2211)}
.game-info{padding:20px}
.game-info h3{font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;color:var(--white)}
.game-info p{font-size:.85rem;color:#999;margin-bottom:14px;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.play-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 20px;background:var(--gradient1);color:var(--white);border-radius:50px;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600;transition:.3s;border:none;cursor:pointer}
.play-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.05);box-shadow:0 4px 15px rgba(108,99,255,.4)}
.game-tag{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase}
.tag-free{background:rgba(67,233,123,.2);color:var(--accent)}
.tag-new{background:rgba(255,101,132,.2);color:var(--secondary)}
.tag-hot{background:rgba(255,215,0,.2);color:var(--gold)}

/* GAME MODAL */
.modal-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.85);z-index:2000;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;backdrop-filter:blur(5px)}
.modal-overlay.active{display:flex}
.modal{background:var(--darker);border-radius:var(--radius);width:100%;max-width:800px;max-height:90vh;overflow-y:auto;position:relative;border:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.2);box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.modal-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:20px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.15)}
.modal-header h2{font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--white)}
.modal-close{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,101,132,.15);border:none;color:var(--secondary);font-size:1.2rem;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:.3s}
.modal-close:hover{background:rgba(255,101,132,.3)}
.modal-body{padding:24px;min-height:400px}

/* WORDLE GAME */
.wordle-container{text-align:center}
.wordle-grid{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin:20px 0}
.wordle-row{display:flex;gap:6px}
.wordle-tile{width:52px;height:52px;border:2px solid rgba(108,99,255,.3);border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;transition:.3s;background:rgba(15,52,96,.5)}
.wordle-tile.correct{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#000}
.wordle-tile.present{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);color:#000}
.wordle-tile.absent{background:#555;border-color:#555}
.wordle-tile.active{border-color:var(--primary);animation:tilePop .1s}
@keyframes tilePop{0%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.1)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
.wordle-keyboard{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-top:16px}
.wordle-key-row{display:flex;gap:4px}
.wordle-key{padding:12px 8px;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(108,99,255,.2);border:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.3);color:var(--text);font-weight:600;font-size:.85rem;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;min-width:32px;text-align:center}
.wordle-key:hover{background:rgba(108,99,255,.4)}
.wordle-key.wide{min-width:60px;font-size:.75rem}
.wordle-key.correct{background:var(--accent);color:#000}
.wordle-key.present{background:var(--gold);color:#000}
.wordle-key.absent{background:#444}
.wordle-message{font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:700;margin:16px 0;min-height:30px}
.wordle-hint{color:#888;font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:12px}

/* SUDOKU */
.sudoku-container{text-align:center}
.sudoku-board{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(9,1fr);gap:1px;background:rgba(108,99,255,.3);border:2px solid var(--primary);border-radius:8px;max-width:400px;margin:16px auto;overflow:hidden}
.sudoku-cell{aspect-ratio:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:600;background:rgba(15,52,96,.5);cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;border:none;color:var(--text);width:100%;padding:0}
.sudoku-cell:nth-child(3n){border-right:2px solid var(--primary)}
.sudoku-cell:nth-child(9n){border-right:none}
.sudoku-cell:nth-child(n+19):nth-child(-n+27),.sudoku-cell:nth-child(n+46):nth-child(-n+54){border-bottom:2px solid var(--primary)}
.sudoku-cell.given{background:rgba(108,99,255,.15);color:var(--white);font-weight:700}
.sudoku-cell.selected{background:rgba(108,99,255,.3);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--primary)}
.sudoku-cell.error{color:var(--secondary)}
.sudoku-cell.user-input{color:var(--cyan)}
.sudoku-controls{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin:16px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sudoku-num-btn{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(108,99,255,.2);border:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.3);color:var(--text);font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}
.sudoku-num-btn:hover{background:rgba(108,99,255,.4)}
.sudoku-num-btn.active{background:var(--primary);color:var(--white)}
.sudoku-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin-top:12px}

/* TIC TAC TOE */
.ttt-container{text-align:center}
.ttt-board{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;max-width:300px;margin:20px auto}
.ttt-cell{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(15,52,96,.5);border:2px solid rgba(108,99,255,.2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:2.5rem;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;transition:.3s;color:var(--white)}
.ttt-cell:hover{border-color:var(--primary);background:rgba(108,99,255,.15)}
.ttt-cell.x{color:var(--primary)}
.ttt-cell.o{color:var(--secondary)}
.ttt-cell.win{animation:winPulse .5s ease infinite alternate}
@keyframes winPulse{from{box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--accent)}to{box-shadow:0 0 25px var(--accent)}}
.ttt-status{font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:700;margin:16px 0;min-height:30px}
.ttt-controls{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}

/* MATH GAME */
.math-container{text-align:center}
.math-problem{font-size:2.5rem;font-weight:800;margin:20px 0;color:var(--white)}
.math-problem .op{color:var(--secondary)}
.math-input{font-size:1.5rem;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:12px;border:2px solid rgba(108,99,255,.3);background:rgba(15,52,96,.5);color:var(--white);text-align:center;width:200px;outline:none}
.math-input:focus{border-color:var(--primary)}
.math-score{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:30px;margin:16px 0}
.math-score-item{text-align:center}
.math-score-item .val{font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:800}
.math-score-item .lbl{font-size:.75rem;color:#888}
.math-timer{font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--gold);font-weight:700}
.math-level{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin:12px 0}
.math-level-btn{padding:6px 16px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(108,99,255,.15);border:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.2);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;font-size:.8rem;transition:.3s}
.math-level-btn.active{background:var(--primary);color:var(--white)}
.math-feedback{font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700;margin:10px 0;min-height:25px}
.math-feedback.correct{color:var(--accent)}
.math-feedback.wrong{color:var(--secondary)}

/* RAIN DROP GAME */
.rain-container{text-align:center}
#rainCanvas{border-radius:12px;border:2px solid rgba(108,99,255,.3);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0a0a2e,#1a1a4e);display:block;margin:0 auto;max-width:100%}
.rain-info{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:24px;margin:12px 0;font-weight:600}
.rain-info .score{color:var(--gold)}
.rain-info .lives{color:var(--secondary)}

/* ROCK DROP GAME */
.rock-container{text-align:center}
#rockCanvas{border-radius:12px;border:2px solid rgba(108,99,255,.3);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1a1a2e,#2a1a3e);display:block;margin:0 auto;max-width:100%}
.rock-info{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:24px;margin:12px 0;font-weight:600}

/* COLORING GAME */
.coloring-container{text-align:center}
#coloringCanvas{border-radius:12px;border:2px solid rgba(108,99,255,.3);background:#fff;display:block;margin:0 auto;cursor:crosshair;max-width:100%}
.color-palette{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin:12px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.color-swatch{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;border:3px solid transparent;transition:.2s}
.color-swatch:hover,.color-swatch.active{border-color:var(--white);transform:scale(1.15)}
.coloring-tools{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin:10px 0}
.coloring-tool{padding:8px 16px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(108,99,255,.15);border:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.2);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;font-size:.8rem;transition:.3s}
.coloring-tool:hover,.coloring-tool.active{background:var(--primary);color:var(--white)}
.coloring-templates{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin:10px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.template-btn{padding:6px 14px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(67,233,123,.1);border:1px solid rgba(67,233,123,.3);color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer;font-size:.75rem;transition:.3s}
.template-btn:hover{background:rgba(67,233,123,.25)}

/* DRAWING GAME */
.drawing-container{text-align:center}
#drawingCanvas{border-radius:12px;border:2px solid rgba(108,99,255,.3);background:#fff;display:block;margin:0 auto;cursor:crosshair;max-width:100%}
.drawing-tools{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin:12px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.drawing-tool{padding:8px 16px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(108,99,255,.15);border:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.2);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;font-size:.8rem;transition:.3s}
.drawing-tool:hover,.drawing-tool.active{background:var(--primary);color:var(--white)}
.brush-size{width:100px;accent-color:var(--primary)}

/* AUCTION GAME */
.auction-container{text-align:center}
.auction-item{background:rgba(15,52,96,.5);border:2px solid rgba(108,99,255,.2);border-radius:12px;padding:24px;margin:16px 0}
.auction-item-icon{font-size:4rem;margin-bottom:12px}
.auction-item-name{font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);margin-bottom:8px}
.auction-item-desc{color:#999;margin-bottom:16px}
.auction-bid{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.auction-bid input{padding:10px 16px;border-radius:8px;border:2px solid rgba(108,99,255,.3);background:rgba(15,52,96,.5);color:var(--white);font-size:1rem;width:150px;text-align:center;outline:none}
.auction-bid input:focus{border-color:var(--primary)}
.auction-timer{font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--gold);font-weight:800;margin:12px 0}
.auction-history{max-height:200px;overflow-y:auto;margin-top:16px;text-align:left}
.auction-history-item{padding:8px 12px;background:rgba(15,52,96,.3);border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:4px;font-size:.85rem}

/* STORY GAME */
.story-container{text-align:center}
.story-scene{background:rgba(15,52,96,.5);border:2px solid rgba(108,99,255,.2);border-radius:12px;padding:30px;margin:16px 0;min-height:200px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.story-scene .scene-icon{font-size:4rem;margin-bottom:16px}
.story-scene .scene-text{font-size:1.1rem;line-height:1.8;color:var(--text);max-width:500px}
.story-choices{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin:16px 0}
.story-choice{padding:12px 28px;border-radius:50px;background:rgba(108,99,255,.15);border:2px solid rgba(108,99,255,.3);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;font-size:.95rem;transition:.3s;max-width:400px}
.story-choice:hover{background:var(--primary);color:var(--white);border-color:var(--primary)}
.story-hearts{color:var(--secondary);font-size:1.5rem;margin:8px 0}

/* CRAFT GAME */
.craft-container{text-align:center}
.craft-workspace{background:rgba(15,52,96,.3);border:2px solid rgba(108,99,255,.2);border-radius:12px;padding:20px;margin:16px 0;min-height:300px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.craft-piece{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:10px;cursor:grab;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.5rem;transition:.2s;user-select:none}
.craft-piece:hover{transform:scale(1.1)}
.craft-piece.placed{cursor:default}
.craft-toolbar{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin:12px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.craft-tool{padding:8px 16px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(108,99,255,.15);border:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.2);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;font-size:.8rem;transition:.3s}
.craft-tool:hover{background:var(--primary);color:var(--white)}

/* BLOG SECTION */
.blog-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:24px}
.blog-card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(15,52,96,.6),rgba(22,33,62,.8));border:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.15);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;transition:.3s}
.blog-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.blog-card-img{height:160px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:3rem;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(108,99,255,.1),rgba(255,101,132,.1))}
.blog-card-body{padding:20px}
.blog-card-body .date{font-size:.75rem;color:#888;margin-bottom:8px}
.blog-card-body h3{font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);margin-bottom:8px}
.blog-card-body p{font-size:.85rem;color:#999}

/* ABOUT / CONTACT / PRIVACY / TERMS */
.page-section{display:none}
.page-section.active{display:block}
.page-content{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:40px 20px}
.page-content h2{font-size:2rem;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:20px;color:var(--white)}
.page-content h3{font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700;margin:24px 0 12px;color:var(--white)}
.page-content p{margin-bottom:16px;color:#bbb;line-height:1.8}
.page-content ul{margin:12px 0 16px 24px;color:#bbb}
.page-content li{margin-bottom:8px}
.contact-form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;max-width:500px;margin:20px auto}
.contact-form input,.contact-form textarea{padding:14px 18px;border-radius:10px;border:2px solid rgba(108,99,255,.2);background:rgba(15,52,96,.3);color:var(--text);font-size:1rem;outline:none;font-family:inherit}
.contact-form input:focus,.contact-form textarea:focus{border-color:var(--primary)}
.contact-form textarea{min-height:120px;resize:vertical}

/* FOOTER */
footer{background:var(--darker);border-top:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.1);padding:48px 20px 24px;margin-top:40px}
.footer-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:32px;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto 32px}
.footer-col h4{font-size:1rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);margin-bottom:16px}
.footer-col a{display:block;color:#888;font-size:.85rem;padding:4px 0;transition:.3s}
.footer-col a:hover{color:var(--primary);padding-left:4px}
.footer-bottom{text-align:center;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.1);color:#666;font-size:.8rem}

/* SCROLLBAR */
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg)}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--primary);border-radius:4px}

/* RESPONSIVE */
@media(max-width:768px){
nav{display:none;position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;right:0;background:rgba(10,10,26,.98);flex-direction:column;padding:16px;gap:4px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.2)}
nav.open{display:flex}
.hamburger{display:flex}
.hero h1{font-size:2rem}
.hero-stats{flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.game-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.modal{max-width:100%;margin:10px;border-radius:12px}
.modal-body{padding:16px}
.wordle-tile{width:42px;height:42px;font-size:1.1rem}
.sudoku-board{max-width:300px}
.sudoku-cell{font-size:.85rem}
}
@media(max-width:480px){
.hero h1{font-size:1.6rem}
.hero p{font-size:1rem}
.section-title h2{font-size:1.6rem}
}

/* ANIMATIONS */
.fade-in{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px);transition:.6s}
.fade-in.visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
@keyframes float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-10px)}}
.float-anim{animation:float 3s ease-in-out infinite}

/* NOTIFICATION */
.notification{position:fixed;top:80px;right:20px;padding:14px 24px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:600;z-index:3000;transform:translateX(120%);transition:.4s;max-width:300px}
.notification.show{transform:translateX(0)}
.notification.success{background:rgba(67,233,123,.15);border:1px solid var(--accent);color:var(--accent)}
.notification.error{background:rgba(255,101,132,.15);border:1px solid var(--secondary);color:var(--secondary)}
.notification.info{background:rgba(108,99,255,.15);border:1px solid var(--primary);color:var(--primary)}

/* SEARCH */
.search-bar{max-width:400px;margin:0 auto 32px;position:relative}
.search-bar input{width:100%;padding:14px 20px 14px 48px;border-radius:50px;border:2px solid rgba(108,99,255,.2);background:rgba(15,52,96,.3);color:var(--text);font-size:1rem;outline:none;transition:.3s}
.search-bar input:focus{border-color:var(--primary)}
.search-bar .search-icon{position:absolute;left:18px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:#888;font-size:1.1rem}

/* FILTER TABS */
.filter-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:32px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.filter-tab{padding:8px 20px;border-radius:50px;background:rgba(108,99,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(108,99,255,.15);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;font-size:.85rem;transition:.3s}
.filter-tab:hover,.filter-tab.active{background:var(--primary);color:var(--white);border-color:var(--primary)}
</style>
</head>

</a>

<span></span><span></span><span></span>

const maxGuesses = 6;
let currentGuess = '';
let guesses = [];

container.innerHTML = `

for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
const tile = document.createElement('div');
tile.className = 'wordle-tile';

const g = guesses[i];
if (g[j] === target[j]) tile.classList.add('correct');
else if (target.includes(g[j])) tile.classList.add('present');
else tile.classList.add('absent');
} else if (i === guesses.length) {
tile.textContent = currentGuess[j] || '';
if (currentGuess[j]) tile.classList.add('active');

row.appendChild(tile);
}

}

function renderKeyboard() {
const kb = document.getElementById('wordleKB');
const rows = [['Q','W','E','R','T','Y','U','I','O','P'],['A','S','D','F','G','H','J','K','L'],['ENTER','Z','X','C','V','B','N','M','⌫']];
kb.innerHTML = '';
rows.forEach(row => {
const rowDiv = document.createElement('div');
rowDiv.className = 'wordle-key-row';
row.forEach(key => {
const btn = document.createElement('button');
btn.className = 'wordle-key';
btn.textContent = key;
if (key === 'ENTER' || key === '⌫') btn.classList.add('wide');
// Color based on guesses
for (let g of guesses) {
for (let ch of g) {
if (key === ch) {
if (ch === target[target.indexOf(ch)]) btn.classList.add('correct');
else if (target.includes(ch) && btn.classList.contains('present') === false) btn.classList.add('present');
else btn.classList.add('absent');
}
}
}
btn.onclick = () => handleKey(key);
rowDiv.appendChild(btn);
});
kb.appendChild(rowDiv);
});
}

function handleKey(key) {
if (gameOver) return;
if (key === 'ENTER') {
if (currentGuess.length !== 5) {
document.getElementById('wordleMsg').textContent = 'Need 5 letters!';
document.getElementById('wordleMsg').style.color = 'var(--secondary)';
return;
}
guesses.push(currentGuess);
if (currentGuess === target) {
gameOver = true;
document.getElementById('wordleMsg').textContent = '🎉 Correct! You got it!';
document.getElementById('wordleMsg').style.color = 'var(--accent)';
} else if (guesses.length >= maxGuesses) {
gameOver = true;
document.getElementById('wordleMsg').textContent = '😔 The word was: ' + target;
document.getElementById('wordleMsg').style.color = 'var(--secondary)';
} else {
document.getElementById('wordleMsg').textContent = '';
}
currentGuess = '';
} else if (key === '⌫') {
currentGuess = currentGuess.slice(0, -1);
} else if (currentGuess.length < 5 && /^[A-Z]$/.test(key)) {
currentGuess += key;
}
renderGrid();
renderKeyboard();
}

renderGrid();
renderKeyboard();
}

function initTicTacToe(container) {
let board = Array(9).fill('');

function renderBoard() {
const b = document.getElementById('tttBoard');
b.innerHTML = '';
board.forEach((cell, i) => {
const div = document.createElement('div');
div.className = 'ttt-cell' + (cell === 'X' ? ' x' : cell === 'O' ? ' o' : '');
div.textContent = cell;
div.onclick = () => makeMove(i);
b.appendChild(div);
});
}

function checkWinner(b) {
const wins = [[0,1,2],[3,4,5],[6,7,8],[0,3,6],[1,4,7],[2,5,8],[0,4,8],[2,4,6]];
for (let w of wins) {
if (b[w[0]] && b[w[0]] === b[w[1]] && b[w[1]] === b[w[2]]) return b[w[0]];
}
if (b.every(c => c)) return 'draw';
return null;
}

function minimax(b, isMax) {
const result = checkWinner(b);
if (result === 'O') return 10;
if (result === 'X') return -10;
if (result === 'draw') return 0;
if (isMax) {
let best = -Infinity;
for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
if (!b[i]) {
b[i] = 'O';
best = Math.max(best, minimax(b, false));
b[i] = '';
}
}
return best;
} else {
let best = Infinity;
for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
if (!b[i]) {
b[i] = 'X';
best = Math.min(best, minimax(b, true));
b[i] = '';
}
}
return best;
}
}

function aiMove() {
let bestScore = -Infinity;
let bestMove = -1;
for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
if (!board[i]) {
board[i] = 'O';
let score = minimax(board, false);
board[i] = '';
if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; bestMove = i; }
}
}
if (bestMove >= 0) board[bestMove] = 'O';
}

function makeMove(i) {
if (gameOver || board[i]) return;
board[i] = 'X';
const result = checkWinner(board);
if (result) { endGame(result); return; }
aiMove();
result2 = checkWinner(board);
if (result2) { endGame(result2); return; }
renderBoard();
}

function endGame(result) {
gameOver = true;
const status = document.getElementById('tttStatus');
if (result === 'X') { status.textContent = '🎉 You win!'; status.style.color = 'var(--accent)'; }
else if (result === 'O') { status.textContent = '🤖 AI wins!'; status.style.color = 'var(--secondary)'; }
else { status.textContent = '🤝 It\'s a draw!'; status.style.color = 'var(--gold)'; }
renderBoard();
}

renderBoard();
}

score = 0; streak = 0; timeLeft = 60;

generateProblem();
timer = setInterval(() => {

document.getElementById('mathInput').disabled = true;
document.getElementById('mathProblem').textContent = '⏰ Time\'s up!';

document.getElementById('mathStartBtn').textContent = '🔄 Play Again';
}
}, 1000);
};

function generateProblem() {
let a, b, op, answer;
if (difficulty === 'easy') {
a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1;
b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1;
op = ['+', '-'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 2)];
} else if (difficulty === 'medium') {
a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 1;
b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 1;
op = ['+', '-', '×'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)];
} else {
a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 50) + 1;
b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 50) + 1;
op = ['+', '-', '×', '÷'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)];
}
if (op === '-' && a < b) [a, b] = [b, a];
if (op === '÷') { answer = b; b = a; a = a * b; }
if (op === '+') answer = a + b;
else if (op === '-') answer = a - b;
else if (op === '×') answer = a * b;
else if (op === '÷') answer = a / b;
currentAnswer = answer;
document.getElementById('mathProblem').innerHTML = `${a} <span class="op">${op}</span> ${b} = ?`;
document.getElementById('mathInput').value = '';
document.getElementById('mathFeedback').textContent = '';
}

if (e.key === 'Enter' && !document.getElementById('mathInput').disabled) {
const val = parseInt(document.getElementById('mathInput').value);
const fb = document.getElementById('mathFeedback');
if (val === currentAnswer) {
score += difficulty === 'easy' ? 10 : difficulty === 'medium' ? 20 : 30;
streak++;

fb.className = 'math-feedback correct';

fb.className = 'math-feedback wrong';
}
document.getElementById('mathScore').textContent = score;
document.getElementById('mathStreak').textContent = streak;
generateProblem();
}
});
}

// ========== RAIN DROP GAME ==========
function initRainDrop(container) {
container.innerHTML = `
<div class="rain-container">
<h3 style="margin-bottom:12px">🌧️ Rain Drop Catcher</h3>
<div class="rain-info">
<span class="score">⭐ Score: <span id="rainScore">0</span></span>
<span class="lives">❤️ Lives: <span id="rainLives">5</span></span>
</div>
<canvas id="rainCanvas" width="500" height="400"></canvas>
<div style="margin-top:12px;font-size:.85rem;color:#888">Move mouse or touch to control the bucket</div>
<button class="play-btn" onclick="initRainDrop(document.getElementById('modalBody'))" style="margin-top:12px">🔄 Restart</button>
</div>`;

const canvas = document.getElementById('rainCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

let bucket = { x: W / 2, w: 60, h: 20 };
let drops = [];
let rocks = [];
let score = 0;
let lives = 5;
let gameRunning = true;
let spawnTimer = 0;

function spawn() {
if (Math.random() < 0.03) {
drops.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: -10, speed: 2 + Math.random() * 3, r: 6 });
}
if (Math.random() < 0.008) {
rocks.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: -10, speed: 1.5 + Math.random() * 2, r: 8 });
}
}

function update() {
if (!gameRunning) return;
spawn();

drops.forEach(d => d.y += d.speed);
drops = drops.filter(d => {
if (d.y > H - 30 && d.x > bucket.x - bucket.w / 2 && d.x < bucket.x + bucket.w / 2) {
score += 10;
document.getElementById('rainScore').textContent = score;
return false;
}
return d.y < H + 10;
});

rocks.forEach(r => r.y += r.speed);
rocks = rocks.filter(r => {
if (r.y > H - 30 && r.x > bucket.x - bucket.w / 2 && r.x < bucket.x + bucket.w / 2) {
lives--;
document.getElementById('rainLives').textContent = lives;
if (lives <= 0) {
gameRunning = false;
document.getElementById('rainScore').textContent = score + ' (Game Over!)';
}
return false;
}
return r.y < H + 10;
});
}

function draw() {
ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
// Background
const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
grad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0a2e');
grad.addColorStop(1, '#1a1a4e');
ctx.fillStyle = grad;
ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

// Drops
drops.forEach(d => {
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, d.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fillStyle = '#4FC3F7';
ctx.fill();
});

// Rocks
rocks.forEach(r => {
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(r.x, r.y, r.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
ctx.fill();
});

// Bucket
ctx.fillStyle = '#FF8C00';
ctx.fillRect(bucket.x - bucket.w / 2, H - 30, bucket.w, bucket.h);
ctx.fillStyle = '#FFA000';
ctx.fillRect(bucket.x - bucket.w / 2 - 5, H - 35, bucket.w + 10, 5);

if (!gameRunning) {
ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
ctx.font = 'bold 28px sans-serif';
ctx.textAlign = 'center';
ctx.fillText('Game Over!', W / 2, H / 2 - 10);
ctx.font = '18px sans-serif';
ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
}
}

function loop() {
update();
draw();
canvas._raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
bucket.x = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
});
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
e.preventDefault();
const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
bucket.x = (e.touches[0].clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
}, { passive: false });

loop();
}

<button class="play-btn" onclick="initRockDrop(document.getElementById('modalBody'))" style="margin-top:12px">🔄 Restart</button>
</div>`;

const canvas = document.getElementById('rockCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

let rocks = [];
let score = 0;
let rocksLeft = 20;
let particles = [];
let mountain = [];

// Generate mountain
for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 5) {
mountain.push({
x: x,
y: H - 100 - Math.random() * 120 - Math.sin(x / 30) * 40
});
}

function dropRock(x, y) {
if (rocksLeft <= 0) return;
rocksLeft--;
document.getElementById('rockCount').textContent = rocksLeft;
rocks.push({ x: x, y: y, vy: 0, r: 8 + Math.random() * 6, gravity: 0.3 });
}

canvas.addEventListener('click', e => {
const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
dropRock((e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width), (e.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height));
});

function update() {
rocks.forEach(r => {
r.vy += r.gravity;
r.y += r.vy;
// Check collision with mountain
for (let m of mountain) {
if (Math.abs(r.x - m.x) < r.r + 3 && r.y > m.y - r.r) {
// Create particles
for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
particles.push({
x: r.x, y: m.y,
vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4,
vy: -Math.random() * 3,
life: 30,
color: '#8B7355'
});
}
// Lower mountain
m.y = Math.min(m.y + 10, H - 20);
score += 5;
document.getElementById('rockScore').textContent = score;
r.y = m.y - r.r;
r.vy = 0;
break;
}
}
});

particles.forEach(p => {
p.x += p.vx;
p.y += p.vy;
p.vy += 0.1;
p.life--;
});
particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);
}

function draw() {
ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
// Sky
const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
grad.addColorStop(0, '#1a1a3e');
grad.addColorStop(1, '#2a1a3e');
ctx.fillStyle = grad;
ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

// Stars
for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.3 + Math.random() * 0.5})`;
ctx.fillRect((i * 37) % W, (i * 53) % (H / 2), 2, 2);
}

// Mountain
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.moveTo(0, H);
mountain.forEach(m => ctx.lineTo(m.x, m.y));
ctx.lineTo(W, H);
ctx.closePath();
const mGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H - 200, 0, H);
mGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4a3728');
mGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2d1f15');
ctx.fillStyle = mGrad;
ctx.fill();

// Rocks
rocks.forEach(r => {
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(r.x, r.y, r.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fillStyle = '#666';
ctx.fill();
ctx.strokeStyle = '#888';
ctx.lineWidth = 1;
ctx.stroke();
});

// Particles
particles.forEach(p => {
ctx.globalAlpha = p.life / 30;
ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
ctx.fillRect(p.x - 2, p.y - 2, 4, 4);
});
ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

if (rocksLeft <= 0 && rocks.length === 0) {
ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
ctx.font = 'bold 24px sans-serif';
ctx.textAlign = 'center';
ctx.fillText('Path Cleared! Score: ' + score, W / 2, H / 2);
}
}

function loop() {
update();
draw();
canvas._raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
}

clearInterval(timer);
if (currentBid > 0) {

// ========== ARITHMETIC GAME ==========
function initArithmetic(container) {
let score = 0;
let total = 0;
let currentAnswer = 0;
let level = 1;

container.innerHTML = `
<div class="math-container">
<h3 style="margin-bottom:12px">➕ Arithmetic Learning Game</h3>
<div class="math-level">
<button class="math-level-btn active" onclick="setArithLevel(1,this)">Level 1</button>
<button class="math-level-btn" onclick="setArithLevel(2,this)">Level 2</button>
<button class="math-level-btn" onclick="setArithLevel(3,this)">Level 3</button>
</div>
<div class="math-score">
<div class="math-score-item"><div class="val" id="arithScore" style="color:var(--accent)">0</div><div class="lbl">Correct</div></div>
<div class="math-score-item"><div class="val" id="arithTotal" style="color:var(--gold)">0</div><div class="lbl">Total</div></div>
</div>
<div class="math-problem" id="arithProblem">Press Start!</div>
<input type="number" class="math-input" id="arithInput" placeholder="?" disabled>
<div class="math-feedback" id="arithFeedback"></div>
<button class="play-btn" id="arithStartBtn" onclick="startArith()">▶ Start</button>
</div>`;

window.setArithLevel = function(l, btn) {
level = l;
document.querySelectorAll('.math-level-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
btn.classList.add('active');
};

window.startArith = function() {
score = 0; total = 0;
document.getElementById('arithInput').disabled = false;
document.getElementById('arithInput').focus();
document.getElementById('arithStartBtn').style.display = 'none';
generateArithProblem();
};

function generateArithProblem() {
let a, b, op, answer;
if (level === 1) {
a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1;
b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1;
op = ['+', '-'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 2)];
} else if (level === 2) {
a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 1;
b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 1;
op = ['+', '-', '×'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)];
} else {
a = Math.floor(Math.random() * 50) + 1;
b = Math.floor(Math.random() * 50) + 1;
op = ['+', '-', '×', '÷'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)];
}
if (op === '-' && a < b) [a, b] = [b, a];
if (op === '÷') { answer = b; b = a; a = a * b; }
if (op === '+') answer = a + b;
else if (op === '-') answer = a - b;
else if (op === '×') answer = a * b;
else if (op === '÷') answer = a / b;
currentAnswer = answer;
document.getElementById('arithProblem').innerHTML = `${a} <span class="op">${op}</span> ${b} = ?`;
document.getElementById('arithInput').value = '';
document.getElementById('arithFeedback').textContent = '';
}

document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
if (e.key === 'Enter' && !document.getElementById('arithInput').disabled) {
const val = parseInt(document.getElementById('arithInput').value);
total++;
const fb = document.getElementById('arithFeedback');
if (val === currentAnswer) {
score++;
fb.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';
fb.className = 'math-feedback correct';
} else {
fb.textContent = '❌ The answer is ' + currentAnswer;
fb.className = 'math-feedback wrong';
}
document.getElementById('arithScore').textContent = score;
document.getElementById('arithTotal').textContent = total;
generateArithProblem();
}
});
}

// ========== SCROLL ANIMATIONS ==========
const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
entries.forEach(entry => {
if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('visible');
});
}, { threshold: 0.1 });

document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

// ========== KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS ==========
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
if (e.key === 'Escape') closeGame();
});

// Close modal on overlay click
document.getElementById('gameModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {

});

  <!-- SLIDE 2: Introduction -->
  <div class="slide slide-2" data-slide="2">

      <div>
        <div class="slide-label animate-in delay-1">Introduction</div>
        <h2 class="slide-title animate-in delay-2">Un contexte éducatif<br>particulier</h2>
        <div class="slide-text animate-in delay-3">
          <p>En milieu rural, l'apprentissage du français se heurte à des réalités spécifiques qui diffèrent sensiblement des contextes urbains. Les élèves y font souvent face à une <strong>double barrière linguistique</strong> : la langue maternelle locale et le français langue d'enseignement.</p>
          <p>Cette présentation explore les défis, les approches pédagogiques adaptées et les opportunités offertes par le numérique pour améliorer l'acquisition du français dans les zones rurales.</p>

      </div>

        <div class="intro-card">
          <div class="stat-grid">

        <div class="challenge-card animate-in delay-3">
          <div class="challenge-icon">🏫</div>
          <div class="challenge-title">Infrastructures limitées</div>

        </div>
        <div class="challenge-card animate-in delay-4">

          <div class="challenge-title">Ressources insuffisantes</div>

        </div>
        <div class="challenge-card animate-in delay-6">
          <div class="challenge-icon">🌍</div>
          <div class="challenge-title">Multilinguisme</div>

        </div>
        <div class="challenge-card animate-in delay-8">
          <div class="challenge-icon">💻</div>

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

<script>
  let currentSlide = 1;
  const totalSlides = 9;

  // Initialize dot navigation
  const dotNav = document.getElementById('dotNav');
  for (let i = 1; i <= totalSlides; i++) {
    const dot = document.createElement('button');
    dot.className = 'dot' + (i === 1 ? ' active' : '');
    dot.onclick = () => goToSlide(i);
    dot.title = `Diapositive ${i}`;
    dotNav.appendChild(dot);
  }

  function updateUI() {
    // Update slides
    document.querySelectorAll('.slide').forEach((slide, index) => {
      const slideNum = index + 1;
      slide.classList.remove('active', 'exit-left');
      if (slideNum === currentSlide) {
        slide.classList.add('active');
      }
    });

    // Update buttons
    document.getElementById('prevBtn').disabled = currentSlide === 1;
    document.getElementById('nextBtn').disabled = currentSlide === totalSlides;

    // Update counter
    document.getElementById('currentSlide').textContent = currentSlide;

    // Update progress bar
    const progress = (currentSlide / totalSlides) * 100;
    document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = progress + '%';

    // Update dots
    document.querySelectorAll('.dot').forEach((dot, index) => {
      dot.classList.toggle('active', index + 1 === currentSlide);
    });
  }

  function changeSlide(direction) {
    const newSlide = currentSlide + direction;
    if (newSlide >= 1 && newSlide <= totalSlides) {
      currentSlide = newSlide;
      updateUI();
    }
  }

  function goToSlide(num) {
    currentSlide = num;
    updateUI();
  }

  // Keyboard navigation
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === ' ') {
      e.preventDefault();
      changeSlide(1);
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      changeSlide(-1);
    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
      e.preventDefault();
      goToSlide(1);
    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
      e.preventDefault();
      goToSlide(totalSlides);
    }
  });

  // Touch support
  let touchStartX = 0;
  let touchEndX = 0;

  document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    touchStartX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
  }, false);

  document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
    touchEndX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
    const diff = touchStartX - touchEndX;
    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
      if (diff > 0) changeSlide(1);
      else changeSlide(-1);
    }
  }, false);

  // Initialize
  updateUI();
</script>

</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Ramp Runner</title>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
body {
background: #0a0a2e;
display: flex;
justify-content: center;
align-items: center;
height: 100vh;
overflow: hidden;
font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
}
canvas {
border-radius: 12px;
box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(100, 200, 255, 0.3);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

canvas.width = 900;
canvas.height = 550;

// Game state
let score = 0;
let highScore = 0;
let gameTime = 0;
let screenShake = 0;
let particles = [];
let floatingTexts = [];
let coins = [];
let stars = [];
let rampSegments = [];
let camera = { x: 0, y: 0 };
let gameStarted = false;
let gameOver = false;

// Player
const player = {
    x: 100,
    y: 400,
    width: 30,
    height: 45,
    vx: 0,
    vy: 0,
    speed: 4,
    onGround: false,
    facing: 1,
    walkFrame: 0,
    walkTimer: 0,
    jumpPower: -10,
    gravity: 0.45,
    invincible: 0,
    trail: []
};

// Ramp definition - a long sloped ramp with some variations
function generateRamp() {
    rampSegments = [];
    const totalLength = 8000;
    let x = 0;
    let y = 420;
    const baseAngle = -0.18; // slight upward slope

    while (x < totalLength) {
        const segmentWidth = 60;
        const slopeVariation = Math.sin(x * 0.003) * 0.05 + Math.sin(x * 0.007) * 0.03;
        const angle = baseAngle + slopeVariation;
        const newX = x + segmentWidth;
        const newY = y + Math.tan(angle) * segmentWidth;

        rampSegments.push({
            x1: x, y1: y,
            x2: newX, y2: newY,
            height: Math.abs(newY - y)
        });

        x = newX;
        y = newY;
    }

    // Generate coins along the ramp
    coins = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
        const coinX = 200 + Math.random() * (totalLength - 400);
        const rampY = getRampYAt(coinX);
        coins.push({
            x: coinX,
            y: rampY - 30 - Math.random() * 60,
            collected: false,
            bobOffset: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
            size: 12 + Math.random() * 4,
            rotation: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
        });
    }

    // Generate stars for background
    stars = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
        stars.push({
            x: Math.random() * totalLength,
            y: Math.random() * 300,
            size: Math.random() * 2.5 + 0.5,
            twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
            speed: Math.random() * 0.02 + 0.01
        });
    }
}

function getRampYAt(x) {
    for (let seg of rampSegments) {
        if (x >= seg.x1 && x < seg.x2) {
            const t = (x - seg.x1) / (seg.x2 - seg.x1);
            return seg.y1 + (seg.y2 - seg.y1) * t;
        }
    }
    return 420;
}

function getRampAngleAt(x) {
    for (let seg of rampSegments) {
        if (x >= seg.x1 && x < seg.x2) {
            return Math.atan2(seg.y2 - seg.y1, seg.x2 - seg.x1);
        }
    }
    return -0.18;
}

// Input
const keys = {};
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    keys[e.code] = true;
    if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'ArrowDown') {
        e.preventDefault();
    }
    if (!gameStarted) {
        gameStarted = true;
    }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => { keys[e.code] = false; });

// Touch controls
let touchLeft = false;
let touchRight = false;
let touchJump = false;
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!gameStarted) { gameStarted = true; }
    for (let touch of e.changedTouches) {
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = touch.clientX - rect.left;
        if (x < canvas.width / 3) touchLeft = true;
        else if (x > canvas.width * 2 / 3) touchRight = true;
        else touchJump = true;
    }
});
canvas.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    touchLeft = false;
    touchRight = false;
    touchJump = false;
});

// Particles
function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count, spread) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        particles.push({
            x, y,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * spread,
            vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * spread - 2,
            life: 1,
            decay: Math.random() * 0.03 + 0.015,
            size: Math.random() * 4 + 2,
            color
        });
    }
}

function spawnFloatingText(x, y, text, color) {
    floatingTexts.push({ x, y, text, color, life: 1, vy: -2 });
}

// Initialize
generateRamp();

// Drawing functions
function drawBackground() {
    // Sky gradient
    const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
    skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0a2e');
    skyGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#1a1a4e');
    skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2a1a3e');
    ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    // Stars
    for (let star of stars) {
        const screenX = star.x - camera.x * 0.3;
        if (screenX < -10 || screenX > canvas.width + 10) continue;
        star.twinkle += star.speed;
        const alpha = 0.4 + Math.sin(star.twinkle) * 0.4;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha})`;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(screenX, star.y, star.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    }

    // Distant mountains (parallax)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#15153a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, canvas.height);
    for (let x = 0; x <= canvas.width; x += 3) {
        const worldX = x + camera.x * 0.1;
        const y = 300 + Math.sin(worldX * 0.005) * 60 + Math.sin(worldX * 0.012) * 30;
        ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a45';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, canvas.height);
    for (let x = 0; x <= canvas.width; x += 3) {
        const worldX = x + camera.x * 0.2;
        const y = 350 + Math.sin(worldX * 0.008) * 40 + Math.sin(worldX * 0.02) * 20;
        ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.fill();
}

function drawRamp() {
    // Draw ramp surface
    ctx.beginPath();
    const startSeg = Math.max(0, Math.floor(camera.x / 60) - 1);
    const endSeg = Math.min(rampSegments.length, startSeg + Math.ceil(canvas.width / 60) + 5);

    // Ramp fill
    ctx.moveTo(rampSegments[startSeg].x1 - camera.x, canvas.height);
    ctx.lineTo(rampSegments[startSeg].x1 - camera.x, rampSegments[startSeg].y1 - camera.y);

    for (let i = startSeg; i < endSeg; i++) {
        ctx.lineTo(rampSegments[i].x2 - camera.x, rampSegments[i].y2 - camera.y);
    }

    ctx.lineTo(rampSegments[endSeg - 1].x2 - camera.x, canvas.height);
    ctx.closePath();

    const rampGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 200, 0, canvas.height);
    rampGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4a6741');
    rampGrad.addColorStop(0.3, '#3a5235');
    rampGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2a3a28');
    ctx.fillStyle = rampGrad;
    ctx.fill();

    // Ramp top edge (grass line)
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = startSeg; i < endSeg; i++) {
        const sx = rampSegments[i].x1 - camera.x;
        const sy = rampSegments[i].y1 - camera.y;
        if (i === startSeg) ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
        else ctx.lineTo(sx, sy);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(rampSegments[endSeg - 1].x2 - camera.x, rampSegments[endSeg - 1].y2 - camera.y);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#6a9a5a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Ramp surface line
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = startSeg; i < endSeg; i++) {
        const sx = rampSegments[i].x1 - camera.x;
        const sy = rampSegments[i].y1 - camera.y;
        if (i === startSeg) ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
        else ctx.lineTo(sx, sy);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(rampSegments[endSeg - 1].x2 - camera.x, rampSegments[endSeg - 1].y2 - camera.y);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#8aba7a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Grass tufts on top
    for (let i = startSeg; i < endSeg; i += 3) {
        const sx = rampSegments[i].x1 - camera.x;
        const sy = rampSegments[i].y1 - camera.y;
        const angle = getRampAngleAt(rampSegments[i].x1);
        for (let g = 0; g < 3; g++) {
            const gx = sx + g * 4 - 4;
            const gy = sy;
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#7aba6a';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(gx, gy);
            ctx.lineTo(gx + Math.sin(angle) * 3 - 3, gy - 6 - Math.random() * 3);
            ctx.stroke();
        }
    }
}

function drawPlayer() {
    const screenX = player.x - camera.x;
    const screenY = player.y - camera.y;
    const angle = getRampAngleAt(player.x);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(screenX, screenY);
    ctx.rotate(angle);

    // Trail effect
    if (Math.abs(player.vx) > 0.5) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.15;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#4af';
        ctx.fillRect(-player.width / 2 - 2, -player.height + 5, player.width + 4, player.height - 5);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    // Body
    const bodyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-12, -player.height, 12, 0);
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#5588ff');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3366cc');
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(-12, -player.height, 24, player.height - 10);

    // Head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc88';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -player.height + 5, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Hair
    ctx.fillStyle = '#443322';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -player.height + 1, 11, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Eyes
    const eyeDir = player.facing;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(eyeDir * 3, -player.height + 4, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Mouth
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#aa6644';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(eyeDir * 2, -player.height + 9, 3, 0, Math.PI);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Legs animation
    const walkCycle = Math.sin(player.walkFrame * 0.3) * 8;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3355aa';
    // Left leg
    ctx.fillRect(-10, -12, 8, 12 + (player.onGround && Math.abs(player.vx) > 0.5 ? walkCycle : 0));
    // Right leg
    ctx.fillRect(2, -12, 8, 12 + (player.onGround && Math.abs(player.vx) > 0.5 ? -walkCycle : 0));

    // Shoes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#884422';
    const shoeOffset1 = player.onGround && Math.abs(player.vx) > 0.5 ? walkCycle : 0;
    const shoeOffset2 = player.onGround && Math.abs(player.vx) > 0.5 ? -walkCycle : 0;
    ctx.fillRect(-11, -1 + shoeOffset1, 10, 4);
    ctx.fillRect(1, -1 + shoeOffset2, 10, 4);

    // Arms
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffcc88';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    const armSwing = player.onGround && Math.abs(player.vx) > 0.5 ? Math.sin(player.walkFrame * 0.3) * 15 : 0;
    // Left arm
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-12, -player.height + 18);
    ctx.lineTo(-18, -player.height + 30 + armSwing);
    ctx.stroke();
    // Right arm
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(12, -player.height + 18);
    ctx.lineTo(18, -player.height + 30 - armSwing);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.restore();

    // Invincibility flash
    if (player.invincible > 0 && Math.floor(player.invincible * 10) % 2 === 0) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(screenX, screenY - player.height / 2, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
}

function drawCoins() {
    for (let coin of coins) {
        if (coin.collected) continue;
        const screenX = coin.x - camera.x;
        if (screenX < -20 || screenX > canvas.width + 20) continue;

        const bobY = Math.sin(gameTime * 0.05 + coin.bobOffset) * 4;
        const screenY = coin.y - camera.y + bobY;

        coin.rotation += 0.03;
        const scaleX = Math.cos(coin.rotation);

        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(screenX, screenY);
        ctx.scale(scaleX, 1);

        // Glow
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 0, coin.size + 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Coin body
        const coinGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(-2, -2, 1, 0, 0, coin.size);
        coinGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ffee44');
        coinGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#ffcc00');
        coinGrad.addColorStop(1, '#cc9900');
        ctx.fillStyle = coinGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 0, coin.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Coin border
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#aa8800';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();

        // Dollar sign
        ctx.fillStyle = '#aa8800';
        ctx.font = `bold ${coin.size}px Arial`;
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.fillText('$', 0, 1);

        ctx.restore();
    }
}

function drawParticles() {
    for (let p of particles) {
        const screenX = p.x - camera.x;
        const screenY = p.y - camera.y;
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
        ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(screenX, screenY, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawFloatingTexts() {
    for (let ft of floatingTexts) {
        const screenX = ft.x - camera.x;
        const screenY = ft.y - camera.y;
        ctx.globalAlpha = ft.life;
        ctx.fillStyle = ft.color;
        ctx.font = `bold ${16 + (1 - ft.life) * 10}px Arial`;
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(ft.text, screenX, screenY);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
    // Score panel
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(10, 10, 180, 55, 10);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd44';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(`⭐ ${score}`, 25, 38);

    // High score
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(canvas.width - 190, 10, 180, 55, 10);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100, 200, 255, 0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#88ccff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 14px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('BEST', canvas.width - 25, 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaddff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
    ctx.fillText(`${highScore}`, canvas.width - 25, 52);

    // Distance indicator
    const dist = Math.floor(player.x / 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(canvas.width / 2 - 60, 10, 120, 35, 10);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaffaa';
    ctx.font = 'bold 14px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(`${dist}m`, canvas.width / 2, 33);

    // Progress bar
    const progress = Math.min(1, player.x / 7000);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(canvas.width / 2 - 100, 50, 200, 8, 4);
    ctx.fill();
    const progGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(canvas.width / 2 - 100, 0, canvas.width / 2 + 100, 0);
    progGrad.addColorStop(0, '#44ff88');
    progGrad.addColorStop(1, '#44aaff');
    ctx.fillStyle = progGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(canvas.width / 2 - 100, 50, 200 * progress, 8, 4);
    ctx.fill();
}

function drawStartScreen() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    // Title
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd44';
    ctx.font = 'bold 52px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('RAMP RUNNER', canvas.width / 2, 180);

    // Subtitle
    ctx.fillStyle = '#88ccff';
    ctx.font = '20px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Walk the ramp, collect the coins!', canvas.width / 2, 230);

    // Instructions
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '16px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('← → or A D to move  |  ↑ or W or SPACE to jump', canvas.width / 2, 300);

    // Start prompt
    const pulse = Math.sin(gameTime * 0.08) * 0.3 + 0.7;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd44';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Press any key to start', canvas.width / 2, 380);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // Animated character preview
    const previewX = canvas.width / 2 + Math.sin(gameTime * 0.03) * 100;
    const previewY = 440;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5588ff';
    ctx.fillRect(previewX - 12, previewY - 45, 24, 35);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc88';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(previewX, previewY - 40, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#443322';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(previewX, previewY - 45, 11, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
}

function drawGameOver() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6666';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', canvas.width / 2, 200);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd44';
    ctx.font = 'bold 28px Arial';
    ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, canvas.width / 2, 270);

    if (score >= highScore) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#44ff88';
        ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
        ctx.fillText('🏆 NEW HIGH SCORE! 🏆', canvas.width / 2, 310);
    }

    const pulse = Math.sin(gameTime * 0.08) * 0.3 + 0.7;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '20px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Press any key to restart', canvas.width / 2, 380);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

// Update functions
function updatePlayer() {
    const left = keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA'] || touchLeft;
    const right = keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD'] || touchRight;
    const jump = keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW'] || keys['Space'] || touchJump;

    // Horizontal movement
    if (left) {
        player.vx = -player.speed;
        player.facing = -1;
    } else if (right) {
        player.vx = player.speed;
        player.facing = 1;
    } else {
        player.vx *= 0.8;
        if (Math.abs(player.vx) < 0.1) player.vx = 0;
    }

    // Jump
    if (jump && player.onGround) {
        const angle = getRampAngleAt(player.x);
        player.vy = player.jumpPower * Math.cos(angle);
        player.vx += player.facing * 2;
        player.onGround = false;
        spawnParticles(player.x, player.y, '#aaddaa', 8, 4);
    }

    // Gravity
    player.vy += player.gravity;

    // Apply velocity
    player.x += player.vx;
    player.y += player.vy;

    // Ramp collision
    const rampY = getRampYAt(player.x);
    const rampAngle = getRampAngleAt(player.x);

    if (player.y >= rampY) {
        player.y = rampY;
        player.vy = 0;
        player.onGround = true;

        // Align to ramp surface
        player.vx += Math.sin(rampAngle) * 0.3;

        // Walking particles
        if (Math.abs(player.vx) > 1 && player.onGround) {
            if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
                spawnParticles(player.x, player.y, '#8a7a5a', 1, 2);
            }
        }
    } else {
        player.onGround = false;
    }

    // Clamp position
    if (player.x < 0) { player.x = 0; player.vx = 0; }
    if (player.x > 7900) { player.x = 7900; }

    // Fall off bottom
    if (player.y > 800) {
        gameOver = true;
        if (score > highScore) highScore = score;
    }

    // Walk animation
    if (Math.abs(player.vx) > 0.5) {
        player.walkFrame += Math.abs(player.vx) * 0.5;
    }

    // Invincibility timer
    if (player.invincible > 0) player.invincible -= 0.016;

    // Trail
    if (Math.abs(player.vx) > 1) {
        player.trail.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y - 22, life: 1 });
    }
    player.trail = player.trail.filter(t => {
        t.life -= 0.05;
        return t.life > 0;
    });
}

function updateCamera() {
    const targetX = player.x - canvas.width * 0.35;
    const targetY = player.y - canvas.height * 0.55;

    camera.x += (targetX - camera.x) * 0.08;
    camera.y += (targetY - camera.y) * 0.08;

    // Keep camera in bounds
    if (camera.x < -50) camera.x = -50;
    if (camera.y > 200) camera.y = 200;
    if (camera.y < -300) camera.y = -300;
}

function updateCoins() {
    for (let coin of coins) {
        if (coin.collected) continue;
        const dx = player.x - coin.x;
        const dy = (player.y - 22) - coin.y;
        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

        if (dist < 30) {
            coin.collected = true;
            const points = 10;
            score += points;
            screenShake = 5;
            spawnParticles(coin.x, coin.y, '#ffdd00', 15, 6);
            spawnParticles(coin.x, coin.y, '#ffee88', 10, 4);
            spawnFloatingText(coin.x, coin.y - 20, `+${points}`, '#ffdd44');
        }
    }
}

function updateParticles() {
    particles = particles.filter(p => {
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;
        p.vy += 0.1;
        p.life -= p.decay;
        return p.life > 0;
    });

    floatingTexts = floatingTexts.filter(ft => {
        ft.y += ft.vy;
        ft.life -= 0.02;
        return ft.life > 0;
    });

    if (screenShake > 0) screenShake -= 0.5;
}

// Main game loop
function update() {
    if (!gameStarted || gameOver) return;

    gameTime++;
    updatePlayer();
    updateCamera();
    updateCoins();
    updateParticles();
}

function draw() {
    ctx.save();

    // Screen shake
    if (screenShake > 0) {
        ctx.translate(
            (Math.random() - 0.5) * screenShake * 2,
            (Math.random() - 0.5) * screenShake * 2
        );
    }

    drawBackground();
    drawRamp();
    drawCoins();
    drawPlayer();
    drawParticles();
    drawFloatingTexts();
    drawHUD();

    ctx.restore();

    if (!gameStarted) drawStartScreen();
    if (gameOver) drawGameOver();
}

function gameLoop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// Restart
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (gameOver) {
        gameOver = false;
        score = 0;
        player.x = 100;
        player.y = 400;
        player.vx = 0;
        player.vy = 0;
        player.invincible = 0;
        camera.x = 0;
        camera.y = 0;
        particles = [];
        floatingTexts = [];
        generateRamp();
    }
});

gameLoop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

prompt: # Game Development Brief: "Sky Runner - Aviation Endless Runner"## Core ConceptBuild a 3D endless runner game inspired by Subway Surfers but with a CUSTOM AIRPLANE/THEME. Instead of running on train tracks, the player pilots a small aircraft through an aerial obstacle course.## Key Differences from Subway Surfers| Subway Surfers | Sky Runner (This Game) ||---------------|------------------------|| Ground-based running | Aerial flight mechanics || Train tracks | Sky lanes with cloud corridors || Jump/roll/dodge | Pitch up/down, barrel roll, boost || Coin collection | Fuel orbs + cargo packages || Police chase | Storm cloud pursuit system |## Game Mechanics1. **Movement:** 3-lane horizontal system (left, center, right) + vertical pitch control2. **Actions:** - Swipe Up: Climb altitude - Swipe Down: Dive - Swipe Left/Right: Change lanes - Double Tap: Barrel roll (invincibility frame)3. **Obstacles:** - Other aircraft (must dodge) - Storm clouds (slowdown zone) - Bird flocks (damage) - Air traffic control towers - Turbulence zones4. **Collectibles:** - Fuel orbs (extend run time) - Cargo crates (bonus points) - Golden propellers (currency) - Power-ups: Turbo boost, Shield, Magnet## Visual Style- **Art Direction:** Low-poly stylized 3D (like Subway Surfers but aviation-themed)- **Color Palette:** Sky blues, sunset oranges, cloud whites, metallic grays- **Environment:** Dynamic skybox with day/night cycle, volumetric clouds- **Player Character:** Customizable pilot with different aircraft skins- **UI:** Minimalist HUD, altitude meter, fuel gauge, score counter## Technical Stack- **Engine:** Unity 2023 LTS or Three.js (for web-based)- **Language:** C# (Unity) or JavaScript/TypeScript (Three.js)- **Physics:** Custom arcade physics (not realistic flight sim)- **Platform:** Mobile (iOS/Android) + Web GL- **Performance:** 60 FPS target, LOD system for distant objects## Required Features1. **Main Menu:** Hangar scene with aircraft selection2. **Game Loop:** Endless procedurally generated sky lanes3. **Progression:** Unlock new planes, pilots, and trails4. **Leaderboard:** Global and friend scores5. **Daily Challenges:** Specific mission types (collect X fuel, dodge Y birds)6. **Shop System:** In-game currency for cosmetics7. **Save System:** Cloud save for progress## Deliverables- Complete project structure- Player controller script with swipe gestures- Obstacle spawning system (object pooling)- Collision detection and damage system- UI manager (score, fuel, game over screen)- 3 sample aircraft models (placeholder or procedurally generated)- Background music + SFX placeholders## Unique Selling Points1. **Verticality:** Unlike Subway Surfers, players can change altitude2. **Aircraft Customization:** Wings, engines, paint jobs, contrail effects3. **Weather System:** Dynamic weather affects gameplay (rain = slippery, wind = lane drift)4. **Multiplayer Mode:** Real-time race against ghost data of other players# OutputGenerate the complete codebase structure, core gameplay scripts, and UI components. Include comments for easy customization. Make it modular for future feature additions.

JEU DE L'IMPOSTEUR

Découvrez qui est l'imposteur parmi vous !

📖 Règles du Jeu

  • Chaque joueur reçoit un mot secret d'une catégorie donnée
  • Un joueur est l'IMPOSTEUR — il ne connaît pas le mot !
  • Les joueurs décrivent leur mot sans le dire directement
  • L'imposteur doit deviner le mot ou se faire passer pour un crewmate
  • Après la discussion, tout le monde vote pour éliminer un suspect
  • Si l'imposteur est voté → les CREWMATES gagnent
  • Si l'imposteur survit → l'IMPOSTEUR gagne
  • Plusieurs tours : l'imposteur change à chaque round !

⚙️ Configuration

🌐 Langue / Language / Idioma

👥 Nombre de joueurs

4

📂 Catégories (sélectionnez au moins 1)

🤖 Mode de jeu

Phase de révélation
💬 Discussion
🗳️ Vote

Votez pour éliminer un joueur
