<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Neon Void - Space Shooter</title>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
body {
background: #000;
display: flex;
justify-content: center;
align-items: center;
height: 100vh;
overflow: hidden;
font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
}
canvas {
display: block;
border: 1px solid #1a1a2e;
box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.15), 0 0 80px rgba(0, 100, 255, 0.08);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

const W = 800, H = 600;
canvas.width = W;
canvas.height = H;

// Audio context
let audioCtx;
function initAudio() {
if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
}

function playSound(freq, type, duration, volume = 0.15) {
if (!audioCtx) return;
const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
osc.type = type;
osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume, audioCtx.currentTime);
gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
osc.connect(gain);
gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
osc.start();
osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
}

function playShoot() { playSound(880, 'square', 0.08, 0.08); }
function playExplosion() {
if (!audioCtx) return;
const bufferSize = audioCtx.sampleRate * 0.3;
const buffer = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, audioCtx.sampleRate);
const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);
for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) {
data[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * Math.pow(1 - i / bufferSize, 2);
}
const source = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
source.buffer = buffer;
gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
source.connect(gain);
gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
source.start();
}
function playPowerUp() {
playSound(523, 'sine', 0.1, 0.12);
setTimeout(() => playSound(659, 'sine', 0.1, 0.12), 80);
setTimeout(() => playSound(784, 'sine', 0.15, 0.12), 160);
}
function playHit() { playSound(200, 'sawtooth', 0.15, 0.1); }

// Game state
let gameState = 'menu'; // menu, playing, gameover
let score = 0;
let highScore = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('neonVoidHigh') || '0');
let wave = 1;
let waveTimer = 0;
let waveDelay = 180;
let enemiesInWave = 0;
let enemiesSpawned = 0;
let spawnTimer = 0;
let shakeTimer = 0;
let shakeIntensity = 0;
let comboCount = 0;
let comboTimer = 0;
let gameTime = 0;

// Stars
const stars = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
stars.push({
x: Math.random() * W,
y: Math.random() * H,
size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
speed: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.3,
brightness: Math.random()
});
}

// Player
const player = {
x: W / 2,
y: H - 80,
w: 32,
h: 32,
speed: 5,
lives: 3,
maxLives: 5,
fireRate: 10,
fireTimer: 0,
invincible: 0,
powerLevel: 0,
powerTimer: 0,
shieldActive: false,
shieldTimer: 0,
trail: []
};

// Arrays
let bullets = [];
let enemies = [];
let particles = [];
let powerUps = [];
let enemyBullets = [];
let floatingTexts = [];

// Input
const keys = {};
let mouseX = W / 2, mouseY = H - 80;
let mouseDown = false;
let useMouseControl = false;

document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
keys[e.key] = true;
if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
e.preventDefault();
}
if (gameState === 'menu' && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {
initAudio();
startGame();
}
if (gameState === 'gameover' && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {
gameState = 'menu';
}
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });

canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
mouseX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
mouseY = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height);
useMouseControl = true;
});

canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
mouseDown = true;
initAudio();
if (gameState === 'menu') startGame();
if (gameState === 'gameover') gameState = 'menu';
});
canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { mouseDown = false; });

canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
e.preventDefault();
const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
const touch = e.touches[0];
mouseX = (touch.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
mouseY = (touch.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height);
useMouseControl = true;
mouseDown = true;
initAudio();
if (gameState === 'menu') startGame();
if (gameState === 'gameover') gameState = 'menu';
});
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
e.preventDefault();
const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
const touch = e.touches[0];
mouseX = (touch.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
mouseY = (touch.clientY - rect.top) * (H / rect.height);
});
canvas.addEventListener('touchend', e => { e.preventDefault(); mouseDown = false; });

function startGame() {
gameState = 'playing';
score = 0;
wave = 1;
waveTimer = 0;
enemiesInWave = 5;
enemiesSpawned = 0;
spawnTimer = 0;
gameTime = 0;
comboCount = 0;
comboTimer = 0;
player.x = W / 2;
player.y = H - 80;
player.lives = 3;
player.powerLevel = 0;
player.powerTimer = 0;
player.shieldActive = false;
player.shieldTimer = 0;
player.invincible = 60;
player.trail = [];
bullets = [];
enemies = [];
particles = [];
powerUps = [];
enemyBullets = [];
floatingTexts = [];
}

function spawnEnemy(type) {
let enemy;
const x = Math.random() * (W - 60) + 30;
switch(type) {
case 'basic':
enemy = { x, y: -30, w: 28, h: 28, hp: 1, maxHp: 1, speed: 1.5 + wave * 0.1, type: 'basic', color: '#ff4466', score: 100, fireRate: 0, movePattern: 'straight', time: 0 };
break;
case 'fast':
enemy = { x, y: -30, w: 22, h: 22, hp: 1, maxHp: 1, speed: 3 + wave * 0.15, type: 'fast', color: '#ffaa22', score: 150, fireRate: 0, movePattern: 'zigzag', time: 0 };
break;
case 'tank':
enemy = { x, y: -30, w: 38, h: 38, hp: 3 + Math.floor(wave / 3), maxHp: 3 + Math.floor(wave / 3), speed: 0.8 + wave * 0.05, type: 'tank', color: '#aa44ff', score: 300, fireRate: 120, fireTimer: 0, movePattern: 'straight', time: 0 };
break;
case 'shooter':
enemy = { x, y: -30, w: 30, h: 30, hp: 2, maxHp: 2, speed: 1 + wave * 0.08, type: 'shooter', color: '#44ffaa', score: 250, fireRate: 80 - Math.min(wave * 3, 40), fireTimer: 0, movePattern: 'sine', time: 0 };
break;
case 'boss':
enemy = { x: W / 2, y: -60, w: 60, h: 50, hp: 20 + wave * 5, maxHp: 20 + wave * 5, speed: 0.5, type: 'boss', color: '#ff2244', score: 2000, fireRate: 40, fireTimer: 0, movePattern: 'boss', time: 0, phase: 0 };
break;
}
enemies.push(enemy);
}

function spawnPowerUp(x, y) {
if (Math.random() < 0.15) {
const types = ['power', 'life', 'shield', 'bomb'];
const weights = [0.4, 0.2, 0.25, 0.15];
let r = Math.random(), cumulative = 0, type = 'power';
for (let i = 0; i < types.length; i++) {
cumulative += weights[i];
if (r < cumulative) { type = types[i]; break; }
}
powerUps.push({ x, y, type, w: 20, h: 20, time: 0, speed: 1.5 });
}
}

function createExplosion(x, y, color, count = 15, speed = 3) {
for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
const angle = (Math.PI * 2 / count) * i + Math.random() * 0.5;
const spd = Math.random() * speed + 1;
particles.push({
x, y,
vx: Math.cos(angle) * spd,
vy: Math.sin(angle) * spd,
life: 1,
decay: Math.random() * 0.03 + 0.02,
size: Math.random() * 4 + 2,
color
});
}
}

function createFloatingText(x, y, text, color = '#fff') {
floatingTexts.push({ x, y, text, color, life: 1, vy: -2 });
}

function updatePlayer() {
let dx = 0, dy = 0;
if (useMouseControl) {
const diffX = mouseX - player.x;
const diffY = mouseY - player.y;
const dist = Math.sqrt(diffX * diffX + diffY * diffY);
if (dist > 3) {
dx = (diffX / dist) * Math.min(player.speed, dist * 0.15);
dy = (diffY / dist) * Math.min(player.speed, dist * 0.15);
}
} else {
if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) dx = -player.speed;
if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) dx = player.speed;
if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) dy = -player.speed;
if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s']) dy = player.speed;
}

player.x += dx;
player.y += dy;
player.x = Math.max(player.w / 2, Math.min(W - player.w / 2, player.x));
player.y = Math.max(player.h / 2, Math.min(H - player.h / 2, player.y));

// Trail
player.trail.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y + 16, life: 1 });
if (player.trail.length > 15) player.trail.shift();
player.trail.forEach(t => t.life -= 0.07);

// Shooting
player.fireTimer--;
const shooting = mouseDown || keys[' '] || keys['z'];
if (shooting && player.fireTimer <= 0) {
player.fireTimer = player.fireRate;
playShoot();

const bSpeed = -8;
if (player.powerLevel === 0) {
bullets.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y - 16, vx: 0, vy: bSpeed, w: 4, h: 12, damage: 1, color: '#00ffff' });
} else if (player.powerLevel === 1) {
bullets.push({ x: player.x - 8, y: player.y - 12, vx: 0, vy: bSpeed, w: 4, h: 12, damage: 1, color: '#00ffff' });
bullets.push({ x: player.x + 8, y: player.y - 12, vx: 0, vy: bSpeed, w: 4, h: 12, damage: 1, color: '#00ffff' });
} else {
bullets.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y - 16, vx: 0, vy: bSpeed, w: 5, h: 14, damage: 2, color: '#00ffff' });
bullets.push({ x: player.x - 12, y: player.y - 8, vx: -1.5, vy: bSpeed, w: 3, h: 10, damage: 1, color: '#00aaff' });
bullets.push({ x: player.x + 12, y: player.y - 8, vx: 1.5, vy: bSpeed, w: 3, h: 10, damage: 1, color: '#00aaff' });
}
}

if (player.invincible > 0) player.invincible--;
if (player.powerTimer > 0) {
player.powerTimer--;
if (player.powerTimer <= 0) player.powerLevel = Math.max(0, player.powerLevel - 1);
}
if (player.shieldTimer > 0) {
player.shieldTimer--;
if (player.shieldTimer <= 0) player.shieldActive = false;
}
}

function updateBullets() {
bullets.forEach(b => {
b.x += b.vx;
b.y += b.vy;
});
bullets = bullets.filter(b => b.y > -20 && b.y < H + 20 && b.x > -20 && b.x < W + 20);

enemyBullets.forEach(b => {
b.x += b.vx;
b.y += b.vy;
});
enemyBullets = enemyBullets.filter(b => b.y > -20 && b.y < H + 20 && b.x > -20 && b.x < W + 20);
}

function updateEnemies() {
enemies.forEach(e => {
e.time++;
switch (e.movePattern) {
case 'straight':
e.y += e.speed;
break;
case 'zigzag':
e.y += e.speed;
e.x += Math.sin(e.time * 0.05) * 3;
break;
case 'sine':
e.y += e.speed;
e.x += Math.sin(e.time * 0.03) * 2;
break;
case 'boss':
if (e.y < 80) {
e.y += e.speed;
} else {
e.x += Math.sin(e.time * 0.02) * 2;
}
e.fireTimer++;
if (e.fireTimer >= e.fireRate) {
e.fireTimer = 0;
const angle = Math.atan2(player.y - e.y, player.x - e.x);
for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
const a = angle + i * 0.2;
enemyBullets.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y + e.h / 2, vx: Math.cos(a) * 3, vy: Math.sin(a) * 3, w: 6, h: 6, color: '#ff4466' });
}
}
break;
}

// Shooter fire
if (e.fireRate > 0 && e.movePattern !== 'boss') {
e.fireTimer++;
if (e.fireTimer >= e.fireRate) {
e.fireTimer = 0;
const angle = Math.atan2(player.y - e.y, player.x - e.x);
enemyBullets.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y + e.h / 2, vx: Math.cos(angle) * 2.5, vy: Math.sin(angle) * 2.5, w: 5, h: 5, color: '#44ffaa' });
}
}

e.x = Math.max(e.w / 2, Math.min(W - e.w / 2, e.x));
});

enemies = enemies.filter(e => e.y < H + 50);
}

function updateParticles() {
particles.forEach(p => {
p.x += p.vx;
p.y += p.vy;
p.vx *= 0.98;
p.vy *= 0.98;
p.life -= p.decay;
});
particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);

floatingTexts.forEach(t => {
t.y += t.vy;
t.life -= 0.02;
});
floatingTexts = floatingTexts.filter(t => t.life > 0);

powerUps.forEach(p => {
p.y += p.speed;
p.time++;
});
powerUps = powerUps.filter(p => p.y < H + 30);
}

function checkCollisions() {
// Bullets vs enemies
for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
const b = bullets[i];
for (let j = enemies.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
const e = enemies[j];
if (Math.abs(b.x - e.x) < (b.w / 2 + e.w / 2) && Math.abs(b.y - e.y) < (b.h / 2 + e.h / 2)) {
e.hp -= b.damage;
bullets.splice(i, 1);
createExplosion(b.x, b.y, e.color, 5, 2);

if (e.hp <= 0) {
// Combo
comboCount++;
comboTimer = 120;
const comboMultiplier = Math.min(comboCount, 10);
const pts = e.score * comboMultiplier;
score += pts;

if (comboCount > 1) {
createFloatingText(e.x, e.y - 20, `${pts} x${comboMultiplier}`, '#ffff00');
} else {
createFloatingText(e.x, e.y - 20, `+${pts}`, '#ffffff');
}

playExplosion();
createExplosion(e.x, e.y, e.color, 20, 4);
shakeTimer = 8;
shakeIntensity = e.type === 'boss' ? 12 : 4;

if (e.type === 'boss') {
for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
setTimeout(() => {
createExplosion(e.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 60, e.y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 50, '#ff8800', 10, 3);
playExplosion();
}, k * 100);
}
}

spawnPowerUp(e.x, e.y);
enemies.splice(j, 1);
} else {
playHit();
}
break;
}
}
}

// Enemy bullets vs player
if (player.invincible <= 0) {
for (let i = enemyBullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
const b = enemyBullets[i];
if (Math.abs(b.x - player.x) < (b.w / 2 + player.w / 2 - 4) && Math.abs(b.y - player.y) < (b.h / 2 + player.h / 2 - 4)) {
enemyBullets.splice(i, 1);
if (player.shieldActive) {
player.shieldActive = false;
player.shieldTimer = 0;
createExplosion(player.x, player.y, '#4488ff', 20, 3);
playExplosion();
} else {
playerHit();
}
break;
}
}

// Enemies vs player
for (let j = enemies.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
const e = enemies[j];
if (Math.abs(e.x - player.x) < (e.w / 2 + player.w / 2 - 4) && Math.abs(e.y - player.y) < (e.h / 2 + player.h / 2 - 4)) {
if (player.shieldActive) {
player.shieldActive = false;
player.shieldTimer = 0;
e.hp -= 3;
createExplosion(player.x, player.y, '#4488ff', 20, 3);
if (e.hp <= 0) {
score += e.score;
createExplosion(e.x, e.y, e.color, 20, 4);
playExplosion();
enemies.splice(j, 1);
}
} else {
playerHit();
}
break;
}
}
}

// Power-ups vs player
for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
const p = powerUps[i];
if (Math.abs(p.x - player.x) < (p.w / 2 + player.w / 2 + 5) && Math.abs(p.y - player.y) < (p.h / 2 + player.h / 2 + 5)) {
playPowerUp();
switch (p.type) {
case 'power':
player.powerLevel = Math.min(2, player.powerLevel + 1);
player.powerTimer = 600;
createFloatingText(p.x, p.y, 'POWER UP!', '#00ffff');
break;
case 'life':
player.lives = Math.min(player.maxLives, player.lives + 1);
createFloatingText(p.x, p.y, '+1 LIFE', '#ff4466');
break;
case 'shield':
player.shieldActive = true;
player.shieldTimer = 600;
createFloatingText(p.x, p.y, 'SHIELD!', '#4488ff');
break;
case 'bomb':
enemies.forEach(e => {
createExplosion(e.x, e.y, e.color, 15, 3);
score += e.score;
});
enemies = [];
enemyBullets = [];
shakeTimer = 15;
shakeIntensity = 8;
createFloatingText(p.x, p.y, 'BOMB!', '#ffaa00');
break;
}
powerUps.splice(i, 1);
}
}
}

function playerHit() {
player.lives--;
player.invincible = 90;
shakeTimer = 12;
shakeIntensity = 8;
createExplosion(player.x, player.y, '#00ffff', 25, 4);
playExplosion();
comboCount = 0;

if (player.lives <= 0) {
gameState = 'gameover';
if (score > highScore) {
highScore = score;
localStorage.setItem('neonVoidHigh', highScore.toString());
}
createExplosion(player.x, player.y, '#ffffff', 40, 6);
}
}

function updateWaves() {
waveTimer++;

if (enemiesSpawned < enemiesInWave) {
spawnTimer++;
const spawnRate = wave >= 10 ? 15 : (wave >= 5 ? 25 : 35);
if (spawnTimer >= spawnRate) {
spawnTimer = 0;
const r = Math.random();
if (wave >= 10 && enemiesSpawned === enemiesInWave - 1) {
spawnEnemy('boss');
} else if (r < 0.4) {
spawnEnemy('basic');
} else if (r < 0.65) {
spawnEnemy('fast');
} else if (r < 0.85) {
spawnEnemy('shooter');
} else {
spawnEnemy('tank');
}
enemiesSpawned++;
}
} else if (enemies.length === 0) {
wave++;
enemiesInWave = 5 + wave * 2;
enemiesSpawned = 0;
spawnTimer = 0;
waveTimer = 0;
createFloatingText(W / 2, H / 2, `WAVE ${wave}`, '#00ffff');
}
}

function drawStars() {
stars.forEach(s => {
s.y += s.speed;
if (s.y > H) { s.y = 0; s.x = Math.random() * W; }
const alpha = 0.3 + s.brightness * 0.7 * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(gameTime * 0.02 + s.x));
ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200, 220, 255, ${alpha})`;
ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.size, s.size);
});
}

function drawPlayer() {
if (player.invincible > 0 && Math.floor(player.invincible / 4) % 2 === 0) return;

// Trail
player.trail.forEach((t, i) => {
if (t.life > 0) {
ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0, 200, 255, ${t.life * 0.3})`;
const s = t.life * 8;
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, s, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fill();
}
});

// Engine glow
const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(player.x, player.y + 18, 0, player.x, player.y + 18, 20);
gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 200, 255, 0.6)');
gradient.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(0, 100, 255, 0.2)');
gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 50, 255, 0)');
ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(player.x, player.y + 18, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fill();

// Ship body
ctx.save();
ctx.translate(player.x, player.y);

// Main body
ctx.fillStyle = '#00ccff';
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.moveTo(0, -18);
ctx.lineTo(-14, 14);
ctx.lineTo(-6, 10);
ctx.lineTo(0, 16);
ctx.lineTo(6, 10);
ctx.lineTo(14, 14);
ctx.closePath();
ctx.fill();

// Cockpit
ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.moveTo(0, -10);
ctx.lineTo(-5, 4);
ctx.lineTo(5, 4);
ctx.closePath();
ctx.fill();

// Wing details
ctx.strokeStyle = '#0088cc';
ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.moveTo(-12, 10);
ctx.lineTo(-4, 0);
ctx.moveTo(12, 10);
ctx.lineTo(4, 0);
ctx.stroke();

ctx.restore();

// Shield
if (player.shieldActive) {
ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(68, 136, 255, ${0.4 + 0.3 * Math.sin(gameTime * 0.1)})`;
ctx.lineWidth = 2;
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, 28, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.stroke();

const shieldGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(player.x, player.y, 20, player.x, player.y, 28);
shieldGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(68, 136, 255, 0)');
shieldGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(68, 136, 255, 0.15)');
ctx.fillStyle = shieldGrad;
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, 28, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fill();
}
}

function drawBullets() {
bullets.forEach(b => {
ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
ctx.shadowColor = b.color;
ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
ctx.fillRect(b.x - b.w / 2, b.y - b.h / 2, b.w, b.h);
ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
});

enemyBullets.forEach(b => {
ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
ctx.shadowColor = b.color;
ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fill();
ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
});
}

function drawEnemies() {
enemies.forEach(e => {
ctx.save();
ctx.translate(e.x, e.y);

// Glow
ctx.shadowColor = e.color;
ctx.shadowBlur = 12;

if (e.type === 'boss') {
// Boss body
ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.moveTo(0, -e.h / 2);
ctx.lineTo(-e.w / 2, 0);
ctx.lineTo(-e.w / 3, e.h / 2);
ctx.lineTo(e.w / 3, e.h / 2);
ctx.lineTo(e.w / 2, 0);
ctx.closePath();
ctx.fill();

// Boss details
ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff33';
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(0, 0, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fill();

// HP bar
ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
const hpRatio = e.hp / e.maxHp;
ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
ctx.fillRect(-e.w / 2, -e.h / 2 - 12, e.w, 6);
ctx.fillStyle = hpRatio > 0.5 ? '#44ff44' : (hpRatio > 0.25 ? '#ffaa00' : '#ff4444');
ctx.fillRect(-e.w / 2, -e.h / 2 - 12, e.w * hpRatio, 6);
} else {
// Regular enemy
ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
const s = e.w / 2;
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.moveTo(0, -s);
ctx.lineTo(s, s * 0.5);
ctx.lineTo(s * 0.4, s);
ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.4, s);
ctx.lineTo(-s, s * 0.5);
ctx.closePath();
ctx.fill();

// Inner detail
ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff44';
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fill();
}

ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
ctx.restore();
});
}

function drawParticles() {
particles.forEach(p => {
ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
});
ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawPowerUps() {
powerUps.forEach(p => {
ctx.save();
ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);

const pulse = 1 + 0.15 * Math.sin(p.time * 0.1);
ctx.scale(pulse, pulse);

let color;
switch (p.type) {
case 'power': color = '#00ffff'; break;
case 'life': color = '#ff4466'; break;
case 'shield': color = '#4488ff'; break;
case 'bomb': color = '#ffaa00'; break;
}

ctx.shadowColor = color;
ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
ctx.fillStyle = color;
ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;

// Diamond shape
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.moveTo(0, -12);
ctx.lineTo(12, 0);
ctx.lineTo(0, 12);
ctx.lineTo(-12, 0);
ctx.closePath();
ctx.fill();
ctx.stroke();

// Icon
ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
ctx.font = 'bold 10px Arial';
ctx.textAlign = 'center';
ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
let icon;
switch (p.type) {
case 'power': icon = 'P'; break;
case 'life': icon = '♥'; break;
case 'shield': icon = 'S'; break;
case 'bomb': icon = 'B'; break;
}
ctx.fillText(icon, 0, 0);

ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
ctx.restore();
});
}

function drawFloatingTexts() {
floatingTexts.forEach(t => {
ctx.globalAlpha = t.life;
ctx.fillStyle = t.color;
ctx.font = 'bold 16px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
ctx.textAlign = 'center';
ctx.fillText(t.text, t.x, t.y);
});
ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawHUD() {
// Score
ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
ctx.textAlign = 'left';
ctx.fillText(`SCORE: ${score.toLocaleString()}`, 15, 32);

// Wave
ctx.fillStyle = '#88aacc';
ctx.font = '16px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
ctx.fillText(`WAVE ${wave}`, 15, 54);

// Combo
if (comboCount > 1 && comboTimer > 0) {
ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 0, ${comboTimer / 120})`;
ctx.font = 'bold 18px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
ctx.fillText(`COMBO x${Math.min(comboCount, 10)}`, 15, 76);
}

// Lives
for (let i = 0; i < player.lives; i++) {
ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4466';
ctx.font = '20px Arial';
ctx.textAlign = 'right';
ctx.fillText('♥', W - 15 - i * 25, 32);
}

// Power level indicator
if (player.powerLevel > 0) {
ctx.fillStyle = '#00ffff';
ctx.font = '14px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
ctx.textAlign = 'right';
ctx.fillText(`POWER LV.${player.powerLevel + 1}`, W - 15, 54);
if (player.powerTimer > 0) {
const barW = 80;
const ratio = player.powerTimer / 600;
ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
ctx.fillRect(W - 15 - barW, 60, barW, 4);
ctx.fillStyle = '#00ffff';
ctx.fillRect(W - 15 - barW, 60, barW * ratio, 4);
}
}

// Shield indicator
if (player.shieldActive) {
ctx.fillStyle = '#4488ff';
ctx.font = '14px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
ctx.textAlign = 'right';
ctx.fillText('SHIELD ACTIVE', W - 15, 76);
}

// High score
ctx.fillStyle = '#666';
ctx.font = '13px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
ctx.textAlign = 'center';
ctx.fillText(`HIGH SCORE: ${highScore.toLocaleString()}`, W / 2, 20);
}

function drawMenu() {
// Title
const pulse = 1 + 0.05 * Math.sin(gameTime * 0.05);
ctx.save();
ctx.translate(W / 2, H / 2 - 60);
ctx.scale(pulse, pulse);

ctx.shadowColor = '#00ffff';
ctx.shadowBlur = 30;
ctx.fillStyle = '#00ffff';
ctx.font = 'bold 56px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
ctx.textAlign = 'center';
ctx.fillText('NEON VOID', 0, 0);

ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff88';
ctx.font = '18px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
ctx.fillText('SPACE SHOOTER', 0, 35);

ctx.restore();

// Instructions
const blink = Math.sin(gameTime * 0.08) > 0;
if (blink) {
ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
ctx.font = '20px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
ctx.textAlign = 'center';
ctx.fillText('CLICK or PRESS ENTER to START', W / 2, H / 2 + 40);
}

ctx.fillStyle = '#888888';
ctx.font = '14px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
ctx.fillText('WASD / Arrow Keys or Mouse to move', W / 2, H / 2 + 90);
ctx.fillText('Auto-fire enabled • Click/Tap to shoot', W / 2, H / 2 + 112);

// High score
if (highScore > 0) {
ctx.fillStyle = '#ffaa00';
ctx.font = 'bold 16px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
ctx.fillText(`HIGH SCORE: ${highScore.toLocaleString()}`, W / 2, H / 2 + 160);
}
}

function drawGameOver() {
ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)';
ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

ctx.shadowColor = '#ff4466';
ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4466';
ctx.font = 'bold 48px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
ctx.textAlign = 'center';
ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, H / 2 - 50);

ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
ctx.font = 'bold 28px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
ctx.fillText(`SCORE: ${score.toLocaleString()}`, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);

ctx.fillStyle = '#88aacc';
ctx.font = '18px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
ctx.fillText(`WAVE REACHED: ${wave}`, W / 2, H / 2 + 45);

if (score >= highScore && score > 0) {
ctx.fillStyle = '#ffaa00';
ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
ctx.fillText('★ NEW HIGH SCORE! ★', W / 2, H / 2 + 80);
}

const blink = Math.sin(gameTime * 0.08) > 0;
if (blink) {
ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
ctx.font = '18px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
ctx.fillText('CLICK or PRESS ENTER to CONTINUE', W / 2, H / 2 + 130);
}
}

function update() {
gameTime++;

if (gameState === 'playing') {
updatePlayer();
updateBullets();
updateEnemies();
updateParticles();
checkCollisions();
updateWaves();

if (comboTimer > 0) {
comboTimer--;
if (comboTimer <= 0) comboCount = 0;
}

if (shakeTimer > 0) shakeTimer--;
} else {
updateParticles();
}
}

function draw() {
ctx.save();

// Screen shake
if (shakeTimer > 0) {
const sx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeIntensity * (shakeTimer / 12);
const sy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeIntensity * (shakeTimer / 12);
ctx.translate(sx, sy);
}

// Background
ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0a1a';
ctx.fillRect(-10, -10, W + 20, H + 20);

drawStars();

if (gameState === 'playing' || gameState === 'gameover') {
drawPowerUps();
drawBullets();
drawEnemies();
drawPlayer();
drawParticles();
drawFloatingTexts();
drawHUD();
}

if (gameState === 'menu') {
drawParticles();
drawMenu();
}

if (gameState === 'gameover') {
drawGameOver();
}

ctx.restore();
}

function gameLoop() {
update();
draw();
requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

gameLoop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

🍥 NARUTO FIGHTING

⚔️ Boxing & Judo Techniques ⚔️

🍥 Naruto

Rasengan | Shadow Clone

html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>Doodle Jump</title>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: #000; }
canvas { display: block; margin: 0 auto; touch-action: none; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

let W, H;
function resize() {
    const ratio = 375 / 667;
    if (window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight < ratio) {
        W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        H = canvas.height = window.innerWidth / ratio;
    } else {
        H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
        W = canvas.width = window.innerHeight * ratio;
    }
    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
}
resize();
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

const GAME_W = 375;
const GAME_H = 667;

// Game state
let state = 'menu'; // menu, playing, gameover
let score = 0;
let highScore = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('doodleJumpHigh') || '0');
let cameraY = 0;
let maxHeight = 0;

// Doodler
let doodler = {};
function resetDoodler() {
    doodler = {
        x: GAME_W / 2,
        y: GAME_H - 150,
        w: 40,
        h: 40,
        vx: 0,
        vy: 0,
        dir: 1, // 1 right, -1 left
        jumping: false,
        legFrame: 0,
        legTimer: 0
    };
}

// Platforms
let platforms = [];
const PLATFORM_W = 70;
const PLATFORM_H = 15;
const PLATFORM_TYPES = ['normal', 'normal', 'normal', 'normal', 'broken', 'moving', 'small', 'small'];

function createPlatform(x, y, type) {
    return {
        x: x,
        y: y,
        w: type === 'small' ? 50 : PLATFORM_W,
        h: PLATFORM_H,
        type: type || 'normal',
        broken: false,
        brokenTimer: 0,
        moveDir: Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1,
        moveSpeed: 1 + Math.random() * 1.5,
        hasSpring: false,
        springActive: false,
        springTimer: 0
    };
}

function generatePlatforms(fromY, toY) {
    let y = fromY;
    while (y > toY) {
        let gap = 50 + Math.random() * 60;
        if (score > 5000) gap = 55 + Math.random() * 70;
        if (score > 15000) gap = 60 + Math.random() * 80;
        y -= gap;

        let x = Math.random() * (GAME_W - PLATFORM_W);
        let type = 'normal';
        let r = Math.random();
        if (score > 2000) {
            if (r < 0.15) type = 'broken';
            else if (r < 0.25) type = 'moving';
            else if (r < 0.35) type = 'small';
        } else if (score > 500) {
            if (r < 0.1) type = 'broken';
            else if (r < 0.18) type = 'small';
        }

        let p = createPlatform(x, y, type);

        // Add spring occasionally
        if (type === 'normal' && Math.random() < 0.08) {
            p.hasSpring = true;
        }

        platforms.push(p);
    }
}

// Particles
let particles = [];
function addParticles(x, y, color, count) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        particles.push({
            x: x,
            y: y,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
            vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6 - 2,
            life: 1,
            decay: 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.03,
            size: 2 + Math.random() * 4,
            color: color
        });
    }
}

// Input
let keys = {};
let touchX = null;
let touchActive = false;

document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    keys[e.key] = true;
    if (state === 'menu' || state === 'gameover') {
        startGame();
    }
    e.preventDefault();
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });

canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    let rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    let scaleX = GAME_W / W;
    touchX = (e.touches[0].clientX - rect.left) * scaleX;
    touchActive = true;
    if (state === 'menu' || state === 'gameover') startGame();
}, { passive: false });

canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    let rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    let scaleX = GAME_W / W;
    touchX = (e.touches[0].clientX - rect.left) * scaleX;
}, { passive: false });

canvas.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    touchActive = false;
    touchX = null;
}, { passive: false });

canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
    let rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    let scaleX = GAME_W / W;
    touchX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX;
    touchActive = true;
    if (state === 'menu' || state === 'gameover') startGame();
});
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
    let rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    let scaleX = GAME_W / W;
    touchX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX;
});
canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', e => {
    touchActive = false;
    touchX = null;
});

function startGame() {
    state = 'playing';
    score = 0;
    maxHeight = 0;
    cameraY = 0;
    platforms = [];
    particles = [];
    resetDoodler();

    // Generate initial platforms
    let y = GAME_H - 50;
    // Ground platform
    platforms.push(createPlatform(GAME_W / 2 - PLATFORM_W / 2, y, 'normal'));

    y -= 80;
    while (y > -200) {
        let x = Math.random() * (GAME_W - PLATFORM_W);
        let type = 'normal';
        let r = Math.random();
        if (r < 0.1) type = 'small';
        if (r < 0.15) { platforms[platforms.length - 1].hasSpring = true; }
        platforms.push(createPlatform(x, y, type));
        y -= 50 + Math.random() * 50;
    }
}

// Physics constants
const GRAVITY = 0.45;
const JUMP_FORCE = -12;
const SPRING_FORCE = -20;
const MOVE_SPEED = 6;
const FRICTION = 0.85;

function update() {
    if (state !== 'playing') return;

    // Input handling
    let moveLeft = keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a'] || keys['A'];
    let moveRight = keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d'] || keys['D'];

    if (touchActive && touchX !== null) {
        if (touchX < GAME_W / 2 - 20) moveLeft = true;
        else if (touchX > GAME_W / 2 + 20) moveRight = true;
    }

    if (moveLeft) {
        doodler.vx -= 1.2;
        doodler.dir = -1;
    }
    if (moveRight) {
        doodler.vx += 1.2;
        doodler.dir = 1;
    }

    doodler.vx *= FRICTION;
    if (Math.abs(doodler.vx) > MOVE_SPEED) doodler.vx = MOVE_SPEED * Math.sign(doodler.vx);

    doodler.vy += GRAVITY;
    doodler.x += doodler.vx;
    doodler.y += doodler.vy;

    // Wrap around screen
    if (doodler.x + doodler.w < 0) doodler.x = GAME_W;
    if (doodler.x > GAME_W) doodler.x = -doodler.w;

    // Leg animation
    doodler.legTimer++;
    if (doodler.legTimer > 6) {
        doodler.legTimer = 0;
        doodler.legFrame = (doodler.legFrame + 1) % 4;
    }

    // Platform collision (only when falling)
    if (doodler.vy > 0) {
        for (let p of platforms) {
            if (p.broken) continue;
            let doodleBottom = doodler.y + doodler.h;
            let doodlePrevBottom = doodleBottom - doodler.vy;

            if (doodleBottom >= p.y && doodlePrevBottom <= p.y + 5 &&
                doodler.x + doodler.w > p.x + 5 && doodler.x < p.x + p.w - 5) {

                if (p.type === 'broken') {
                    p.broken = true;
                    p.brokenTimer = 20;
                    addParticles(p.x + p.w / 2, p.y, '#8B7355', 8);
                    continue;
                }

                if (p.hasSpring) {
                    doodler.vy = SPRING_FORCE;
                    p.springActive = true;
                    p.springTimer = 15;
                    addParticles(p.x + p.w / 2, p.y - 10, '#FFD700', 6);
                } else {
                    doodler.vy = JUMP_FORCE;
                }
                doodler.jumping = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    // Update moving platforms
    for (let p of platforms) {
        if (p.type === 'moving' && !p.broken) {
            p.x += p.moveDir * p.moveSpeed;
            if (p.x <= 0 || p.x + p.w >= GAME_W) {
                p.moveDir *= -1;
            }
        }
        if (p.broken && p.brokenTimer > 0) {
            p.brokenTimer--;
        }
        if (p.springTimer > 0) {
            p.springTimer--;
            if (p.springTimer <= 0) p.springActive = false;
        }
    }

    // Camera follow
    let targetCamY = doodler.y - GAME_H * 0.4;
    if (targetCamY < cameraY) {
        cameraY += (targetCamY - cameraY) * 0.1;
    }

    // Track height
    let currentHeight = Math.max(0, Math.floor((GAME_H - doodler.y) / 10));
    if (currentHeight > score) score = currentHeight;
    if (doodler.y < maxHeight) maxHeight = doodler.y;

    // Generate more platforms above
    let topPlatformY = platforms.length > 0 ? Math.min(...platforms.map(p => p.y)) : 0;
    if (topPlatformY > cameraY - 400) {
        generatePlatforms(topPlatformY, cameraY - 600);
    }

    // Remove platforms below screen
    platforms = platforms.filter(p => p.y < cameraY + GAME_H + 100 && p.brokenTimer > 0);

    // Update particles
    for (let p of particles) {
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;
        p.vy += 0.1;
        p.life -= p.decay;
    }
    particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);

    // Game over check
    if (doodler.y > cameraY + GAME_H + 50) {
        state = 'gameover';
        if (score > highScore) {
            highScore = score;
            localStorage.setItem('doodleJumpHigh', highScore.toString());
        }
    }
}

// Drawing functions
function drawBackground() {
    // Notebook paper background
    ctx.fillStyle = '#F5F5DC';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, GAME_W, GAME_H);

    // Grid lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#D4D4D4';
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
    let offsetY = cameraY % 20;
    for (let y = -offsetY; y < GAME_H; y += 20) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, y);
        ctx.lineTo(GAME_W, y);
        ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (let x = 0; x < GAME_W; x += 20) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(x, GAME_H);
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Red margin line
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#FFB6C1';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(30, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(30, GAME_H);
    ctx.stroke();
}

function drawPlatform(p) {
    let screenY = p.y - cameraY;
    if (screenY < -30 || screenY > GAME_H + 30) return;

    ctx.save();

    if (p.broken) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.brokenTimer / 20;
        ctx.translate(p.x + p.w / 2, screenY + p.h / 2);
        ctx.rotate((20 - p.brokenTimer) * 0.1);
        ctx.translate(-(p.x + p.w / 2), -(screenY + p.h / 2));
    }

    if (p.type === 'normal') {
        // Green platform
        ctx.fillStyle = '#7EC850';
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#5A9E2F';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        roundRect(p.x, screenY, p.w, p.h, 7);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.stroke();

        // Highlight
        ctx.fillStyle = '#A8E06E';
        roundRect(p.x + 3, screenY + 2, p.w - 6, p.h / 2 - 1, 4);
        ctx.fill();
    } else if (p.type === 'broken') {
        // Brown broken platform
        ctx.fillStyle = '#C4956A';
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#8B6914';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        roundRect(p.x, screenY, p.w, p.h, 7);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.stroke();

        // Crack lines
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#8B6914';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(p.x + p.w * 0.3, screenY);
        ctx.lineTo(p.x + p.w * 0.5, screenY + p.h);
        ctx.moveTo(p.x + p.w * 0.7, screenY);
        ctx.lineTo(p.x + p.w * 0.4, screenY + p.h);
        ctx.stroke();
    } else if (p.type === 'moving') {
        // Blue moving platform
        ctx.fillStyle = '#5BA3D9';
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#3A7BBF';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        roundRect(p.x, screenY, p.w, p.h, 7);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.fillStyle = '#8BC4F0';
        roundRect(p.x + 3, screenY + 2, p.w - 6, p.h / 2 - 1, 4);
        ctx.fill();
    } else if (p.type === 'small') {
        // Brown small platform
        ctx.fillStyle = '#8B7355';
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#5C4A32';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        roundRect(p.x, screenY, p.w, p.h, 5);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Spring
    if (p.hasSpring) {
        let springX = p.x + p.w / 2 - 8;
        let springY = screenY - 12;
        let springH = p.springActive ? 4 : 12;

        // Spring coil
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#C0C0C0';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            let sy = springY + (springH / 4) * i;
            ctx.moveTo(springX + (i % 2 === 0 ? 0 : 10), sy);
            ctx.lineTo(springX + (i % 2 === 0 ? 10 : 0), sy + springH / 4);
        }
        ctx.stroke();

        // Spring top
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FF4444';
        ctx.fillRect(springX - 2, springY - 4, 14, 6);
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#CC0000';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.strokeRect(springX - 2, springY - 4, 14, 6);
    }

    ctx.restore();
}

function drawDoodler() {
    let screenX = doodler.x;
    let screenY = doodler.y - cameraY;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(screenX + doodler.w / 2, screenY + doodler.h / 2);
    ctx.scale(doodler.dir, 1);

    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFF00';
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;

    // Main body (oval)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 2, 16, 18, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();

    // Head
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(8, -10, 12, 11, 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();

    // Eye
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(12, -12, 5, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();

    // Pupil
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(14, -11, 2.5, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Eye shine
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(15, -13, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Mouth
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(14, -5, 3, 0, Math.PI);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Legs
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';

    let legOffset = Math.sin(doodler.legFrame * Math.PI / 2) * 4;
    let jumpLegSpread = doodler.vy < 0 ? 6 : 0;

    // Left leg
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-8, 16);
    ctx.lineTo(-10 - legOffset - jumpLegSpread, 24);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Right leg
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(8, 16);
    ctx.lineTo(10 + legOffset + jumpLegSpread, 24);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Feet
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFF00';
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-10 - legOffset - jumpLegSpread, 25, 5, 3, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(10 + legOffset + jumpLegSpread, 25, 5, 3, 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticles() {
    for (let p of particles) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
        ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y - cameraY, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawScore() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(score, 40, 30);

    // High score
    ctx.font = '12px Arial';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
    ctx.fillText('HI ' + highScore, 40, 48);
}

function drawMenu() {
    drawBackground();

    // Title
    ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('DOODLE', GAME_W / 2, 180);
    ctx.fillText('JUMP', GAME_W / 2, 240);

    // Doodler preview
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(GAME_W / 2, 350);
    ctx.scale(2, 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFF00';
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 2, 16, 18, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(8, -10, 12, 11, 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(12, -12, 5, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(14, -11, 2.5, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(14, -5, 3, 0, Math.PI);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    // Instructions
    ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
    ctx.font = '16px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Use Arrow Keys or Touch', GAME_W / 2, 450);
    ctx.fillText('to tilt and jump!', GAME_W / 2, 475);

    // Start prompt
    let pulse = Math.sin(Date.now() / 300) * 0.3 + 0.7;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Tap or Press Any Key', GAME_W / 2, 540);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    if (highScore > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
        ctx.font = '14px Arial';
        ctx.fillText('High Score: ' + highScore, GAME_W / 2, 590);
    }
}

function drawGameOver() {
    drawBackground();

    // Overlay
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, GAME_W, GAME_H);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
    ctx.font = 'bold 42px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', GAME_W / 2, 250);

    ctx.font = 'bold 28px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, GAME_W / 2, 320);

    if (score >= highScore && score > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FF6600';
        ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
        ctx.fillText('★ NEW HIGH SCORE! ★', GAME_W / 2, 360);
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
    ctx.font = '16px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Best: ' + highScore, GAME_W / 2, 400);

    let pulse = Math.sin(Date.now() / 300) * 0.3 + 0.7;
    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Tap or Press Any Key', GAME_W / 2, 480);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
    ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
    ctx.closePath();
}

function gameLoop() {
    update();

    ctx.save();
    ctx.scale(W / GAME_W, H / GAME_H);

    if (state === 'menu') {
        drawMenu();
    } else if (state === 'playing') {
        drawBackground();
        drawParticles();
        for (let p of platforms) drawPlatform(p);
        drawDoodler();
        drawScore();
    } else if (state === 'gameover') {
        drawGameOver();
    }

    ctx.restore();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

gameLoop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

let W, H, scale;
function resize() {
    W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    scale = Math.min(W / 800, H / 450);
}
resize();
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

// Game state
let gameState = 'menu'; // menu, playing, gameover
let score = 0;
let highScore = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('sprintDashHigh') || '0');
let distance = 0;
let gameSpeed = 4;
let baseSpeed = 4;
let maxSpeed = 14;
let frameCount = 0;
let shakeTimer = 0;
let shakeIntensity = 0;

// Colors
const COLORS = {
    sky1: '#4FC3F7', sky2: '#E1F5FE',
    mountain1: '#81C784', mountain2: '#66BB6A', mountain3: '#4CAF50',
    ground: '#8D6E63', groundTop: '#A1887F', groundDark: '#6D4C41',
    player: '#FF6F00', playerSkin: '#FFCC80', playerShirt: '#E65100',
    coin: '#FFD700', coinShine: '#FFF8E1',
    spike: '#B71C1C', crate: '#795548',
    cloud: '#FFFFFF', cloudShadow: '#E0E0E0',
    powerup: '#00E5FF', shield: '#76FF03', magnet: '#FF4081',
    text: '#FFFFFF', textShadow: '#000000',
    ui_bg: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)',
};

// Player
const player = {
    x: 120, y: 0, w: 36, h: 52,
    vy: 0, grounded: true, jumping: false,
    runFrame: 0, runTimer: 0,
    doubleJump: false, canDoubleJump: true,
    shielded: false, shieldTimer: 0,
    magnetActive: false, magnetTimer: 0,
    invincible: false, invTimer: 0,
    trail: [],
    alive: true,
    jumpPower: -13,
    gravity: 0.6,
};

const GROUND_Y_OFFSET = 80;
let groundY;

// Parallax layers
let bgOffset1 = 0, bgOffset2 = 0, bgOffset3 = 0;

// Clouds
let clouds = [];
function spawnCloud() {
    clouds.push({
        x: W + 100,
        y: 30 + Math.random() * 100,
        w: 60 + Math.random() * 80,
        h: 25 + Math.random() * 20,
        speed: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        opacity: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5
    });
}

// Mountains
let mountains = [];
function initMountains() {
    mountains = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        mountains.push({
            x: i * 250 - 100,
            h: 80 + Math.random() * 120,
            w: 150 + Math.random() * 150,
            color: i % 2 === 0 ? COLORS.mountain1 : COLORS.mountain2,
            layer: i < 3 ? 0 : 1
        });
    }
}

// Ground segments with gaps
let groundSegments = [];
let nextGapX = 0;

function initGround() {
    groundSegments = [];
    let x = 0;
    while (x < W + 400) {
        let segW = 200 + Math.random() * 300;
        groundSegments.push({ x: x, w: segW });
        x += segW;
        if (x > 300) {
            let gapW = 60 + Math.random() * 80;
            x += gapW;
            nextGapX = x;
        }
    }
}

// Obstacles
let obstacles = [];
function spawnObstacle() {
    let type = Math.random();
    let ox = W + 50;
    let oy = groundY - 40;

    if (type < 0.4) {
        // Crate
        obstacles.push({ type: 'crate', x: ox, y: oy, w: 36, h: 36, hit: false });
    } else if (type < 0.7) {
        // Spike
        obstacles.push({ type: 'spike', x: ox, y: groundY - 30, w: 28, h: 30, hit: false });
    } else if (type < 0.85) {
        // Double crate
        obstacles.push({ type: 'crate', x: ox, y: oy, w: 36, h: 36, hit: false });
        obstacles.push({ type: 'crate', x: ox + 40, y: oy, w: 36, h: 36, hit: false });
    } else {
        // Floating obstacle
        obstacles.push({ type: 'crate', x: ox, y: groundY - 80 - Math.random() * 40, w: 36, h: 36, hit: false });
    }
}

// Coins
let coins = [];
function spawnCoin() {
    let cx = W + 50;
    let pattern = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
    if (pattern === 0) {
        // Line
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            coins.push({ x: cx + i * 30, y: groundY - 60 - Math.random() * 40, r: 10, collected: false, bobOffset: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 });
        }
    } else if (pattern === 1) {
        // Arc
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            coins.push({ x: cx + i * 30, y: groundY - 40 - Math.sin(i / 4 * Math.PI) * 60, r: 10, collected: false, bobOffset: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 });
        }
    } else {
        // High coins
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            coins.push({ x: cx + i * 30, y: groundY - 120 - Math.random() * 30, r: 10, collected: false, bobOffset: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 });
        }
    }
}

// Power-ups
let powerups = [];
function spawnPowerup() {
    let type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'shield' : 'magnet';
    powerups.push({
        x: W + 50,
        y: groundY - 60 - Math.random() * 60,
        type: type,
        r: 16,
        collected: false,
        bobOffset: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        glow: 0
    });
}

// Particles
let particles = [];
function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count, spread) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        particles.push({
            x: x, y: y,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * spread,
            vy: (Math.random() - 0.8) * spread,
            life: 1,
            decay: 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.03,
            size: 2 + Math.random() * 4,
            color: color
        });
    }
}

// Floating texts
let floatingTexts = [];
function spawnFloatingText(x, y, text, color) {
    floatingTexts.push({ x, y, text, color, life: 1, vy: -2 });
}

// Spawn timers
let obstacleTimer = 0;
let coinTimer = 0;
let powerupTimer = 0;
let spawnInterval = 90;

// Input
let jumpPressed = false;
let jumpHeld = false;

function handleJump() {
    if (gameState === 'menu') {
        startGame();
        return;
    }
    if (gameState === 'gameover') {
        startGame();
        return;
    }
    if (gameState === 'playing') {
        if (player.grounded) {
            player.vy = player.jumpPower;
            player.grounded = false;
            player.jumping = true;
            player.canDoubleJump = true;
            spawnParticles(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h, '#FFFFFF', 5, 4);
        } else if (player.canDoubleJump) {
            player.vy = player.jumpPower * 0.85;
            player.canDoubleJump = false;
            player.jumping = true;
            spawnParticles(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h, '#80DEEA', 8, 5);
        }
    }
}

window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'KeyW') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!jumpHeld) {
            jumpPressed = true;
            jumpHeld = true;
        }
    }
    if (e.code === 'ArrowDown' || e.code === 'KeyS') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (player.grounded && player.vy < 0) {
            player.vy += 4;
        }
    }
});
window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'KeyW') {
        jumpHeld = false;
    }
});

canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    handleJump();
}, { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    handleJump();
});

function startGame() {
    gameState = 'playing';
    score = 0;
    distance = 0;
    gameSpeed = baseSpeed;
    frameCount = 0;
    shakeTimer = 0;
    player.y = groundY - player.h;
    player.vy = 0;
    player.grounded = true;
    player.jumping = false;
    player.alive = true;
    player.shielded = false;
    player.shieldTimer = 0;
    player.magnetActive = false;
    player.magnetTimer = 0;
    player.invincible = false;
    player.invTimer = 0;
    player.trail = [];
    obstacles = [];
    coins = [];
    powerups = [];
    particles = [];
    floatingTexts = [];
    clouds = [];
    obstacleTimer = 0;
    coinTimer = 0;
    powerupTimer = 0;
    initMountains();
    initGround();
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) spawnCloud();
}

function gameOver() {
    if (!player.alive) return;
    player.alive = false;
    shakeTimer = 20;
    shakeIntensity = 8;
    spawnParticles(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h / 2, '#FF5722', 20, 8);
    spawnParticles(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h / 2, '#FFC107', 15, 6);
    if (score > highScore) {
        highScore = score;
        localStorage.setItem('sprintDashHigh', highScore.toString());
    }
    setTimeout(() => { gameState = 'gameover'; }, 800);
}

function update() {
    frameCount++;
    groundY = H - GROUND_Y_OFFSET;

    if (gameState !== 'playing') return;

    // Increase speed
    gameSpeed = Math.min(maxSpeed, baseSpeed + distance * 0.0008);

    // Distance & score
    distance += gameSpeed;
    score = Math.floor(distance / 10);

    // Player physics
    player.vy += player.gravity;
    player.y += player.vy;

    // Ground collision
    if (player.y + player.h >= groundY) {
        player.y = groundY - player.h;
        player.vy = 0;
        player.grounded = true;
        player.jumping = false;
        player.canDoubleJump = true;
    }

    // Fall into gap
    if (player.y > H + 100) {
        gameOver();
        return;
    }

    // Run animation
    if (player.grounded) {
        player.runTimer += gameSpeed * 0.15;
        player.runFrame = Math.floor(player.runTimer) % 4;
    }

    // Trail
    if (frameCount % 2 === 0) {
        player.trail.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y + player.h / 2, alpha: 0.4 });
    }
    player.trail = player.trail.filter(t => {
        t.x -= gameSpeed * 0.5;
        t.alpha -= 0.02;
        return t.alpha > 0;
    });

    // Power-up timers
    if (player.shielded) {
        player.shieldTimer--;
        if (player.shieldTimer <= 0) player.shielded = false;
    }
    if (player.magnetActive) {
        player.magnetTimer--;
        if (player.magnetTimer <= 0) player.magnetActive = false;
    }
    if (player.invincible) {
        player.invTimer--;
        if (player.invTimer <= 0) player.invincible = false;
    }

    // Spawn obstacles
    obstacleTimer++;
    let currentInterval = Math.max(40, spawnInterval - distance * 0.005);
    if (obstacleTimer >= currentInterval) {
        spawnObstacle();
        obstacleTimer = 0;
    }

    // Spawn coins
    coinTimer++;
    if (coinTimer >= 60 + Math.random() * 40) {
        spawnCoin();
        coinTimer = 0;
    }

    // Spawn power-ups
    powerupTimer++;
    if (powerupTimer >= 600 + Math.random() * 300) {
        spawnPowerup();
        powerupTimer = 0;
    }

    // Update clouds
    clouds.forEach(c => { c.x -= c.speed; });
    clouds = clouds.filter(c => c.x + c.w > -100);
    if (frameCount % 120 === 0) spawnCloud();

    // Update mountains
    mountains.forEach(m => {
        m.x -= gameSpeed * (m.layer === 0 ? 0.2 : 0.4);
        if (m.x + m.w < -50) {
            m.x = W + 50 + Math.random() * 100;
            m.h = 80 + Math.random() * 120;
        }
    });

    // Update obstacles
    obstacles.forEach(o => {
        o.x -= gameSpeed;
        // Collision
        if (!o.hit && player.alive) {
            let px = player.x + 6, py = player.y + 4;
            let pw = player.w - 12, ph = player.h - 8;
            if (px < o.x + o.w && px + pw > o.x && py < o.y + o.h && py + ph > o.y) {
                if (player.shielded) {
                    o.hit = true;
                    player.shielded = false;
                    spawnParticles(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y + o.h / 2, '#76FF03', 12, 6);
                    spawnFloatingText(o.x, o.y, 'BLOCKED!', '#76FF03');
                } else if (!player.invincible) {
                    gameOver();
                }
            }
        }
    });
    obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.x + o.w > -50 && !o.hit);

    // Update coins
    coins.forEach(c => {
        c.x -= gameSpeed;
        // Magnet pull
        if (player.magnetActive && !c.collected) {
            let dx = (player.x + player.w / 2) - c.x;
            let dy = (player.y + player.h / 2) - c.y;
            let dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
            if (dist < 200) {
                c.x += dx * 0.08;
                c.y += dy * 0.08;
            }
        }
        // Collection
        if (!c.collected) {
            let dx = (player.x + player.w / 2) - c.x;
            let dy = (player.y + player.h / 2) - c.y;
            if (Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) < c.r + 20) {
                c.collected = true;
                score += 5;
                distance += 50;
                spawnParticles(c.x, c.y, COLORS.coin, 8, 4);
                spawnFloatingText(c.x, c.y - 20, '+5', COLORS.coin);
            }
        }
    });
    coins = coins.filter(c => c.x > -50 && !c.collected);

    // Update powerups
    powerups.forEach(p => {
        p.x -= gameSpeed;
        p.glow = (Math.sin(frameCount * 0.1 + p.bobOffset) + 1) / 2;
        if (!p.collected) {
            let dx = (player.x + player.w / 2) - p.x;
            let dy = (player.y + player.h / 2) - p.y;
            if (Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) < p.r + 20) {
                p.collected = true;
                if (p.type === 'shield') {
                    player.shielded = true;
                    player.shieldTimer = 600;
                    spawnFloatingText(p.x, p.y - 20, 'SHIELD!', '#76FF03');
                } else {
                    player.magnetActive = true;
                    player.magnetTimer = 480;
                    spawnFloatingText(p.x, p.y - 20, 'MAGNET!', '#FF4081');
                }
                spawnParticles(p.x, p.y, p.type === 'shield' ? '#76FF03' : '#FF4081', 15, 6);
            }
        }
    });
    powerups = powerups.filter(p => p.x > -50 && !p.collected);

    // Update particles
    particles.forEach(p => {
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;
        p.vy += 0.15;
        p.life -= p.decay;
    });
    particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);

    // Update floating texts
    floatingTexts.forEach(t => {
        t.y += t.vy;
        t.life -= 0.02;
    });
    floatingTexts = floatingTexts.filter(t => t.life > 0);

    // Screen shake
    if (shakeTimer > 0) shakeTimer--;
}

// Drawing functions
function drawSky() {
    let grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, groundY);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#29B6F6');
    grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#4FC3F7');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#E1F5FE');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, groundY);
}

function drawSun() {
    let sx = W - 120, sy = 80;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF176';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, 60, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, 40, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF9C4';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
}

function drawClouds() {
    clouds.forEach(c => {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = c.opacity;
        ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.cloud;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y, c.w / 2, c.h / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(c.x - c.w * 0.25, c.y + 5, c.w * 0.3, c.h * 0.4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(c.x + c.w * 0.25, c.y + 3, c.w * 0.35, c.h * 0.45, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
    });
}

function drawMountains() {
    mountains.forEach(m => {
        ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(m.x, groundY);
        ctx.lineTo(m.x + m.w / 2, groundY - m.h);
        ctx.lineTo(m.x + m.w, groundY);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();

        // Snow cap
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(m.x + m.w / 2 - m.w * 0.1, groundY - m.h + m.h * 0.15);
        ctx.lineTo(m.x + m.w / 2, groundY - m.h);
        ctx.lineTo(m.x + m.w / 2 + m.w * 0.1, groundY - m.h + m.h * 0.15);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    });
}

function drawGround() {
    // Main ground
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.ground;
    ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, W, H - groundY);

    // Ground top stripe
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.groundTop;
    ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, W, 6);

    // Ground texture
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.groundDark;
    for (let i = 0; i < W; i += 40) {
        let offset = ((i + Math.floor(distance * 0.5)) % 40);
        ctx.fillRect(i - offset, groundY + 10, 20, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(i + 15 - offset, groundY + 20, 15, 2);
    }

    // Grass tufts
    ctx.fillStyle = '#66BB6A';
    for (let i = 0; i < W; i += 25) {
        let offset = ((i + Math.floor(distance)) % 25);
        ctx.fillRect(i - offset, groundY - 3, 3, 6);
        ctx.fillRect(i + 8 - offset, groundY - 5, 2, 8);
        ctx.fillRect(i + 16 - offset, groundY - 2, 3, 5);
    }
}

function drawPlayer() {
    if (!player.alive) return;

    let px = player.x;
    let py = player.y;

    // Trail
    player.trail.forEach(t => {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = t.alpha * 0.3;
        ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.player;
        ctx.fillRect(t.x - 5, t.y - 10, 10, 20);
        ctx.restore();
    });

    ctx.save();

    // Invincibility flash
    if (player.invincible && frameCount % 4 < 2) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
    }

    // Shield visual
    if (player.shielded) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(118, 255, 3, ${0.4 + Math.sin(frameCount * 0.15) * 0.2})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(px + player.w / 2, py + player.h / 2, 32, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(118, 255, 3, 0.1)`;
        ctx.fill();
    }

    // Magnet visual
    if (player.magnetActive) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 64, 129, ${0.3 + Math.sin(frameCount * 0.1) * 0.15})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(px + player.w / 2, py + player.h / 2, 35 + i * 15 + Math.sin(frameCount * 0.08 + i) * 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.stroke();
        }
    }

    // Body
    let legOffset = player.grounded ? Math.sin(player.runTimer * 0.8) * 6 : 4;
    let armOffset = player.grounded ? Math.sin(player.runTimer * 0.8) * 8 : -5;
    let bodyBob = player.grounded ? Math.abs(Math.sin(player.runTimer * 0.8)) * 2 : 0;

    // Shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(px + player.w / 2, groundY + 2, 18, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Legs
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1565C0';
    // Left leg
    ctx.fillRect(px + 8, py + 34 + bodyBob, 8, 18 + legOffset);
    // Right leg
    ctx.fillRect(px + 20, py + 34 + bodyBob, 8, 18 - legOffset);

    // Shoes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#E53935';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 6, py + 50 + bodyBob + legOffset, 12, 5);
    ctx.fillRect(px + 18, py + 50 + bodyBob - legOffset, 12, 5);

    // Body / shirt
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.playerShirt;
    ctx.fillRect(px + 6, py + 16 + bodyBob, 24, 20);

    // Shirt detail
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FF8F00';
    ctx.fillRect(px + 14, py + 18 + bodyBob, 8, 3);

    // Arms
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.playerSkin;
    // Left arm
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(px + 4, py + 18 + bodyBob);
    ctx.rotate((-20 + armOffset) * Math.PI / 180);
    ctx.fillRect(-3, 0, 6, 16);
    ctx.restore();
    // Right arm
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(px + 32, py + 18 + bodyBob);
    ctx.rotate((20 - armOffset) * Math.PI / 180);
    ctx.fillRect(-3, 0, 6, 16);
    ctx.restore();

    // Head
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.playerSkin;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px + player.w / 2, py + 10 + bodyBob, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Hair
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4E342E';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px + player.w / 2, py + 6 + bodyBob, 14, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillRect(px + player.w / 2 - 14, py + 4 + bodyBob, 28, 4);

    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(px + 14, py + 9 + bodyBob, 5, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(px + 26, py + 9 + bodyBob, 5, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Pupils
    ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px + 16, py + 9 + bodyBob, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px + 28, py + 9 + bodyBob, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Mouth
    if (!player.grounded && player.vy < -2) {
        // Excited face
        ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(px + player.w / 2, py + 17 + bodyBob, 4, 0, Math.PI);
        ctx.fill();
    } else {
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(px + player.w / 2, py + 16 + bodyBob, 4, 0.1, Math.PI - 0.1);
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    ctx.restore();
}

function drawObstacles() {
    obstacles.forEach(o => {
        if (o.type === 'crate') {
            // Crate
            ctx.fillStyle = '#8D6E63';
            ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#A1887F';
            ctx.fillRect(o.x + 2, o.y + 2, o.w - 4, o.h - 4);
            // Cross pattern
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#6D4C41';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(o.x + 4, o.y + 4);
            ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w - 4, o.y + o.h - 4);
            ctx.moveTo(o.x + o.w - 4, o.y + 4);
            ctx.lineTo(o.x + 4, o.y + o.h - 4);
            ctx.stroke();
            // Border
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#5D4037';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.strokeRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
        } else if (o.type === 'spike') {
            // Spikes
            ctx.fillStyle = '#E53935';
            let spikeCount = 3;
            let sw = o.w / spikeCount;
            for (let i = 0; i < spikeCount; i++) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(o.x + i * sw, o.y + o.h);
                ctx.lineTo(o.x + i * sw + sw / 2, o.y);
                ctx.lineTo(o.x + (i + 1) * sw, o.y + o.h);
                ctx.closePath();
                ctx.fill();
            }
            // Shine
            ctx.fillStyle = '#FF8A80';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(o.x + sw * 0.5, o.y + o.h);
            ctx.lineTo(o.x + sw, o.y + 5);
            ctx.lineTo(o.x + sw * 1.5, o.y + o.h);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
        }
    });
}

function drawCoins() {
    coins.forEach(c => {
        let bob = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.08 + c.bobOffset) * 3;
        let cy = c.y + bob;

        // Glow
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3;
        ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.coin;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(c.x, cy, c.r + 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();

        // Coin body
        ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.coin;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(c.x, cy, c.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Inner circle
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFA000';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(c.x, cy, c.r - 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Shine
        ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.coinShine;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(c.x - 2, cy - 2, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // $ symbol
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFA000';
        ctx.font = `bold ${c.r}px Arial`;
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.fillText('$', c.x, cy + 1);
    });
}

function drawPowerups() {
    powerups.forEach(p => {
        let bob = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.06 + p.bobOffset) * 5;
        let py = p.y + bob;

        // Glow
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3 + p.glow * 0.3;
        ctx.fillStyle = p.type === 'shield' ? '#76FF03' : '#FF4081';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, py, p.r + 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();

        // Body
        ctx.fillStyle = p.type === 'shield' ? '#76FF03' : '#FF4081';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, py, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Inner
        ctx.fillStyle = p.type === 'shield' ? '#B2FF59' : '#F8BBD0';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, py, p.r - 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Icon
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
        ctx.font = 'bold 14px Arial';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.fillText(p.type === 'shield' ? '🛡' : '🧲', p.x, py + 1);
    });
}

function drawParticles() {
    particles.forEach(p => {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
        ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
    });
}

function drawFloatingTexts() {
    floatingTexts.forEach(t => {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = t.life;
        ctx.fillStyle = t.color;
        ctx.font = 'bold 16px Arial';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#000';
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.strokeText(t.text, t.x, t.y);
        ctx.fillText(t.text, t.x, t.y);
        ctx.restore();
    });
}

function drawUI() {
    // Score
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(10, 10, 180, 50, 10);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
    ctx.font = 'bold 14px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('DISTANCE', 22, 28);
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px Arial';
    ctx.fillText(Math.floor(distance / 10) + 'm', 22, 50);

    // Coins
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(W - 120, 10, 110, 50, 10);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.coin;
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('🪙 ' + Math.floor(score / 5), W - 108, 40);

    // Speed indicator
    let speedPct = (gameSpeed - baseSpeed) / (maxSpeed - baseSpeed);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(W / 2 - 60, 10, 120, 12, 6);
    ctx.fill();

    let speedColor = speedPct < 0.5 ? '#76FF03' : speedPct < 0.8 ? '#FFC107' : '#FF5722';
    ctx.fillStyle = speedColor;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(W / 2 - 58, 12, 116 * speedPct, 8, 4);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
}

function drawMenu() {
    drawSky();
    drawSun();
    drawClouds();
    drawMountains();
    drawGround();

    // Title
    ctx.save();
    let titleY = H * 0.3;

    // Title shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
    ctx.font = `bold ${60 * scale}px Arial`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('SPRINT DASH', W / 2 + 3, titleY + 3);

    // Title
    let titleGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(W / 2 - 200, titleY - 30, W / 2 + 200, titleY + 10);
    titleGrad.addColorStop(0, '#FF6F00');
    titleGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#FFD700');
    titleGrad.addColorStop(1, '#FF6F00');
    ctx.fillStyle = titleGrad;
    ctx.fillText('SPRINT DASH', W / 2, titleY);

    // Subtitle
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
    ctx.font = `${18 * scale}px Arial`;
    ctx.fillText('An Endless Runner Adventure', W / 2, titleY + 35);

    // Play button
    let btnW = 220, btnH = 55;
    let btnX = W / 2 - btnW / 2, btnY = H * 0.5;
    let pulse = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.05) * 3;

    ctx.fillStyle = '#E65100';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(btnX - pulse, btnY - pulse, btnW + pulse * 2, btnH + pulse * 2, 12);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#FF6F00';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(btnX, btnY, btnW, btnH, 12);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
    ctx.font = `bold ${24 * scale}px Arial`;
    ctx.fillText('▶  TAP TO PLAY', W / 2, btnY + btnH / 2 + 1);

    // High score
    if (highScore > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
        ctx.font = `${14 * scale}px Arial`;
        ctx.fillText('Best: ' + highScore + 'm', W / 2, btnY + btnH + 35);
    }

    // Controls info
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.font = `${12 * scale}px Arial`;
    ctx.fillText('SPACE / UP / TAP to Jump  |  Double Jump enabled', W / 2, H * 0.82);
    ctx.fillText('DOWN to Fast Fall', W / 2, H * 0.82 + 20);

    // Animated character preview
    let previewY = H * 0.68;
    let previewBob = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.06) * 5;
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.playerSkin;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W / 2, previewY - 20 + previewBob, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4E342E';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W / 2, previewY - 24 + previewBob, 14, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#E65100';
    ctx.fillRect(W / 2 - 12, previewY + 2 + previewBob, 24, 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1565C0';
    ctx.fillRect(W / 2 - 8, previewY + 20 + previewBob, 8, 16);
    ctx.fillRect(W / 2 + 2, previewY + 20 + previewBob, 8, 16);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#E53935';
    ctx.fillRect(W / 2 - 10, previewY + 34 + previewBob, 12, 5);
    ctx.fillRect(W / 2, previewY + 34 + previewBob, 12, 5);

    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(W / 2 - 4, previewY - 22 + previewBob, 5, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(W / 2 + 6, previewY - 22 + previewBob, 5, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W / 2 - 2, previewY - 22 + previewBob, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W / 2 + 8, previewY - 22 + previewBob, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
}

function drawGameOver() {
    // Darken
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.save();

    // Panel
    let panelW = 320, panelH = 280;
    let panelX = W / 2 - panelW / 2, panelY = H / 2 - panelH / 2;

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(30,30,30,0.95)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(panelX, panelY, panelW, panelH, 16);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = '#FF6F00';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(panelX, panelY, panelW, panelH, 16);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Game Over text
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FF5722';
    ctx.font = `bold ${36 * scale}px Arial`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W / 2, panelY + 50);

    // Score
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
    ctx.font = `${16 * scale}px Arial`;
    ctx.fillText('Distance', W / 2, panelY + 90);
    ctx.font = `bold ${32 * scale}px Arial`;
    ctx.fillText(Math.floor(distance / 10) + 'm', W / 2, panelY + 125);

    // High score
    ctx.fillStyle = score >= highScore ? '#FFD700' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.font = `${16 * scale}px Arial`;
    ctx.fillText(score >= highScore ? '🏆 NEW BEST!' : 'Best: ' + highScore + 'm', W / 2, panelY + 155);

    // Restart button
    let btnW = 200, btnH = 50;
    let btnX = W / 2 - btnW / 2, btnY = panelY + panelH - 70;

    ctx.fillStyle = '#E65100';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(btnX, btnY, btnW, btnH, 10);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
    ctx.font = `bold ${20 * scale}px Arial`;
    ctx.fillText('↻  TRY AGAIN', W / 2, btnY + btnH / 2 + 1);

    ctx.restore();
}

function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    if (gameState === 'menu') {
        drawMenu();
        return;
    }

    // Screen shake
    ctx.save();
    if (shakeTimer > 0) {
        let sx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeIntensity * (shakeTimer / 20);
        let sy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeIntensity * (shakeTimer / 20);
        ctx.translate(sx, sy);
    }

    drawSky();
    drawSun();
    drawClouds();
    drawMountains();
    drawGround();
    drawCoins();
    drawPowerups();
    drawObstacles();
    drawPlayer();
    drawParticles();
    drawFloatingTexts();
    drawUI();

    ctx.restore();

    if (gameState === 'gameover') {
        drawGameOver();
    }
}

// Polyfill roundRect if needed
if (!ctx.roundRect) {
    CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect = function(x, y, w, h, r) {
        if (typeof r === 'number') r = [r, r, r, r];
        this.moveTo(x + r[0], y);
        this.lineTo(x + w - r[1], y);
        this.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r[1]);
        this.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r[2]);
        this.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r[2], y + h);
        this.lineTo(x + r[3], y + h);
        this.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r[3]);
        this.lineTo(x, y + r[0]);
        this.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r[0], y);
        this.closePath();
    };
}

function gameLoop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// Initialize
initMountains();
for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) spawnCloud();
gameLoop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
