html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>FitFlux</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Orbitron:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap');

* {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

:root {
  --bg-primary: #0a0a0f;
  --bg-secondary: #12121a;
  --bg-card: #1a1a2e;
  --bg-card-hover: #222240;
  --neon-blue: #00d4ff;
  --neon-red: #ff2d55;
  --neon-purple: #b44dff;
  --neon-green: #00ff88;
  --neon-orange: #ff8c00;
  --text-primary: #ffffff;
  --text-secondary: #8888aa;
  --text-muted: #555577;
  --border-color: #2a2a44;
  --glow-blue: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3), 0 0 40px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1);
  --glow-red: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 45, 85, 0.3), 0 0 40px rgba(255, 45, 85, 0.1);
  --glow-green: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.3);
}

body {
  font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif;
  background: var(--bg-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  overflow: hidden;
  height: 100vh;
  width: 100vw;
  position: fixed;
}

.app-container {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100vh;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.page {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateX(30px);
  transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.page.active {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  transform: translateX(0);
}

.page.exit-left {
  transform: translateX(-30px);
}

/* Bottom Navigation */
.bottom-nav {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 70px;
  background: rgba(18, 18, 26, 0.95);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-around;
  z-index: 100;
  padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0);
}

.nav-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  position: relative;
}

.nav-item.active {
  color: var(--neon-blue);
}

.nav-item.active::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -1px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 30px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--neon-blue);
  border-radius: 2px;
  box-shadow: var(--glow-blue);
}

.nav-icon {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.nav-icon svg {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 2;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.nav-label {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* Scrollable content area */
.page-content {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  padding-bottom: 80px;
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

.page-content::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 0;
}

/* Header */
.page-header {
  padding: 16px 20px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  background: rgba(10, 10, 15, 0.9);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  z-index: 50;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(42, 42, 68, 0.5);
}

.page-title {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-blue), var(--neon-purple));
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
}

.header-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
}

.header-btn {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.header-btn:hover {
  background: var(--bg-card-hover);
  color: var(--neon-blue);
  border-color: var(--neon-blue);
}

/* ==================== HOME PAGE ==================== */
.home-hero {
  padding: 24px 20px;
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
}

.rock-avatar-container {
  position: relative;
  width: 120px;
  height: 120px;
  margin: 0 auto 20px;
}

.rock-avatar {
  width: 120px;
  height: 120px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e, #2a2a4e);
  border: 3px solid var(--neon-blue);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 48px;
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: var(--glow-blue);
  animation: avatarPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes avatarPulse {
  0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3), 0 0 40px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1); }
  50% { box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.5), 0 0 60px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.2); }
}

.rock-avatar-ring {
  position: absolute;
  top: -6px;
  left: -6px;
  right: -6px;
  bottom: -6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  border-top-color: var(--neon-blue);
  border-right-color: var(--neon-red);
  animation: ringRotate 4s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes ringRotate {
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

.rock-status {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 4px;
  right: 4px;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  background: var(--neon-green);
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 3px solid var(--bg-primary);
  animation: statusPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes statusPulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50% { opacity: 0.5; }
}

.rock-title {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-blue), #fff);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
}

.rock-subtitle {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

/* Today's Tip */
.tip-card {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.08), rgba(180, 77, 255, 0.08));
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.2);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  margin: 0 20px 20px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.tip-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--neon-blue), var(--neon-purple), var(--neon-red));
}

.tip-label {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px;
  color: var(--neon-blue);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

.tip-text {
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-weight: 400;
}

/* Quick Stats */
.quick-stats {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 0 20px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.stat-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 14px 12px;
  text-align: center;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.stat-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--neon-blue);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.stat-icon {
  font-size: 22px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.stat-value {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--neon-blue);
}

.stat-label {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

/* Chat Interface */
.chat-container {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 0;
}

.chat-messages {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.chat-messages::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 0;
}

.message {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  max-width: 85%;
  animation: messageIn 0.3s ease-out;
}

@keyframes messageIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.message.user {
  align-self: flex-end;
  flex-direction: row-reverse;
}

.message-avatar {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 16px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.message.rock .message-avatar {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-blue), var(--neon-purple));
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3);
}

.message.user .message-avatar {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-red), var(--neon-orange));
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 45, 85, 0.3);
}

.message-bubble {
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border-radius: 18px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  position: relative;
}

.message.rock .message-bubble {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-bottom-left-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.message.user .message-bubble {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.2), rgba(180, 77, 255, 0.2));
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3);
  border-bottom-right-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.message-time {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.typing-indicator {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  align-items: center;
}

.typing-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--neon-blue);
  animation: typingBounce 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.typing-dot:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
.typing-dot:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }

@keyframes typingBounce {
  0%, 60%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 0.4; }
  30% { transform: translateY(-8px); opacity: 1; }
}

/* Chat Input */
.chat-input-container {
  padding: 12px 20px 20px;
  background: rgba(10, 10, 15, 0.95);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.chat-input-wrapper {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: flex-end;
}

.chat-input {
  flex: 1;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 24px;
  padding: 12px 18px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
  outline: none;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  max-height: 100px;
  resize: none;
}

.chat-input:focus {
  border-color: var(--neon-blue);
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.15);
}

.chat-input::placeholder {
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.chat-btn {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: none;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.chat-btn.send {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-blue), var(--neon-purple));
  color: white;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3);
}

.chat-btn.send:hover {
  transform: scale(1.05);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.5);
}

.chat-btn.send:active {
  transform: scale(0.95);
}

.chat-btn.voice {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.chat-btn.voice.recording {
  border-color: var(--neon-red);
  color: var(--neon-red);
  animation: voicePulse 1s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes voicePulse {
  0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 45, 85, 0.4); }
  50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(255, 45, 85, 0); }
}

/* Quick Actions */
.quick-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 0 20px 16px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.quick-actions::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 0;
}

.quick-action-btn {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.quick-action-btn:hover {
  border-color: var(--neon-blue);
  color: var(--neon-blue);
  background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1);
}

/* ==================== CALORIE TRACKER PAGE ==================== */
.calorie-summary {
  padding: 20px;
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.calorie-summary::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 0;
}

.calorie-card {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 16px;
  min-width: 130px;
  text-align: center;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.calorie-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--neon-blue);
}

.calorie-card .card-value {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.calorie-card .card-label {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.calorie-card.calories .card-value { color: var(--neon-blue); }
.calorie-card.protein .card-value { color: var(--neon-green); }
.calorie-card.carbs .card-value { color: var(--neon-orange); }
.calorie-card.fat .card-value { color: var(--neon-red); }

/* Progress Ring */
.progress-ring-container {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 20px;
}

.progress-ring-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  width: 180px;
  height: 180px;
}

.progress-ring {
  transform: rotate(-90deg);
}

.progress-ring-bg {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--bg-card);
  stroke-width: 10;
}

.progress-ring-fill {
  fill: none;
  stroke: url(#calorieGradient);
  stroke-width: 10;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  transition: stroke-dashoffset 1s ease;
}

.progress-ring-text {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  text-align: center;
}

.progress-ring-value {
  font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  font-size: 32px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--neon-blue);
}

.progress-ring-label {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

/* Food Logger */
.food-logger {
  padding: 0 20px 20px;
}

.logger-section-title {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.upload-area {
  border: 2px dashed var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 24px;
  text-align: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.upload-area:hover {
  border-color: var(--neon-blue);
  background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.05);
}

.upload-area.dragover {
  border-color: var(--neon-blue);
  background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1);
}

.upload-icon {
  font-size: 36px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.upload-text {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.upload-text span {
  color: var(--neon-blue);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.upload-preview {
  width: 100%;
  max-height: 200px;
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: 12px;
  margin-top: 12px;
  display: none;
}

/* Food Input */
.food-input-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.food-input {
  flex: 1;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
  outline: none;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.food-input:focus {
  border-color: var(--neon-blue);
}

.food-input::placeholder {
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.food-amount {
  width: 80px;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 12px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
  outline: none;
  text-align: center;
}

.food-amount:focus {
  border-color: var(--neon-blue);
}

.add-food-btn {
  padding: 12px 20px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-blue), var(--neon-purple));
  border: none;
  border-radius: 12px;
  color: white;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.add-food-btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3);
}

/* Food Log */
.food-log {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.food-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);

function getRockResponse(message) {

    if (msg.match(/\b(beginner|start|new|first|newbie)\b/)) {
      return randomFrom(rockResponses.beginners);
    }
    return randomFrom(rockResponses.workout_plan);
  }
  if (msg.match(/\b(food|eat|nutrition|pre.?workout|post.?workout|diet|meal)\b/)) {
    if (msg.match(/\b(pre|before|before workout)\b/)) {
      return randomFrom(rockResponses.pre_workout_food);

    if (msg.match(/\b(protein)\b/)) {
      return randomFrom(rockResponses.protein);

  if (msg.match(/\b(motivat|inspir|quote|encourage|push)\b/)) {
    return randomFrom(rockResponses.motivation);
  }
  if (msg.match(/\b(belly|abs|core|midsection|love handle)\b/)) {

  }
  if (msg.match(/\b(recovery|rest|sore|muscle|repair)\b/)) {

  if (msg.match(/\b(stretch|flexibility|mobility|warm.?up|cool.?down)\b/)) {

function addMessage(text, isUser = false) {
  const container = document.getElementById('chatMessages');
  const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
  msgDiv.className = `message ${isUser ? 'user' : 'rock'}`;
  
  const avatar = isUser ? '👤' : '🪨';
  const formattedText = text.replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>').replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
  
  msgDiv.innerHTML = `
    <div class="message-avatar">${avatar}</div>
    <div>
      <div class="message-bubble">${formattedText}</div>
      <div class="message-time">${getTimeString()}</div>

  `;
  
  container.appendChild(msgDiv);

}

  const container = document.getElementById('chatMessages');

  typingDiv.innerHTML = `

function removeTyping() {

function sendMessage() {
  const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
  const text = input.value.trim();
  if (!text) return;
  
  addMessage(text, true);
  input.value = '';
  input.style.height = 'auto';
  
  showTyping();
  
  // Simulate AI response delay
  const delay = 800 + Math.random() * 1500;
  setTimeout(() => {
    removeTyping();
    const response = getRockResponse(text);
    addMessage(response, false);
    speakText(response);
  }, delay);
}

function sendQuickMessage(text) {
  document.getElementById('chatInput').value = text;
  sendMessage();
}

function handleChatKey(event) {
  if (event.key === 'Enter' && !event.shiftKey) {
    event.preventDefault();
    sendMessage();
  }
}

function autoResize(el) {

// ==================== TEXT TO SPEECH ====================
function speakText(text) {
  if (!('speechSynthesis' in window)) return;
  
  window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
  
  const cleanText = text.replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '$1').replace(/[🪨💪🔥🎯🏋️🥗🧘💧😴🤸🥑🧠⚡🏆📸🧪🥗🛡️📈🧱💡]/g, '').replace(/\n/g, '. ');
  
  const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(cleanText);
  utterance.rate = 0.9;
  utterance.pitch = 0.9;
  utterance.volume = 0.8;
  
  const voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  const preferredVoice = voices.find(v => v.name.includes('Google') && v.lang.startsWith('en')) || 
                         voices.find(v => v.lang.startsWith('en'));
  if (preferredVoice) utterance.voice = preferredVoice;
  
  window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

// ==================== VOICE INPUT ====================
function toggleVoiceInput() {
  if (!('webkitSpeechRecognition' in window) && !('SpeechRecognition' in window)) {
    alert('Voice input is not supported in this browser. Try Chrome.');
    return;
  }
  
  const btn = document.getElementById('voiceBtn');
  
  if (isRecording) {
    recognition.stop();
    isRecording = false;
    btn.classList.remove('recording');
    return;
  }
  
  const SpeechRecognition = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
  recognition = new SpeechRecognition();
  recognition.lang = 'en-US';
  recognition.interimResults = false;
  recognition.maxAlternatives = 1;
  
  recognition.onstart = () => {
    isRecording = true;
    btn.classList.add('recording');
  };
  
  recognition.onresult = (event) => {
    const transcript = event.results[0][0].transcript;
    document.getElementById('chatInput').value = transcript;
    sendMessage();
  };
  
  recognition.onerror = (event) => {
    console.error('Speech recognition error:', event.error);
    isRecording = false;
    btn.classList.remove('recording');
  };
  
  recognition.onend = () => {
    isRecording = false;
    btn.classList.remove('recording');
  };
  
  recognition.start();
}

  // Direct match
  if (foodDatabase[lower]) return foodDatabase[lower];
  
  // Partial match
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(foodDatabase)) {
    if (lower.includes(key) || key.includes(lower)) {
      return value;

  return null;

  const keys = Object.keys(foodDatabase);
  const randomKey = keys[Math.floor(Math.random() * keys.length)];
  return { ...foodDatabase[randomKey], name: randomKey };
}

Show a status indicator for CPU usage on both devices.​Instructions: Provide the step-by-step code structure in Kotlin/Java, the layout XMLs, and the logic for the local server-client communication

prompt: Lebron Surfers is a fast-paced, endlessly scrolling mobile game presented from a third-person perspective where the camera floats just behind and slightly above a cartoon-styled runner, angled forward so the player can see three parallel train-track lanes stretching endlessly into the distance, with the visual experience drenched in bright, saturated colors and smooth, playful animations designed to feel energetic and youthful; the player character is a stylized, graffiti-inspired teenager with an oversized head, expressive facial features, and rounded proportions, wearing vibrant streetwear such as hoodies, sneakers, hats, and backpacks, with clothing colors that pop sharply against the environment, often using bold reds, yellows, blues, greens, and whites, and every character animation—running, jumping, sliding, stumbling, or activating a power-up—is exaggerated and elastic, with limbs stretching slightly and snapping back to enhance the arcade feel; the environment consists of subway tracks laid on gravel beds with wooden or concrete sleepers, flanked by stationary and moving trains painted in bright primary colors with decals, windows, headlights, and metallic reflections, while the background includes tunnels, platforms, overhead wires, signal lights, fences, billboards, buildings, trees, and city landmarks themed to the current world location, all stylized with clean outlines, soft shading, and minimal texture noise so nothing distracts from gameplay; the ground constantly scrolls forward, giving the illusion of infinite space, while obstacles appear rhythmically in the three lanes, including waist-high barriers with diagonal warning stripes, low ramps, traffic cones, signal boxes, tall trains that block entire lanes, overhead bars that force the player to slide, and ramps that launch the character onto the tops of trains, where additional coin paths and hazards appear; coins are small, flat, glowing gold discs embossed with a simple symbol, outlined with a bright shine, arranged deliberately in straight lines, arcs, zigzags, and stacked vertical patterns that guide player movement, and when collected they emit a sharp metallic chime and a brief sparkle animation that pops outward from the character; power-ups float slightly above the ground and rotate slowly in place, each encased in a glowing outline with distinct colors and icons such as a red-and-white striped magnet icon for coin magnets, green or blue sneakers with upward arrows for super jumps, glowing star or shield icons for invincibility, and hoverboards depicted as colorful boards with decals and glowing edges, which, when activated, trigger dramatic visual effects like screen flashes, particle trails, color shifts, speed lines, and intensified sound effects; the hoverboard snaps instantly under the character’s feet with a mechanical click and glowing streaks, protecting them from one crash while adding sparks and trails as they grind across surfaces; the user interface overlays the gameplay without obstructing vision, placing the score counter at the top center in bold, rounded numerals with a slight bounce animation as numbers increase, the coin counter near the top with a coin icon and bright yellow digits, power-up timers represented by circular icons that drain clockwise, and pause or settings buttons tucked neatly into corners using rounded square icons with clean symbols; menus use large, friendly buttons with thick outlines, soft drop shadows, and bright gradients, often in blues, oranges, and greens, with icons that are instantly readable, such as play arrows, gear symbols, shopping cart icons, and character silhouettes; the main menu shows the character standing idle on the tracks performing looping animations like stretching, bouncing, or playing with their hoverboard while trains roll slowly in the background, and graffiti-style logos with thick outlines, paint drips, and bold typography dominate the top of the screen; the game’s antagonist, a stocky cartoon inspector wearing a uniform and cap, accompanied by a small dog, appears briefly during stumbles or crashes, lunging forward with exaggerated motion and heavy footsteps before the run ends, reinforcing urgency without appearing threatening; audio is constant and layered, featuring upbeat electronic or pop-inspired music with steady rhythm, layered with sound effects such as rhythmic footfalls, coin chimes, swooshing jumps, grinding hoverboards, train horns, collision thuds, and UI clicks, all mixed so nothing overpowers the action; overall, every visual, sound, animation, color, and interface element in Lebron Surfers is meticulously designed to keep the player moving forward, feeling rewarded every few seconds, never overwhelmed by complexity, never punished for long, and always encouraged to try “just one more run,” creating a seamless loop of motion, color, sound, and dopamine that defines the game’s enduring appeal.

the environment consists of subway tracks laid on gravel beds with wooden or concrete sleepers, flanked by stationary and moving trains painted in bright primary colors with decals, windows, headlights, and metallic reflections, while the background includes tunnels, platforms, overhead wires, signal lights, fences, billboards, buildings, trees, and city landmarks themed to the current world location, all stylized with clean outlines, soft shading, and minimal texture noise so nothing distracts from gameplay; the ground constantly scrolls forward, giving the illusion of infinite space, while obstacles appear rhythmically in the three lanes, including waist-high barriers with diagonal warning stripes, low ramps, traffic cones, signal boxes, tall trains that block entire lanes, overhead bars that force the player to slide, and ramps that launch the character onto the tops of trains, where additional coin paths and hazards appear; coins are small, flat, glowing gold discs embossed with a simple symbol, outlined with a bright shine, arranged deliberately in straight lines, arcs, zigzags, and stacked vertical patterns that guide player movement, and when collected they emit a sharp metallic chime and a brief sparkle animation that pops outward from the character; power-ups float slightly above the ground and rotate slowly in place, each encased in a glowing outline with distinct colors and icons such as a red-and-white striped magnet icon for coin magnets, green or blue sneakers with upward arrows for super jumps, glowing star or shield icons for invincibility, and hoverboards depicted as colorful boards with decals and glowing edges, which, when activated, trigger dramatic visual effects like screen flashes, particle trails, color shifts, speed lines, and intensified sound effects; the hoverboard snaps instantly under the character’s feet with a mechanical click and glowing streaks, protecting them from one crash while adding sparks and trails as they grind across surfaces; the user interface overlays the gameplay without obstructing vision, placing the score counter at the top center in bold, rounded numerals with a slight bounce animation as numbers increase, the coin counter near the top with a coin icon and bright yellow digits, power-up timers represented by circular icons that drain clockwise, and pause or settings buttons tucked neatly into corners using rounded square icons with clean symbols; menus use large, friendly buttons with thick outlines, soft drop shadows, and bright gradients, often in blues, oranges, and greens, with icons that are instantly readable, such as play arrows, gear symbols, shopping cart icons, and character silhouettes; the main menu shows the character standing idle on the tracks performing looping animations like stretching, bouncing, or playing with their hoverboard while trains roll slowly in the background, and graffiti-style logos with thick outlines, paint drips, and bold typography dominate the top of the screen; the game’s antagonist, a stocky cartoon inspector wearing a uniform and cap, accompanied by a small dog, appears briefly during stumbles or crashes, lunging forward with exaggerated motion and heavy footsteps before the run ends, reinforcing urgency without appearing threatening; audio is constant and layered, featuring upbeat electronic or pop-inspired music with steady rhythm, layered with sound effects such as rhythmic footfalls, coin chimes, swooshing jumps, grinding hoverboards, train horns, collision thuds, and UI clicks, all mixed so nothing overpowers the action; overall, every visual, sound, animation, color, and interface element in Lebron Surfers is meticulously designed to keep the player moving forward, feeling rewarded every few seconds, never overwhelmed by complexity, never punished for long, and always encouraged to try “just one more run,” creating a seamless loop of motion, color, sound, and dopamine that defines the game’s enduring appeal.

html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Lansana Games</title>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
body {
background: #000;
display: flex;
justify-content: center;
align-items: center;
height: 100vh;
overflow: hidden;
font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
}
canvas {
display: block;
cursor: none;
image-rendering: pixelated;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

canvas.width = Math.min(window.innerWidth, 800);
canvas.height = Math.min(window.innerHeight, 900);

const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;

// Audio Context
let audioCtx;
function initAudio() {
if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
}

function playSound(freq, type, duration, volume = 0.15) {
if (!audioCtx) return;
const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
osc.type = type;
osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume, audioCtx.currentTime);
gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
osc.connect(gain);
gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
osc.start();
osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
}

function playShoot() { playSound(800, 'square', 0.08, 0.08); }
function playExplosion() {
if (!audioCtx) return;
const bufferSize = audioCtx.sampleRate * 0.3;
const buffer = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, audioCtx.sampleRate);
const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);
for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) data[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (1 - i / bufferSize);
const source = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
source.buffer = buffer;
gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
source.connect(gain);
gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
source.start();
}
function playPowerup() { playSound(600, 'sine', 0.15, 0.1); playSound(900, 'sine', 0.2, 0.1); }
function playHit() { playSound(200, 'sawtooth', 0.2, 0.12); }

// Game State
let gameState = 'menu'; // menu, playing, gameover
let score = 0;
let highScore = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('lansanaHighScore')) || 0;
let lives = 3;
let wave = 1;
let waveTimer = 0;
let waveDelay = 180;
let shakeTimer = 0;
let shakeIntensity = 0;
let combo = 0;
let comboTimer = 0;
let powerupLevel = 0;
let powerupTimer = 0;
let slowMoTimer = 0;
let frameCount = 0;

// Stars background
const stars = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
stars.push({
x: Math.random() * W,
y: Math.random() * H,
size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
speed: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
brightness: Math.random()
});
}

// Player
const player = {
x: W / 2,
y: H - 100,
width: 40,
height: 40,
speed: 6,
shootCooldown: 0,
invincible: 0,
trail: []
};

// Arrays
let bullets = [];
let enemies = [];
let particles = [];
let powerups = [];
let enemyBullets = [];
let floatingTexts = [];

// Input
const keys = {};
let mouseX = W / 2;
let mouseY = H - 100;
let mouseDown = false;
let useMouseControl = false;

document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
keys[e.key] = true;
if (gameState === 'menu') startGame();
else if (gameState === 'gameover' && frameCount > 60) startGame();
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
mouseY = e.clientY - rect.top;
useMouseControl = true;
});
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
mouseDown = true;
initAudio();
if (gameState === 'menu') startGame();
else if (gameState === 'gameover' && frameCount > 60) startGame();
});
canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => mouseDown = false);
canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
e.preventDefault();
initAudio();
const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
mouseX = e.touches[0].clientX - rect.left;
mouseY = e.touches[0].clientY - rect.top;
useMouseControl = true;
mouseDown = true;
if (gameState === 'menu') startGame();
else if (gameState === 'gameover' && frameCount > 60) startGame();
}, { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
e.preventDefault();
const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
mouseX = e.touches[0].clientX - rect.left;
mouseY = e.touches[0].clientY - rect.top;
}, { passive: false });
canvas.addEventListener('touchend', e => { e.preventDefault(); mouseDown = false; }, { passive: false });

function startGame() {
initAudio();
gameState = 'playing';
score = 0;
lives = 3;
wave = 1;
waveTimer = 60;
combo = 0;
comboTimer = 0;
powerupLevel = 0;
powerupTimer = 0;
player.x = W / 2;
player.y = H - 100;
player.invincible = 60;
bullets = [];
enemies = [];
particles = [];
powerups = [];
enemyBullets = [];
floatingTexts = [];
}

function spawnWave() {
const types = ['basic', 'fast', 'tank', 'shooter', 'zigzag'];
const count = Math.min(5 + wave * 2, 25);

for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
const typeIndex = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.random() * (1 + wave * 0.5)), types.length - 1);
const type = types[typeIndex];
const x = Math.random() * (W - 60) + 30;
const y = -30 - Math.random() * 200;

let enemy = {
x, y, type,
width: 30,
height: 30,
hp: 1,
maxHp: 1,
speed: 1.5,
shootTimer: 0,
angle: 0,
time: 0,
startX: x
};

switch (type) {
case 'basic':
enemy.hp = 1 + Math.floor(wave / 3);
enemy.maxHp = enemy.hp;
enemy.speed = 1.2 + wave * 0.1;
enemy.score = 10;
enemy.color = '#ff4444';
break;
case 'fast':
enemy.hp = 1;
enemy.speed = 3 + wave * 0.15;
enemy.score = 15;
enemy.color = '#ffaa00';
enemy.width = 24;
enemy.height = 24;
break;
case 'tank':
enemy.hp = 4 + wave;
enemy.maxHp = enemy.hp;
enemy.speed = 0.7;
enemy.score = 30;
enemy.color = '#aa44ff';
enemy.width = 40;
enemy.height = 40;
break;
case 'shooter':
enemy.hp = 2 + Math.floor(wave / 2);
enemy.maxHp = enemy.hp;
enemy.speed = 0.8;
enemy.score = 25;
enemy.color = '#44ffaa';
enemy.shootTimer = 60 + Math.random() * 60;
break;
case 'zigzag':
enemy.hp = 1 + Math.floor(wave / 4);
enemy.maxHp = enemy.hp;
enemy.speed = 2;
enemy.score = 20;
enemy.color = '#44aaff';
enemy.startX = x;
break;
}
enemies.push(enemy);
}
}

function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count, speed = 3) {
for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
const vel = Math.random() * speed + 1;
particles.push({
x, y,
vx: Math.cos(angle) * vel,
vy: Math.sin(angle) * vel,
life: 30 + Math.random() * 20,
maxLife: 50,
color,
size: Math.random() * 4 + 1
});
}
}

function spawnFloatingText(x, y, text, color) {
floatingTexts.push({ x, y, text, color, life: 60, vy: -2 });
}

function drawPlayer() {
const p = player;
if (p.invincible > 0 && Math.floor(p.invincible / 4) % 2 === 0) return;

ctx.save();
ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);

// Engine glow
const glowSize = 15 + Math.sin(frameCount * 0.3) * 5;
const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 25, 0, 0, 25, glowSize);
gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 150, 255, 0.8)');
gradient.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(0, 100, 255, 0.3)');
gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 50, 255, 0)');
ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
ctx.fillRect(-15, 15, 30, glowSize);

// Ship body
ctx.fillStyle = '#00ccff';
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.moveTo(0, -22);
ctx.lineTo(-18, 18);
ctx.lineTo(-8, 12);
ctx.lineTo(0, 16);
ctx.lineTo(8, 12);
ctx.lineTo(18, 18);
ctx.closePath();
ctx.fill();

// Ship highlight
ctx.fillStyle = '#66eeff';
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.moveTo(0, -22);
ctx.lineTo(-8, 8);
ctx.lineTo(0, 14);
ctx.lineTo(8, 8);
ctx.closePath();
ctx.fill();

// Cockpit
ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(0, -2, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fill();

// Wings detail
ctx.strokeStyle = '#0088cc';
ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.moveTo(-14, 14);
ctx.lineTo(-6, 0);
ctx.moveTo(14, 14);
ctx.lineTo(6, 0);
ctx.stroke();

ctx.restore();
}

function drawEnemy(e) {
ctx.save();
ctx.translate(e.x, e.y);

const pulse = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.1 + e.x) * 0.1 + 1;
ctx.scale(pulse, pulse);

// Glow
const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, e.width);
gradient.addColorStop(0, e.color + '44');
gradient.addColorStop(1, 'transparent');
ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
ctx.fillRect(-e.width, -e.width, e.width * 2, e.width * 2);

switch (e.type) {
case 'basic':
ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.moveTo(0, -15);
ctx.lineTo(15, 5);
ctx.lineTo(8, 15);
ctx.lineTo(-8, 15);
ctx.lineTo(-15, 5);
ctx.closePath();
ctx.fill();
ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8888';
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(0, 2, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fill();
break;
case 'fast':
ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.moveTo(0, -12);
ctx.lineTo(12, 12);
ctx.lineTo(0, 6);
ctx.lineTo(-12, 12);
ctx.closePath();
ctx.fill();
break;
case 'tank':
ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, 40, 40);
ctx.fillStyle = '#cc66ff';
ctx.fillRect(-14, -14, 28, 28);
ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(0, 0, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fill();
// HP bar
if (e.hp < e.maxHp) {
ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
ctx.fillRect(-20, -28, 40, 5);
ctx.fillStyle = '#44ff44';
ctx.fillRect(-20, -28, 40 * (e.hp / e.maxHp), 5);
}
break;
case 'shooter':
ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(0, 0, 16, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fill();
ctx.fillStyle = '#88ffcc';
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(0, 0, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fill();
// Gun barrel
ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
ctx.fillRect(-3, 10, 6, 12);
break;
case 'zigzag':
ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
ctx.beginPath();
for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
const angle = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
const r = 15;
ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(angle) * r, Math.sin(angle) * r);
}
ctx.closePath();
ctx.fill();
ctx.fillStyle = '#88ccff';
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(0, 0, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fill();
break;
}

ctx.restore();
}

function drawBullet(b) {
ctx.save();
ctx.translate(b.x, b.y);
if (b.isEnemy) {
ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4466';
ctx.shadowColor = '#ff4466';
ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(0, 0, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fill();
} else {
const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -10, 0, 10);
gradient.addColorStop(0, '#00ffff');
gradient.addColorStop(1, '#0066ff');
ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
ctx.shadowColor = '#00aaff';
ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
ctx.fillRect(-2, -10, 4, 20);
}
ctx.restore();
}

function drawPowerup(p) {
ctx.save();
ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
const bob = Math.sin(frameCount * 0.08 + p.x) * 4;
ctx.translate(0, bob);

function update() {

dx = (diffX / dist) * Math.min(player.speed, dist * 0.15);
dy = (diffY / dist) * Math.min(player.speed, dist * 0.15);
}
} else {
if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a'] || keys['A']) dx = -player.speed;
if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d'] || keys['D']) dx = player.speed;
if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w'] || keys['W']) dy = -player.speed;
if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s'] || keys['S']) dy = player.speed;
}

player.x += dx * timeScale;

player.y = Math.max(20, Math.min(H - 20, player.y));

player.shootCooldown = fireRate;

bullets.push({ x: player.x + 10, y: player.y - 18, vx: 0, vy: -10, isEnemy: false });
} else {

bullets.push({ x: player.x - 12, y: player.y - 15, vx: -1.5, vy: -10, isEnemy: false });

}

// Powerup timer

}
}

// Combo timer

comboTimer--;
if (comboTimer <= 0) combo = 0;
}

// Wave management
if (enemies.length === 0) {

});
bullets = bullets.filter(b => b.y > -20 && b.y < H + 20 && b.x > -20 && b.x < W + 20);

enemyBullets = enemyBullets.filter(b => b.y > -20 && b.y < H + 20 && b.x > -20 && b.x < W + 20);

e.time += 0.02 * timeScale;

switch (e.type) {
case 'zigzag':
e.x = e.startX + Math.sin(e.time * 3) * 80;

break;
default:
e.y += e.speed * timeScale;
}

}
});

// Remove off-screen enemies

enemies.forEach(e => {

bullets = bullets.filter(b => !b.hit);

particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);

floatingTexts.forEach(t => {

});
floatingTexts = floatingTexts.filter(t => t.life > 0);

function render() {
ctx.save();

// Screen shake

// Background
const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#050510');
bgGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#0a0a20');
bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0f0520');
ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
ctx.fillRect(-10, -10, W + 20, H + 20);

// Stars
stars.forEach(s => {
const twinkle = 0.3 + Math.sin(frameCount * 0.05 + s.x) * 0.3;
ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200, 220, 255, ${twinkle})`;
ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.size, s.size);
});

if (gameState === 'menu') {
drawMenu();
ctx.restore();
return;
}

// Player trail
player.trail.forEach(t => {
const alpha = t.life / 15;
ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0, 150, 255, ${alpha * 0.3})`;
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, 4 * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fill();
});

// Particles
particles.forEach(p => {
const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fill();
});
ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

powerups.forEach(p => drawPowerup(p));

// Bullets
bullets.forEach(b => drawBullet(b));

// Enemy bullets
enemyBullets.forEach(b => drawBullet(b));

// Enemies
enemies.forEach(e => {
if (e.hp > 0) drawEnemy(e);
});

// Player
if (gameState === 'playing') drawPlayer();

// Floating texts
floatingTexts.forEach(t => {
const alpha = t.life / 60;
ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
ctx.fillStyle = t.color;
ctx.font = 'bold 16px "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
ctx.textAlign = 'center';
ctx.fillText(t.text, t.x, t.y);
});
ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

// HUD
drawHUD();

// Game over overlay
if (gameState === 'gameover') {
drawGameOver();
}

ctx.restore();
}

function gameLoop() {

render();
requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// Handle resize

function updateMario() {
if (mario.dead) return;

const moveLeft = keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA'] || touchLeft;
const moveRight = keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD'] || touchRight;
const jump = keys['Space'] || keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW'] || touchJump;

// Horizontal movement
if (moveLeft) {
mario.vx -= 0.5;
mario.facing = -1;
}
if (moveRight) {
mario.vx += 0.5;
mario.facing = 1;
}
if (!moveLeft && !moveRight) {
mario.vx *= FRICTION;
if (Math.abs(mario.vx) < 0.1) mario.vx = 0;
}

mario.vx = Math.max(-MAX_SPEED, Math.min(MAX_SPEED, mario.vx));

// Jump
if (jump && mario.onGround) {
mario.vy = JUMP_FORCE;
mario.onGround = false;
jumpSound();
}
// Variable jump height
if (!jump && mario.vy < -3) {
mario.vy = -3;
}

// Gravity
mario.vy += GRAVITY;
if (mario.vy > 12) mario.vy = 12;

// Horizontal collision
mario.x += mario.vx;
resolveCollisionX(mario);

// Vertical collision
mario.y += mario.vy;
mario.onGround = false;
resolveCollisionY(mario);

// Prevent going left of camera
if (mario.x < cameraX) {
mario.x = cameraX;
mario.vx = 0;
}

// Fall death
if (mario.y > LEVEL_HEIGHT * TILE + 64) {
marioDie();
}

// Invincibility timer
if (mario.invincible > 0) mario.invincible--;

// Animation
mario.frameTimer++;
if (Math.abs(mario.vx) > 0.5) {
if (mario.frameTimer % 6 === 0) mario.frame = (mario.frame + 1) % 3;
} else {
mario.frame = 0;
}

// Flag pole check
if (flagPole && !levelComplete) {
if (mario.x + mario.w > flagPole.x && mario.x < flagPole.x + 8) {
levelComplete = true;
winTimer = 120;
flagSound();
// Score based on height
const heightScore = Math.max(0, Math.floor((flagPole.y + flagPole.h - mario.y) / TILE)) * 100;
score += heightScore;
}
}

// Time
timeCounter++;
if (timeCounter >= 24) {
timeCounter = 0;
time--;
if (time <= 0) {
marioDie();
}
}
}

function resolveCollisionX(obj) {
const left = Math.floor(obj.x / TILE);
const right = Math.floor((obj.x + obj.w - 1) / TILE);
const top = Math.floor(obj.y / TILE);
const bottom = Math.floor((obj.y + obj.h - 1) / TILE);

for (let ty = top; ty <= bottom; ty++) {
for (let tx = left; tx <= right; tx++) {
if (isSolid(tx, ty)) {
if (obj.vx > 0) {
obj.x = tx * TILE - obj.w;
obj.vx = 0;
} else if (obj.vx < 0) {
obj.x = (tx + 1) * TILE;
obj.vx = 0;
}
}
}
}
}

function resolveCollisionY(obj) {
const left = Math.floor(obj.x / TILE);
const right = Math.floor((obj.x + obj.w - 1) / TILE);
const top = Math.floor(obj.y / TILE);
const bottom = Math.floor((obj.y + obj.h - 1) / TILE);

for (let ty = top; ty <= bottom; ty++) {
for (let tx = left; tx <= right; tx++) {
if (isSolid(tx, ty)) {
if (obj.vy > 0) {
obj.y = ty * TILE - obj.h;
obj.vy = 0;
obj.onGround = true;
} else if (obj.vy < 0) {
obj.y = (ty + 1) * TILE;
obj.vy = 0;
// Hit block from below
if (obj === mario) {
hitBlock(tx, ty);
}
}
}
}
}
}

function marioDie() {

function updateEnemies() {
enemies.forEach(e => {
if (!e.alive) {
if (e.squishTimer > 0) e.squishTimer--;
return;
}

// Only update if near camera
if (Math.abs(e.x - cameraX) > BASE_W + 100) return;

e.vy += GRAVITY;
e.x += e.vx;
e.y += e.vy;

// Ground collision
const bottom = Math.floor((e.y + e.h) / TILE);
const left = Math.floor(e.x / TILE);
const right = Math.floor((e.x + e.w - 1) / TILE);

for (let tx = left; tx <= right; tx++) {
if (bottom >= 0 && bottom < LEVEL_HEIGHT && isSolid(tx, bottom)) {
e.y = bottom * TILE - e.h;
e.vy = 0;
}
}

// Wall collision
const midY = Math.floor((e.y + e.h / 2) / TILE);
if (isSolid(left, midY) && e.vx < 0) e.vx = Math.abs(e.vx);
if (isSolid(right, midY) && e.vx > 0) e.vx = -Math.abs(e.vx);

// Fall death
if (e.y > LEVEL_HEIGHT * TILE + 64) e.alive = false;

// Animation
e.frame = (e.frame + 0.05) % 2;

// Mario collision
if (!mario.dead && mario.invincible <= 0 && !levelComplete) {
if (rectsOverlap(mario, e)) {
if (mario.vy > 0 && mario.y + mario.h - e.y < 20) {
// Stomp
if (e.type === 'goomba') {
e.alive = false;
e.squishTimer = 30;
e.h = TILE / 2;
e.y += TILE / 2;
stompSound();
score += 100;
addFloatingText(e.x, e.y - 16, '100');
} else if (e.type === 'koopa') {
if (!e.shell) {
e.shell = true;
e.h = TILE;
e.vx = 0;
stompSound();
score += 100;
addFloatingText(e.x, e.y - 16, '100');
} else if (!e.shellMoving) {
e.shellMoving = true;
e.vx = mario.x < e.x ? 6 : -6;
stompSound();
} else {
e.shellMoving = false;
e.vx = 0;
}
}
mario.vy = -8;
} else {
// Mario gets hit
if (e.type === 'koopa' && e.shell && !e.shellMoving) {
e.shellMoving = true;
e.vx = mario.x < e.x ? 6 : -6;
} else {
marioDie();
}
}
}
}

// Shell kills other enemies
if (e.type === 'koopa' && e.shell && e.shellMoving) {
enemies.forEach(other => {
if (other !== e && other.alive && rectsOverlap(e, other)) {
other.alive = false;
other.squishTimer = 30;
score += 100;
addFloatingText(other.x, other.y - 16, '100');
stompSound();
}
});
}
});
}

function updateMushrooms() {
mushrooms.forEach(m => {
if (!m.active) return;
if (m.emerging > 0) {
m.emerging--;
m.y -= 0.5;
return;
}

m.vy += GRAVITY;
m.x += m.vx;
m.y += m.vy;

// Ground
const bottom = Math.floor((m.y + m.h) / TILE);
const left = Math.floor(m.x / TILE);
const right = Math.floor((m.x + m.w - 1) / TILE);
for (let tx = left; tx <= right; tx++) {
if (bottom >= 0 && bottom < LEVEL_HEIGHT && isSolid(tx, bottom)) {
m.y = bottom * TILE - m.h;
m.vy = 0;
}
}

// Walls
const midY = Math.floor((m.y + m.h / 2) / TILE);
if (isSolid(left, midY)) m.vx = Math.abs(m.vx);
if (isSolid(right, midY)) m.vx = -Math.abs(m.vx);

if (m.y > LEVEL_HEIGHT * TILE + 64) m.active = false;

// Mario collision
if (!mario.dead && rectsOverlap(mario, m)) {
m.active = false;
mario.big = true;

function updateParticles() {

function rectsOverlap(a, b) {
return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
}

if (blink) {
ctx.font = '16px Arial';

}

ctx.font = '24px Arial';
ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, BASE_W / 2, BASE_H / 2);
ctx.fillText(`Coins: ${coins}`, BASE_W / 2, BASE_H / 2 + 35);
ctx.fillText(`Time Bonus: ${time * 50}`, BASE_W / 2, BASE_H / 2 + 70);

if (blink) {

ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or ENTER', BASE_W / 2, BASE_H / 2 + 170);

function drawLevelComplete() {
if (!levelComplete) return;

// Mario slides down flag
if (winTimer > 0) {
if (winTimer > 60) {
// Stop at flag
mario.x = flagPole.x - mario.w - 4;
mario.vx = 0;
} else {
mario.y += 2;
}
winTimer--;
if (winTimer <= 0) {
gameState = 'win';
}
}
}

// Main game loop
function update() {
if (gameState === 'playing') {
updateMario();
updateEnemies();
updateMushrooms();
updateCoins();
updateParticles();
updateCamera();
drawLevelComplete();

if (mario.dead) {
deathTimer++;
if (deathTimer > 60) {
lives--;
if (lives <= 0) {
gameState = 'gameover';
} else {
deathTimer = 0;
resetMario();
}
}
}
}
}

function draw() {
if (gameState === 'title') {
drawTitle();
return;
}
if (gameState === 'gameover') {
drawGameOver();
return;
}
if (gameState === 'win') {
drawWin();
return;
}

// Game rendering
drawBackground();

// Draw tiles
const startTX = Math.max(0, Math.floor(cameraX / TILE) - 1);
const endTX = Math.min(LEVEL_WIDTH, Math.ceil((cameraX + BASE_W) / TILE) + 1);

for (let ty = 0; ty < LEVEL_HEIGHT; ty++) {
for (let tx = startTX; tx < endTX; tx++) {
if (tiles[ty][tx] !== 0) {
drawTile(tx, ty, tiles[ty][tx]);
}
}
}

// Draw pipes
pipes.forEach(p => {
const x = p.x - cameraX;
if (x < -p.w || x > BASE_W) return;
// Pipe body
ctx.fillStyle = '#00A800';
ctx.fillRect(x + 4, p.y + p.h - 32, p.w - 8, 32);
ctx.fillStyle = '#00D800';
ctx.fillRect(x + 8, p.y + p.h - 32, p.w - 24, 32);
// Pipe top
ctx.fillStyle = '#00A800';
ctx.fillRect(x, p.y, p.w, 32);
ctx.fillStyle = '#00D800';
ctx.fillRect(x + 4, p.y + 4, p.w - 8, 24);
// Highlight
ctx.fillStyle = '#00FF00';
ctx.fillRect(x + 8, p.y + 6, 6, 20);
});

// Draw coins
coinItems.forEach(c => drawCoin(c));

// Draw mushrooms
mushrooms.forEach(m => drawMushroom(m));

// Draw flag pole
drawFlagPole();

// Draw enemies
enemies.forEach(e => drawEnemy(e));

// Draw Mario
drawMario();

// Draw particles
particles.forEach(p => {
ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
ctx.fillRect(p.x - cameraX, p.y, p.size, p.size);
});

// Draw floating texts
floatingTexts.forEach(t => {
ctx.fillStyle = '#FFF';
ctx.font = 'bold 14px Arial';
ctx.textAlign = 'center';
ctx.globalAlpha = t.life / 40;
ctx.fillText(t.text, t.x - cameraX, t.y);
ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
});

// HUD
drawHUD();

// Death overlay
if (mario.dead && deathTimer < 60) {
ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${deathTimer / 60 * 0.5})`;
ctx.fillRect(0, 0, BASE_W, BASE_H);
}
}

function gameLoop() {
update();
draw();
requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

gameLoop();
</script>

-- DataStore Funktionen
local function getPlayerData(player)
	local playerKey = "Player_" .. player.UserId
	local data
	local success, err = pcall(function()
		data = StellwerkDataStore:GetAsync(playerKey)
	end)

	if success and data then
		return data
	else
		return {
			Coins = 1000,
			OwnedStellwerke = {},
			StellwerkPositions = {}
		}
	end
end

local function savePlayerData(player, data)
	local playerKey = "Player_" .. player.UserId
	local success, err = pcall(function()
		StellwerkDataStore:SetAsync(playerKey, data)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("Fehler beim Speichern: " .. tostring(err))
	end
end

**Einrichtung in Roblox Studio:**

1. **ServerScriptService** → Erstelle ein Script und füge den gesamten Code ein
2. **ReplicatedStorage** → Ein RemoteEvent namens `StellwerkRemote` wird automatisch erstellt
3. Der **Sitz** wird automatisch als leuchtender Part im Workspace platziert
4. Wenn ein Spieler den Bereich berührt, erscheint das **Hauptmenü**
5. Klick auf **"Stellwerke"** → Liste mit allen Strecken
6. Klick auf **"Kaufen"** → Stellwerk wird als 3D-Modell mit Signallichtern erstellt

- 💰 Coins-System mit DataStore (wird gespeichert!)

	local nameTag = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

-- DataStore Funktionen
local function getPlayerData(player)
	local playerKey = "Player_" .. player.UserId
	local data
	local success, err = pcall(function()
		data = StellwerkDataStore:GetAsync(playerKey)
	end)

	if success and data then
		return data
	else
		return {
			Coins = 1000,
			OwnedStellwerke = {},
			StellwerkPositions = {}
		}
	end
end

local function savePlayerData(player, data)
	local playerKey = "Player_" .. player.UserId
	local success, err = pcall(function()
		StellwerkDataStore:SetAsync(playerKey, data)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("Fehler beim Speichern: " .. tostring(err))
	end
end

-- Helper
local function tableContains(tbl, value)
	for _, v in ipairs(tbl) do
		if v == value then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

// ============ UTILITY FUNCTIONS ============
function rand(min,max) { return Math.floor(Math.random()*(max-min+1))+min; }
function clamp(v,min,max) { return Math.max(min,Math.min(max,v)); }
function lerp(a,b,t) { return a+(b-a)*t; }
function easeOut(t) { return 1-Math.pow(1-t,3); }
function easeInOut(t) { return t<.5?2*t*t:1-Math.pow(-2*t+2,2)/2; }

function getCardStats(card) {
    let stats = {pac:card.pac,sho:card.sho,pas:card.pas,dri:card.dri,def:card.def,phy:card.phy};
    if (card.type === 'Tactics' || card.type === 'Reaction') {
        return stats;
    }
    return stats;
}

function getOverall(card) {
    if (card.type === 'Tactics' || card.type === 'Reaction') return 0;
    return Math.round((card.pac+card.sho+card.pas+card.dri+card.def+card.phy)/6);
}

function getCardColor(rarity) {
    switch(rarity) {
        case 'Special': return '#FFD700';
        case 'Gold': return '#FFD700';
        case 'Silver': return '#C0C0C0';
        case 'Bronze': return '#CD7F32';
        default: return '#888';
    }
}

// ============ DECK BUILDING ============
function buildDeck(rarity) {
    let pool = CARD_DB.filter(c => c.rarity === rarity && (c.type !== 'Tactics' && c.type !== 'Reaction'));
    let deck = [];
    let used = new Set();
    while(deck.length < 40 && used.size < pool.length) {
        let idx = rand(0, pool.length-1);
        if(!used.has(idx)) {
            used.add(idx);
            deck.push({...pool[idx], uid: Date.now()+Math.random()});
        }
    }
    return deck;
}

function buildAIDeck(archetype) {
    let deck = [];
    let pool = CARD_DB.filter(c => c.rarity !== 'Special' || c.id <= 12);
    let used = new Set();
    while(deck.length < 40 && used.size < pool.length) {
        let idx = rand(0, pool.length-1);
        if(!used.has(idx)) {
            used.add(idx);
            let card = {...pool[idx], uid: Date.now()+Math.random()};
            if(archetype === 'defensive' && (card.pos === 'ST' || card.pos === 'LW' || card.pos === 'RW')) {
                card.def = Math.min(99, card.def + 10);
            }
            if(archetype === 'aggressive' && (card.pos === 'ST' || card.pos === 'LW' || card.pos === 'RW')) {
                card.sho = Math.min(99, card.sho + 10);
                card.pac = Math.min(99, card.pac + 8);
            }
            deck.push(card);
        }
    }
    return deck;
}
