    let positions = ['GK','DEF','MID','ATT','ATT'];
    oppCards.forEach((c,i) => {
        game.opponentField[positions[i]] = c;
    });

    startTurn();
}

function startTurn() {
    game.turnTimer = 90;
    game.turnPhase = 'DRAW';
    game.placedThisTurn = 0;
    game.attackPhase = false;
    game.attackQueue = [];
    game.comboCount = 0;
    game.currentTurn = 'player';
    game.phaseText = 'YOUR TURN';
    game.phaseTimer = 60;
    game.turnIndicator = 'player';

    if(game.turnTimerInterval) clearInterval(game.turnTimerInterval);
    game.turnTimerInterval = setInterval(() => {
        game.turnTimer--;
        if(game.turnTimer <= 0) {
            endTurn();
        }
    }, 1000);

    // Draw a card if bench has space
    if(game.playerBench.length < 5 && game.playerHand.length < 10) {
        if(game.playerDeck.length > 0) {
            game.playerHand.push(game.playerDeck.pop());
        }
    }
}

function endTurn() {
    if(game.turnTimerInterval) clearInterval(game.turnTimerInterval);

    // Process attacks
    if(game.attackQueue.length > 0) {
        processAttacks();
    } else {
        finishRound();
    }
}

function processAttacks() {
    let nextAttack = game.attackQueue.shift();
    if(!nextAttack) { finishRound(); return; }

    let attacker = nextAttack.attacker;
    let zone = nextAttack.zone;
    let defender = game.opponentField[zone];

    game.combatAnim = {
        attacker: attacker,
        defender: defender,
        zone: zone,
        phase: 'resolve',
        timer: 0,
        result: null,
        progress: 0
    };

    game.state = 'COMBAT';
}

function resolveCombat(combat) {
    let atkStats = getCardStats(combat.attacker);
    let defStats = combat.defender ? getCardStats(combat.defender) : null;

    let atkPower = 0;
    let defPower = 0;

    if(combat.zone === 'ATT') {
        atkPower = atkStats.sho + atkStats.pac;
        if(defender) {
            defPower = defStats.def + defStats.phy;
        } else {
            defPower = 30; // No defender
        }
    } else if(combat.zone === 'MID') {
        atkPower = atkStats.pas + atkStats.dri;
        if(defender) {
            defPower = defStats.def + defStats.pac;
        } else {
            defPower = 30;
        }
    } else if(combat.zone === 'DEF') {
        atkPower = atkStats.pac + atkStats.dri;
        if(defender) {
            defPower = defStats.def + defStats.phy;
        } else {
            defPower = 30;
        }
    } else if(combat.zone === 'GK') {
        atkPower = atkStats.sho + atkStats.pac;
        if(defender) {
            defPower = defStats.def + 20;
        } else {
            defPower = 20;
        }
    }

    // Random factor
    atkPower += rand(-10, 10);
    defPower += rand(-10, 10);

    let result;
    if(atkPower > defPower) {
        if(combat.zone === 'GK') {
            result = 'GOAL';
            game.playerScore++;
            game.totalGoals++;
            game.streak++;
            if(game.streak > game.bestStreak) game.bestStreak = game.streak;
            game.comboCount++;
            addParticle(W/2, H*0.3, 'goal');
            game.shakeTimer = 20;
            game.shakeIntensity = 8;
            game.flashTimer = 15;
            game.flashColor = 'rgba(255,255,0,0.3)';
            game.goalAnim = 90;
            game.goalTeam = 'player';
        } else {
            result = 'WIN';
            game.streak++;
            if(game.streak > game.bestStreak) game.bestStreak = game.streak;
            game.comboCount++;
            addParticle(W/2, H*0.4, 'win');
        }
    } else if(atkPower < defPower) {
        result = 'LOSE';
        game.streak = 0;
        game.comboCount = 0;
        addParticle(W/2, H*0.4, 'lose');
        game.shakeTimer = 10;
        game.shakeIntensity = 4;
    } else {
        result = 'DRAW';
        game.streak = 0;
    }

    combat.result = result;
    combat.progress = 1;

    // Remove attacker from field
    game.playerField[combat.zone] = null;

    setTimeout(() => {
        if(game.attackQueue.length > 0) {
            processAttacks();
        } else {
            finishRound();
        }
    }, 800);
}

function finishRound() {
    game.round++;
    if(game.round > game.maxRounds) {
        endMatch();
        return;
    }

    // Draw new cards
    if(game.playerDeck.length > 0 && game.playerHand.length < 7) {
        game.playerHand.push(game.player.deck.pop());
    }

    // AI turn
    game.currentTurn = 'opponent';
    game.turnIndicator = 'opponent';
    game.phaseText = 'OPPONENT\'S TURN';
    game.phaseTimer = 60;

    setTimeout(() => {
        aiPlayTurn();
    }, 1000);
}

function aiPlayTurn() {
    let field = game.opponentField;
    let hand = game.opponentHand;

    // AI decides which card to attack with
    let bestCard = null;
    let bestZone = null;
    let bestScore = -999;

    for(let i=0; i<hand.length; i++) {
        let card = hand[i];
        let pos = card.pos;
        for(let z of ZONES) {
            let score = 0;
            if(POS_MAP[z] && POS_MAP[z].includes(pos)) {
                let def = field[z];
                if(!def) {
                    score = 100; // Free attack
                } else {
                    let atk = getCardStats(card);
                    let defS = getCardStats(def);
                    if(z === 'ATT') score = atk.sho + atk.pac - (defS.def + defS.phy);
                    else if(z === 'MID') score = atk.pas + atk.dri - (defS.def + defS.pac);
                    else if(z === 'DEF') score = atk.pac + atk.dri - (defS.def + defS.phy);
                    else if(z === 'GK') score = atk.sho + atk.pac - (defS.def + 20);
                }
                // AI archetype bonuses
                if(game.aiArchetype === 'aggressive' && z === 'ATT') score += 10;
                if(game.aiArchetype === 'defensive' && z === 'DEF') score += 10;
            }
            if(score > bestScore) {
                bestScore = score;
                bestCard = card;
                bestZone = z;
            }
        }
    }

    if(bestCard) {
        hand.splice(hand.indexOf(bestCard), 1);
        field[bestZone] = bestCard;
        game.opponentHand.push(bestCard);
        game.opponentHand = game.opponentHand.filter(c => c !== bestCard);
        game.opponentHand.push(bestCard); // Put back in hand for attack

        // Actually place on field
        field[bestZone] = bestCard;

        // Attack if player has a card in that zone
        let playerCard = game.playerField[bestZone];
        if(playerCard) {
            game.attackQueue.push({attacker: bestCard, zone: bestZone});
        }
    }

    // Process AI attacks
    if(game.attackQueue.length > 0) {
        // Swap queue for AI
        let aiAttacks = game.attackQueue;
        game.attackQueue = [];
        game.state = 'COMBAT';

        let processAIAttack = () => {
            let attack = aiAttacks.shift();
            if(!attack) {
                // AI turn done, player's turn
                game.currentTurn = 'player';
                game.turnIndicator = 'player';
                game.phaseText = 'YOUR TURN';
                game.phaseTimer = 60;
                game.turnTimer = 90;
                game.turnPhase = 'DRAW';
                game.placedThisTurn = 0;
                game.attackPhase = false;
                game.attackQueue = [];

                if(game.turnTimerInterval) clearInterval(game.turnTimerInterval);
                game.turnTimerInterval = setInterval(() => {
                    game.turnTimer--;
                    if(game.turnTimer <= 0) {
                        endTurn();
                    }
                }, 1000);

                if(game.playerDeck.length > 0 && game.playerHand.length < 10) {
                    game.playerHand.push(game.playerDeck.pop());
                }
                return;
            }

            let defender = game.playerField[attack.zone];
            let atkStats = getCardStats(attack.attacker);
            let defStats = defender ? getCardStats(defender) : null;

            let atkPower = 0, defPower = 0;
            if(attack.zone === 'ATT') {
                atkPower = atkStats.sho + atkStats.pac + rand(-10,10);
                defPower = defender ? (defStats.def + defStats.phy + rand(-10,10)) : (30 + rand(-10,10));
            } else if(attack.zone === 'MID') {
                atkPower = atkStats.pas + atkStats.dri + rand(-10,10);
                defPower = defender ? (defStats.def + defStats.pac + rand(-10,10)) : (30 + rand(-10,10));
            } else if(attack.zone === 'DEF') {
                atkPower = atkStats.pac + atkStats.dri + rand(-10,10);
                defPower = defender ? (defStats.def + defStats.phy + rand(-10,10)) : (30 + rand(-10,10));
            } else if(attack.zone === 'GK') {
                atkPower = atkStats.sho + atkStats.pac + rand(-10,10);
                defPower = defender ? (defStats.def + 20 + rand(-10,10)) : (20 + rand(-10,10));
            }

            let result;
            if(atkPower > defPower) {
                if(attack.zone === 'GK') {
                    result = 'GOAL';
                    game.opponentScore++;
                    game.totalConceded++;
                    game.streak = 0;
                    game.comboCount = 0;
                    game.shakeTimer = 20;
                    game.shakeIntensity = 8;
                    game.flashTimer = 15;
                    game.flashColor = 'rgba(255,0,0,0.3)';
                    game.goalAnim = 90;
                    game.goalTeam = 'opponent';
                } else {
                    result = 'WIN';
                }
            } else {
                result = 'LOSE';
            }

            game.opponentField[attack.zone] = null;
            game.opponentHand.push(attack.attacker);

            setTimeout(processAIAttack, 800);
        };

        processAIAttack();
    } else {
        // AI did nothing, player's turn
        game.currentTurn = 'player';
        game.turnIndicator = 'player';
        game.phaseText = 'YOUR TURN';
        game.phaseTimer = 60;
        game.turnTimer = 90;
        game.turnPhase = 'DRAW';
        game.placedThisTurn = 0;
        game.attackPhase = false;
        game.attackQueue = [];

        if(game.turnTimerInterval) clearInterval(game.turnTimerInterval);
        game.turnTimerInterval = setInterval(() => {
            game.turnTimer--;
            if(game.turnTimer <= 0) {
                endTurn();
            }
        }, 1000);

        if(game.playerDeck.length > 0 && game.playerHand.length < 10) {
            game.playerHand.push(game.playerDeck.pop());
        }
    }
}

function endMatch() {
    if(game.turnTimerInterval) clearInterval(game.turnTimerInterval);

    let won = game.playerScore > game.opponentScore;
    let drew = game.playerScore === game.opponentScore;

    if(won) {
        game.wins++;
        game.coins += 100 + game.round * 50;
        game.energy = Math.max(0, game.energy - 1);
        if(game.rank < 9) game.rank++;
        addNotification('VICTORY! +' + (100 + game.round * 50) + ' coins', '#4CAF50');
    } else if(drew) {
        game.draws++;
        game.coins += 50;
        game.energy = Math.max(0, game.energy - 1);
        addNotification('DRAW! +50 coins', '#FF9800');
    } else {
        game.losses++;
        game.coins += 25;
        game.energy = Math.max(0, game.energy - 1);
        if(game.rank > 0) game.rank--;
        addNotification('DEFEAT', '#F44336');
    }

    game.matchHistory.unshift({
        result: won ? 'W' : drew ? 'D' : 'L',
        score: game.playerScore + '-' + game.opponentScore,
        round: game.round,
        date: Date.now()
    });

    game.state = 'GAME_OVER';
}

// ============ DRAFT MODE ============
function initDraft() {
    game.draftWins = 0;
    game.draftLosses = 0;
    game.draftCards = [];
    game.draftPicks = [];
    game.draftRound = 0;
    game.state = 'DRAFT';
    game.draftPool = [];

    // Generate draft pool
    let pool = CARD_DB.filter(c => c.type !== 'Tactics' && c.type !== 'Reaction');
    for(let i=0; i<30; i++) {
        let card = {...pool[rand(0, pool.length-1)], uid: Date.now()+Math.random()};
        game.draftPool.push(card);
    }

    showDraftRound();
}

function showDraftRound() {
    game.draftRound++;
    game.draftChoices = [];

    // Pick 4 cards from remaining pool
    let available = game.draftPool.filter(c => !game.draftCards.includes(c));
    if(available.length < 4) {
        endDraft();
        return;
    }

    // Shuffle and pick 4
    for(let i=available.length-1; i>0; i--) {
        let j = rand(0, i);
        [available[i], available[j]] = [available[j], available[i]];
    }
    game.draftChoices = available.slice(0, 4);
}

function draftPick(card) {
    game.draftCards.push(card);
    game.draftPool = game.draftPool.filter(c => c !== card);
    game.selectedDraftCard = null;

    if(game.draftCards.length >= 11) {
        // Draft complete, play match
        startDraftMatch();
    } else {
        showDraftRound();
    }
}

function startDraftMatch() {
    game.draftWins = 0;
    game.draftLosses = 0;
    game.state = 'DRAFT_MATCH';

    // Build draft deck
    game.playerDeck = game.draftCards.slice();
    game.opponentDeck = buildAIDeck('balanced');
    game.playerField = {GK:null,DEF:null,MID:null,ATT:null,ATT:null};
    game.opponentField = {GK:null,DEF:null,MID:null,ATT:null,ATT:null};
    game.playerHand = [];
    game.opponentHand = [];
    game.playerBench = [];
    game.opponentBench = [];
    game.playerScore = 0;
    game.opponentScore = 0;
    game.round = 1;
    game.maxRounds = 3;
    game.turnTimer = 90;
    game.currentTurn = 'player';
    game.turnPhase = 'DRAW';
    game.placedThisTurn = 0;
    game.attackPhase = false;
    game.attackQueue = [];
    game.comboCount = 0;
    game.streak = 0;
    game.phaseTimer = 0;

    for(let i=0;i<7;i++) {
        if(game.playerDeck.length>0) game.playerHand.push(game.playerDeck.pop());
        if(game.opponentDeck.length>0) game.opponentHand.push(game.opponentDeck.pop());
    }

    let oppCards = game.opponentDeck.splice(0, 5);
    let positions = ['GK','DEF','MID','ATT','ATT'];
    oppCards.forEach((c,i) => { game.opponentField[positions[i]] = c; });

    startTurn();
}

function endDraftMatch() {
    if(game.turnTimerInterval) clearInterval(game.turnTimerInterval);

    let won = game.playerScore > game.opponentScore;
    if(won) game.draftWins++;
    else game.draftLosses++;

    if(game.draftWins >= 4) {
        game.coins += 500;
        game.gems += 50;
        addNotification('DRAFT CHAMPION! +500 coins, +50 gems', '#FFD700');
        game.state = 'MENU';
    } else if(game.draftLosses >= 2) {
        game.coins += 100;
        addNotification('DRAFT ELIMINATED. +100 coins', '#F44336');
        game.state = 'MENU';
    } else {
        // Continue draft
        game.draftCards = [];
        game.draftPool = [];
        let pool = CARD_DB.filter(c => c.type !== 'Tactics' && c.type !== 'Reaction');
        for(let i=0; i<30; i++) {
            game.draftPool.push({...pool[rand(0, pool.length-1)], uid: Date.now()+Math.random()});
        }
        showDraftRound();
    }
}

// ============ ENERGY SYSTEM ============
function updateEnergy() {
    let now = Date.now();
    let elapsed = (now - game.lastEnergyUpdate) / 1000;
    let regen = Math.floor(elapsed / 600); // 1 per 10 minutes
    if(regen > 0) {
        game.energy = Math.min(game.maxEnergy, game.energy + regen);
        game.lastEnergyUpdate = now;
    }
}

// ============ UI RENDERING ============
function drawRoundedRect(x,y,w,h,r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
    ctx.lineTo(x+w-r,y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+r);
    ctx.lineTo(x+w,y+h-r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y+h,x+w-r,y+h);
    ctx.lineTo(x+r,y+h);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y+h,x,y+h-r);
    ctx.lineTo(x,y+r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y,x+r,y);
    ctx.closePath();
}

function drawCard(card, x, y, w, h, scale=1, selected=false, highlight=false) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.scale(scale, scale);

    let cw = w, ch = h;

    // Shadow
    ctx.shadowColor = selected ? '#FFD700' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = selected ? 20 : 8;
    ctx.shadowOffsetX = 0;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = selected ? 0 : 4;

    // Card background
    let bg = getCardBg(card.rarity);
    ctx.fillStyle = bg;
    drawRoundedRect(0, 0, cw, ch, 8);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';

    // Border
    let borderColor = getCardColor(card.rarity);
    ctx.strokeStyle = borderColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = selected ? 3 : 2;
    drawRoundedRect(0, 0, cw, ch, 8);
    ctx.stroke();

    if(highlight) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.setLineDash([4,4]);
        drawRoundedRect(2, 2, cw-4, ch-4, 6);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.setLineDash([]);
    }

    // Header
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    drawRoundedRect(4, 4, cw-8, 22, 4);
    ctx.fill();

    // Overall rating
    let ov = getOverall(card);
    if(ov > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.font = 'bold 14px Arial';
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        ctx.fillText(ov, 10, 20);
    }

    // Name
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 11px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(card.name, cw/2, 20);

    // Position badge
    let posColor = getPosColor(card.pos);
    ctx.fillStyle = posColor;
    ctx.font = 'bold 10px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText(card.pos, cw-10, 20);

    // Type indicator
    if(card.type === 'Tactics') {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#9C27B0';
        ctx.font = 'bold 9px Arial';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText('TACTICS', cw/2, 38);
    } else if(card.type === 'Reaction') {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#E91E63';
        ctx.font = 'bold 9px Arial';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText('REACTION', cw/2, 38);
    }

    // Player image area (simplified)
    let imgY = card.type === 'Tactics' || card.type === 'Reaction' ? 28 : 40;
    let imgH = card.type === 'Tactics' || card.type === 'Reaction' ? 50 : 38;

    // Player silhouette
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cw/2, imgY + imgH*0.35, 14, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cw/2, imgY + imgH*0.85, 16, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Stats
    if(card.type !== 'Tactics' && card.type !== 'Reaction') {
        let stats = [
            {label:'PAC', val:card.pac, y:imgY+imgH+8},
            {label:'SHO', val:card.sho, y:imgY+imgH+20},
            {label:'PAS', val:card.pas, y:imgY+imgH+32},
            {label:'DRI', val:card.dri, y:imgY+imgH+44},
            {label:'DEF', val:card.def, y:imgY+imgH+56},
            {label:'PHY', val:card.phy, y:imgY+imgH+68}
        ];

        stats.forEach(s => {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
            ctx.fillRect(6, s.y, cw-12, 10);

            // Stat bar
            let barW = (s.val/99) * (cw-16);
            let barColor = s.val >= 85 ? '#4CAF50' : s.val >= 70 ? '#FF9800' : s.val >= 55 ? '#FFC107' : '#F44336';
            ctx.fillStyle = barColor;
            ctx.fillRect(8, s.y+1, barW, 8);

            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = 'bold 7px Arial';
            ctx.textAlign = 'left';
            ctx.fillText(s.label, 10, s.y+8);
            ctx.textAlign = 'right';
            ctx.fillText(s.val, cw-10, s.y+8);
        });
    } else if(card.type === 'Tactics' || card.type === 'Reaction') {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.font = 'bold 10px Arial';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        let bonusText = card.bonusVal ? '+' + card.bonusVal + ' ' + card.bonus.toUpperCase() : '';
        ctx.fillText(bonusText, cw/2, imgY + imgH/2 + 5);
    }

    // Stars
    if(card.stars > 0) {
        for(let i=0; i<card.stars; i++) {
            let sx = cw/2 - (card.stars-1)*6 + i*12;
            let sy = ch - 10;
            ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
            ctx.font = '10px Arial';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('★', sx, sy);
        }
    }

    // Rarity label
    ctx.fillStyle = borderColor;
    ctx.font = 'bold 7px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(card.rarity.toUpperCase(), cw/2, ch - 2);

    ctx.restore();
}

function drawButton(x, y, w, h, text, color='#2196F3', textColor='#fff', fontSize=14) {
    ctx.save();
    let isHovered = game.hoveredBtn && game.hoveredBtn.x === x && game.hoveredBtn.y === y;

    // Shadow
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 2;

    let bgColor = isHovered ? lightenColor(color, 30) : color;
    ctx.fillStyle = bgColor;
    drawRoundedRect(x, y, w, h, 8);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';

    // Border
    ctx.strokeStyle = isHovered ? '#fff' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    drawRoundedRect(x, y, w, h, 8);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
    ctx.font = `bold ${fontSize}px Arial`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(text, x + w/2, y + h/2);

    ctx.restore();
}

function lightenColor(hex, amount) {
    let r = parseInt(hex.slice(1,3),16);
    let g = parseInt(hex.slice(3,5),16);
    let b = parseInt(hex.slice(5,7),16);
    r = Math.min(255, r+amount);
    g = Math.min(255, g+amount);
    b = Math.min(255, b+amount);
    return `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
}

function drawField() {
    let fieldX = 30, fieldY = 120, fieldW = W - 60, fieldH = 340;

    // Field background
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a472a';
    drawRoundedRect(fieldX, fieldY, fieldW, fieldH, 12);
    ctx.fill();

    // Field pattern
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)';
    for(let i=0; i<fieldW; i+=40) {
        ctx.fillRect(fieldX+i, fieldY, 20, fieldH);
    }

    // Field lines
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(fieldX, fieldY, fieldW, fieldH);

    // Center line
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(fieldX, fieldY + fieldH/2);
    ctx.lineTo(fieldX + fieldW, fieldY + fieldH/2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Center circle
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(fieldX + fieldW/2, fieldY + fieldH/2, 30, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Zones
    let zoneH = fieldH / 5;
    let zoneLabels = ['OPPONENT', '', '', '', 'YOUR FIELD'];

    for(let i=0; i<5; i++) {
        let zy = fieldY + i * zoneH;
        let isPlayerZone = i >= 3;

        // Zone background
        ctx.fillStyle = isPlayerZone ? 'rgba(33,150,243,0.15)' : 'rgba(244,67,54,0.15)';
        ctx.fillRect(fieldX, zy, fieldW, zoneH);

        // Zone label
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
        ctx.font = '9px Arial';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(ZONES[i], fieldX + fieldW/2, zy + 12);

        // Zone card slot
        let cardX = fieldX + fieldW/2 - 35;
        let cardY = zy + zoneH/2 - 40;
        let cardW = 70, cardH = 80;

        let playerCard = game.playerField[ZONES[i]];
        let opponentCard = game.opponentField[ZONES[i]];

        if(playerCard) {
            drawCard(playerCard, cardX, cardY, cardW, cardH, 0.7, false, false);
        } else if(opponentCard) {
            drawCard(opponentCard, cardX, cardY, cardW, cardH, 0.7, false, false);
        } else {
            // Empty slot
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.setLineDash([4,4]);
            drawRoundedRect(cardX, cardY, cardW, cardH, 8);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]);

            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
            ctx.font = '10px Arial';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('Empty', cardX + cardW/2, cardY + cardH/2 + 4);
        }
    }

    // Score display
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    drawRoundedRect(W/2 - 60, fieldY - 30, 120, 30, 8);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#F44336';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText(game.opponentScore, W/2 - 15, fieldY - 10);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 14px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('-', W/2, fieldY - 10);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#2196F3';
    ctx.font = 'bold 16px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(game.playerScore, W/2 + 15, fieldY - 10);

    // Round indicator
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    drawRoundedRect(W/2 - 40, fieldY + fieldH + 8, 80, 20, 6);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 10px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Round ' + game.round + '/' + game.maxRounds, W/2, fieldY + fieldH + 22);
}

function drawHand() {
    let handY = H - 130;
    let cardW = 65, cardH = 85;
    let totalW = game.playerHand.length * (cardW + 8);
    let startX = clamp((W - totalW) / 2, 10, W - totalW - 10);

    // Hand background
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    drawRoundedRect(10, handY - 5, W - 20, cardH + 35, 12);
    ctx.fill();

    // Label
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.font = '10px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('HAND (' + game.playerHand.length + ')', 20, handY + 8);

    game.hoveredCard = null;

    game.playerHand.forEach((card, i) => {
        let cx = startX + i * (cardW + 8);
        let cy = handY + 15;
        let isSelected = game.selectedCard === card;
        let isHovered = game.lastTap.x >= cx && game.lastTap.x <= cx + cardW &&
                        game.lastTap.y >= cy && game.lastTap.y <= cy + cardH;

        if(isHovered) game.hoveredCard = card;

        drawCard(card, cx, cy, cardW, cardH, 0.85, isSelected, false);

        // Card index
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
        ctx.font = '8px Arial';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(i+1, cx + cardW/2, cy + cardH + 12);
    });

    // Bench
    let benchY = handY + cardH + 25;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
    ctx.font = '9px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('BENCH: ' + game.playerBench.length + '/5', 20, benchY + 5);

    // Energy bar
    let energyX = W - 100, energyY = benchY;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    drawRoundedRect(energyX, energyY, 90, 16, 6);
    ctx.fill();

    let energyW = (game.energy / game.maxEnergy) * 86;
    ctx.fillStyle = game.energy > 3 ? '#4CAF50' : '#F44336';
    drawRoundedRect(energyX + 2, energyY + 2, energyW, 12, 4);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 9px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('⚡ ' + game.energy + '/' + game.maxEnergy, energyX + 45, energyY + 11);

    // Coins
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
    ctx.font = 'bold 10px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('🪙 ' + game.coins, energyX, benchY + 28);
}

function drawParticles() {
    game.particles.forEach((p, i) => {
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;
        p.vy += 0.1;
        p.life -= 0.02;

        if(p.life > 0) {
            ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
            if(p.type === 'goal') {
                ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
                ctx.font = p.size * 3 + 'px Arial';
                ctx.fillText('⚽', p.x, p.y);
            } else if(p.type === 'win') {
                ctx.fillStyle = '#4CAF50';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI*2);
                ctx.fill();
            } else if(p.type === 'lose') {
                ctx.fillStyle = '#F44336';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI*2);
                ctx.fill();
            }
            ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        }
    });
    game.particles = game.particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);
}

function drawNotifications() {
    game.notifications.forEach((n, i) => {
        n.y -= 0.5;
        n.life--;
        if(n.life < 30) n.alpha = n.life / 30;

        ctx.globalAlpha = n.alpha;
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
        drawRoundedRect(W/2 - 120, n.y - 15, 240, 30, 8);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = n.color;
        ctx.font = 'bold 12px Arial';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(n.text, W/2, n.y + 3);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    });
    game.notifications = game.notifications.filter(n => n.life > 0);
}

        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(33,150,243,${0.02 + Math.sin(game.animFrame*0.02+i)*0.01})`;
        ctx.fillRect(
            Math.sin(game.animFrame*0.01+i*0.5)*W/2 + W/2,
            Math.cos(game.animFrame*0.008+i*0.3)*H/2 + H/2,
            3, 3
        );
    }

    // Logo
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
    ctx.font = 'bold 36px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('⚽ FIFA CARD', W/2, 120);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillText('DUEL', W/2, 160);

    // Subtitle
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.font = '12px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Build Your Dream Team', W/2, 185);

    // Menu tabs
    let tabs = ['PLAY', 'DECK', 'DRAFT', 'SHOP', 'PROFILE'];
    let tabW = W / tabs.length;

    tabs.forEach((tab, i) => {
        let tx = i * tabW;
        let isActive = game.menuTab === i;

            drawRoundedRect(tx, 200, tabW, 35, 8);

        ctx.font = 'bold 12px Arial';

        ctx.fillText(tab, tx + tabW/2, 222);

    // Tab content
    switch(game.menuTab) {

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Attacker card

    ctx.font = 'bold 28px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('VS', W/2, H/2);

    let defY = H/2 - 60;

        drawCard(combat.defender, defX, defY, 100, 130, 1, false, false);

        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(combat.result, W/2, H/2 + 100);

        if(combat.result === 'GOAL') {

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
    ctx.font = '11px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Attacking: ' + combat.zone + ' zone', W/2, H/2 - 90);
}

function drawGameOver() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.85)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    let won = game.playerScore > game.opponentScore;
    let drew = game.playerScore === game.opponentScore;

    // Result banner
    let bannerColor = won ? '#4CAF50' : drew ? '#FF9800' : '#F44336';
    ctx.fillStyle = bannerColor;
    drawRoundedRect(W/2 - 120, 150, 240, 60, 12);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 28px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(won ? 'VICTORY!' : drew ? 'DRAW' : 'DEFEAT', W/2, 190);

    // Score
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Arial';
    ctx.fillText(game.playerScore + ' - ' + game.opponentScore, W/2, 280);

    // Stats
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
    ctx.font = '12px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Rounds played: ' + (game.round - 1), W/2, 330);
    ctx.fillText('Best streak: ' + game.bestStreak, W/2, 350);
    ctx.fillText('Combos: ' + game.comboCount, W/2, 370);

    // Rewards
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
    ctx.font = 'bold 14px Arial';
    let reward = won ? 100 + game.round * 50 : drew ? 50 : 25;
    ctx.fillText('+ ' + reward + ' coins', W/2, 420);

    // Buttons
    drawButton(W/2 - 100, 460, 200, 45, '🏠 Menu', '#2196F3', '#fff', 14);
    drawButton(W/2 - 100, 515, 200, 45, '🔄 Play Again', '#4CAF50', '#fff', 14);

    // Match history
    if(game.matchHistory.length > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
        ctx.font = '10px Arial';
        ctx.fillText('Recent: ' + game.matchHistory.slice(0,5).map(m => m.result).join(' '), W/2, 580);
    }
}

function drawDraftScreen() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0a1a';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#FF9800';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('🎯 DRAFT - Pick ' + (11 - game.draftCards.length) + ' more', W/2, 40);

    // Round info
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.font = '12px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('Round ' + game.draftRound, W/2, 65);

    // Choices
    if(game.draftChoices.length > 0) {
        let cardW = 85, cardH = 110;
        let totalW = game.draftChoices.length * (cardW + 15);
        let startX = (W - totalW) / 2;

        game.draftChoices.forEach((card, i) => {
            let cx = startX + i * (cardW + 15);
            let cy = 90;
            drawCard(card, cx, cy, cardW, cardH, 1, false, false);

            // Tap area
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(33,150,243,0.3)';
            drawRoundedRect(cx, cy + cardH + 5, cardW, 30, 6);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = 'bold 10px Arial';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('PICK', cx + cardW/2, cy + cardH + 24);
        });
    }

    // Drafted cards
    if(game.draftCards.length > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
        ctx.font = '11px Arial';
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        ctx.fillText('Drafted (' + game.draftCards.length + '/11):', 20, 250);

        let startX = 20;
        game.draftCards.forEach((card, i) => {
            drawCard(card, startX, 260, 50, 65, 0.5, false, false);
            startX += 55;
        });
    }
}

function drawDraftMatchUI() {
    // Override top bar
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)';
    drawRoundedRect(0, 0, W, 50, 0);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#FF9800';
    ctx.font = 'bold 14px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('DRAFT MATCH', W/2, 20);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#4CAF50';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('W:' + game.draftWins, 15, 38);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#F44336';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('L:' + game.draftLosses, W - 15, 38);

    // Timer
    ctx.fillStyle = game.turnTimer > 30 ? '#4CAF50' : game.turnTimer > 10 ? '#FF9800' : '#F44336';
    ctx.font = 'bold 12px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('⏱ ' + game.turnTimer + 's', W/2, 42);
}

// ============ INPUT HANDLING ============
function getCanvasPos(e) {
    let rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    let scaleX = W / rect.width;
    let scaleY = H / rect.height;
    let clientX, clientY;
    if(e.touches) {
        clientX = e.touches[0].clientX;
        clientY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    } else {
        clientX = e.clientX;
        clientY = e.clientY;
    }
    return {
        x: (clientX - rect.left) * scaleX,
        y: (clientY - rect.top) * scaleY
    };
}

function handleTap(pos) {
    game.lastTap = pos;

    if(game.state === 'MENU') {
        handleMenuTap(pos);
    } else if(game.state === 'PLAYING' || game.state === 'COMBAT') {
        handleGameTap(pos);
    } else if(game.state === 'GAME_OVER') {
        handleGameOverTap(pos);
    } else if(game.state === 'DRAFT') {
        handleDraftTap(pos);
    } else if(game.state === 'DRAFT_MATCH') {
        handleGameTap(pos);
    }
}

function handleMenuTap(pos) {
    // Tabs
    let tabs = ['PLAY', 'DECK', 'DRAFT', 'SHOP', 'PROFILE'];
    let tabW = W / tabs.length;
    for(let i=0; i<5; i++) {
        if(pos.x >= i*tabW && pos.x <= (i+1)*tabW && pos.y >= 200 && pos.y <= 235) {
            game.menuTab = i;
            return;
        }
    }

    let startY = 260;

    if(game.menuTab === 0) {
        // Quick Match
        if(pos.x >= W/2-120 && pos.x <= W/2+120 && pos.y >= startY && pos.y <= startY+50) {
            if(game.energy > 0) {
                game.mode = 'quick';
                game.energy--;
                game.state = 'PLAYING';
                game.aiArchetype = ['defensive','balanced','aggressive'][
                    ['Quick Match','Ranked','Draft'].indexOf('Quick Match')
                ];
                initMatch();
            } else {
                addNotification('No energy! Wait for regen.', '#F44336');
            }
            return;
        }
        // Ranked
        if(pos.x >= W/2-120 && pos.x <= W/2+120 && pos.y >= startY+80 && pos.y <= startY+130) {
            if(game.energy > 0) {
                game.mode = 'ranked';
                game.energy--;
                game.state = 'PLAYING';
                game.aiArchetype = ['defensive','balanced','aggressive'][rand(0,2)];
                game.rankName = 'Division ' + (10 - game.rank);
                initMatch();
            } else {
                addNotification('No energy! Wait for regen.', '#F44336');
            }
            return;
        }
        // Archetype buttons
        let archetypes = ['defensive','balanced','aggressive'];
        archetypes.forEach((a, i) => {
            let ax = W/2 - 100 + i * 100;
            if(pos.x >= ax-40 && pos.x <= ax+40 && pos.y >= startY+190 && pos.y <= startY+230) {
                game.aiArchetype = a;
            }
        });
    } else if(game.menuTab === 1) {
        // View All Cards
        if(pos.x >= W/2-100 && pos.x <= W/2+100 && pos.y >= startY+230 && pos.y <= startY+270) {
            game.showCardList = !game.showCardList;
            return;
        }
        // Build Random Deck
        if(pos.x >= W/2-100 && pos.x <= W/2+100 && pos.y >= startY+180 && pos.y <= startY+220) {
            game.playerDeck = buildDeck();
            addNotification('Deck built! 40 cards ready.', '#4CAF50');
            return;
        }
        // Card detail
        if(game.cardDetail) {
            if(pos.x >= W/2-60 && pos.x <= W/2+60 && pos.y >= H-80 && pos.y <= H-45) {
                game.cardDetail = null;
            }
            return;
        }
    } else if(game.menuTab === 2) {
        // Start Draft
        if(pos.x >= W/2-100 && pos.x <= W/2+100 && pos.y >= startY+30 && pos.y <= startY+80) {
            if(game.energy > 0) {
                game.energy--;
                initDraft();
            } else {
                addNotification('No energy!', '#F44336');
            }
            return;
        }
    } else if(game.menuTab === 3) {
        // Shop items
        let gy = startY + 50;
        for(let i=0; i<4; i++) {
            if(pos.x >= W/2-100 && pos.x <= W/2+100 && pos.y >= gy+i*55 && pos.y <= gy+i*55+45) {
                let gems = [100,500,1200,3000][i];
                addNotification('Gems purchased! (Demo mode)', '#FFD700');
                return;
            }
        }
        // Energy refill
        if(pos.x >= W/2-100 && pos.x <= W/2+100 && pos.y >= startY+270 && pos.y <= startY+315) {
            game.energy = game.maxEnergy;
            addNotification('Energy refilled!', '#4CAF50');
            return;
        }
        // Card packs
        if(pos.x >= W/2-100 && pos.x <= W/2+100 && pos.y >= startY+325 && pos.y <= startY+370) {
            addNotification('Bronze Pack opened! (Demo)', '#CD7F32');
            return;
        }
        if(pos.x >= W/2-100 && pos.x <= W/2+100 && pos.y >= startY+375 && pos.y <= startY+420) {
            addNotification('Silver Pack opened! (Demo)', '#C0C0C0');
            return;
        }
        if(pos.x >= W/2-100 && pos.x <= W/2+100 && pos.y >= startY+425 && pos.y <= startY+470) {
            addNotification('Gold Pack opened! (Demo)', '#FFD700');
            return;
        }
    } else if(game.menuTab === 4) {
        // Settings
        if(pos.x >= W/2-100 && pos.x <= W/2+100 && pos.y >= startY+350 && pos.y <= startY+390) {
            game.settingsOpen = !game.settingsOpen;
            return;
        }
        // Reset
        if(pos.x >= W/2-100 && pos.x <= W/2+100 && pos.y >= startY+400 && pos.y <= startY+440) {
            game.wins = 0; game.losses = 0; game.draws = 0;
            game.rank = 0; game.coins = 5000; game.gems = 100;
            addNotification('Progress reset!', '#F44336');
            return;
        }
    }
}

function handleGameTap(pos) {
    if(game.state === 'COMBAT') return;

    // Check if tapping on hand
    let handY = H - 130;
    let cardW = 65, cardH = 85;
    let totalW = game.playerHand.length * (cardW + 8);
    let startX = clamp((W - totalW) / 2, 10, W - totalW - 10);

    for(let i=0; i<game.playerHand.length; i++) {
        let cx = startX + i * (cardW + 8);
        let cy = handY + 15;
        if(pos.x >= cx && pos.x <= cx + cardW && pos.y >= cy && pos.y <= cy + cardH) {
            if(game.selectedCard === game.playerHand[i]) {
                game.selectedCard = null;
                game.selectedZone = null;
            } else {
                game.selectedCard = game.playerHand[i];
                game.selectedZone = null;
            }
            return;
        }
    }

    // Check if tapping on field zones
    let fieldX = 30, fieldY = 120, fieldW = W - 60, fieldH = 340;
    let zoneH = fieldH / 5;

    for(let i=0; i<5; i++) {
        let zy = fieldY + i * zoneH;
        if(pos.x >= fieldX && pos.x <= fieldX + fieldW && pos.y >= zy && pos.y <= zy + zoneH) {
            if(game.selectedCard && game.currentTurn === 'player') {
                let card = game.selectedCard;
                let zone = ZONES[i];

                // Check if card can go in this zone
                let canPlace = true;
                if(card.type !== 'Tactics' && card.type !== 'Reaction') {
                    if(!POS_MAP[zone] || !POS_MAP[zone].includes(card.pos)) {
                        canPlace = false;
                        addNotification('Position mismatch!', '#F44336');
                    }
                }

                if(canPlace && !game.playerField[zone]) {
                    game.playerField[zone] = card;
                    game.playerHand = game.playerHand.filter(c => c !== card);
                    game.selectedCard = null;
                    game.placedThisTurn++;
                    addNotification('Placed ' + card.name + ' in ' + zone, '#4CAF50');
                    addParticle(pos.x, pos.y, 'win');
                } else if(game.playerField[zone]) {
                    addNotification('Zone occupied!', '#F44336');
                }
            }
            return;
        }
    }

    // End turn button (if cards placed)
    if(game.placedThisTurn > 0 && game.selectedCard === null) {
        // Auto-attack if player has cards on field
        game.attackPhase = true;
        game.attackQueue = [];

        for(let zone of ZONES) {
            if(game.playerField[zone]) {
                game.attackQueue.push({attacker: game.playerField[zone], zone: zone});
            }
        }

        if(game.attackQueue.length > 0) {
            processAttacks();
        } else {
            finishRound();
        }
    }
}

function handleGameOverTap(pos) {
    // Menu button
    if(pos.x >= W/2-100 && pos.x <= W/2+100 && pos.y >= 460 && pos.y <= 505) {
        game.state = 'MENU';
        return;
    }
    // Play again
    if(pos.x >= W/2-100 && pos.x <= W/2+100 && pos.y >= 515 && pos.y <= 560) {
        if(game.energy > 0) {
            game.energy--;
            game.state = 'PLAYING';
            initMatch();
        } else {
            addNotification('No energy!', '#F44336');
        }
        return;
    }
}

function handleDraftTap(pos) {
    if(!game.draftChoices.length) return;

    let cardW = 85, cardH = 110;
    let totalW = game.draftChoices.length * (cardW + 15);
    let startX = (W - totalW) / 2;

    game.draftChoices.forEach((card, i) => {
        let cx = startX + i * (cardW + 15);
        let cy = 90;
        if(pos.x >= cx && pos.x <= cx + cardW && pos.y >= cy && pos.y <= cy + cardH + 30) {
            draftPick(card);
        }
    });
}

// ============ EVENT LISTENERS ============
canvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    let pos = getCanvasPos(e);
    handleTap(pos);
});

canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    let pos = getCanvasPos(e);
    handleTap(pos);
}, {passive: false});

// ============ MAIN GAME LOOP ============
function gameLoop() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Screen shake
    if(game.shakeTimer > 0) {
        game.shakeTimer--;
        let sx = (Math.random()-0.5) * game.shakeIntensity;
        let sy = (Math.random()-0.5) * game.shakeIntensity;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(sx, sy);
    }

    switch(game.state) {
        case 'MENU':
            drawMenu();
            break;
        case 'PLAYING':
            drawField();
            drawTopBar();
            drawHand();
            drawParticles();
            drawNotifications();
            break;
        case 'COMBAT':
            drawField();
            drawTopBar();
            drawHand();
            drawCombatScreen();
            drawParticles();
            drawNotifications();
            break;
        case 'GAME_OVER':
            drawField();
            drawTopBar();
            drawHand();
            drawGameOver();
            drawParticles();
            break;
        case 'DRAFT':
            drawDraftScreen();
            drawNotifications();
            break;
        case 'DRAFT_MATCH':
            drawDraftMatchUI();
            drawField();
            drawHand();
            drawParticles();
            drawNotifications();
            break;
    }

    // Flash effect
    if(game.flashTimer > 0) {
        game.flashTimer--;
        ctx.fillStyle = game.flashColor;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }

    // Goal animation
    if(game.goalAnim > 0) {
        game.goalAnim--;
        let alpha = game.goalAnim / 90;
        ctx.fillStyle = game.goalTeam === 'player' ?
            `rgba(33,150,243,${alpha * 0.3})` :
            `rgba(244,67,54,${alpha * 0.3})`;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
        ctx.font = 'bold 36px Arial';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText('⚽ GOAL! ⚽', W/2, H/2);
    }

    if(game.shakeTimer > 0) {
        ctx.restore();
    }

    // Update energy
    updateEnergy();

    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// ============ INITIALIZATION ============
function init() {
    game.lastEnergyUpdate = Date.now();
    game.energy = 10;
    game.coins = 5000;
    game.gems = 100;
    game.rank = 0;
    game.rankName = 'Division 10';

    // Load saved data
    try {
        let saved = localStorage.getItem('fifaCardDuel');
        if(saved) {
            let data = JSON.parse(saved);
            game.coins = data.coins || 5000;
            game.gems = data.gems || 100;
            game.wins = data.wins || 0;
            game.losses = data.losses || 0;
            game.draws = data.draws || 0;
            game.rank = data.rank || 0;
            game.bestStreak = data.bestStreak || 0;
            game.totalGoals = data.totalGoals || 0;
            game.totalConceded = data.totalConceded || 0;
            game.energy = data.energy || 10;
            game.matchHistory = data.matchHistory || [];
        }
    } catch(e) {}

    // Auto-save
    setInterval(() => {
        try {
            localStorage.setItem('fifaCardDuel', JSON.stringify({
                coins: game.coins,
                gems: game.gems,
                wins: game.wins,
                losses: game.losses,
                draws: game.draws,
                rank: game.rank,
                bestStreak: game.bestStreak,
                totalGoals: game.totalGoals,
                totalConceded: game.totalConceded,
                energy: game.energy,
                matchHistory: game.matchHistory
            }));
        } catch(e) {}
    }, 5000);

    gameLoop();
}

init();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Starlight Adventures</title>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
body {
background: #0a0a1a;
display: flex;
justify-content: center;
align-items: center;
height: 100vh;
overflow: hidden;
font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
}
canvas {
display: block;
border-radius: 4px;
box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(100, 50, 200, 0.4);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

canvas.width = 960;
canvas.height = 640;

// Game State
const STATE = { MENU: 0, PLAYING: 1, GAMEOVER: 2, WIN: 3, LEVEL_TRANS: 4 };
let gameState = STATE.MENU;
let currentLevel = 0;
let score = 0;
let lives = 3;
let levelTransitionTimer = 0;
let screenShake = 0;
let gameTime = 0;

// Input
const keys = {};
const keysPressed = {};
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (!keys[e.code]) keysPressed[e.code] = true;
    keys[e.code] = true;
    e.preventDefault();
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; e.preventDefault(); });

// Camera
const camera = { x: 0, y: 0, targetX: 0, targetY: 0 };

// Particles
let particles = [];
class Particle {
    constructor(x, y, vx, vy, color, size, life, type = 'circle') {
        this.x = x; this.y = y; this.vx = vx; this.vy = vy;
        this.color = color; this.size = size; this.life = life;
        this.maxLife = life; this.type = type; this.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        this.rotSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2;
    }
    update() {
        this.x += this.vx; this.y += this.vy;
        this.vy += 0.05; this.life--;
        this.rotation += this.rotSpeed;
        if (this.type === 'spark') this.vy += 0.02;
    }
    draw() {
        const alpha = Math.max(0, this.life / this.maxLife);
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
        ctx.translate(this.x - camera.x, this.y - camera.y);
        ctx.rotate(this.rotation);
        if (this.type === 'circle') {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(0, 0, this.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
            ctx.fill();
        } else if (this.type === 'spark') {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(0, 0, this.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, this.size);
            grad.addColorStop(0, '#fff');
            grad.addColorStop(0.3, this.color);
            grad.addColorStop(1, 'transparent');
            ctx.fillStyle = grad;
            ctx.fill();
        } else if (this.type === 'star') {
            drawStar(0, 0, this.size * alpha, this.color);
        } else if (this.type === 'trail') {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(0, 0, this.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
            ctx.fill();
        } else if (this.type === 'leaf') {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.ellipse(0, 0, this.size * 1.5, this.size * 0.7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
            ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.restore();
    }
}

function drawStar(x, y, r, color) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const angle = (i * 4 * Math.PI) / 5 - Math.PI / 2;
        const method = i === 0 ? 'moveTo' : 'lineTo';
        ctx[method](Math.cos(angle) * r, Math.sin(angle) * r);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.fill();
}

function spawnParticles(x, y, count, config) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const angle = config.angle !== undefined ? config.angle + (Math.random() - 0.5) * (config.spread || Math.PI * 2) : Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const speed = (config.speed || 3) * (0.5 + Math.random());
        particles.push(new Particle(
            x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * (config.offsetX || 0),
            y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * (config.offsetY || 0),
            Math.cos(angle) * speed,
            Math.sin(angle) * speed,
            config.colors ? config.colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * config.colors.length)] : config.color || '#fff',
            config.size ? (config.size * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5)) : (2 + Math.random() * 3),
            config.life || 30 + Math.random() * 20,
            config.type || 'circle'
        ));
    }
}

// Collision detection
function rectCollision(a, b) {
    return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.width > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.height > b.y;
}

function pointInRect(px, py, r) {
    return px >= r.x && px <= r.x + r.w && py >= r.y && py <= r.y + r.h;
}

// Platform drawing
function drawPlatform(p) {
    const sx = p.x - camera.x, sy = p.y - camera.y;
    if (sx + p.w < -50 || sx > canvas.width + 50) return;

    if (p.type === 'ground') {
        // Ground with grass
        const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(sx, sy, sx, sy + p.h);
        grad.addColorStop(0, '#4a8c3f');
        grad.addColorStop(0.15, '#3d7a34');
        grad.addColorStop(0.3, '#6b4226');
        grad.addColorStop(1, '#4a2e1a');
        ctx.fillStyle = grad;
        ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, p.w, p.h);

        // Grass top
        ctx.fillStyle = '#5cb85c';
        ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, p.w, 8);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#6dd66d';
        ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, p.w, 4);

        // Grass blades
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#7ee87e';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        for (let i = 0; i < p.w; i += 8) {
            const gh = 4 + Math.sin(i * 0.5 + gameTime * 0.05) * 3;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(sx + i, sy);
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx + i + 2, sy - gh, sx + i + 4, sy);
            ctx.stroke();
        }
    } else {
        // Floating platform
        const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(sx, sy, sx, sy + p.h);
        grad.addColorStop(0, '#8B7355');
        grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#6B5340');
        grad.addColorStop(1, '#5a4230');
        ctx.fillStyle = grad;

        // Rounded rect
        const r = 6;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(sx + r, sy);
        ctx.lineTo(sx + p.w - r, sy);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx + p.w, sy, sx + p.w, sy + r);
        ctx.lineTo(sx + p.w, sy + p.h - r);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx + p.w, sy + p.h, sx + p.w - r, sy + p.h);
        ctx.lineTo(sx + r, sy + p.h);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx, sy + p.h, sx, sy + p.h - r);
        ctx.lineTo(sx, sy + r);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx, sy, sx + r, sy);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();

        // Top highlight
        ctx.fillStyle = '#a0896b';
        ctx.fillRect(sx + 2, sy, p.w - 4, 4);

        // Moss on sides
        ctx.fillStyle = '#5a9e5a';
        for (let i = 0; i < p.w; i += 15) {
            const mh = 3 + Math.sin(i * 0.8) * 2;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(sx + i + 7, sy + p.h, 5, 0, Math.PI);
            ctx.fill();
        }
    }
}

// Draw decorations
function drawDecoration(d) {
    const sx = d.x - camera.x, sy = d.y - camera.y;
    if (sx < -100 || sx > canvas.width + 100) return;

    if (d.type === 'tree') {
        // Tree trunk
        ctx.fillStyle = '#5a3a1a';
        ctx.fillRect(sx - 6, sy - 60, 12, 60);

        // Tree canopy
        const sway = Math.sin(gameTime * 0.02 + d.x) * 2;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#2d6b2d';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(sx + sway, sy - 80, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#3a8a3a';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(sx - 10 + sway, sy - 70, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(sx + 12 + sway, sy - 75, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#4aaa4a';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(sx + 5 + sway, sy - 90, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    } else if (d.type === 'bush') {
        const sway = Math.sin(gameTime * 0.03 + d.x) * 1.5;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#3a8a3a';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(sx + sway, sy - 10, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#4aaa4a';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(sx - 10 + sway, sy - 8, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(sx + 12 + sway, sy - 12, 13, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        // Flowers
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6b9d';
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(sx - 8 + i * 10 + sway, sy - 15, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }
    }
}

// Draw coins
function drawCoin(coin) {
    if (coin.collected) return;
    const sx = coin.x - camera.x, sy = coin.y - camera.y;
    if (sx < -30 || sx > canvas.width + 30) return;

    const bob = Math.sin(gameTime * 0.05 + coin.x) * 4;
    const scale = Math.abs(Math.cos(gameTime * 0.04 + coin.x * 0.1));

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(sx, sy + bob);
    ctx.scale(scale, 1);

    // Glow
    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 18);
    glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.4)');
    glow.addColorStop(1, 'transparent');
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.fillRect(-18, -18, 36, 36);

    // Coin body
    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(-3, -3, 0, 0, 0, 10);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffe066');
    grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#ffd700');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#cc9900');
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#aa8800';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Star on coin
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff8dc';
    ctx.font = 'bold 10px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('★', 0, 0);

    ctx.restore();
}

// Draw enemies
function drawEnemy(enemy) {
    if (enemy.dead) return;
    const sx = enemy.x - camera.x, sy = enemy.y - camera.y;
    if (sx < -50 || sx > canvas.width + 50) return;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(sx, sy);

    if (enemy.type === 'walker') {
        // Body
        const squish = Math.sin(gameTime * 0.1) * 0.1;
        ctx.scale(1 + squish, 1 - squish);

        // Shadow
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, enemy.height / 2 + 2, 14, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Body
        const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(-3, -5, 0, 0, 0, 16);
        grad.addColorStop(0, '#e85d75');
        grad.addColorStop(1, '#c0392b');
        ctx.fillStyle = grad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 0, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Eyes
        const eyeOffX = player.x > enemy.x ? 3 : -3;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(-5 + eyeOffX, -3, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.arc(5 + eyeOffX, -3, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(-4 + eyeOffX, -2, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.arc(6 + eyeOffX, -2, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Angry eyebrows
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#222';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-9, -9);
        ctx.lineTo(-2, -7);
        ctx.moveTo(9, -9);
        ctx.lineTo(2, -7);
        ctx.stroke();

        // Mouth
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 5, 4, 0, Math.PI);
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#222';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();

        // Feet
        const walk = Math.sin(gameTime * 0.15) * 3;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#a0302a';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(-6, 12 + walk, 5, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(6, 12 - walk, 5, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

    } else if (enemy.type === 'flyer') {
        const bob = Math.sin(gameTime * 0.08) * 8;
        ctx.translate(0, bob);

        // Wings
        const wingAngle = Math.sin(gameTime * 0.3) * 0.5;
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150, 100, 255, 0.6)';
        ctx.save();
        ctx.rotate(wingAngle);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(-12, -5, 14, 6, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
        ctx.save();
        ctx.rotate(-wingAngle);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(12, -5, 14, 6, 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();

        // Body
        const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 12);
        grad.addColorStop(0, '#9b59b6');
        grad.addColorStop(1, '#6c3483');
        ctx.fillStyle = grad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 0, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Eyes
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(-4, -2, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.arc(4, -2, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(-4, -2, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.arc(4, -2, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Stinger
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6600';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-3, 10);
        ctx.lineTo(0, 18);
        ctx.lineTo(3, 10);
        ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.restore();
}

// Draw player
function drawPlayer() {
    if (player.invincible > 0 && Math.floor(player.invincible / 3) % 2 === 0) return;

    const sx = player.x - camera.x, sy = player.y - camera.y;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(sx + player.width / 2, sy + player.height);
    ctx.scale(player.facing, 1);
    ctx.scale(player.squash, player.stretch);

    // Shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 14, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Body
    const bodyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-12, -player.height, 12, 0);
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#7c5cbf');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#6a4cad');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#5a3d99');
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;

    // Body shape
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-10, -4);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-12, -player.height + 10, -8, -player.height + 2);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -player.height - 4, 8, -player.height + 2);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(12, -player.height + 10, 10, -4);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(6, -2, 0, -2);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-6, -2, -10, -4);
    ctx.fill();

    // Belt
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.fillRect(-9, -14, 18, 3);

    // Head
    const headGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, -player.height + 8, 0, 0, -player.height + 8, 12);
    headGrad.addColorStop(0, '#c9a0dc');
    headGrad.addColorStop(1, '#a070c0');
    ctx.fillStyle = headGrad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -player.height + 8, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Hair
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8b5fbf';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -player.height + 2, 11, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Hair tuft
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-4, -player.height - 2);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -player.height - 10, 6, -player.height - 4);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(2, -player.height - 2, -4, -player.height - 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Eyes
    const blink = Math.sin(gameTime * 0.05) > 0.95;
    if (!blink) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(-4, -player.height + 7, 4, 4.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.ellipse(4, -player.height + 7, 4, 4.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        ctx.fillStyle = '#2d1b69';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(-3, -player.height + 7.5, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.arc(5, -player.height + 7.5, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Eye shine
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(-2, -player.height + 6, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.arc(6, -player.height + 6, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    } else {
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#2d1b69';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-7, -player.height + 7);
        ctx.lineTo(-1, -player.height + 7);
        ctx.moveTo(1, -player.height + 7);
        ctx.lineTo(7, -player.height + 7);
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Mouth
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2d1b69';
    if (player.vy < -2) {
        // Surprised mouth when jumping
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -player.height + 14, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    } else {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -player.height + 13, 2.5, 0.1, Math.PI - 0.1);
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#2d1b69';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Legs animation
    const legAnim = player.onGround ? Math.sin(gameTime * 0.2) * (Math.abs(player.vx) > 0.5 ? 6 : 0) : 3;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5a3d99';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-5, -2 + legAnim, 5, 4, 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(5, -2 - legAnim, 5, 4, -0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Shoes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(-5, 1 + legAnim, 6, 3, 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(5, 1 - legAnim, 6, 3, -0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();

    // Trail effect
    if (Math.abs(player.vx) > 2 || !player.onGround) {
        player.trail.push({ x: player.x + player.width / 2, y: player.y + player.height / 2, life: 10 });
    }
    player.trail = player.trail.filter(t => { t.life--; return t.life > 0; });
    player.trail.forEach(t => {
        const alpha = t.life / 10;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(150, 100, 255, ${alpha * 0.3})`;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(t.x - camera.x, t.y - camera.y, 8 * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    });
}

// Draw flag
function drawFlag(flagX, flagY) {
    const sx = flagX - camera.x, sy = flagY - camera.y;
    if (sx < -50 || sx > canvas.width + 50) return;

    // Pole
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ddd';
    ctx.fillRect(sx - 2, sy - 80, 4, 80);

    // Flag
    const wave = Math.sin(gameTime * 0.08) * 5;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6b9d';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(sx + 2, sy - 80);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx + 25 + wave, sy - 70, sx + 2, sy - 55);
    ctx.fill();

    // Star on flag
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.font = '12px Arial';
    ctx.fillText('★', sx + 6 + wave * 0.5, sy - 62);

    // Glow
    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx, sy - 60, 0, sx, sy - 60, 40);
    glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 107, 157, 0.2)');
    glow.addColorStop(1, 'transparent');
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.fillRect(sx - 40, sy - 100, 80, 80);
}

// Background rendering
function drawBackground(level) {
    const bg = level.bgType || 'sunset';

    // Sky gradient
    let skyTop, skyMid, skyBot;
    if (bg === 'sunset') {
        skyTop = '#1a0a3e'; skyMid = '#4a1942'; skyBot = '#c84b31';
    } else if (bg === 'night') {
        skyTop = '#0a0a2e'; skyMid = '#1a1a4e'; skyBot = '#2a2a6e';
    } else if (bg === 'aurora') {
        skyTop = '#0a1a2e'; skyMid = '#1a3a4e'; skyBot = '#2a5a5e';
    }

    const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
    skyGrad.addColorStop(0, skyTop);
    skyGrad.addColorStop(0.5, skyMid);
    skyGrad.addColorStop(1, skyBot);
    ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    // Stars (more visible in night/aurora)
    const starAlpha = bg === 'night' ? 1 : bg === 'aurora' ? 0.8 : 0.4;
    stars.forEach(s => {
        const sx = ((s.x - camera.x * 0.1) % (canvas.width + 100) + canvas.width + 100) % (canvas.width + 100);
        const twinkle = Math.sin(s.twinkle + gameTime * s.speed) * 0.5 + 0.5;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${starAlpha * twinkle})`;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(sx, s.y, s.size * twinkle, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    });

    // Moon/Sun
    if (bg === 'sunset') {
        const sunX = canvas.width * 0.75 - camera.x * 0.05;
        const sunGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(sunX, 150, 0, sunX, 150, 60);
        sunGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 200, 50, 0.8)');
        sunGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255, 150, 50, 0.3)');
        sunGrad.addColorStop(1, 'transparent');
        ctx.fillStyle = sunGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(sunX - 80, 70, 160, 160);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe080';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(sunX, 150, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    } else {
        const moonX = canvas.width * 0.8 - camera.x * 0.05;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#e8e8f0';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(moonX, 100, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = skyTop;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(moonX + 8, 95, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    }

    // Aurora effect
    if (bg === 'aurora') {
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${100 + i * 50}, ${200 + i * 20}, ${150 + i * 30}, 0.15)`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 30;
            ctx.moveTo(0, 100 + i * 40);
            for (let x = 0; x < canvas.width; x += 20) {
                const y = 100 + i * 40 + Math.sin(x * 0.01 + gameTime * 0.01 + i) * 30 + Math.sin(x * 0.005 + gameTime * 0.005) * 20;
                ctx.lineTo(x, y);
            }
            ctx.stroke();
        }
    }

    // Far mountains (parallax 0.2)
    ctx.fillStyle = bg === 'night' ? '#0d0d2d' : bg === 'aurora' ? '#0d1d2d' : '#2a1a3e';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, canvas.height);
    for (let x = 0; x <= canvas.width; x += 60) {
        const wx = x + camera.x * 0.2;
        const h = 200 + Math.sin(wx * 0.005) * 80 + Math.sin(wx * 0.012) * 40;
        ctx.lineTo(x, canvas.height - h);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.fill();

    // Near mountains (parallax 0.4)
    ctx.fillStyle = bg === 'night' ? '#12123a' : bg === 'aurora' ? '#122a3a' : '#3a2a4e';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, canvas.height);
    for (let x = 0; x <= canvas.width; x += 40) {
        const wx = x + camera.x * 0.4;
        const h = 150 + Math.sin(wx * 0.008 + 1) * 60 + Math.sin(wx * 0.02) * 30;
        ctx.lineTo(x, canvas.height - h);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.fill();

    // Clouds (parallax 0.15)
    clouds.forEach(c => {
        c.x += c.speed;
        if (c.x > 3200) c.x = -200;
        const cx = ((c.x - camera.x * 0.15) % (canvas.width + 300) + canvas.width + 300) % (canvas.width + 300) - 150;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${c.opacity})`;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(cx, c.y, c.w / 2, c.h / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(cx - c.w * 0.25, c.y + 5, c.w * 0.3, c.h * 0.4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(cx + c.w * 0.25, c.y + 3, c.w * 0.35, c.h * 0.45, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
    });

    // Mid-ground trees (parallax 0.6)
    ctx.fillStyle = bg === 'night' ? '#0a0a20' : bg === 'aurora' ? '#0a1a20' : '#1a2a1a';
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        const tx = ((i * 180 - camera.x * 0.6) % (canvas.width + 200) + canvas.width + 200) % (canvas.width + 200) - 100;
        const th = 60 + Math.sin(i * 2.5) * 30;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(tx, canvas.height);
        ctx.lineTo(tx - 15, canvas.height);
        ctx.lineTo(tx - 8, canvas.height - th);
        ctx.lineTo(tx, canvas.height - th - 15);
        ctx.lineTo(tx + 8, canvas.height - th);
        ctx.lineTo(tx + 15, canvas.height);
        ctx.fill();
    }
}
