// Game logic
let level = null;
let coins = [];
let enemies = [];
let decorations = [];

function loadLevel(index) {
    if (index >= levels.length) {
        gameState = STATE.WIN;
        return;
    }
    const data = levels[index];
    level = data;
    coins = data.coins.map(c => ({ ...c, collected: false, bobOffset: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 }));
    enemies = data.enemies.map(e => ({
        ...e,
        startX: e.x, startY: e.y,
        alive: true, dead: false,
        vx: 1, vy: 0,
        height: e.type === 'walker' ? 28 : 24,
        width: 28,
        animTimer: 0
    }));
    decorations = data.decorations || [];
    resetPlayer(data.spawnX, data.spawnY);
    camera.x = player.x - canvas.width / 3;
    camera.y = player.y - canvas.height / 2;
    particles = [];
}

function update() {
    gameTime++;

    if (gameState === STATE.MENU) {
        if (keysPressed['Space'] || keysPressed['Enter']) {
            score = 0; lives = 3; currentLevel = 0;
            loadLevel(0);
            gameState = STATE.LEVEL_TRANS;
            levelTransitionTimer = 90;
        }
        return;
    }

    if (gameState === STATE.LEVEL_TRANS) {
        levelTransitionTimer--;
        if (levelTransitionTimer <= 0) gameState = STATE.PLAYING;
        return;
    }

    if (gameState === STATE.GAMEOVER) {
        if (keysPressed['Space'] || keysPressed['Enter']) {
            score = 0; lives = 3; currentLevel = 0;
            loadLevel(0);
            gameState = STATE.LEVEL_TRANS;
            levelTransitionTimer = 90;
        }
        return;
    }

    if (gameState === STATE.WIN) {
        if (keysPressed['Space'] || keysPressed['Enter']) {
            gameState = STATE.MENU;
        }
        // Win particles
        if (gameTime % 5 === 0) {
            spawnParticles(
                Math.random() * canvas.width + camera.x,
                Math.random() * canvas.height * 0.5 + camera.y,
                3,
                { colors: ['#ffd700', '#ff6b9d', '#7c5cbf', '#fff'], speed: 4, size: 4, life: 40, type: 'star' }
            );
        }
        particles.forEach(p => p.update());
        particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);
        return;
    }

    // Player movement
    const moveLeft = keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA'];
    const moveRight = keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD'];
    const jumpKey = keys['Space'] || keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW'];

    const accel = player.onGround ? 0.8 : 0.5;
    const friction = player.onGround ? 0.82 : 0.92;
    const maxSpeed = 5.5;

    if (moveLeft) { player.vx -= accel; player.facing = -1; }
    if (moveRight) { player.vx += accel; player.facing = 1; }
    player.vx *= friction;
    if (Math.abs(player.vx) > maxSpeed) player.vx = maxSpeed * Math.sign(player.vx);
    if (Math.abs(player.vx) < 0.1) player.vx = 0;

    // Jump
    if (jumpKey) {
        player.jumpBuffer = 8;
    } else {
        player.jumpBuffer = Math.max(0, player.jumpBuffer - 1);
    }

    if (player.jumpBuffer > 0) {
        if (player.coyoteTime > 0) {
            player.vy = -11;
            player.onGround = false;
            player.coyoteTime = 0;
            player.jumpBuffer = 0;
            player.squash = 0.7;
            player.stretch = 1.3;
            spawnParticles(player.x + player.width / 2, player.y + player.height, 8, {
                colors: ['#c9a0dc', '#fff', '#a070c0'], speed: 2, size: 3, life: 20, type: 'circle'
            });
        } else if (!player.onGround && player.canDoubleJump) {
            player.vy = -10;
            player.canDoubleJump = false;
            player.jumpBuffer = 0;
            player.squash = 0.7;
            player.stretch = 1.3;
            spawnParticles(player.x + player.width / 2, player.y + player.height, 12, {
                colors: ['#7c5cbf', '#c9a0dc', '#fff'], speed: 3, size: 3, life: 25, type: 'spark'
            });
        }
    }

    // Variable jump height
    if (!jumpKey && player.vy < -4) {
        player.vy *= 0.85;
    }

    // Gravity
    player.vy += 0.55;
    if (player.vy > 12) player.vy = 12;

    // Move X
    player.x += player.vx;

    // Collide X with platforms
    const allPlatforms = level.platforms;
    player.onGround = false;

    for (const p of allPlatforms) {
        if (rectCollision(player, p)) {
            if (player.vx > 0) {
                player.x = p.x - player.width;
            } else if (player.vx < 0) {
                player.x = p.x + p.w;
            }
            player.vx = 0;
        }
    }

    // Move Y
    player.y += player.vy;

    for (const p of allPlatforms) {
        if (rectCollision(player, p)) {
            if (player.vy > 0) {
                player.y = p.y - player.height;
                if (player.vy > 5) {
                    player.squash = 1.3;
                    player.stretch = 0.7;
                    spawnParticles(player.x + player.width / 2, player.y + player.height, 5, {
                        colors: ['#c9a0dc', '#fff'], speed: 1.5, size: 2, life: 15, type: 'circle'
                    });
                }
                player.vy = 0;
                player.onGround = true;
                player.coyoteTime = 6;
                player.canDoubleJump = true;
            } else if (player.vy < 0) {
                player.y = p.y + p.h;
                player.vy = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    // Coyote time
    if (!player.onGround) {
        player.coyoteTime = Math.max(0, player.coyoteTime - 1);
    }

    // Fall death
    if (player.y > 700) {
        playerDie();
    }

    // Squash and stretch recovery
    player.squash += (1 - player.squash) * 0.15;
    player.stretch += (1 - player.stretch) * 0.15;

    // Invincibility
    if (player.invincible > 0) player.invincible--;

    // Collect coins
    coins.forEach(coin => {
        if (coin.collected) return;
        const dx = (player.x + player.width / 2) - coin.x;
        const dy = (player.y + player.height / 2) - coin.y;
        if (Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) < 20) {
            coin.collected = true;
            score += 10;
            spawnParticles(coin.x, coin.y, 15, {
                colors: ['#ffd700', '#fff', '#ffe066'], speed: 4, size: 4, life: 30, type: 'star'
            });
            screenShake = 3;
        }
    });

    // Update enemies
    enemies.forEach(enemy => {
        if (enemy.dead) return;
        enemy.animTimer++;

        if (enemy.type === 'walker') {
            enemy.x += enemy.vx;
            if (Math.abs(enemy.x - enemy.startX) > enemy.range) {
                enemy.vx *= -1;
            }
            // Simple gravity for walkers
            enemy.vy = (enemy.vy || 0) + 0.5;
            enemy.y += enemy.vy;
            // Platform collision for walker
            for (const p of allPlatforms) {
                if (enemy.x + 14 > p.x && enemy.x - 14 < p.x + p.w &&
                    enemy.y + 14 > p.y && enemy.y + 14 < p.y + p.h + 10) {
                    enemy.y = p.y - 14;
                    enemy.vy = 0;
                }
            }
        } else if (enemy.type === 'flyer') {
            enemy.x += enemy.vx;
            if (Math.abs(enemy.x - enemy.startX) > enemy.range) {
                enemy.vx *= -1;
            }
        }

        // Player collision with enemy
        if (player.invincible <= 0) {
            const dx = (player.x + player.width / 2) - enemy.x;
            const dy = (player.y + player.height / 2) - enemy.y;
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
            if (dist < 22) {
                // Stomp from above
                if (player.vy > 0 && player.y + player.height - 8 < enemy.y) {
                    enemy.dead = true;
                    player.vy = -8;
                    score += 25;
                    spawnParticles(enemy.x, enemy.y, 20, {
                        colors: ['#ff6b6b', '#ff9999', '#fff'], speed: 5, size: 5, life: 35, type: 'spark'
                    });
                    screenShake = 5;
                } else {
                    playerDie();
                }
            }
        }
    });

    // Flag collision (level complete)
    const flagX = level.flagX, flagY = level.flagY;
    const fdx = (player.x + player.width / 2) - flagX;
    const fdy = (player.y + player.height / 2) - flagY;
    if (Math.sqrt(fdx * fdx + fdy * fdy) < 35) {
        if (currentLevel < levels.length - 1) {
            currentLevel++;
            score += 50;
            loadLevel(currentLevel);
            gameState = STATE.LEVEL_TRANS;
            levelTransitionTimer = 90;
        } else {
            score += 100;
            gameState = STATE.WIN;
        }
        spawnParticles(flagX, flagY, 30, {
            colors: ['#ffd700', '#ff6b9d', '#c9a0dc', '#fff'], speed: 6, size: 5, life: 50, type: 'star'
        });
    }

    // Camera
    camera.targetX = player.x - canvas.width / 3;
    camera.targetY = player.y - canvas.height / 2 + 50;
    camera.x += (camera.targetX - camera.x) * 0.08;
    camera.y += (camera.targetY - camera.y) * 0.06;
    camera.y = Math.min(camera.y, 100);

    // Screen shake
    if (screenShake > 0) {
        camera.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * screenShake * 2;
        camera.y += (Math.random() - 0.5) * screenShake * 2;
        screenShake *= 0.85;
        if (screenShake < 0.5) screenShake = 0;
    }

    // Ambient particles
    if (gameTime % 20 === 0) {
        spawnParticles(
            camera.x + Math.random() * canvas.width,
            camera.y - 10,
            1,
            { colors: ['#c9a0dc', '#7c5cbf', '#a070c0'], speed: 0.5, size: 2, life: 80, type: 'leaf' }
        );
    }

    // Update particles
    particles.forEach(p => p.update());
    particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);

    // Clear pressed keys
    for (const key in keysPressed) keysPressed[key] = false;
}

function playerDie() {
    if (player.invincible > 0) return;
    lives--;
    screenShake = 10;
    spawnParticles(player.x + player.width / 2, player.y + player.height / 2, 30, {
        colors: ['#ff6b6b', '#ff9999', '#c9a0dc', '#fff'], speed: 6, size: 5, life: 40, type: 'spark'
    });

    if (lives <= 0) {
        gameState = STATE.GAMEOVER;
    } else {
        player.invincible = 90;
        resetPlayer(level.spawnX, level.spawnY);
    }
}

function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    if (gameState === STATE.MENU) {
        drawMenu();
        return;
    }

    if (!level) return;

    // Background
    drawBackground(level);

    // Decorations (behind platforms)
    decorations.forEach(d => drawDecoration(d));

    // Platforms
    level.platforms.forEach(p => drawPlatform(p));

    // Coins
    coins.forEach(c => drawCoin(c));

    // Flag
    drawFlag(level.flagX, level.flagY);

    // Enemies
    enemies.forEach(e => drawEnemy(e));

    // Player
    if (gameState === STATE.PLAYING || gameState === STATE.LEVEL_TRANS) {
        drawPlayer();
    }

    // Particles
    particles.forEach(p => p.draw());

    // HUD
    drawHUD();

    // Overlays
    if (gameState === STATE.LEVEL_TRANS) drawLevelTransition();
    if (gameState === STATE.GAMEOVER) drawGameOver();
    if (gameState === STATE.WIN) drawWinScreen();
}

// Game loop
function gameLoop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// Polyfill roundRect
if (!ctx.roundRect) {
    CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect = function(x, y, w, h, r) {
        if (typeof r === 'number') r = [r, r, r, r];
        this.moveTo(x + r[0], y);
        this.lineTo(x + w - r[1], y);
        this.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r[1]);
        this.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r[2]);
        this.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r[2], y + h);
        this.lineTo(x + r[3], y + h);
        this.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r[3]);
        this.lineTo(x, y + r[0]);
        this.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r[0], y);
        this.closePath();
    };
}

gameLoop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

⟨ HOW A HACKER THINKS ⟩

Mindset • Reconnaissance • Exploitation — An Educational Cybersecurity Game
MINDSET
RECON
EXPLOIT
SCORE: 0
welcome — hacker-mindset.exe
root@cyber-academy:~$ cat welcome.txt
╔══════════════════════════════════════════╗
║ Welcome, Recruit. Today you learn to ║
║ think like a hacker. ║
║ ║
║ A hacker doesn't just break in — they ║
║ understand the system first. ║
║ They observe, they plan, they adapt. ║
║ ║
║ This game has 3 phases: ║
║ 1. MINDSET — Learn how hackers think ║
║ 2. RECON — Gather intelligence ║
║ 3. EXPLOITATION — Chain vulnerabilities║
║ ║
║ Earn flags and points at each stage. ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════╝
ℹ This is an educational simulation. All targets are fictional.
root@cyber-academy:~$

🎯 What You'll Learn

The Hacker Mindset: Understanding that hacking is fundamentally about creative problem-solvingHackers see systems not as rigid structures but as puzzles with hidden paths. They ask "what if?" and "why not?" constantly. — asking questions others don't think to ask.

Reconnaissance: 80-90% of a real engagement is gathering information. Learning to collect data about targets without being detected.

Exploitation: Understanding how vulnerabilities chain together. One weak link can compromise an entire system.

Ethical Hacking Penetration Testing OSINT Vulnerability Assessment Defense in Depth
PHASE 1: THE HACKER MINDSET

🧠 Thinking Like a Hacker

Before any tool is launched, a hacker develops a mental model of the target. They think about:

• Trust boundaries — Where does the system trust input?

• Attack surface — What can be reached from the outside?

• Assumptions — What does the system assume is true that might be false?

• Chain of trust — What happens if one component is compromised?

mindset — scenario-01.txt
scenario@mindset:~$ load scenario --id=web-app-auth
[SCENARIO] You're analyzing a web application's login page.
[OBSERVATION] The login form has username/password fields.
[OBSERVATION] After 5 failed attempts, you get a "lockout" message.
[OBSERVATION] The error message says: "Username not found" vs "Invalid password"
[QUESTION] What vulnerability does this reveal?

Q1: The different error messages for "user not found" vs "wrong password" allow an attacker to:

✅ Correct! User Enumeration

Different error messages reveal whether a username exists in the system. An attacker can iterate through common usernames, then focus brute-force attacks on confirmed accounts. This is why systems should return generic error messages like "Invalid username or password."

mindset — scenario-02.txt
scenario@mindset:~$ load scenario --id=developer-assumption
[SCENARIO] A developer wrote this validation rule:
if (user.role === "admin") { grantAccess(); }

[QUESTION] What's the fundamental flaw in this approach?

Q2: This code assumes that:

✅ Correct! Trust Boundary Violation

This is a classic client-side trustNever trust data from the client. If role checking happens in JavaScript on the user's browser, an attacker can modify the role field in browser dev tools before sending the request. problem. If role validation happens on the client (browser), an attacker can modify the role in browser developer tools. Server-side validation is essential — never trust user input.

mindset — scenario-03.txt
scenario@mindset:~$ load scenario --id=security-by-obscurity
[SCENARIO] A company hides their admin panel at /admin/secret-panel-x9z2
[OBSERVATION] They have no firewall, no authentication,
[OBSERVATION] and use the default password "admin123"
[QUESTION] What security principle are they violating?

Q3: Hiding the admin URL instead of securing it violates:

✅ Correct! Security by Obscurity

Kerckhoffs's principleNamed after cryptographer Auguste Kerckhoffs: a system should remain secure even if everything about the system, except the key, is public knowledge. Hiding the URL is not security — it's just making it harder to find. states that a system should remain secure even if everything about it is known except the key. Hiding an admin URL provides no real protection — anyone who discovers the URL has full access. Real security requires authentication, authorization, and encryption.

🧠 Mindset Summary

The hacker's mindset is built on three pillars:

1. Curiosity — Question every assumption the system makes

2. Persistence — If one path is blocked, find another

3. Systematic thinking — Map the attack surface before acting

Now that you think like a hacker, it's time to gather intelligence.

PHASE 2: RECONNAISSANCE

🔍 Gathering Intelligence

Reconnaissance is the most critical phase. A hacker collects information about the target to identify potential entry points. This includes:

• Network mapping — Finding live hosts and open ports

• Service enumeration — What's running on each port?

• Technology fingerprinting — What software and versions?

• OSINT — Open Source Intelligence from public sources

recon — network-scan.sh
recon@target:~$ nmap -sV --script=vuln 10.0.0.0/24
[SCANNING] Network 10.0.0.0/24 — 256 hosts
[ALERT] 8 hosts found with open ports.
[INSTRUCTION] Click on each node to scan it. Identify vulnerabilities.
💡 Hint: Focus on nodes with open ports. Each node reveals different services. Look for outdated software versions and misconfigurations. You need to find at least 3 vulnerabilities to proceed.

📋 Reconnaissance Report

PHASE 3: EXPLOITATION — CHAINING VULNERABILITIES

⛓️ The Exploit Chain

Real-world breaches rarely exploit a single vulnerability. Hackers chain multiple weaknessesAn exploit chain connects multiple vulnerabilities to achieve a goal. For example: XSS → Session Hijack → Privilege Escalation → Data Exfiltration. to move from initial access to full compromise.

Build the correct exploit chain by selecting vulnerabilities in the right order.

exploit — chain-builder.py
exploit@target:~$ python3 chain-builder.py --target=corp-server
[TARGET] corp-server.internal (10.0.0.5)
[OBJECTIVE] Achieve root access
[AVAILABLE] Select vulnerabilities from the list below and chain them in the correct order.

🎯 Goal: Build the Exploit Chain

Click vulnerabilities in the order they should be exploited. The chain must logically progress from external access → internal access → privilege escalation → objective.

ℹ In real engagements, defenders use defense in depth — multiple security layers so that if one fails, others still protect the system.

⟨ TRAINING COMPLETE ⟩

📚 Key Takeaways

• Think first, act second. Understanding the system is more important than any tool.

• Recon is 80% of the work. The better you know your target, the easier the exploit.

• Defense in depth. Layer your security — no single point of failure.

function buildRoom(roomId) {
    const room = rooms[roomId];
    room.walls = [];
    room.doors = [];
    room.items = room.items || [];
    room.npcs = room.npcs || [];

    // Generate walls based on room size
    for (let x = 0; x < room.width; x++) {
        room.walls.push({x, y: 0});
        room.walls.push({x, y: room.height - 1});
    }
    for (let y = 0; y < room.height; y++) {
        room.walls.push({x: 0, y});
        room.walls.push({x: room.width - 1, y});
    }

    // Add doors between rooms
    if (roomId === 'barber_lobby') {
        room.doors.push({x: 9, y: 3, to: 'parking', dir: 'right'});
        room.doors.push({x: 9, y: 6, to: 'shop_lobby', dir: 'right'});
        room.doors.push({x: 0, y: 4, to: 'house_bedroom', dir: 'left'});
        room.doors.push({x: 4, y: 0, to: 'barber_wc', dir: 'up'});
        // Barber chairs
        room.npcs.push({x: 3, y: 4, type: 'customer', name: 'Pak Budi', state: 'waiting', served: false});
        room.npcs.push({x: 6, y: 4, type: 'customer', name: 'Mas Andi', state: 'waiting', served: false});
    }
    if (roomId === 'barber_wc') {
        room.doors.push({x: 2, y: 4, to: 'barber_lobby', dir: 'down'});
    }
    if (roomId === 'parking') {
        room.doors.push({x: 0, y: 4, to: 'barber_lobby', dir: 'left'});
    }
    if (roomId === 'house_bedroom') {
        room.doors.push({x: 7, y: 3, to: 'barber_lobby', dir: 'right'});
        room.doors.push({x: 4, y: 0, to: 'house_kitchen', dir: 'up'});
    }
    if (roomId === 'house_kitchen') {
        room.doors.push({x: 3, y: 5, to: 'house_bedroom', dir: 'down'});
        room.doors.push({x: 0, y: 2, to: 'house_wc', dir: 'left'});
    }
    if (roomId === 'house_wc') {
        room.doors.push({x: 4, y: 2, to: 'house_kitchen', dir: 'right'});
    }
    if (roomId === 'shop_lobby') {
        room.doors.push({x: 0, y: 4, to: 'barber_lobby', dir: 'left'});
        room.doors.push({x: 4, y: 0, to: 'shop_wc', dir: 'up'});
        room.doors.push({x: 9, y: 6, to: 'parking', dir: 'right'});
    }
    if (roomId === 'shop_wc') {
        room.doors.push({x: 2, y: 4, to: 'shop_lobby', dir: 'down'});
    }
}

// Particles
function addParticle(x, y, color, count) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        particles.push({
            x, y,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4,
            vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4,
            life: 30 + Math.random() * 30,
            color,
            size: Math.random() * 3 + 1
        });
    }
}

// Check collision with walls
function isWall(x, y, roomId) {
    const room = rooms[roomId];
    const tx = Math.floor(x / TILE);
    const ty = Math.floor(y / TILE);
    if (tx < 0 || tx >= room.width || ty < 0 || ty >= room.height) return true;
    return room.walls.some(w => w.x === tx && w.y === ty);
}

// Check if can move to position
function canMove(nx, ny, roomId) {
    const margin = 6;
    return !isWall(nx + margin, ny + margin, roomId) &&
           !isWall(nx + player.w - margin, ny + margin, roomId) &&
           !isWall(nx + margin, ny + player.h - margin, roomId) &&
           !isWall(nx + player.w - margin, ny + player.h - margin, roomId);
}

// Check door transition
function checkDoors() {
    const room = rooms[currentRoom];
    for (let door of room.doors) {
        const px = player.x;
        const py = player.y;
        const dx = door.x * TILE;
        const dy = door.y * TILE;

        if (Math.abs(px - dx) < 20 && Math.abs(py - dy) < 20) {
            if (keys['e'] || keys['KeyE']) {
                currentRoom = door.to;
                if (door.dir === 'left') { player.x = 1 * TILE; player.y = door.y * TILE + 20; }
                if (door.dir === 'right') { player.x = (rooms[door.to].width - 2) * TILE; player.y = door.y * TILE + 20; }
                if (door.dir === 'up') { player.x = door.x * TILE + 20; player.y = 1 * TILE; }
                if (door.dir === 'down') { player.x = door.x * TILE + 20; player.y = (rooms[door.to].height - 2) * TILE; }
                keys['e'] = false;
                keys['KeyE'] = false;
                addParticle(player.x, player.y, '#ffffff', 5);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Check item pickup
function checkItems() {
    const room = rooms[currentRoom];
    for (let item of room.items) {
        if (itemsCollected.includes(item.type)) continue;
        const ix = item.x * TILE + TILE / 2;
        const iy = item.y * TILE + TILE / 2;
        const px = player.x + player.w / 2;
        const py = player.y + player.h / 2;
        if (Math.abs(px - ix) < 30 && Math.abs(py - iy) < 30) {
            if (keys['g'] || keys['KeyG']) {
                itemsCollected.push(item.type);
                addParticle(ix, iy, '#ffff00', 10);
                if (item.type === 'letter') {
                    dialogueBox = 'Dimas menemukan SURAT MISTERIUS!';
                    dialogueTimer = 180;
                    letterFound = true;
                }
                if (item.type === 'flashlight') {
                    dialogueBox = 'Dimas mengambil SENTER! (Tekan F untuk menyalakan)';
                    dialogueTimer = 180;
                }
                if (item.type === 'key') {
                    dialogueBox = 'Dimas menemukan KUNCI RUKO!';
                    dialogueTimer = 180;
                }
                if (item.type === 'candle') {
                    dialogueBox = 'Dimas mengambil LILIN!';
                    dialogueTimer = 180;
                }
                if (item.type === 'knife') {
                    dialogueBox = 'Dimas mengambil PISAU DAPUR!';
                    dialogueTimer = 180;
                }
                keys['g'] = false;
                keys['KeyG'] = false;
            }
        }
    }
}

// Check customer interaction
function checkCustomers() {
    const room = rooms[currentRoom];
    for (let npc of room.npcs) {
        if (npc.type !== 'customer') continue;
        const nx = npc.x * TILE + TILE / 2;
        const ny = npc.y * TILE + TILE / 2;
        const px = player.x + player.w / 2;
        const py = player.y + player.h / 2;
        if (Math.abs(px - nx) < 40 && Math.abs(py - ny) < 40) {
            if (npc.state === 'waiting' && (keys['h'] || keys['KeyH'])) {
                npc.state = 'serving';
                npc.servingTimer = 120;
                keys['h'] = false;
                keys['KeyH'] = false;
                addParticle(nx, ny, '#ffaa00', 8);
            }
            if (npc.state === 'serving' && npc.servingTimer > 0) {
                npc.servingTimer--;
                if (npc.servingTimer <= 0) {
                    npc.state = 'done';
                    npc.doneTimer = 60;
                    customersServed++;
                    dialogueBox = `${npc.name}: "Terima kasih pak! Rambutnya rapi!"`;
                    dialogueTimer = 150;
                    addParticle(nx, ny, '#00ff00', 12);
                }
            }
            if (npc.state === 'done') {
                npc.doneTimer--;
                if (npc.doneTimer <= 0) {
                    // Remove customer
                    const idx = room.npcs.indexOf(npc);
                    if (idx > -1) room.npcs.splice(idx, 1);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// Draw pixel art character
function drawCharacter(x, y, dir, frame, color1, color2, isGhost) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);

    if (isGhost) {
        // Ghost entity
        const flicker = Math.sin(Date.now() / 100) * 3;
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6 + Math.sin(Date.now() / 200) * 0.3;

        // Body - dark shadowy figure
        ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        ctx.fillRect(4 + flicker, 0, 20, 36);

        // Glowing eyes
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0000';
        ctx.fillRect(8 + flicker, 6, 4, 4);
        ctx.fillRect(16 + flicker, 6, 4, 4);

        // Eye glow
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,0,0,0.3)';
        ctx.fillRect(6 + flicker, 4, 8, 8);
        ctx.fillRect(14 + flicker, 4, 8, 8);

        // Dark aura
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,0,0,0.2)';
        ctx.fillRect(0, -4, 28, 44);

        ctx.restore();
        return;
    }

    // Player - Dimas
    // Hair
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.fillRect(6, 0, 16, 8);
    ctx.fillRect(4, 2, 20, 6);

    // Face
    ctx.fillStyle = '#d4a574';
    ctx.fillRect(6, 6, 16, 12);

    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    if (dir === 0) { // down
        ctx.fillRect(9, 10, 3, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(16, 10, 3, 3);
        // Mouth
        ctx.fillRect(12, 15, 4, 2);
    } else if (dir === 1) { // left
        ctx.fillRect(6, 10, 3, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(13, 10, 3, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(9, 15, 4, 2);
    } else if (dir === 2) { // right
        ctx.fillRect(9, 10, 3, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(16, 10, 3, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(15, 15, 4, 2);
    } else { // up
        ctx.fillRect(9, 10, 3, 3);
        ctx.fillRect(16, 10, 3, 3);
    }

    // Body / Shirt
    ctx.fillStyle = color1;
    ctx.fillRect(4, 18, 20, 12);

    // Barber apron
    ctx.fillStyle = color2;
    ctx.fillRect(6, 18, 16, 14);

    // Legs
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2a2a';
    ctx.fillRect(6, 30, 7, 6);
    ctx.fillRect(15, 30, 7, 6);

    // Shoes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    ctx.fillRect(5, 34, 8, 4);
    ctx.fillRect(15, 34, 8, 4);

    // Animation bob
    if (frame % 2 === 1) {
        ctx.fillRect(6, 30, 7, 4);
        ctx.fillRect(15, 30, 7, 4);
    }

    ctx.restore();
}

// Draw NPC customer
function drawCustomer(x, y, state, servingTimer) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);

    // Body
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a5a8a';
    ctx.fillRect(4, 10, 20, 16);

    // Head
    ctx.fillStyle = '#d4a574';
    ctx.fillRect(6, 0, 16, 12);

    // Hair (varies)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a1a0a';
    ctx.fillRect(4, 0, 20, 6);
    ctx.fillRect(6, -2, 16, 4);

    // Eyes
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.fillRect(9, 5, 3, 3);
    ctx.fillRect(16, 5, 3, 3);

    // Mouth
    if (state === 'waiting') {
        ctx.fillRect(12, 10, 4, 1);
    } else if (state === 'serving') {
        ctx.fillRect(11, 9, 6, 3);
    } else {
        ctx.fillRect(11, 9, 6, 3);
        // Happy
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6666';
        ctx.fillRect(12, 10, 4, 2);
    }

    // Legs
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a3a3a';
    ctx.fillRect(6, 26, 7, 8);
    ctx.fillRect(15, 26, 7, 8);

    // Chair
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5a3a2a';
    ctx.fillRect(2, 20, 24, 14);
    ctx.fillRect(0, 18, 4, 18);
    ctx.fillRect(24, 18, 4, 18);

    // Serving progress
    if (state === 'serving') {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffaa00';
        ctx.fillRect(4, 36, 20, 3);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#00ff00';
        ctx.fillRect(4, 36, 20 * (1 - servingTimer / 120), 3);
    }

    ctx.restore();
}

// Draw room
function drawRoom(roomId) {
    const room = rooms[roomId];
    const isHorror = horrorActive;

    // Floor
    ctx.fillStyle = isHorror ? '#1a0505' : room.floorColor;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, room.width * TILE, room.height * TILE);

    // Floor tiles pattern
    for (let x = 0; x < room.width; x++) {
        for (let y = 0; y < room.height; y++) {
            if ((x + y) % 2 === 0) {
                ctx.fillStyle = isHorror ? 'rgba(40,0,0,0.3)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)';
                ctx.fillRect(x * TILE, y * TILE, TILE, TILE);
            }
        }
    }

    // Horror cracks
    if (isHorror) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,0,0,0.4)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            const sx = (i * 137 + 50) % (room.width * TILE);
            const sy = (i * 251 + 30) % (room.height * TILE);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
            ctx.lineTo(sx + 20, sy + 15);
            ctx.lineTo(sx + 35, sy + 5);
            ctx.stroke();
        }
    }

    // Walls
    for (let wall of room.walls) {
        ctx.fillStyle = isHorror ? '#3a0a0a' : room.wallColor;
        ctx.fillRect(wall.x * TILE, wall.y * TILE, TILE, TILE);

        // Wall detail
        ctx.fillStyle = isHorror ? '#2a0505' : room.accentColor;
        ctx.fillRect(wall.x * TILE + 2, wall.y * TILE + 2, TILE - 4, TILE - 4);
    }

    // Doors
    for (let door of room.doors) {
        ctx.fillStyle = isHorror ? '#0a0000' : '#5a4a3a';
        ctx.fillRect(door.x * TILE + 2, door.y * TILE + 2, TILE - 4, TILE - 4);

        // Door handle
        ctx.fillStyle = '#8a7a5a';
        ctx.fillRect(door.x * TILE + 30, door.y * TILE + 20, 4, 4);

        // Arrow indicator
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffff00';
        ctx.font = '12px monospace';
        ctx.fillText('▶', door.x * TILE + 12, door.y * TILE + 24);
    }

    // Items
    for (let item of room.items) {
        if (itemsCollected.includes(item.type)) continue;
        const ix = item.x * TILE + TILE / 2;
        const iy = item.y * TILE + TILE / 2;
        const bob = Math.sin(Date.now() / 300) * 3;

        // Glow
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,100,0.2)';
        ctx.fillRect(ix - 15, iy - 15 + bob, 30, 30);

        // Item
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffff00';
        if (item.type === 'letter') {
            ctx.fillRect(ix - 8, iy - 6 + bob, 16, 12);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.fillRect(ix - 5, iy - 3 + bob, 10, 6);
        } else if (item.type === 'flashlight') {
            ctx.fillRect(ix - 3, iy - 8 + bob, 6, 16);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
            ctx.fillRect(ix - 4, iy - 10 + bob, 8, 4);
        } else if (item.type === 'key') {
            ctx.fillRect(ix - 6, iy - 2 + bob, 12, 4);
            ctx.fillRect(ix - 6, iy - 6 + bob, 4, 4);
        } else if (item.type === 'candle') {
            ctx.fillRect(ix - 3, iy - 6 + bob, 6, 12);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8800';
            ctx.fillRect(ix - 1, iy - 10 + bob, 2, 4);
        } else if (item.type === 'knife') {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ccc';
            ctx.fillRect(ix - 1, iy - 8 + bob, 2, 12);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#8B4513';
            ctx.fillRect(ix - 3, iy + 4 + bob, 6, 4);
        }

        // Label
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.font = '9px monospace';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(item.name, ix, iy + 16 + bob);
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    }

    // NPCs
    for (let npc of room.npcs) {
        if (npc.type === 'customer') {
            drawCustomer(npc.x * TILE, npc.y * TILE, npc.state, npc.servingTimer || 0);

            // Name tag
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = '10px monospace';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText(npc.name, npc.x * TILE + TILE / 2, npc.y * TILE - 8);

            // State indicator
            if (npc.state === 'waiting') {
                ctx.fillStyle = '#ffaa00';
                ctx.font = '16px monospace';
                ctx.fillText('❗', npc.x * TILE + TILE / 2, npc.y * TILE - 22);
            }
            ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        }
    }

    // Interaction prompts
    const room2 = rooms[currentRoom];
    for (let door of room2.doors) {
        const dx = door.x * TILE;
        const dy = door.y * TILE;
        const px = player.x;
        const py = player.y;
        if (Math.abs(px - dx) < 40 && Math.abs(py - dy) < 40) {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
            ctx.fillRect(200, 520, 400, 40);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = '14px monospace';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('[E] Masuk ke ' + rooms[door.to].name, 400, 545);
            ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        }
    }

    // Player
    const pDir = player.dir;
    drawCharacter(player.x, player.y, pDir, player.frame, '#4a6a9a', '#6a4a3a', false);

    // Flashlight effect
    if (flashlightOn && itemsCollected.includes('flashlight')) {
        const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(
            player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h / 2, 20,
            player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h / 2, 150
        );
        gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,200,0.15)');
        gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,200,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, room.width * TILE, room.height * TILE);
    }

    // Horror darkness overlay
    if (horrorActive && !flashlightOn) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, room.width * TILE, room.height * TILE);
    }

    // Ghost (visible in horror mode)
    if (horrorActive && ghostVisible) {
        drawCharacter(ghost.x, ghost.y, 0, ghost.frame, '#000', '#000', true);
    }

    // Room name
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, room.width * TILE, 24);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '14px monospace';
    ctx.fillText(room.name, 10, 17);

    // Player name
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(room.width * TILE - 100, 0, 100, 24);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6666';
    ctx.font = '12px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText(player.name, room.width * TILE - 10, 17);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';

    // Horror red vignette
    if (horrorActive) {
        const vigGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(400, 300, 100, 400, 300, 500);
        vigGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(100,0,0,0)');
        vigGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(80,0,0,0.5)');
        ctx.fillStyle = vigGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);
    }

    // Whispers
    if (horrorActive && whisperTimer > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,0,0,${whisperTimer / 120})`;
        ctx.font = '12px monospace';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(whisperText, 400, 300);
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    }

    // Items collected display
    if (itemsCollected.length > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 560, 200, 40);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
        ctx.font = '10px monospace';
        ctx.fillText('Barang: ' + itemsCollected.join(', '), 10, 585);
    }

    // Customers served
    if (currentRoom === 'barber_lobby') {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
        ctx.fillRect(600, 560, 190, 40);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffaa00';
        ctx.font = '12px monospace';
        ctx.fillText(`Pelanggan: ${customersServed}/${totalCustomersNeeded}`, 610, 585);
    }
}

// Draw title screen
function drawTitle() {
    // Dark background
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0a0a';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

    // Stars
    for (let star of stars) {
        star.b += 0.02;
        const alpha = 0.3 + Math.sin(star.b) * 0.3;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
        ctx.fillRect(star.x, star.y, star.s, star.s);
    }

    // Blood drip effect
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8a0000';
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const dx = 100 + i * 150;
        const dh = 50 + Math.sin(Date.now() / 1000 + i) * 20;
        ctx.fillRect(dx, 0, 8, dh);
        ctx.fillRect(dx - 2, dh - 5, 12, 8);
    }

    // Title
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8a0000';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('TUKANG PANGKAS', 400, 180);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0000';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('C I T A M P I', 400, 220);

    // Subtitle
    ctx.fillStyle = '#666';
    ctx.font = '14px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Sebuah cerita horor dari Bandung', 400, 260);

    // Player info
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
    ctx.font = '16px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Nama: DIMAS', 400, 320);

    // Start prompt
    titleTimer += 0.05;
    const alpha = 0.5 + Math.sin(titleTimer * 3) * 0.5;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
    ctx.font = '18px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('[ TEKAN E UNTUK MULAI ]', 400, 400);

    // Controls
    ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
    ctx.font = '12px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('WASD/Panah: Gerak | E: Pindah | F: Senter | G: Ambil | H: Pangkas', 400, 480);
    ctx.fillText('R: Lanjut Storyboard', 400, 500);

    // Horror atmosphere
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(80,0,0,0.1)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

// Draw cutscene
function drawCutscene() {
    // Dark background
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0a0a';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

    // Red filter increasing
    const redIntensity = Math.min(cutscenePhase * 0.1, 0.6);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${Math.floor(redIntensity * 150)},0,0,0.3)`;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

    // Draw current room in background
    drawRoom(currentRoom);

    // Dark overlay
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

    // Cutscene text box
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)';
    ctx.fillRect(100, 400, 600, 150);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#8a0000';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeRect(100, 400, 600, 150);

    // Typewriter text
    if (cutsceneTextTimer > 0) {
        cutsceneTextTimer--;
        const charsToShow = Math.min(cutsceneTextFull.length, cutsceneData[cutscenePhase].duration - cutsceneTextTimer);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.font = '16px monospace';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(cutsceneTextFull.substring(0, charsToShow), 400, 470);

        if (cutsceneTextTimer <= 0) {
            cutscenePhase++;
            if (cutscenePhase >= cutsceneData.length) {
                // Transition to horror
                horrorActive = true;
                gameState = 'playing';
                ghostVisible = true;
                ghost.x = 3 * TILE;
                ghost.y = 3 * TILE;
                ghost.active = true;
                whisperText = '...kamu tidak boleh masuk...';
                whisperTimer = 180;
                addParticle(player.x, player.y, '#ff0000', 20);
                return;
            }
            cutsceneTextFull = cutsceneData[cutscenePhase].text;
            cutsceneTextTimer = cutsceneData[cutscenePhase].duration;
        }
    }

    // Continue prompt
    if (cutsceneTextTimer <= 0) {
        const alpha = 0.5 + Math.sin(Date.now() / 300) * 0.5;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
        ctx.font = '14px monospace';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText('[ TEKAN R UNTUK LANJUT ]', 400, 520);

        if (keys['r'] || keys['KeyR']) {
            cutsceneTextTimer = cutsceneData[cutscenePhase].duration;
            cutsceneTextFull = cutsceneData[cutscenePhase].text;
            keys['r'] = false;
            keys['KeyR'] = false;
        }
    }

    ctx.textAlign = 'left';

    // Screen shake
    if (screenShake > 0) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(Math.random() * screenShake - screenShake / 2, Math.random() * screenShake - screenShake / 2);
        ctx.restore();
    }
}

// Draw chase scene
function drawChase() {
    // Red everything
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a0000';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

    // Draw room
    drawRoom(currentRoom);

    // Heavy red overlay
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,0,0,0.4)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

    // Darkness
    if (!flashlightOn) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);
    }

    // Ghost chasing
    if (ghost.active) {
        const dx = player.x - ghost.x;
        const dy = player.y - ghost.y;
        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

        if (dist > 0) {
            ghost.x += (dx / dist) * ghost.speed;
            ghost.y += (dy / dist) * ghost.speed;
        }

        drawCharacter(ghost.x, ghost.y, 0, ghost.frame, '#000', '#000', true);

        // Check catch
        if (dist < 30) {
            caught = true;
            gameState = 'cutscene';
            cutscenePhase = 0;
            cutsceneTextFull = 'KAMU TERTANGKAP...';
            cutsceneTextTimer = 180;
            cutsceneData.length = 0;
            cutsceneData.push(
                { text: 'KAMU TERTANGKAP...', duration: 120 },
                { text: 'Kegelapan menelan segalanya...', duration: 100 },
                { text: '...', duration: 80 },
                { text: 'Keesokan harinya, berita muncul di televisi...', duration: 120 }
            );
            cutscenePhase = 0;
            cutsceneTextTimer = 120;
            cutsceneTextFull = cutsceneData[0].text;
            gameState = 'cutscene';
            return;
        }

        // Ghost flicker
        ghost.frameTimer++;
        if (ghost.frameTimer > 10) {
            ghost.frame++;
            ghost.frameTimer = 0;
        }
    }

    // Chase text
    chaseTimer++;
    const textIdx = Math.min(Math.floor(chaseTimer / 180), chaseTexts.length - 1);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0000';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(chaseTexts[textIdx], 400, 100);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';

    // Distance indicator
    const dx = player.x - ghost.x;
    const dy = player.y - ghost.y;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    ctx.fillStyle = dist < 100 ? '#ff0000' : '#ff6600';
    ctx.font = '14px monospace';
    ctx.fillText(`Jarak: ${Math.floor(dist)}px`, 10, 590);

    // Whispers
    if (Math.random() < 0.01) {
        const whispers = ['LARI...', 'KAMU TIDAK BISA LARI...', 'AKU DI BELAKANGMU...', 'MENYERAH SAJA...', 'KAMU MILIKKU...'];
        whisperText = whispers[Math.floor(Math.random() * whispers.length)];
        whisperTimer = 60;
    }

    if (whisperTimer > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,0,0,${whisperTimer / 60})`;
        ctx.font = '14px monospace';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(whisperText, 400, 300);
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        whisperTimer--;
    }

    // Screen shake
    if (dist < 150) {
        screenShake = (150 - dist) / 10;
    } else {
        screenShake = 0;
    }
}

// Draw game over
function drawGameOver() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

    // Blood drips
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8a0000';
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const dx = i * 80 + Math.sin(Date.now() / 1000 + i) * 10;
        const dh = 100 + Math.sin(Date.now() / 500 + i) * 30;
        ctx.fillRect(dx, 0, 6, dh);
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0000';
    ctx.font = 'bold 36px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', 400, 200);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
    ctx.font = '18px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Dimas telah menghilang...', 400, 260);

    const alpha = 0.5 + Math.sin(Date.now() / 300) * 0.5;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
    ctx.font = '16px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('[ TEKAN R UNTUK ULANGI ]', 400, 380);

    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

// Draw news screen
function drawNews() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2a';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

    // News ticker
    ctx.fillStyle = '#cc0000';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 50);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';

    const tickerOffset = (Date.now() / 50) % 800;
    ctx.fillText('📺 BERITA TERKINI: TOKO BARBERSHOP DI BANDUNG KOSONG - PEMILIK HILANG TANPA JEJAK 📺', 400, 32);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';

    // News content
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2a3a';
    ctx.fillRect(50, 70, 700, 400);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#cc0000';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.strokeRect(50, 70, 700, 400);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('KRONOLOGI KEHILANGAN DIMAS', 400, 120);

    ctx.font = '14px monospace';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ccc';
    const newsLines = [
        '',
        'BANDUNG - Dimas (25), pemilik sebuah barbershop di kawasan Citamiang,',
        'dikenah hilang sejak malam hari Sabtu lalu.',
        '',
        'Tetangga melaporkan telah mendengar suara teriakan dari dalam toko',
        'sekitar pukul 23.00 WIB. Namun saat polisi datang, tidak ada siapa-siapa.',
        '',
        'Di dalam barbershop, ditemukan peralatan pangkas rambut masih dalam',
        'keadaan siap pakai. Sebuah surat misterius juga ditemukan di lantai.',
        '',
        'Polisi masih menyelidiki kasus ini. Warga sekitar mulai merasa tidak',
        'nyaman dengan kejadian aneh yang sering terdengar di malam hari.',
        '',
        '"Ruko sebelah juga terlihat kosong sejak kejadian itu. Orang-orang',
        'berkata ada suara langkah kaki di malam hari," kata seorang saksi.',
        '',
        'Kasus masih dalam penyelidikan.'
    ];

    newsLines.forEach((line, i) => {
        ctx.fillText(line, 400, 160 + i * 22);
    });

    ctx.textAlign = 'left';

    // End prompt
    const alpha = 0.5 + Math.sin(Date.now() / 300) * 0.5;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
    ctx.font = '14px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('[ TEKAN R UNTUK MAIN LAGI ]', 400, 520);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';

    // Static noise effect
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${Math.random() * 0.1})`;
        ctx.fillRect(Math.random() * 800, Math.random() * 600, Math.random() * 50, 2);
    }
}

// Update
function update() {
    if (gameState === 'title') return;
    if (gameState === 'gameover') return;
    if (gameState === 'news') return;

    if (gameState === 'cutscene') {
        // Cutscene handled in draw
        return;
    }

    if (gameState === 'chase') {
        // Chase handled in draw
        return;
    }

    // Playing state
    if (gameState !== 'playing') return;

    // Check if should trigger horror
    if (letterFound && !horrorTriggered && !horrorActive) {
        // Trigger after letter is found and player explores
        if (itemsCollected.includes('letter') && storyboardPhase === 0) {
            storyboardPhase = 1;
            triggerHorror();
            return;
        }
    }

    // Player movement
    let mx = 0, my = 0;
    player.walking = false;

    if (keys['w'] || keys['arrowup']) { my = -player.speed; player.dir = 3; player.walking = true; }
    if (keys['s'] || keys['arrowdown']) { my = player.speed; player.dir = 0; player.walking = true; }
    if (keys['a'] || keys['arrowleft']) { mx = -player.speed; player.dir = 1; player.walking = true; }
    if (keys['d'] || keys['arrowright']) { mx = player.speed; player.dir = 2; player.walking = true; }

    if (mx !== 0 && my !== 0) {
        mx *= 0.707;
        my *= 0.707;
    }

    const room = rooms[currentRoom];
    const newX = player.x + mx;
    const newY = player.y + my;

    if (canMove(newX, player.y, currentRoom)) player.x = newX;
    if (canMove(player.x, newY, currentRoom)) player.y = newY;

    // Keep in room bounds
    player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(player.x, room.width * TILE - player.w));
    player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(player.y, room.height * TILE - player.h));

    // Animation
    if (player.walking) {
        player.frameTimer++;
        if (player.frameTimer > 8) {
            player.frame++;
            player.frameTimer = 0;
        }
    }

    // Flashlight
    if ((keys['f'] || keys['KeyF']) && itemsCollected.includes('flashlight')) {
        flashlightOn = !flashlightOn;
        keys['f'] = false;
        keys['KeyF'] = false;
    }

    // Check doors
    checkDoors();

    // Check items
    checkItems();

    // Check customers
    checkCustomers();

    // Dialogue timer
    if (dialogueTimer > 0) {
        dialogueTimer--;
        if (dialogueTimer <= 0) {
            dialogueBox = '';
        }
    }

    // Check if all customers served - trigger horror
    if (customersServed >= totalCustomersNeeded && !horrorTriggered) {
        if (letterFound) {
            triggerHorror();
        }
    }

    // Horror whispers
    if (horrorActive && Math.random() < 0.003) {
        const whispers = [
            '...kamu tidak seharusnya di sini...',
            '...pergi...',
            '...dia datang...',
            '...jangan berputar...',
            '...terlambat...',
            '...kamu terlihat enak...',
            '...ruko sebelah... masuk...'
        ];
        whisperText = whispers[Math.floor(Math.random() * whispers.length)];
        whisperTimer = 120;
    }

    // Ghost visibility in horror
    if (horrorActive) {
        ghostTimer++;
        if (ghostTimer > 300) {
            ghostVisible = !ghostVisible;
            ghostTimer = 0;
        }
        if (ghostVisible) {
            ghost.frameTimer++;
            if (ghost.frameTimer > 10) {
                ghost.frame++;
                ghost.frameTimer = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    // Particles
    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        particles[i].x += particles[i].vx;
        particles[i].y += particles[i].vy;
        particles[i].life--;
        if (particles[i].life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // Screen shake decay
    if (screenShake > 0 && !horrorActive) {
        screenShake *= 0.9;
        if (screenShake < 0.5) screenShake = 0;
    }
}

// Draw
function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

    if (gameState === 'title') {
        drawTitle();
        return;
    }

    if (gameState === 'cutscene') {
        drawCutscene();
        return;
    }

    if (gameState === 'chase') {
        drawChase();
        return;
    }

    if (gameState === 'gameover') {
        drawGameOver();
        return;
    }

    if (gameState === 'news') {
        drawNews();
        return;
    }

    // Playing state
    drawRoom(currentRoom);

    // Particles
    for (let p of particles) {
        ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.life / 60;
        ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.size, p.size);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // Dialogue box
    if (dialogueBox && dialogueTimer > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.85)';
        ctx.fillRect(50, 500, 700, 80);
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#8a0000';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(50, 500, 700, 80);

        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.font = '14px monospace';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(dialogueBox, 400, 545);
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    }

    // Controls hint
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 575, 800, 25);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#666';
    ctx.font = '10px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('WASD: Gerak | E: Pindah | F: Senter | G: Ambil | H: Pangkas | R: Storyboard', 10, 592);

    // Horror mode indicator
    if (horrorActive) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,0,0,0.7)';
        ctx.fillRect(300, 575, 200, 25);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0000';
        ctx.font = '12px monospace';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText('⚠ MISTERI BERLANGSUNG ⚠', 400, 592);
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    }
}

// Game loop
function gameLoop() {
    update();
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// Start
gameLoop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
