<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>Flappy Bird</title>
<style>
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    -webkit-touch-callout: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    user-select: none;
}
html, body {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #000;
    touch-action: none;
}
#gameCanvas {
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto;
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
(function() {
    const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

    // --- Responsive sizing ---
    const BASE_W = 400;
    const BASE_H = 700;
    let scale = 1;

    function resize() {
        const ww = window.innerWidth;
        const wh = window.innerHeight;
        const ratio = BASE_W / BASE_H;
        let w, h;
        if (ww / wh < ratio) {
            w = ww;
            h = ww / ratio;
        } else {
            h = wh;
            w = wh * ratio;
        }
        canvas.style.width = w + 'px';
        canvas.style.height = h + 'px';
        canvas.width = BASE_W;
        canvas.height = BASE_H;
        scale = w / BASE_W;
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    resize();

    // --- Audio System ---
    const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    let audioCtx = null;
    function ensureAudio() {
        if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new AudioCtx();
        if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
    }

    function playSound(type) {
        ensureAudio();
        const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
        const g = audioCtx.createGain();
        g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
        const o = audioCtx.createOscillator();
        o.connect(g);

        switch(type) {
            case 'jump':
                o.type = 'sine';
                o.frequency.setValueAtTime(400, now);
                o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(600, now + 0.1);
                g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, now);
                g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + 0.15);
                o.start(now);
                o.stop(now + 0.15);
                break;
            case 'score':
                o.type = 'sine';
                o.frequency.setValueAtTime(523, now);
                o.frequency.setValueAtTime(659, now + 0.08);
                o.frequency.setValueAtTime(784, now + 0.16);
                g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.25, now);
                g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + 0.3);
                o.start(now);
                o.stop(now + 0.3);
                break;
            case 'hit':
                o.type = 'sawtooth';
                o.frequency.setValueAtTime(200, now);
                o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(50, now + 0.3);
                g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, now);
                g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + 0.3);
                o.start(now);
                o.stop(now + 0.3);
                break;
            case 'gameover':
                o.type = 'square';
                o.frequency.setValueAtTime(400, now);
                o.frequency.setValueAtTime(350, now + 0.15);
                o.frequency.setValueAtTime(300, now + 0.3);
                o.frequency.setValueAtTime(200, now + 0.45);
                g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, now);
                g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + 0.6);
                o.start(now);
                o.stop(now + 0.6);
                break;
            case 'coin':
                o.type = 'sine';
                o.frequency.setValueAtTime(880, now);
                o.frequency.setValueAtTime(1100, now + 0.05);
                g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, now);
                g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + 0.15);
                o.start(now);
                o.stop(now + 0.15);
                break;
            case 'click':
                o.type = 'sine';
                o.frequency.setValueAtTime(600, now);
                g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, now);
                g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + 0.08);
                o.start(now);
                o.stop(now + 0.08);
                break;
        }
    }

    // --- Background Music ---
    let bgMusicPlaying = false;
    let bgMusicInterval = null;
    function startBgMusic() {
        if (bgMusicPlaying) return;
        bgMusicPlaying = true;
        const notes = [262, 294, 330, 349, 392, 349, 330, 294];
        let idx = 0;
        bgMusicInterval = setInterval(() => {
            if (!bgMusicPlaying) return;
            ensureAudio();
            const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
            const g = audioCtx.createGain();
            g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
            const o = audioCtx.createOscillator();
            o.type = 'sine';
            o.frequency.value = notes[idx % notes.length];
            g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.06, now);
            g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.3);
            o.connect(g);
            o.start(now);
            o.stop(now + 0.3);
            idx++;
        }, 400);
    }
    function stopBgMusic() {
        bgMusicPlaying = false;
        if (bgMusicInterval) { clearInterval(bgMusicInterval); bgMusicInterval = null; }
    }

    // --- Game State ---
    const STATE = { START: 0, PLAYING: 1, GAME_OVER: 2 };
    let gameState = STATE.START;

    // --- Persistent Data ---
    let highScore = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('flappyHighScore')) || 0;
    let totalCoins = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('flappyCoins')) || 0;
    let unlockedSkins = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('flappySkins')) || ['default'];
    let currentSkin = localStorage.getItem('flappyCurrentSkin') || 'default';
    let firstHighScoreAchieved = localStorage.getItem('flappyFirstHS') === 'true';

    function saveData() {
        localStorage.setItem('flappyHighScore', highScore);
        localStorage.setItem('flappyCoins', totalCoins);
        localStorage.setItem('flappySkins', JSON.stringify(unlockedSkins));
        localStorage.setItem('flappyCurrentSkin', currentSkin);
        localStorage.setItem('flappyFirstHS', firstHighScoreAchieved);
    }

    // --- YouTube Link ---
    const YOUTUBE_URL = 'https://www.youtube.com/@YourChannel';

    // --- Bird ---
    const bird = {
        x: 80,
        y: BASE_H / 2,
        w: 34,
        h: 26,
        vy: 0,
        gravity: 0.45,
        jumpForce: -7.5,
        rotation: 0,
        frame: 0,
        frameTimer: 0,
        skin: currentSkin
    };

    // --- Pipes ---
    let pipes = [];
    const PIPE_WIDTH = 52;
    const BASE_GAP = 145;
    let currentGap = BASE_GAP;
    const BASE_PIPE_SPEED = 2.5;
    let pipeSpeed = BASE_PIPE_SPEED;
    const BASE_SPAWN_RATE = 100;
    let spawnRate = BASE_SPAWN_RATE;
    let pipeTimer = 0;
    let difficultyLevel = 0;
    let score = 0;

    // --- Coins ---
    let coins = [];
    const COIN_RADIUS = 10;

    // --- Ground ---
    const GROUND_H = 80;
    let groundX = 0;

    // --- Clouds ---
    let clouds = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        clouds.push({
            x: Math.random() * BASE_W,
            y: 30 + Math.random() * 150,
            w: 40 + Math.random() * 60,
            speed: 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3
        });
    }

    // --- Stars (background) ---
    let stars = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        stars.push({
            x: Math.random() * BASE_W,
            y: Math.random() * (BASE_H - GROUND_H - 100),
            size: 1 + Math.random() * 2,
            twinkle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
        });
    }

    // --- Particles ---
    let particles = [];

    // --- Buttons ---
    let buttons = [];

    // --- Flash effect ---
    let flashAlpha = 0;

    // --- Coin flash ---
    let coinFlash = 0;

    // --- Draw Functions ---

    function drawBackground() {
        // Sky gradient
        const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, BASE_H - GROUND_H);
        skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1a1a2e');
        skyGrad.addColorStop(0.3, '#16213e');
        skyGrad.addColorStop(0.6, '#0f3460');
        skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#533483');
        ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, BASE_W, BASE_H - GROUND_H);

        // Stars
        const time = Date.now() / 1000;
        stars.forEach(s => {
            const alpha = 0.3 + 0.7 * Math.abs(Math.sin(time * 2 + s.twinkle));
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        });

        // Moon
        ctx.fillStyle = '#f5f5dc';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(320, 80, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(310, 75, 28, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Clouds
        clouds.forEach(c => {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y, c.w / 2, 15, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.ellipse(c.x - c.w * 0.25, c.y + 5, c.w * 0.3, 12, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.ellipse(c.x + c.w * 0.25, c.y + 3, c.w * 0.25, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        });
    }

    function drawGround() {
        // Ground body
        const gGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, BASE_H - GROUND_H, 0, BASE_H);
        gGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4a7c3f');
        gGrad.addColorStop(0.15, '#3d6b34');
        gGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2d4f26');
        ctx.fillStyle = gGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(0, BASE_H - GROUND_H, BASE_W, GROUND_H);

        // Ground top stripe
        ctx.fillStyle = '#5cb85c';
        ctx.fillRect(0, BASE_H - GROUND_H, BASE_W, 4);

        // Ground pattern
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.15)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        for (let i = -1; i < BASE_W / 20 + 2; i++) {
            const gx = (i * 20 + groundX % 20);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(gx, BASE_H - GROUND_H + 10);
            ctx.lineTo(gx + 10, BASE_H - GROUND_H + 25);
            ctx.stroke();
        }
    }

    function drawPipe(pipe) {
        const gapTop = pipe.y;
        const gapBottom = pipe.y + pipe.gap;

        // Top pipe
        drawSinglePipe(pipe.x, 0, PIPE_WIDTH, gapTop, true);
        // Bottom pipe
        drawSinglePipe(pipe.x, gapBottom, PIPE_WIDTH, BASE_H - GROUND_H - gapBottom, false);
    }

    function drawSinglePipe(x, y, w, h, isTop) {
        if (h <= 0) return;

        // Pipe body
        const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, 0, x + w, 0);
        grad.addColorStop(0, '#2d8a4e');
        grad.addColorStop(0.2, '#4ec972');
        grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#3db860');
        grad.addColorStop(0.8, '#2d8a4e');
        grad.addColorStop(1, '#1d6b3a');
        ctx.fillStyle = grad;
        ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);

        // Pipe border
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#1a5c30';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeRect(x, y, w, h);

        // Pipe cap
        const capH = 24;
        const capW = w + 10;
        const capX = x - 5;
        const capY = isTop ? y + h - capH : y;

        const capGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(capX, 0, capX + capW, 0);
        capGrad.addColorStop(0, '#2d8a4e');
        capGrad.addColorStop(0.15, '#5cd980');
        capGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#4ec972');
        capGrad.addColorStop(0.85, '#2d8a4e');
        capGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1d6b3a');
        ctx.fillStyle = capGrad;

        // Rounded cap
        const r = 4;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(capX + r, capY);
        ctx.lineTo(capX + capW - r, capY);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(capX + capW, capY, capX + capW, capY + r);
        ctx.lineTo(capX + capW, capY + capH - r);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(capX + capW, capY + capH, capX + capW - r, capY + capH);
        ctx.lineTo(capX + r, capY + capH);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(capX, capY + capH, capX, capY + capH - r);
        ctx.lineTo(capX, capY + r);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(capX, capY, capX + r, capY);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#1a5c30';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();

        // Highlight on pipe body
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
        ctx.fillRect(x + 6, y, 6, h);
    }

    function drawBird() {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(bird.x + bird.w / 2, bird.y + bird.h / 2);
        ctx.rotate(bird.rotation);

        const skin = bird.skin;
        let bodyColor, wingColor, eyeColor, beakColor, bellyColor;

        switch(skin) {
            case 'default':
                bodyColor = '#f5c842'; wingColor = '#e6a817'; eyeColor = '#fff'; beakColor = '#e8572a'; bellyColor = '#f7dc6f';
                break;
            case 'red':
                bodyColor = '#e74c3c'; wingColor = '#c0392b'; eyeColor = '#fff'; beakColor = '#f39c12'; bellyColor = '#f1948a';
                break;
            case 'blue':
                bodyColor = '#3498db'; wingColor = '#2980b9'; eyeColor = '#fff'; beakColor = '#f1c40f'; bellyColor = '#85c1e9';
                break;
            case 'green':
                bodyColor = '#2ecc71'; wingColor = '#27ae60'; eyeColor = '#fff'; beakColor = '#e67e22'; bellyColor = '#82e0aa';
                break;
            case 'purple':
                bodyColor = '#9b59b6'; wingColor = '#8e44ad'; eyeColor = '#fff'; beakColor = '#f39c12'; bellyColor = '#c39bd3';
                break;
            case 'gold':
                bodyColor = '#f1c40f'; wingColor = '#d4ac0d'; eyeColor = '#fff'; beakColor = '#e74c3c'; bellyColor = '#f9e79f';
                break;
            default:
                bodyColor = '#f5c842'; wingColor = '#e6a817'; eyeColor = '#fff'; beakColor = '#e8572a'; bellyColor = '#f7dc6f';
        }

        // Body
        ctx.fillStyle = bodyColor;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, bird.w / 2, bird.h / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();

        // Belly
        ctx.fillStyle = bellyColor;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(2, 4, bird.w / 3, bird.h / 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Wing
        const wingFlap = Math.sin(bird.frame * 0.5) * 6;
        ctx.fillStyle = wingColor;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(-4, -2 + wingFlap, 10, 6, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.stroke();

        // Eye white
        ctx.fillStyle = eyeColor;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(8, -5, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.stroke();

        // Pupil
        ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(10, -5, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Eye shine
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(11, -6.5, 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Beak
        ctx.fillStyle = beakColor;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(12, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(22, 2);
        ctx.lineTo(12, 5);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.stroke();

        // Tail feathers
        ctx.fillStyle = wingColor;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-bird.w / 2, -3);
        ctx.lineTo(-bird.w / 2 - 8, -7);
        ctx.lineTo(-bird.w / 2 - 6, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(-bird.w / 2 - 8, 7);
        ctx.lineTo(-bird.w / 2, 3);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.restore();
    }

    function drawCoin(coin) {
        const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(Date.now() / 200 + coin.x) * 0.1;
        const r = COIN_RADIUS * pulse;

        // Glow
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,215,0,0.2)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(coin.x, coin.y, r + 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Coin body
        const cGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(coin.x - 2, coin.y - 2, 1, coin.x, coin.y, r);
        cGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ffe066');
        cGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#f5c842');
        cGrad.addColorStop(1, '#d4a017');
        ctx.fillStyle = cGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(coin.x, coin.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#b8860b';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();

        // $ symbol
        ctx.fillStyle = '#b8860b';
        ctx.font = 'bold 11px Arial';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.fillText('$', coin.x, coin.y + 1);
    }

    function drawParticles() {
        particles.forEach(p => {
            ctx.globalAlpha = p.alpha;
            ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        });
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    function spawnParticles(x, y, count, color) {
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            particles.push({
                x: x,
                y: y,
                vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
                vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
                size: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
                color: color,
                alpha: 1,
                decay: 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.03
            });
        }
    }

    function updateParticles() {
        for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            const p = particles[i];
            p.x += p.vx;
            p.y += p.vy;
            p.vy += 0.1;
            p.alpha -= p.decay;
            if (p.alpha <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
        }
    }

    // --- Button System ---
    function createButton(x, y, w, h, text, color, hoverColor) {
        return { x, y, w, h, text, color, hoverColor, hovered: false };
    }

    function isInsideButton(btn, px, py) {
        return px >= btn.x && px <= btn.x + btn.w && py >= btn.y && py <= btn.y + btn.h;
    }

    function drawButton(btn) {
        // Shadow
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
        roundRect(btn.x + 2, btn.y + 3, btn.w, btn.h, 12, true, false);

        // Button body
        ctx.fillStyle = btn.hovered ? btn.hoverColor : btn.color;
        roundRect(btn.x, btn.y, btn.w, btn.h, 12, true, false);

        // Border
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        roundRect(btn.x, btn.y, btn.w, btn.h, 12, false, true);

        // Text
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.font = 'bold 18px Arial';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.fillText(btn.text, btn.x + btn.w / 2, btn.y + btn.h / 2);
    }

    function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r, fill, stroke) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
        ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
        ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
        ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
        ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
        ctx.closePath();
        if (fill) ctx.fill();
        if (stroke) ctx.stroke();
    }

    // --- YouTube Button ---
    function drawYouTubeButton(x, y) {
        const w = 36, h = 26;
        // Red background
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FF0000';
        roundRect(x, y, w, h, 6, true, false);
        // Play triangle
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x + 13, y + 6);
        ctx.lineTo(x + 13, y + h - 6);
        ctx.lineTo(x + w - 6, y + h / 2);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
    }

    // --- UI Drawing ---

    function drawScore() {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 4;
        ctx.font = 'bold 48px Arial';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
        ctx.strokeText(score, BASE_W / 2, 40);
        ctx.fillText(score, BASE_W / 2, 40);
    }

    function drawStartScreen() {
        drawBackground();
        drawGround();

        // Title
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 5;
        ctx.font = 'bold 52px Arial';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.strokeText('Flappy Bird', BASE_W / 2, 140);
        ctx.fillText('Flappy Bird', BASE_W / 2, 140);

        // Subtitle
        ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.strokeText('Tap to Start', BASE_W / 2, 220);
        ctx.fillText('Tap to Start', BASE_W / 2, 220);

        // Animated bird
        bird.y = BASE_H / 2 - 40 + Math.sin(Date.now() / 400) * 15;
        bird.rotation = 0;
        bird.frame += 0.1;
        drawBird();

        // YouTube button
        drawYouTubeButton(BASE_W / 2 - 18, BASE_H - GROUND_H - 60);

        // Coins display
        if (totalCoins > 0) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#f5c842';
            ctx.font = 'bold 16px Arial';
            ctx.fillText(`Coins: ${totalCoins}`, BASE_W / 2, BASE_H - GROUND_H - 25);
        }

        // Skin selector hint
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
        ctx.font = '14px Arial';
        ctx.fillText('🎨 Tap bird to change skin', BASE_W / 2, 260);
    }

    function drawGameOverScreen() {
        drawBackground();
        pipes.forEach(drawPipe);
        drawGround();
        drawBird();

        // Overlay
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, BASE_W, BASE_H);

        // Panel
        const panelX = BASE_W / 2 - 130;
        const panelY = 120;
        const panelW = 260;
        const panelH = 300;

        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(30,30,60,0.95)';
        roundRect(panelX, panelY, panelW, panelH, 16, true, false);
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#f5c842';
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        roundRect(panelX, panelY, panelW, panelH, 16, false, true);

        // Game Over text
        ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
        ctx.lineWidth = 4;
        ctx.font = 'bold 40px Arial';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.strokeText('Game Over', BASE_W / 2, panelY + 45);
        ctx.fillText('Game Over', BASE_W / 2, panelY + 45);

        // Score
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.font = 'bold 20px Arial';
        ctx.fillText('Score', BASE_W / 2, panelY + 90);
        ctx.font = 'bold 44px Arial';
        ctx.fillStyle = '#f5c842';
        ctx.fillText(score, BASE_W / 2, panelY + 130);

        // High Score
        ctx.font = 'bold 18px Arial';
        ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
        ctx.fillText('Best', BASE_W / 2, panelY + 170);
        ctx.font = 'bold 32px Arial';
        ctx.fillStyle = '#f5c842';
        ctx.fillText(highScore, BASE_W / 2, panelY + 205);

        // New high score indicator
        if (score >= highScore && score > 0) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
            ctx.font = 'bold 16px Arial';
            ctx.fillText('🎉 NEW BEST! 🎉', BASE_W / 2, panelY + 235);
        }

        // Coins
        if (coinsCollected > 0) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#f5c842';
            ctx.font = 'bold 16px Arial';
            ctx.fillText(`+${coinsCollected} Coin${coinsCollected > 1 ? 's' : ''} this run`, BASE_W / 2, panelY + 260);
        }

        // Buttons
        buttons = [];

        // Restart button
        const restartBtn = createButton(BASE_W / 2 - 70, panelY + panelH + 15, 140, 50, '🔄 Restart', '#2ecc71', '#27ae60');
        buttons.push(restartBtn);
        drawButton(restartBtn);

        // Home button
        const homeBtn = createButton(BASE_W / 2 - 70, panelY + panelH + 75, 140, 50, '🏠 Home', '#3498db', '#2980b9');
        buttons.push(homeBtn);
        drawButton(homeBtn);

        // YouTube button
        drawYouTubeButton(BASE_W / 2 - 18, panelY + panelH + 140);

        // Skin selector
        const skinBtn = createButton(BASE_W / 2 - 60, panelY + panelH + 175, 120, 40, '🎨 Skins', '#9b59b6', '#8e44ad');
        buttons.push(skinBtn);
        drawButton(skinBtn);
    }

    // --- Game Logic ---
    let coinsCollected = 0;

    function resetGame() {
        bird.y = BASE_H / 2;
        bird.vy = 0;
        bird.rotation = 0;
        bird.frame = 0;
        bird.skin = currentSkin;
        pipes = [];
        coins = [];
        particles = [];
        score = 0;
        coinsCollected = 0;
        pipeTimer = 0;
        difficultyLevel = 0;
        currentGap = BASE_GAP;
        pipeSpeed = BASE_PIPE_SPEED;
        spawnRate = BASE_SPAWN_RATE;
        flashAlpha = 0;
        coinFlash = 0;
    }

    function jump() {
        ensureAudio();
        bird.vy = bird.jumpForce;
        bird.rotation = -0.4;
        playSound('jump');
        spawnParticles(bird.x, bird.y + bird.h, 3, '#fff');
    }

    function checkCollision() {
        const bx = bird.x + 4;
        const by = bird.y + 4;
        const bw = bird.w - 8;
        const bh = bird.h - 8;

        // Ground collision
        if (by + bh >= BASE_H - GROUND_H) return true;

        // Ceiling collision
        if (by <= 0) return true;

        // Pipe collision
        for (let p of pipes) {
            // Check if bird is in pipe x range
            if (bx + bw > p.x && bx < p.x + PIPE_WIDTH) {
                // Check top pipe
                if (by < p.y) return true;
                // Check bottom pipe
                if (by + bh > p.y + p.gap) return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    function checkCoinCollision() {
        for (let i = coins.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            const c = coins[i];
            const dx = (bird.x + bird.w / 2) - c.x;
            const dy = (bird.y + bird.h / 2) - c.y;
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
            if (dist < COIN_RADIUS + bird.w / 2) {
                coins.splice(i, 1);
                totalCoins++;
                score += 0.5; // bonus
                playSound('coin');
                spawnParticles(c.x, c.y, 8, '#f5c842');
                coinFlash = 1;
            }
        }
    }

    function increaseDifficulty() {
        difficultyLevel++;
        pipeSpeed = BASE_PIPE_SPEED * Math.pow(1.1, difficultyLevel);
        currentGap = Math.max(95, BASE_GAP - difficultyLevel * 3);
        spawnRate = Math.max(60, BASE_SPAWN_RATE - difficultyLevel * 3);
    }

    function update() {
        if (gameState !== STATE.PLAYING) return;

        // Bird physics
        bird.vy += bird.gravity;
        bird.y += bird.vy;

        // Bird rotation
        if (bird.vy < 0) {
            bird.rotation = Math.max(-0.4, bird.rotation + 0.05);
        } else {
            bird.rotation = Math.min(Math.PI / 2 - 0.2, bird.rotation + 0.03);
        }

        // Bird animation frame
        bird.frame += 0.15;

        // Ground scroll
        groundX -= pipeSpeed;

        // Cloud scroll
        clouds.forEach(c => {
            c.x -= c.speed;
            if (c.x + c.w < 0) {
                c.x = BASE_W + c.w;
                c.y = 30 + Math.random() * 150;
            }
        });

        // Pipe spawning
        pipeTimer++;
        if (pipeTimer >= spawnRate) {
            pipeTimer = 0;
            const minY = 80;
            const maxY = BASE_H - GROUND_H - currentGap - 80;
            const pipeY = minY + Math.random() * (maxY - minY);

            pipes.push({
                x: BASE_W,
                y: pipeY,
                gap: currentGap,
                scored: false
            });

            // Spawn coin in gap
            if (Math.random() < 0.5) {
                coins.push({
                    x: BASE_W + PIPE_WIDTH / 2,
                    y: pipeY + currentGap / 2
                });
            }
        }

        // Pipe movement
        for (let i = pipes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            pipes[i].x -= pipeSpeed;

            // Score
            if (!pipes[i].scored && pipes[i].x + PIPE_WIDTH < bird.x) {
                pipes[i].scored = true;
                score++;
                playSound('score');
                spawnParticles(bird.x + bird.w, bird.y, 5, '#f5c842');

                // Difficulty scaling after score 3
                if (score > 3) {
                    increaseDifficulty();
                }
            }

            // Remove off-screen pipes
            if (pipes[i].x + PIPE_WIDTH < -10) {
                pipes.splice(i, 1);
            }
        }

        // Coin movement
        for (let i = coins.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            coins[i].x -= pipeSpeed;
            if (coins[i].x + COIN_RADIUS < -10) {
                coins.splice(i, 1);
            }
        }

        // Coin collision
        checkCoinCollision();

        // Coin flash decay
        if (coinFlash > 0) coinFlash -= 0.05;

        // Flash decay
        if (flashAlpha > 0) flashAlpha -= 0.05;

        // Update particles
        updateParticles();

        // Collision check
        if (checkCollision()) {
            gameOver();
        }
    }

    function gameOver() {
        gameState = STATE.GAME_OVER;
        playSound('hit');
        setTimeout(() => playSound('gameover'), 200);
        stopBgMusic();
        flashAlpha = 1;
        spawnParticles(bird.x + bird.w / 2, bird.y + bird.h / 2, 20, '#e74c3c');
        spawnParticles(bird.x + bird.w / 2, bird.y + bird.h / 2, 15, '#f5c842');

        // Update high score
        const finalScore = Math.floor(score);
        if (finalScore > highScore) {
            highScore = finalScore;
            firstHighScoreAchieved = true;
        }

        // Unlock skins based on coins
        if (totalCoins >= 10 && !unlockedSkins.includes('red')) {
            unlockedSkins.push('red');
        }
        if (totalCoins >= 25 && !unlockedSkins.includes('blue')) {
            unlockedSkins.push('blue');
        }
        if (totalCoins >= 50 && !unlockedSkins.includes('green')) {
            unlockedSkins.push('green');
        }
        if (totalCoins >= 75 && !unlockedSkins.includes('purple')) {
            unlockedSkins.push('purple');
        }
        if (totalCoins >= 100 && !unlockedSkins.includes('gold')) {
            unlockedSkins.push('gold');
        }

        saveData();
    }

    function draw() {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, BASE_W, BASE_H);

        if (gameState === STATE.START) {
            drawStartScreen();
        } else if (gameState === STATE.PLAYING) {
            drawBackground();
            pipes.forEach(drawPipe);
            coins.forEach(drawCoin);
            drawGround();
            drawBird();
            drawParticles();
            drawScore();

            // Coin flash effect
            if (coinFlash > 0) {
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,215,0,${coinFlash * 0.3})`;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, BASE_W, BASE_H);
            }
        } else if (gameState === STATE.GAME_OVER) {
            drawGameOverScreen();
        }

        // Flash overlay
        if (flashAlpha > 0) {
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${flashAlpha})`;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, BASE_W, BASE_H);
        }
    }

    // --- Input Handling ---
    let mouseX = 0, mouseY = 0;

    function getPos(e) {
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const clientX = e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX;
        const clientY = e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY;
        return {
            x: (clientX - rect.left) / scale,
            y: (clientY - rect.top) / scale
        };
    }

    function handleTap(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const pos = getPos(e);
        mouseX = pos.x;
        mouseY = pos.y;

        ensureAudio();

        if (gameState === STATE.START) {
            // Check YouTube button
            if (isInsideButton({x: BASE_W/2 - 18, y: BASE_H - GROUND_H - 60, w: 36, h: 26}, pos.x, pos.y)) {
                window.open(YOUTUBE_URL, '_blank');
                playSound('click');
                return;
            }

            // Check skin selector on start screen
            if (pos.y > 240 && pos.y < 280) {
                cycleSkin();
                playSound('click');
                return;
            }

            gameState = STATE.PLAYING;
            resetGame();
            jump();
            startBgMusic();
        } else if (gameState === STATE.PLAYING) {
            jump();
        } else if (gameState === STATE.GAME_OVER) {
            // Check buttons
            for (let btn of buttons) {
                if (isInsideButton(btn, pos.x, pos.y)) {
                    playSound('click');
                    if (btn.text.includes('Restart')) {
                        gameState = STATE.PLAYING;
                        resetGame();
                        jump();
                        startBgMusic();
                    } else if (btn.text.includes('Home')) {
                        gameState = STATE.START;
                        resetGame();
                        stopBgMusic();
                    } else if (btn.text.includes('Skins')) {
                        cycleSkin();
                    }
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    function cycleSkin() {
        const idx = unlockedSkins.indexOf(currentSkin);
        const next = (idx + 1) % unlockedSkins.length;
        currentSkin = unlockedSkins[next];
        bird.skin = currentSkin;
        saveData();
        playSound('click');
    }

    canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        const pos = getPos(e);
        mouseX = pos.x;
        mouseY = pos.y;
        // Check hover for buttons
        if (gameState === STATE.GAME_OVER) {
            for (let btn of buttons) {
                btn.hovered = isInsideButton(btn, pos.x, pos.y);
            }
        }
        handleTap(e);
    });

    canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        const pos = getPos(e);
        if (gameState === STATE.GAME_OVER) {
            for (let btn of buttons) {
                btn.hovered = isInsideButton(btn, pos.x, pos.y);
            }
        }
    });

    canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', handleTap, { passive: false });
    canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => e.preventDefault(), { passive: false });

    // Keyboard support
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleTap({ preventDefault: () => {}, touches: null, clientX: BASE_W/2, clientY: BASE_H/2 });
        }
    });

    // --- Game Loop ---
    function gameLoop() {
        update();
        draw();
        requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
    }

    // --- Initialize ---
    resetGame();
    gameLoop();

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

Текстуры 1024×1024, динамическое освещение, погода, следы, разрушаемые объекты.Здания: 5-10 шаблонов, двери, окна, лестницы, мебель, коллизии. Предметы спавнятся в зданиях (3-7 шт), редкость (Common-Legendary), анимация подбора.Миникарта 200×200пкс: позиция игрока, здания, метки (союзники, враги, маркеры), безопасная зона. Интерфейс: здоровье, броня, оружие, патроны, слоты 1-5, чат, таймер зоны, счетчик игроков.Управление: WASD-движение, Пробел-прыжок, Shift-бег, Ctrl-присесть, Z-лечь, ЛКМ-стрельба, ПКМ-прицел, R-перезарядка, 1-5-оружие, F-взаимодействие, G-граната, C-поза, M-карта. Боевая система: баллистика, урон (голова×2, тело×1, конечности×0.5), пробитие брони, отдача, разброс. Здоровье 100HP, восстановление аптечками.Зона безопасности: начинается со всей карты, сжимается каждые 5 мин на 20%, 7 этапов, финал 100×100м. Опасная зона: 5HP/сек урона, красный экран, предупреждения. Визуализация: синий/красный круги, анимация сжатия.99 ИИ-противников: патрулирование, поиск лута, реакция на звуки, укрытия, стрельба, гранаты, лечение, тактика. Сложность: Easy (30%), Medium (50%), Hard (20%). Командный ИИ: коммуникация, поддержка, спасение.Финальный экран: при победе "ПОБЕДА!" со статистикой (убийства, урон, время, дистанция, предметы), танцующий персонаж; при поражении "ВЫБЫЛ" со статистикой и позицией. Рейтинг: +10 за убийство, +20 за дальнее, +1 за минуту, +500 за победу. Сохранение в localStorage.
